model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [C-FoS + Alexa Fluor (secondary, e.g., Alexa Fluor 647), NeuN + Alexa Fluor (secondary, e.g., Alexa Fluor 546), DAPI]

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is the gold-standard solvent-based clearing method for whole adult mouse brains, offering excellent lipid removal, deep antibody penetration (enabled by the methanol dehydration/rehydration cycle that permeabilizes membranes), and compatibility with immunolabeling of endogenous proteins. For mapping neurons activated by a specific behavioral stimulus, **c-Fos** (an immediate-early gene product, IEG) is the canonical activity marker—its protein expression peaks ~90 min post-stimulus and is detectable by immunostaining. **NeuN** serves as a pan-neuronal counterstain to provide anatomical context and allow normalization of c-Fos+ cells to total neuron number per region. **DAPI** provides nuclear/cytoarchitectural reference for brain atlas registration. iDISCO+ uses DBE (dibenzyl ether) as the final RI-matching medium (RI ≈ 1.56), which is compatible with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) — the optimal modality for single-cell resolution 3D whole-brain imaging. The methanol-based dehydration step in iDISCO+ also quenches autofluorescence, improving signal-to-noise. Alexa Fluor dyes (546 and 647) are highly photostable, bright, and well-separated spectrally, surviving the solvent-based clearing process.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Pre-treatment & Permeabilization (Methanol Dehydration Series)**
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous), second change, with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**2 Bleaching (Autofluorescence Quenching)**
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH) to quench endogenous autofluorescence, protected from light. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)

**3 Rehydration Series**
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Incubation with PBS (1×, pH 7.4) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.6 Incubation with PBS (1×, pH 7.4), second wash, with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**4 Pre-immunolabeling Blocking & Permeabilization**
4.1 Incubation with PTwH buffer (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with PTwH buffer, second wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution (PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 0.3 M glycine) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
4.4 Incubation with Blocking Solution (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin + 6% normal donkey serum + 10% DMSO) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**5 Primary Antibody Immunolabeling**
5.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail in PTwH + 5% DMSO + 3% normal donkey serum: anti-c-Fos rabbit polyclonal antibody (1:1000, e.g., Synaptic Systems #226 003) + anti-NeuN mouse monoclonal antibody (1:500, e.g., Millipore MAB377), with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
5.2 Wash with PTwH buffer, 5 × changes with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash, total 5 hours)
5.3 Wash with PTwH buffer overnight to remove unbound primary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**6 Secondary Antibody Immunolabeling**
6.1 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail in PTwH + 3% normal donkey serum: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) + donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 546 (1:500), protected from light, with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
6.2 Wash with PTwH buffer, 5 × changes with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash, total 5 hours)
6.3 Wash with PTwH buffer overnight to remove unbound secondary antibody, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**7 Nuclear Counterstain (DAPI)**
7.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS) with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
7.2 Wash with PBS (1×), 3 × changes with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes per wash, total 1.5 hours)

**8 Tissue Optical Clearing (Solvent Dehydration)**
8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous) with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.6 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous), second change, with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.7 Incubation with 100% DCM (dichloromethane, Sigma 270997) with gentle shaking to complete delipidation, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
8.8 Incubation with 100% DCM, second change, with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

**9 Refractive Index Matching**
9.1 Transfer brain to glass vial; incubation with 100% DBE (dibenzyl ether, Sigma 108014, RI ≈ 1.56) without shaking, protected from light, until tissue is fully transparent and sinks to the bottom of the vial. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24–48 hours)
9.2 Replace DBE with fresh 100% DBE and continue incubation to ensure complete RI equilibration, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**10 Storage & Pre-imaging Preparation**
10.1 Store cleared brain in 100% DBE in a sealed glass vial, protected from light, until imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 6 months)
10.2 Prior to light-sheet imaging, mount brain in a custom agarose-free holder or FEP (fluorinated ethylene propylene) tube filled with 100% DBE to maintain RI matching during acquisition; ensure objective immersion medium is compatible with DBE (use long-working-distance air or DBE-immersion objectives). (Temperature: RT, Time: as needed for imaging setup)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [NeuN (RBFOX3) + Alexa Fluor (488), MAP2 + Alexa Fluor (546), MBP + Alexa Fluor (647)]

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected as the optimal clearing method for this application because: (1) it achieves excellent clearing of large, intact adult mouse brains (~10×8×6 mm) through organic solvent-based delipidation (dichloromethane/dibenzyl ether), yielding high transparency suitable for light-sheet microscopy; (2) it is highly compatible with immunolabeling of deep tissue via optimized detergent-based permeabilization and extended antibody incubation, enabling whole-brain antibody penetration; (3) it preserves antigenicity sufficiently for robust immunostaining. The labeling strategy combines three complementary markers: **NeuN** (neuronal nuclear marker, labels all mature neuron somata for mapping neuronal distribution), **MAP2** (microtubule-associated protein 2, labels dendrites and soma for dendritic morphology), and **MBP** (myelin basic protein, labels myelinated axonal fiber tracts for major white matter tract visualization). Together these three markers provide a comprehensive 3D atlas of neuronal somata, dendritic arbors, and major axonal fiber pathways across the whole brain. Three spectrally distinct Alexa Fluor secondaries (488/546/647) allow simultaneous three-channel light-sheet imaging with minimal spectral overlap.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Pretreatment & Permeabilization**

1.1 Wash fixed whole brain (post-fixed in 4% PFA, PBS-rinsed) with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

1.2 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PTx0.2) to initiate permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation with permeabilization solution: PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3 M glycine (PTxD). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

1.4 Incubation with blocking solution: PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% normal donkey serum (PBSDT). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

**2 Primary Antibody Labeling**

2.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in PBSDT (PTx0.2 + 5% DMSO + 3% normal donkey serum):
- Anti-NeuN (rabbit, e.g., Abcam ab177487), 1:500
- Anti-MAP2 (chicken, e.g., Abcam ab5392), 1:500
- Anti-MBP (rat, e.g., Abcam ab7349), 1:400

2.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail solution with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

2.3 Wash with PTwH (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin) to remove unbound primary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight)

**3 Secondary Antibody Labeling**

3.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in PTwH + 3% normal donkey serum:
- Donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488, 1:500
- Donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 546, 1:500
- Donkey anti-rat Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500

3.2 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail solution with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

3.3 Wash with PTwH to remove unbound secondary antibodies, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight)

3.4 Post-fixation with 4% PFA in PBS to crosslink antibodies in place. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.5 Wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

**4 Dehydration**

4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% methanol (anhydrous) to ensure complete dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**5 Bleaching (Autofluorescence Quenching)**

5.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes 100% MeOH), sample fully submerged. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

5.2 Wash with 100% methanol to remove residual H₂O₂. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

**6 Delipidation**

6.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

6.2 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) DCM in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

6.3 Incubation with 100% DCM to complete delipidation; tissue should sink to bottom of vial when clearing is complete. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min × 2)

**7 Refractive Index (RI) Matching**

7.1 Transfer cleared brain into dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014; RI ≈ 1.562) in a glass vial; ensure sample is fully submerged. Do not use plastic containers. Protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours minimum, until fully transparent — typically 3–6 hours for whole adult brain)

7.2 Replace with fresh DBE and confirm complete optical transparency of the sample before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: overnight if needed)

**8 Storage & Pre-Imaging Preparation**

8.1 Store cleared brain in DBE in sealed glass vial, protected from light, until imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 4 weeks; for longer storage use 4 ℃)

8.2 For light-sheet microscopy: mount cleared brain in a glass cuvette or custom imaging chamber filled with DBE (RI = 1.562); use DBE-compatible immersion objective (e.g., CLARITY/LSFM objective matched to RI ~1.56). (Temperature: RT, Time: allow 30 min equilibration before imaging)

8.3 Confirm channel assignments prior to imaging:
- Channel 1 (488 nm excitation): NeuN–Alexa Fluor 488 → neuronal somata distribution
- Channel 2 (546 nm excitation): MAP2–Alexa Fluor 546 → dendritic morphology
- Channel 3 (647 nm excitation): MBP–Alexa Fluor 647 → myelinated axonal fiber tracts

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [C-FoS + Alexa Fluor 647, Npas4 (IEGs) + Alexa Fluor 546 (via secondary antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor series)]

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) it achieves excellent whole-brain clearing of adult mouse brains (~10×8×6 mm) through organic solvent-based delipidation (methanol + DCM/DBE), enabling deep antibody penetration throughout the entire tissue; (2) it is the gold-standard method for whole-brain immunolabeling with single-cell resolution, compatible with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM); (3) the methanol dehydration/rehydration cycle combined with H₂O₂ bleaching reduces autofluorescence, critical for detecting sparse IEG+ neurons; (4) iDISCO+ supports multiplexed immunostaining, allowing simultaneous detection of two IEG markers (c-Fos and Npas4) with spectrally distinct Alexa Fluor dyes to distinguish two activated neuron subpopulations across the whole brain. c-Fos (C-FoS) marks general neuronal activation post-behavioral stimulus; Npas4 marks a distinct IEG subpopulation with different expression kinetics and circuit specificity. Alexa Fluor dyes (e.g., AF647 and AF546) are highly photostable, compatible with iDISCO+ organic solvents when used as secondary antibody conjugates, and spectrally resolvable on LSFM systems.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Tissue Fixation and Pre-treatment**
1.1 Transcardially perfuse adult mouse with ice-cold PBS (50 mL) followed by ice-cold 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS (50 mL) at defined post-behavioral timepoint (c-Fos peak: 60–90 min post-stimulus). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ~10 min perfusion)
1.2 Dissect whole brain and post-fix in 4% (wt/vol) PFA in PBS with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.3 Wash brain 3× in PBS with gentle rocking, 1 hour per wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)

**2 Dehydration**
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O (ddH₂O) with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 Bleaching (Autofluorescence Reduction)**
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes 100% MeOH) with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

**4 Rehydration**
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with PBS with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.6 Repeat wash with fresh PBS with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**5 Permeabilization and Blocking**
5.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS] with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
5.2 Incubation with blocking solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) in PBS] with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

**6 Primary Antibody Immunolabeling (Dual IEG Staining)**
6.1 Prepare primary antibody solution in PTwH buffer [0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 0.1% (wt/vol) heparin in PBS] supplemented with 5% (vol/vol) DMSO and 3% (vol/vol) NDS:
- Anti-c-Fos rabbit monoclonal antibody (e.g., Cell Signaling #2250) at 1:500 dilution
- Anti-Npas4 guinea pig polyclonal antibody (e.g., custom or commercial) at 1:300 dilution
6.2 Incubation with primary antibody solution with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
6.3 Wash brain 5× in PTwH buffer with gentle rocking, 1 hour per wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours total)
6.4 Additional overnight wash in PTwH buffer with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**7 Secondary Antibody Immunolabeling**

- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (Thermo Fisher, A31573) at 1:500 dilution → labels c-Fos+ neurons (far-red channel)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [C-Fos + Alexa Fluor (488-conjugated secondary), Npas4 (IEGs) + Alexa Fluor (647-conjugated secondary), DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is the optimal choice for this application for the following reasons:
1. **Tissue size compatibility**: iDISCO+ uses methanol-based dehydration followed by dibenzyl ether (DBE) as the final RI-matching medium, which achieves deep and uniform clearing of large intact adult mouse brains (10×8×6 mm) — far superior to the 2-day CUBIC-L + 1-day CUBIC-RA protocol that failed due to insufficient delipidation time and incomplete RI matching for this tissue volume.
2. **Dual IEG labeling**: The two immediate early gene (IEG) targets — **C-Fos** (canonical activity marker) and **Npas4** (activity-dependent, excitatory/inhibitory synapse regulator with distinct expression kinetics) — are both accessible via whole-mount immunolabeling with iDISCO+'s methanol-permeabilization + detergent-based antibody penetration protocol, enabling single-cell resolution across the whole brain.
3. **Fluorophore compatibility**: Alexa Fluor dyes (488 and 647) are highly photostable, survive the iDISCO+ dehydration/clearing pipeline, and provide well-separated emission channels for two-color IEG discrimination. DAPI is added post-clearing for nuclear counterstaining to aid cell segmentation and atlas registration.
4. **Failure analysis of original protocol**: CUBIC-L (2 days) + CUBIC-RA (1 day) is grossly insufficient for an intact adult mouse brain. CUBIC-L requires ≥7–14 days at 37°C for complete delipidation of a whole brain, and CUBIC-RA requires ≥3–5 days for full RI equilibration. The resulting opacity, weak deep signal, and edge-center inhomogeneity are direct consequences of under-processing. iDISCO+ avoids these issues through organic solvent-based delipidation, which is faster and more complete for large lipid-rich neural tissue.
5. **Downstream compatibility**: DBE (RI ≈ 1.56) provides excellent RI matching for light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM), which is the standard modality for whole-brain single-cell 3D mapping, atlas registration, and spatial clustering analysis.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Pre-treatment and Permeabilization
1.1 Wash fixed brain (4% PFA post-fixed) in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation in 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.7 Incubation in 100% methanol (second change). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.8 Incubation in chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes 100% MeOH) to quench endogenous peroxidase and autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.9 Rehydration: incubation in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.10 Rehydration: incubation in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.11 Rehydration: incubation in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.12 Rehydration: incubation in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.13 Rehydration: incubation in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.14 Incubation in PBS/0.2% Triton X-100 (PTx0.2) for permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)
1.15 Incubation in permeabilization solution: PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3 M glycine. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.16 Incubation in blocking solution: PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% normal donkey serum (NDS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

2 Primary Antibody Labeling
2.1 Prepare primary antibody solution in PTwH (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin) containing 5% DMSO and 3% NDS: anti-C-Fos rabbit polyclonal antibody (1:1000) + anti-Npas4 guinea pig polyclonal antibody (1:500). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle rocking)
2.2 Wash in PTwH (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight)

3 Secondary Antibody Labeling
3.1 Prepare secondary antibody solution in PTwH containing 3% NDS: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) + donkey anti-guinea pig Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, with gentle rocking, protected from light)
3.2 Wash in PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight, protected from light)

4 Nuclear Counterstaining with DAPI
4.1 Incubation in DAPI solution (5 µg/mL in PTwH) for nuclear labeling to facilitate cell segmentation and atlas registration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)
4.2 Wash in PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 2 hours, protected from light)

5 Dehydration
5.1 Incubation in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
5.2 Incubation in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
5.3 Incubation in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
5.4 Incubation in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
5.5 Incubation in 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
5.6 Incubation in 100% methanol (second change). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

6 Delipidation
6.1 Incubation in 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, protected from light, in fume hood)
6.2 Incubation in 66% (vol/vol) DCM in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, protected from light, in fume hood)
6.3 Incubation in 100% DCM (first change). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, protected from light, in fume hood)
6.4 Incubation in 100% DCM (second change) until tissue sinks to bottom of vial, confirming complete dehydration and delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, protected from light, in fume hood)

7 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
7.1 Incubation in 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014; RI ≈ 1.56) — first change. Ensure tissue is fully submerged; replace DCM-contaminated DBE after 30 min. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes, protected from light, in fume hood)
7.2 Incubation in fresh 100% DBE — second change. Tissue should become fully transparent and optically clear. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours to overnight, protected from light)
7.3 Store cleared brain in 100% DBE in sealed glass vial until imaging. (Temperature: RT, protected from light, Time: up to 6 months)

8 Imaging Preparation
8.1 Mount cleared brain in a custom agarose (1% in DBE) or silicone-based holder compatible with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) objective immersion in DBE (RI = 1.56). Ensure brain is oriented with dorsal surface facing the illumination objective for optimal atlas registration to Allen Mouse Brain Atlas. (Temperature: RT, Time: as needed for mounting)
8.2 Acquire whole-brain 3D image stacks using LSFM with the following channel assignments: DAPI (405 nm excitation / 450 nm emission) for nuclear segmentation and atlas registration; Alexa Fluor 488 (488 nm excitation / 525 nm emission) for C-Fos⁺ neurons; Alexa Fluor 647 (638 nm excitation / 680 nm emission) for Npas4⁺ neurons. Tile and stitch full brain at ≤5 µm isotropic voxel resolution for single-cell detection. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4–12 hours per brain depending on resolution)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, GAP-43/Tuj1 replaced by → β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 546 & GFAP + Alexa Fluor 647]

> 具体双靶点策略：**β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)** 标记所有轴突/神经纤维骨架（保留轴突 + 再生轴突均可见）；**GFAP** 标记反应性星形胶质细胞及胶质瘢痕边界，用于界定损伤中心位置并区分轴突是否穿越/绕行瘢痕区域。二抗分别偶联 **Alexa Fluor 546**（TUJ1）和 **Alexa Fluor 647**（GFAP），两通道光谱分离良好，适合光片显微镜成像。

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ 采用有机溶剂（甲醇脱水 + DBE 折射率匹配），对 15 mm × 4 mm 的大鼠脊髓节段具有优异的深层组织穿透和透明效果，透明周期可控（约 5–7 天），且与免疫荧光抗体标记高度兼容。相较于水性方法（CUBIC、ScaleS），iDISCO+ 对该尺寸脊髓组织的透明效率更高，背景更低。双靶点选择 TUJ1（β-III Tubulin）+ GFAP 的组合可同时重建轴突三维走行路径（TUJ1）和损伤区胶质瘢痕空间边界（GFAP），直接回答轴突是否接近、绕行或穿越损伤中心的科学问题，并可分析损伤上下游轴突的连续性与方向性。Alexa Fluor 546/647 在有机溶剂中荧光稳定性优于短波长染料，适合 iDISCO+ 流程。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样本预处理（Post-fixation 后处理）**
1.1 将已完成 4% PFA 灌流固定及后固定（4% PFA，4 ℃，过夜）的大鼠脊髓损伤节段（约 15 mm × 4 mm）用 1× PBS 充分漂洗。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 30 min)
1.2 用锋利手术刀修整样本两端，确保总长度约 15 mm，轻柔去除残余硬脊膜（可选，有助于试剂渗透）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)

**2 脱水（Dehydration）**
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol（第二次，确保完全脱水）.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 漂白（Bleaching）**
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH, 现配现用) to reduce tissue autofluorescence.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours, 避光)

**4 复水（Rehydration）**
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 1× PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.6 Incubation with 1× PBS（第二次漂洗）.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**5 通透与封闭（Permeabilization and Blocking）**
5.1 Incubation with PTwH buffer（1× PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin）进行漂洗.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)
5.2 Incubation with Permeabilization solution（1× PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 0.3 M glycine）.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, 轻摇)
5.3 Incubation with Blocking solution（1× PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin + 6% Normal Donkey Serum + 5% DMSO）.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, 轻摇)

**6 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）**
6.1 配制一抗工作液：
- 抗 **β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)** 抗体（兔源多克隆或单克隆，如 Abcam ab18207），稀释比 1:500
- 抗 **GFAP** 抗体（鸡源多克隆，如 Abcam ab4674），稀释比 1:500
- 溶于 PTwH + 5% Normal Donkey Serum + 3% DMSO
6.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail solution（TUJ1 兔源 1:500 + GFAP 鸡源 1:500 in PTwH/5% NDS/3% DMSO）.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours, 轻摇，避光)
6.3 Incubation with PTwH buffer 漂洗以去除未结合一抗.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, 轻摇)

**7 二抗孵育（Secondary Antibody Incubation）**
7.1 配制二抗工作液：
- 驴抗兔 **Alexa Fluor 546**（针对 TUJ1），稀释比 1:500
- 驴抗鸡 **Alexa Fluor 647**（针对 GFAP），稀释比 1:500
- 溶于 PTwH + 5% Normal Donkey Serum + 3% DMSO
7.2 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail solution（Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 546 1:500 + Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 647 1:500 in PTwH/5% NDS/3% DMSO）.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, 轻摇，避光)
7.3 Incubation with PTwH buffer 漂洗以去除未结合二抗.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, 轻摇，避光)
7.4 Incubation with PTwH buffer 过夜终漂洗.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours, 避光)

**8 组织透明化——脱水（Clearing Dehydration）**
8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 避光)
8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 避光)
8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 避光)
8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 避光)
8.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 避光)
8.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol（第二次）.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 避光)

**9 脱脂（Delipidation）**
9.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol（DCM:MeOH = 1:2）.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, 通风橱，避光)
9.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM)（第一次）.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min, 通风橱，避光)
9.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM)（第二次，确保完全脱脂）.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min, 通风橱，避光)

**10 折射率匹配（Refractive Index Matching）**
10.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014, RI ≈ 1.562) without shaking，直至样本完全透明（沉入管底）.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3–6 hours, 避光，通风橱)
10.2 更换新鲜 DBE，继续孵育以确保 RI 完全均一化.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours 或过夜, 避光)

**11 样本保存与成像前处理（Storage and Pre-imaging Preparation）**
11.1 将透明样本转移至玻璃样品管或定制成像腔（避免使用普通塑料容器，DBE 可溶解部分塑料），用新鲜 DBE 充满腔体，密封避光保存.(Temperature: RT 或 4 ℃, Time: 可保存数周至数月，避光密封)
11.2 成像前将样本置于 DBE 中平衡至室温，使用折射率匹配浸没物镜（RI = 1.56，如 CLARITY/CUBIC 专用物镜或 Olympus XLPLN10XSVMP2 等长工作距离物镜）进行光片显微镜（LSFM）或共聚焦显微镜成像.(Temperature: RT, Time: 平衡 30 min)
11.3 成像通道设置：
- 通道 1：激发 561 nm / 发射 580–620 nm → 检测 **Alexa Fluor 546**（TUJ1，轴突骨架）
- 通道 2：激发 640 nm / 发射 660–720 nm → 检测 **Alexa Fluor 647**（GFAP，胶质瘢痕）
- 建议 Z 步长：2–5 µm（全样本三维重建），损伤中心区域可加密至 1 µm.(Temperature: RT, Time: 依成像系统而定)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [GAP-43 + Alexa Fluor 647, NF-H (β-III Tubulin/Tuj1) + Alexa Fluor 555]

> **双靶点策略说明：**
> - **靶点1 — 新生/重塑轴突：** GAP-43（生长相关蛋白-43）是轴突生长锥的经典标志物，在损伤后再生或出芽的神经纤维中高表达，而在成熟静止轴突中表达极低，适合标记新生/重塑纤维的空间延伸路径。→ 二抗偶联 **Alexa Fluor 647**（远红通道，穿透深度好）。
> - **靶点2 — 成熟/残存轴突骨架：** **β-III Tubulin（Tuj1）** 标记神经元特异性微管蛋白，在所有神经元轴突（包括成熟残存轴突）中稳定表达，可反映轴突骨架的连续性与密度。→ 二抗偶联 **Alexa Fluor 555**（绿-橙通道）。
> - 两者信号互补，可在同一样本中同时评估"再生新生纤维"与"残存成熟轴突"的三维空间关系。

**Justification:** iDISCO+ 采用有机溶剂（甲醇脱水 + DBE折射率匹配），对直径约4 mm、长15 mm的大鼠脊髓节段具有优异的深层透明效果，可实现全段均一透明；其免疫标记步骤在脱水前完成，抗体渗透效率高，适合厚组织深层抗原标记；Alexa Fluor 647和555在有机溶剂中荧光稳定性良好；整体流程成熟、参数明确，适合光片显微镜（LSFM）三维成像。

---

## Protocol Steps

### 1 样本预处理（固定后漂洗）

1.1 将已完成4% PFA固定和后固定的大鼠脊髓损伤节段（约15 mm × 4 mm）置于1× PBS中充分漂洗，去除残余固定液。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min，每次更换新鲜PBS)

1.2 将样本转移至含0.2% Triton X-100的1× PBS（PTx）中进行渗透处理，促进后续抗体渗透。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

---

### 2 漂白（Bleaching，消除内源性荧光与血红素）

2.1 配制漂白液：5% H₂O₂溶于甲醇（1体积30% H₂O₂ + 5体积100% MeOH），预冷至4 ℃。将样本置于漂白液中孵育，以消除血红素及内源性荧光背景。
(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2.2 取出样本，用100% MeOH漂洗2次，再用PTx漂洗3次，每次更换新鲜溶液。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min PTx漂洗)

---

### 3 封闭与渗透（Pre-immunolabeling Permeabilization & Blocking）

3.1 将样本置于渗透/封闭液（PTwH + 5% DMSO + 3% donkey serum + 0.2% heparin，PTwH = PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 μg/mL heparin）中孵育，充分封闭非特异性结合位点并增强抗体渗透。
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours，轻摇)

---

### 4 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）

4.1 配制一抗工作液：
- 抗GAP-43抗体（兔源多克隆，如Abcam ab75810），稀释比例 1:500
- 抗β-III Tubulin/Tuj1抗体（小鼠源单克隆，如BioLegend 801201），稀释比例 1:500
- 溶于PTwH + 5% DMSO + 3% donkey serum + 0.2% heparin

将样本完全浸没于一抗工作液中，密封孵育。
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days，轻摇，每2天更换一次新鲜一抗液)

4.2 一抗孵育结束后，用PTwH漂洗样本，去除未结合抗体。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour，每次更换新鲜PTwH)

---

### 5 二抗孵育（Secondary Antibody Incubation）

5.1 配制二抗工作液：
- 驴抗兔-Alexa Fluor 647（标记GAP-43），稀释比例 1:500
- 驴抗小鼠-Alexa Fluor 555（标记Tuj1/β-III Tubulin），稀释比例 1:500
- 溶于PTwH + 3% donkey serum + 0.2% heparin

将样本完全浸没于二抗工作液中，避光密封孵育。
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days，避光轻摇，每2天更换一次新鲜二抗液)

5.2 二抗孵育结束后，用PTwH充分漂洗样本，去除未结合二抗，避光操作。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour，每次更换新鲜PTwH，避光)

---

### 6 脱水（Dehydration，Methanol Gradient）

6.1 将样本置于20% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液中孵育，开始梯度脱水。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.2 将样本置于40% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液中孵育。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.3 将样本置于60% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液中孵育。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.4 将样本置于80% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液中孵育。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.5 将样本置于100% 甲醇中孵育，第一次。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.6 将样本置于100% 甲醇中孵育，第二次，确保完全脱水。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 7 脱脂（Delipidation，DCM处理）

7.1 将样本置于二氯甲烷（DCM，Sigma 270997）与甲醇的混合液（33% DCM / 67% MeOH，vol/vol）中孵育，开始脱脂。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours，轻摇)

7.2 将样本转移至100% DCM中孵育，完成深度脱脂，直至样本沉入管底（表明脱水脱脂完全）。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min，每次更换新鲜DCM)

---

### 8 折射率匹配（RI Matching，DBE浸泡）

8.1 将完成脱脂的样本直接转移至100% 苯甲酸苄酯/苯甲醇混合液（DBE，dibenzyl ether，Sigma 108014；RI ≈ 1.562）中孵育，避光静置，直至样本完全透明（呈玻璃状）。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 第一次：3 hours，随后更换新鲜DBE继续孵育 12–24 hours，避光，不振摇)

8.2 观察样本透明度，若中心区域仍有不透明区域，继续在新鲜DBE中延长孵育至完全透明。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 最长可延长至48 hours，视透明效果而定)

---

### 9 成像前处理与保存（Pre-imaging Preparation & Storage）

9.1 将完全透明的样本转移至新鲜DBE中，置于适配光片显微镜（LSFM，如LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope II 或 Zeiss Lightsheet Z.1）的样本槽或折射率匹配成像腔中，确保样本完全浸没于DBE（RI ≈ 1.562）中，与物镜浸没介质RI匹配。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 成像前静置平衡 30 min)

9.2 成像完成后，样本可长期保存于密封的100% DBE中，避光、室温保存。
(Temperature: RT，避光密封保存，可保存数月)

> **成像建议：** 使用光片显微镜（LSFM）进行三维全段扫描，推荐激发/发射通道：Alexa Fluor 555（Ex 555 nm / Em 580 nm，Tuj1残存轴突）；Alexa Fluor 647（Ex 647 nm / Em 670 nm，GAP-43新生轴突）。Z步长建议2–5 μm，以实现轴突连续性的高分辨率三维重建。

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [GAP-43 + Alexa Fluor 647, MBP + Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]

> **Marker rationale:** GAP-43 (growth-associated protein 43) is a canonical marker of regenerating/sprouting axons and growth cones, directly addressing the "再生神经纤维" target. MBP (myelin basic protein) labels mature, myelinated axon sheaths, serving as the structural scaffold reference for "成熟轴突骨架结构". Together they provide spectrally separated dual-channel readout of regenerating vs. mature axonal compartments across the full 15 mm injury segment. DAPI provides cytoarchitectural context for injury-zone delineation.

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because (1) it achieves high transparency in dense, lipid-rich CNS white matter tracts (spinal cord) via organic-solvent delipidation, enabling deep-tissue immunolabeling penetration across the full ~4 mm diameter; (2) its methanol-based dehydration/rehydration cycle combined with DCM/DBE clearing is well-validated for long-range axon tracing in spinal cord; (3) it preserves antigenicity for both GAP-43 and MBP after optimized PFA fixation; (4) the final RI medium (DBE, n ≈ 1.56) is compatible with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM), which is optimal for volumetric 3-D mapping of fiber trajectories across a 15 mm tissue column; (5) the protocol accommodates the relatively large spinal cord diameter through extended incubation times and detergent-enhanced antibody penetration.

---

## Protocol Steps

### 1 Post-fixation Wash

1.1 Wash tissue in 1× PBS (pH 7.4) with gentle rocking to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

---

### 2 Pretreatment / Permeabilization

2.1 Incubation in 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in 1× PBS (PTx0.2) with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

2.2 Incubation in 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine in PTx0.2 (permeabilization/blocking pre-step) with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours)

---

### 3 Dehydration (Methanol Series)

3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

---

### 4 Bleaching (H₂O₂ / Methanol)

4.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH) to reduce autofluorescence in the injury zone. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)

---

### 5 Rehydration

5.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.5 Incubation with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

---

### 6 Blocking / Serum Pre-absorption

6.1 Incubation in blocking solution: 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO in 1× PBS (PTwH-block). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

---

### 7 Primary Antibody Incubation (Dual-target Labeling)

7.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in PTwH-block solution:
- Anti-GAP-43 (rabbit polyclonal, e.g., Abcam ab75810), 1:500 dilution
- Anti-MBP (rat monoclonal, e.g., Millipore MAB386), 1:400 dilution
- 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) NDS + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO in 1× PBS

Incubation with primary antibody cocktail with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 5 days)

---

### 8 Post-primary Antibody Wash

8.1 Wash in PTwH (1× PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin) with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

8.2 Extended overnight wash in PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

---

### 9 Secondary Antibody Incubation

9.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in PTwH-block:
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (Thermo Fisher A31573), 1:500 dilution → labels GAP-43 (regenerating axons, far-red channel)
- Donkey anti-rat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 555 (Thermo Fisher A21434), 1:500 dilution → labels MBP (mature myelin/axon scaffold, red channel)
- 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) NDS + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO in 1× PBS

Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 4 days)

---

### 10 Nuclear Counterstain (DAPI)

10.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PTwH, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

---

### 11 Post-secondary Antibody Wash

11.1 Wash in PTwH with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

11.2 Extended overnight wash in PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

---

### 12 Dehydration (Pre-clearing Methanol Series)

12.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

12.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

12.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

12.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

12.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

---

### 13 Delipidation (DCM)

13.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol (1:2 vol/vol DCM:MeOH) with gentle rocking in a sealed glass vial. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

13.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (Sigma 270997) in a sealed glass vial to complete delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

> ⚠ Perform steps 13.1–13.2 in a chemical fume hood; use glass containers only.

---

### 14 Refractive Index Matching (DBE Clearing)

14.1 Remove DCM completely by brief air-drying in fume hood (≤5 min; do not over-dry).

14.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG, n = 1.559) in a sealed glass vial without shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

14.3 Replace with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE and continue incubation until tissue is fully transparent (typically 12–24 hours for 4 mm diameter spinal cord). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours)

> The cleared tissue should appear optically transparent. RI of DBE (≈1.56) is matched to the objective immersion medium for LSFM.

---

### 15 Storage and Pre-imaging Preparation

15.1 Store cleared tissue in 100% DBE in a sealed glass vial, protected from light, until imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 4 weeks)

15.2 Mount tissue in a custom glass-bottom imaging chamber or FEP tube filled with 100% DBE. Orient the 15 mm spinal cord segment longitudinally along the light-sheet propagation axis to enable continuous volumetric acquisition from caudal to rostral across the injury zone.

15.3 Acquire 3-D image stacks using a light-sheet fluorescence microscope (LSFM) equipped with:
- 405 nm laser / BP 420–470 nm emission → DAPI (cytoarchitecture / injury boundary)
- 561 nm laser / BP 570–620 nm emission → Alexa Fluor 555 / MBP (mature myelinated axon scaffold)
- 638 nm laser / BP 660–720 nm emission → Alexa Fluor 647 / GAP-43 (regenerating/sprouting axons)
- Use a 4× or 12× LSFM objective with DBE-compatible immersion (e.g., LaVision Ultramicroscope II or Miltenyi UltraMicroscope Blaze).
- Step size: 2–5 µm Z-interval for full 15 mm column; reduce to 1 µm for injury core sub-volume.

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** CUBIC

**Chosen Labeling:** [Alexa Fluor (anti-MBP + Alexa Fluor secondary, for mature/retained myelin sheaths), Alexa Fluor (anti-β-III Tubulin/TUJ1 + Alexa Fluor secondary, for axonal skeleton and regenerating fibers)]

**Justification:**
CUBIC (Clear, Unobstructed Brain/Body Imaging Cocktails and Computational analysis) is selected over electrophoresis-based CLARITY/PACT because it is a **purely passive, aqueous immersion** protocol that eliminates all mechanical and electrical stress on the tissue. This is critical for the fragile spinal cord injury (SCI) segment, where the lesion core is mechanically compromised and prone to fragmentation under electrophoretic force. CUBIC uses two sequential reagent cocktails (CUBIC-1 for delipidation/decolorization and CUBIC-2 for RI matching) applied by gentle shaking, preserving the spatial continuity of the 15 mm × 4 mm tissue block across the injury epicenter and the rostral/caudal segments. CUBIC achieves sufficient transparency for deep imaging of spinal cord tissue (~4 mm diameter) and is fully compatible with immunofluorescence labeling. The dual-marker strategy combines **MBP** (myelin basic protein) to visualize mature, retained myelinated axon sheaths and **β-III Tubulin (TUJ1)** to label the pan-axonal cytoskeleton including regenerating/sprouting fibers. This combination directly addresses the scientific goal: TUJ1 reveals spatial trajectory, continuity, directionality, and density of all axons (including thin regenerating ones), while MBP distinguishes mature/preserved myelinated tracts from unmyelinated regenerating fibers, enabling relative distribution mapping between the two populations across the injury core, proximal, and distal zones. Both antibodies are well-validated for rat spinal cord and are compatible with CUBIC's aqueous chemistry. Alexa Fluor dyes (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647) are chosen for their high photostability, brightness, and compatibility with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM), which is optimal for long-distance axon tracing in large cleared volumes.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Pre-clearing Wash**
1.1 Remove tissue from post-fixation storage (4% PFA in PBS). Wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

**2 Immunolabeling – Blocking and Permeabilization**
2.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization buffer: 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS), 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours, gentle shaking)

**3 Immunolabeling – Primary Antibody Incubation**
3.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail in antibody diluent buffer (0.2% Triton X-100, 5% NDS, 0.1% sodium azide in 1× PBS): anti-MBP rabbit polyclonal (1:200) + anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) mouse monoclonal (1:300). (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking)
3.2 Wash with 1× PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PTwH or equivalent). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, gentle shaking)

**4 Immunolabeling – Secondary Antibody Incubation**
4.1 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail in antibody diluent buffer: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:400) + donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 488 (1:400), protected from light. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 5 days, gentle shaking, foil-wrapped)
4.2 Wash with 1× PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, gentle shaking, protected from light)
4.3 Post-labeling fixation with 4% (wt/vol) PFA in 1× PBS to stabilize antibody-antigen complexes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle shaking)
4.4 Wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

**5 Nuclear Counterstain (Optional Reference Channel)**
5.1 Incubation with DAPI (5 µg/mL in 1× PBS) to provide cytoarchitectural reference for injury zone delineation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, gentle shaking, protected from light)
5.2 Wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

**6 Delipidation and Decolorization – CUBIC-1 Treatment**
6.1 Prepare CUBIC-1 reagent: 25% (wt/vol) urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N′,N′-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine (Quadrol), 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in distilled water (adjust to pH ~9.0). (Preparation step, no incubation)
6.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-1 diluted in distilled water (half-strength CUBIC-1) to initiate gentle delipidation. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours, gentle shaking on orbital shaker at ~60 rpm, protected from light)
6.3 Replace with full-strength CUBIC-1 (100%). (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 3–5 days, gentle shaking, change reagent every 24 hours until tissue is visibly translucent, protected from light)
6.4 Monitor tissue integrity daily; the SCI lesion core should remain intact due to passive immersion. Continue until tissue appears uniformly translucent.

**7 Post-CUBIC-1 Wash**
7.1 Wash with 1× PBS to remove residual CUBIC-1 reagent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 2 hours, gentle shaking)

**8 Refractive Index Matching – CUBIC-2 Treatment**
8.1 Prepare CUBIC-2 reagent: 50% (wt/vol) sucrose, 25% (wt/vol) urea, 10% (wt/vol) 2,2′,2″-nitrilotriethanol (triethanolamine), 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in distilled water (RI ≈ 1.49–1.52). (Preparation step)
8.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-2 diluted in 1× PBS (half-strength) for gradual RI equilibration to prevent osmotic distortion. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, gentle shaking, protected from light)
8.3 Incubation with full-strength CUBIC-2 (100%). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2–3 days, gentle shaking, protected from light, change once at 48 hours)
8.4 Verify optical clarity: tissue should appear fully transparent and uniformly matched. Final RI of CUBIC-2 solution should be confirmed with a refractometer (target RI = 1.49 ± 0.01).

**9 Sample Mounting and Imaging Preparation**
9.1 Transfer cleared tissue into fresh CUBIC-2 solution in a custom-fabricated FEP tube or agarose-free imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM). Orient the 15 mm spinal cord segment longitudinally along the imaging axis to maximize axon tracing length. (Temperature: RT, Time: equilibrate 2–4 hours before imaging)
9.2 Seal the imaging chamber with optical-grade glass coverslip or FEP film. Ensure no air bubbles are present along the tissue length. (Temperature: RT)
9.3 Confirm RI of immersion medium matches objective immersion RI specification (for LSFM with RI = 1.45–1.52 objectives, CUBIC-2 is directly compatible; for confocal with water-immersion objectives, dilute CUBIC-2 to RI ≈ 1.45 with distilled water). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min equilibration)

**10 Imaging Parameters (Guidance)**
10.1 Acquire Alexa Fluor 488 channel (TUJ1, pan-axonal) using 488 nm excitation laser; acquire Alexa Fluor 647 channel (MBP, mature myelin) using 638–647 nm excitation laser; acquire DAPI channel using 405 nm excitation. Set z-step to ≤ 2 µm for full volumetric reconstruction of axon trajectories. (Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)
10.2 For long-distance axon path tracing across the 15 mm segment, acquire tiled z-stacks with ≥ 10% overlap between adjacent tiles and apply stitching algorithms (e.g., BigStitcher, TeraStitcher) during post-processing. (Temperature: RT)

**11 Storage**
11.1 Store cleared, labeled tissue in CUBIC-2 at 4 °C in sealed, light-protected container if imaging is delayed. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: up to 4 weeks; re-equilibrate to RT before imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (内源性荧光蛋白，用于标记皮层来源投射神经元), MBP + Alexa Fluor 647 (免疫标记髓鞘，用于显示内源性轴突网络背景)]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ 是目前最成熟的有机溶剂基透明方法，专为完整大型神经系统样本（全脑+脊髓，35–40 mm）设计，具有以下优势：
1. **样本尺寸兼容性**：iDISCO+ 的二苄基醚（DBE）最终折射率匹配介质（RI ≈ 1.56）可使完整 CNS 达到高度透明，适合光片显微镜对长轴样本的成像需求。
2. **荧光蛋白保留**：tdTomato 对甲醇脱水步骤耐受性优于 GFP，在 iDISCO+ 流程中信号保留良好，适合追踪皮层投射神经元的长程轴突。
3. **双靶点策略**：tdTomato 标记皮层来源投射纤维（通过病毒注射或转基因小鼠），MBP 免疫标记髓鞘化轴突网络作为内源性轴突背景参照，两者光谱分离（tdTomato: ~581/609 nm；Alexa Fluor 647: ~650/668 nm），无串色干扰，可在三维空间中同时评估投射路径连续性与周围轴突网络的空间关系。
4. **成像兼容性**：DBE 匹配的样本直接适用于光片荧光显微镜（LSFM），可对 35–40 mm 长轴样本进行全程扫描。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**前提说明：** 样本为已完成 4% PFA 灌注固定及后固定的完整小鼠 CNS（大脑+脑干+脊髓全长，约 35–40 mm）。皮层投射神经元已通过立体定位注射 AAV-CaMKII-tdTomato 完成标记（病毒表达期 ≥ 3 周）。所有步骤在避光条件下进行，使用 15 mL 或 50 mL 锥形管，样本置于旋转摇床上温和振荡。

---

**1 样本预处理与脱水（Pretreatment & Dehydration）**

1.1 用 1× PBS 洗涤样本，去除残余固定液。（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min）

1.2 浸泡于 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中进行梯度脱水。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

1.3 浸泡于 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

1.4 浸泡于 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

1.5 浸泡于 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

1.6 浸泡于 100% 甲醇中，第一次换液。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

1.7 浸泡于 100% 甲醇中，第二次换液，确保完全脱水。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

---

**2 漂白（Bleaching）**

2.1 配制漂白液：5% H₂O₂ 甲醇溶液（1 体积 30% H₂O₂ + 5 体积 100% 甲醇），新鲜配制，预冷至 4 ℃。将样本浸泡于漂白液中以降低组织自发荧光。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours）

2.2 取出样本，用 100% 甲醇洗涤 3 次，去除残余 H₂O₂。（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min）

---

**3 复水（Rehydration）**

3.1 浸泡于 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中进行梯度复水。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

3.2 浸泡于 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

3.3 浸泡于 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

3.4 浸泡于 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

3.5 浸泡于 1× PBS 中洗涤。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min）

---

**4 通透处理（Permeabilization）**

4.1 浸泡于 0.2% Triton X-100 / 20% DMSO / 0.3 M 甘氨酸 / 1× PBS 溶液中进行深度通透，以确保抗体渗透至脊髓深部。（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours）

4.2 浸泡于 0.2% Triton X-100 / 10% DMSO / 6% 正常驴血清（NDS）/ 1× PBS 封闭液中进行封闭，减少非特异性结合。（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours）

---

**5 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）**

5.1 配制一抗工作液：抗 MBP 抗体（兔源多克隆，1:500 稀释）溶于 0.2% Tween-20 / 10 μg/mL 肝素 / 0.5% Triton X-100 / 5% DMSO / 3% NDS / 1× PBS（PTwH+DMSO+NDS 缓冲液）中。将完整 CNS 样本浸泡于一抗工作液中。（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days）

5.2 用 PTwH 缓冲液（0.2% Tween-20 / 10 μg/mL 肝素 / 1× PBS）洗涤样本，去除未结合一抗。（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 × 1 hour，随后过夜洗涤 1 次，共 24 hours）

---

**6 二抗孵育（Secondary Antibody Incubation）**

6.1 配制二抗工作液：驴抗兔 IgG-Alexa Fluor 647（1:500 稀释）溶于 PTwH+DMSO+NDS 缓冲液中（同步骤 5.1 缓冲液配方）。将样本浸泡于二抗工作液中，全程严格避光。（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days）

6.2 用 PTwH 缓冲液洗涤样本，去除未结合二抗，全程避光。（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 × 1 hour，随后过夜洗涤 1 次，共 24 hours）

6.3 用 1× PBS 终洗，确保去除所有 Tween-20 残留（Tween-20 可能影响后续脱水步骤）。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min）

---

**7 组织透明化——脱水（Clearing Dehydration）**

7.1 浸泡于 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中进行梯度脱水，全程避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

7.2 浸泡于 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

7.3 浸泡于 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

7.4 浸泡于 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

7.5 浸泡于 100% 甲醇中，第一次换液。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

7.6 浸泡于 100% 甲醇中，第二次换液，确保完全脱水。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

---

**8 脱脂（Delipidation）**

8.1 将完全脱水的样本转移至二氯甲烷（DCM，Sigma 270997）中进行脱脂，密封容器操作（通风橱内）。（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours）

8.2 更换新鲜 DCM，继续脱脂，直至样本沉入管底（表明脱脂完全）。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

---

**9 折射率匹配（Refractive Index Matching）**

9.1 将脱脂后的样本转移至 100% 二苄基醚（DBE，Sigma 108014-1KG；RI ≈ 1.56）中进行折射率匹配，密封容器，避光静置（不振荡），直至样本完全透明（通常 CNS 样本需较长时间）。（Temperature: RT, Time: 24–48 hours）

9.2 更换新鲜 DBE，继续孵育至样本达到最佳透明度（样本应完全透明，可透过样本清晰看到管壁文字）。（Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours）

---

**10 保存与成像前处理（Storage & Pre-imaging Preparation）**

10.1 透明化完成后，将样本保存于新鲜 DBE 中，置于密封玻璃容器（避免使用普通塑料容器，DBE 可溶解部分塑料）中，避光保存，可在室温下短期保存（≤ 1 周）或 4 ℃ 长期保存（≤ 1 个月）。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 长期保存至成像）

10.2 成像前，将样本转移至光片显微镜专用成像腔（玻璃底成像槽），用 DBE 充满成像腔，确保样本完全浸没，使用折射率匹配物镜（推荐 RI = 1.56 浸液物镜，如 LaVision BioTec 或 Miltenyi Biotec 配套物镜）。（Temperature: RT, Time: 平衡 30 min 后成像）

10.3 成像参数建议：光片荧光显微镜（LSFM），激发/发射通道设置：tdTomato 通道（激发 561 nm，发射 600/50 nm 带通滤片）；Alexa Fluor 647 通道（激发 638 nm，发射 680/30 nm 带通滤片）。沿脊髓长轴（Z 轴）进行连续扫描，步长 ≤ 5 μm，以确保长程投射纤维的三维连续性重建。（Temperature: RT, Time: 根据样本长度，单通道全程扫描约 4–8 hours）

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ 是目前最成熟的有机溶剂基整体透明方案，专为大型哺乳动物 CNS 样本设计，已有完整小鼠脑-脊髓连续组织（35–40 mm）的成功应用记录。其甲醇脱水 + DBE（二苄基醚）折射率匹配流程可将 RI 均一化至 ~1.56，实现深层（>5 mm）光片显微镜成像，满足长程投射追踪需求。双靶点策略选择：① tdTomato 作为皮层投射神经元的内源荧光报告（通过 AAV 病毒注射皮层，Cre 依赖或泛表达），标记特定投射通路轴突，信号强、光稳定性好，在 iDISCO+ 甲醇流程中保留率高；② β-III Tubulin（TUJ1）抗体 + Alexa Fluor 647 二抗进行全轴突/神经纤维网络免疫标记，提供整体轴突骨架背景，用于区分特定投射信号与背景神经纤维结构，并辅助分析路径连续性、分支模式和终末分布。两通道光谱分离良好（tdTomato ~581/609 nm；Alexa Fluor 647 ~650/668 nm），适合双通道光片成像。

**Protocol Steps:**

**前提条件：** 样本已完成 4% PFA 灌注固定及后固定（4°C，过夜），皮层投射神经元已通过立体定位注射 AAV-tdTomato 完成标记（注射后等待 3–4 周表达）。CNS 整体（大脑至脊髓末端，~35–40 mm）已从颅骨和椎管中完整取出。

---

**1 样本预处理与脱水**

1.1 用 1× PBS（含 0.2% Triton X-100）在摇床上漂洗样本，去除残余血液和组织碎片。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 2次）

1.2 用 20%（vol/vol）甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本，置于密封玻璃瓶中，摇床振荡。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）

1.3 用 40%（vol/vol）甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）

1.4 用 60%（vol/vol）甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）

1.5 用 80%（vol/vol）甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）

1.6 用 100%（vol/vol）甲醇孵育样本，第一次。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）

1.7 用 100%（vol/vol）甲醇孵育样本，第二次（确保完全脱水）。（Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours）

---

**2 漂白（H₂O₂处理，去除内源色素，提升深层透光性）**

2.1 配制漂白液：5%（vol/vol）H₂O₂ 甲醇溶液（1体积30% H₂O₂ + 5体积100%甲醇），新鲜配制，预冷至4°C。将样本完全浸没于漂白液中，避光孵育。（Temperature: 4°C, Time: 16 hours）

2.2 弃漂白液，用100%甲醇漂洗样本，去除残余H₂O₂。（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min × 2次）

---

**3 复水（为免疫标记做准备）**

3.1 用 80%（vol/vol）甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

3.2 用 60%（vol/vol）甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

3.3 用 40%（vol/vol）甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

3.4 用 20%（vol/vol）甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

3.5 用 1× PBS 孵育样本，第一次漂洗。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

3.6 用 1× PBS 孵育样本，第二次漂洗，确保完全复水。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）

---

**4 通透化处理（Permeabilization）**

4.1 用 PTx.2 溶液（1× PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100）孵育样本，初步通透。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）

4.2 用 Permeabilization Buffer（1× PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 0.3 M 甘氨酸）孵育样本，深度通透，适用于超长 CNS 整体样本。（Temperature: 37°C, Time: 72 hours，摇床振荡）

4.3 用 Blocking Buffer（1× PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% DMSO + 6% 正常驴血清（NDS））孵育样本，封闭非特异性结合位点。（Temperature: 37°C, Time: 48 hours，摇床振荡）

---

**5 一抗孵育（β-III Tubulin / TUJ1 抗体标记全轴突骨架）**

5.1 配制一抗工作液：兔抗 β-III Tubulin（TUJ1）抗体，稀释比例 1:500，溶于 PTwH 溶液（1× PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 μg/mL 肝素）+ 5% DMSO + 3% NDS。将样本完全浸没于一抗工作液中，避光孵育。（Temperature: 37°C, Time: 7 days，摇床振荡）

5.2 用 PTwH 溶液漂洗样本，去除未结合一抗，每次换液间隔 2 小时。（Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours，多次换液，至少5次换液）

---

**6 二抗孵育（Alexa Fluor 647 标记）**

6.1 配制二抗工作液：驴抗兔 IgG-Alexa Fluor 647 二抗，稀释比例 1:500，溶于 PTwH 溶液 + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS。避光孵育。（Temperature: 37°C, Time: 5 days，摇床振荡，避光）

6.2 用 PTwH 溶液漂洗样本，去除未结合二抗，每次换液间隔 2 小时。（Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours，多次换液，至少5次换液，全程避光）

---

**7 二次脱水（iDISCO+ 有机溶剂透明化前处理）**

7.1 用 20%（vol/vol）甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）

7.2 用 40%（vol/vol）甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）

7.3 用 60%（vol/vol）甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）

7.4 用 80%（vol/vol）甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）

7.5 用 100%（vol/vol）甲醇孵育样本，第一次，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）

7.6 用 100%（vol/vol）甲醇孵育样本，第二次，确保完全脱水，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours）

---

**8 脱脂透明化（DCM 处理）**

8.1 用 DCM/甲醇混合液（二氯甲烷 DCM : 甲醇 = 2:1，vol/vol）孵育样本，置于通风橱中操作，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours，轻柔摇动）

8.2 弃 DCM/甲醇混合液，用 100%（vol/vol）DCM 孵育样本，完全脱脂，样本应沉入瓶底（表明脱水脱脂完全）。（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min × 2次，通风橱操作，避光）

---

**9 折射率匹配（RI Matching，DBE 透明化）**

9.1 弃 DCM，立即加入 100%（vol/vol）DBE（二苄基醚，Sigma 108014-1KG），确保样本完全浸没，不振荡，避光静置。样本应在数小时内变为完全透明（RI ≈ 1.56）。（Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours，不振荡，避光）

9.2 更换新鲜 100%（vol/vol）DBE，继续孵育，确保超长样本（35–40 mm）深层完全透明，避光静置。（Temperature: RT, Time: 24–48 hours，不振荡，避光）

---

**10 成像前处理与样本保存**

10.1 将透明化完成的 CNS 样本转移至定制长条形玻璃成像槽（建议使用 50 mm × 10 mm × 10 mm 石英玻璃槽或 FEP 管），用 DBE 完全填充成像槽，排除气泡，避光密封。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 hours，静置排泡）

10.2 使用折射率匹配物镜（RI = 1.56，如 Olympus XLFLUOR 4×/0.28 或 Miltenyi Biotec LVMI-Fluor 4×/0.3 长工作距离物镜）在光片显微镜（如 LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope II 或 Miltenyi Biotec UltraMicroscope Blaze）上进行双通道三维成像：通道1（tdTomato，激发 561 nm，发射 600/50 nm 滤片）追踪皮层特异性长程投射轴突；通道2（Alexa Fluor 647，激发 638 nm，发射 680/30 nm 滤片）显示全轴突骨架背景。建议成像步长 Z-step = 5–10 μm，覆盖全长 CNS。（Temperature: RT）

10.3 成像完成后，样本可在 DBE 中密封避光长期保存。（Temperature: RT 或 4°C，避光，可保存数月）

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato (内源荧光，标记皮层脊髓束投射神经元), MBP + Alexa Fluor 647 (免疫标记髓鞘/白质通路作为结构参考)]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ 是目前最成熟的有机溶剂基透明方法，专为完整大型哺乳动物CNS样本（全脑+脊髓，35–40 mm）设计，其二苄基醚（DBE）终介质可将RI匹配至~1.56，实现深层组织的均匀透明，适合光片显微镜长距离三维成像。该方法对甲醛固定后的内源荧光蛋白（如tdTomato）保留良好，同时支持全组织免疫标记（whole-mount immunostaining）。双靶点策略：①tdTomato内源信号标记皮层脊髓束（CST）投射神经元（通过病毒注射或转基因小鼠预先引入），提供高信噪比的长程投射轨迹；②抗MBP抗体（偶联Alexa Fluor 647）标记髓鞘化白质束（皮质脊髓束、内囊、脑干锥体束、脊髓背侧柱），作为解剖参考通道，用于判断目标纤维是否沿预期白质通路下行、是否在脑干/脊髓节段分支，以及与内源轴突网络的空间重叠。两通道光谱分离良好（tdTomato ~581/609 nm；Alexa Fluor 647 ~650/668 nm），适合双通道光片同步采集。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样品预处理与脱水**

1.1 将已完成4% PFA固定及后固定的完整小鼠CNS（大脑+脑干+脊髓，约35–40 mm）用PBS在室温下洗涤3次，每次1小时，以彻底去除残余固定液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

1.2 将样品转入20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 将样品转入40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 将样品转入60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 将样品转入80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 将样品转入100% 甲醇中孵育，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.7 再次更换100% 甲醇，过夜孵育以确保完全脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

**2 漂白（H₂O₂处理，保护tdTomato同时去除内源过氧化物酶活性）**

2.1 配制漂白液：5% H₂O₂ in 甲醇（1体积30% H₂O₂ + 5体积100% MeOH），新鲜配制，预冷至4 ℃。将样品置于该溶液中孵育，避光。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2.2 漂白后用100% 甲醇洗涤2次，每次30分钟，去除残余H₂O₂。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

**3 复水**

3.1 将样品转入80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.2 将样品转入60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.3 将样品转入40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.4 将样品转入20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.5 将样品转入PBS中洗涤2次，每次1小时。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

**4 通透化处理（Permeabilization）**

4.1 将样品转入PBS/0.2% Triton X-100溶液中孵育，轻摇，初步通透。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

4.2 将样品转入通透化缓冲液（PBS含0.16% Triton X-100、20% DMSO、0.3 M甘氨酸）中孵育，37 ℃轻摇，以增强大体积CNS样品的抗体渗透。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

**5 封闭（Blocking）**

5.1 将样品转入封闭缓冲液（PBS含0.2% Triton X-100、10% DMSO、6% 正常驴血清）中孵育，37 ℃轻摇，以减少非特异性结合。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

**6 一抗孵育（Anti-MBP，标记白质参考通道）**

6.1 配制一抗工作液：兔抗MBP抗体（1:500稀释）溶于抗体孵育缓冲液（PBS含0.2% Tween-20、10 μg/mL heparin、5% DMSO、3% 正常驴血清）。将样品完全浸没于一抗工作液中，37 ℃缓慢摇动孵育，以确保抗体充分渗透至35–40 mm长的完整CNS深层。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

6.2 用PBS/0.2% Tween-20/10 μg/mL heparin（PTwH缓冲液）洗涤样品，每次1小时，共5次，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

6.3 继续用PTwH缓冲液在37 ℃过夜洗涤，确保彻底去除背景。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**7 二抗孵育（驴抗兔-Alexa Fluor 647）**

7.1 配制二抗工作液：驴抗兔 IgG-Alexa Fluor 647（1:500稀释）溶于PTwH缓冲液（含3% 正常驴血清），避光。将样品完全浸没于二抗工作液中，37 ℃缓慢摇动孵育，避光。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)

7.2 用PTwH缓冲液洗涤样品，每次1小时，共5次，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

7.3 继续用PTwH缓冲液在37 ℃过夜洗涤，避光，确保彻底去除游离二抗。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**8 脱水（第二次，透明化前）**

8.1 将样品转入20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育，避光，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.2 将样品转入40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育，避光，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.3 将样品转入60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育，避光，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.4 将样品转入80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育，避光，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.5 将样品转入100% 甲醇中孵育，避光，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.6 再次更换100% 甲醇，过夜孵育，确保完全脱水，避光。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

**9 脱脂透明化（DCM处理）**

9.1 将样品转入二氯甲烷（DCM，Sigma 270997）/甲醇 = 2:1 (vol/vol) 混合液中孵育，避光，轻摇，进行初步脱脂。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

9.2 将样品转入100% DCM中孵育，避光，轻摇，完成彻底脱脂。对于35–40 mm完整CNS，需确保样品沉入管底（表明脱水脱脂完全）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

**10 折射率匹配（RI Matching，DBE浸泡）**

10.1 将完全透明的CNS样品转入100% 二苄基醚（DBE，Sigma 108014-1KG，RI ≈ 1.559）中孵育，避光，不振摇（防止气泡），直至样品完全透明（通常12–24小时）。对于完整35–40 mm CNS，建议延长至24小时以确保均匀RI匹配。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

10.2 更换新鲜DBE，继续孵育，避光，不振摇，确保完整脊髓远端节段充分透明。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**11 成像前处理与样品安装**

11.1 将透明CNS样品转移至定制的长条形玻璃成像槽（长度≥45 mm，以容纳完整35–40 mm样品），用DBE作为成像介质（RI ≈ 1.559）填充成像槽，确保样品完全浸没，避免气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

11.2 使用低荧光硅胶或琼脂糖（以DBE预平衡）将样品固定于成像槽底部，保持大脑至脊髓末端的自然伸展姿态，确保整体轴线平直，便于连续三维采集。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

11.3 使用配备长工作距离物镜（推荐2×或4×，NA 0.1–0.2，工作距离≥10 mm）的光片荧光显微镜（LSFM）进行成像，设置双通道采集：通道1（tdTomato，激发561 nm，发射600/50 nm滤片）用于投射纤维追踪；通道2（Alexa Fluor 647，激发638 nm，发射680/30 nm滤片）用于白质参考结构。沿样品长轴（Z轴）以1–2 μm步长进行连续扫描，覆盖完整35–40 mm CNS。(Temperature: RT, Time: 根据样品长度和分辨率设置，预计6–12 hours/完整样品)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS

**Chosen Labeling:** [YFP (endogenous / Thy1-YFP transgenic reporter for long-range projection tracing), β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor (secondary antibody conjugate, e.g., Alexa Fluor 647, for pan-axonal network reference)]

**Justification:**
PEGASOS (PolyEthylene Glycol associated solvent System) is selected over uDISCO/iDISCO+ for this application for the following reasons:
1. **Shrinkage prevention:** PEGASOS uses PEG-associated organic solvents (BB-PEG, ethyl cinnamate) that dramatically reduce tissue shrinkage compared to classical uDISCO/BABB/DBE pipelines. The original protocol suffered severe shrinkage from direct 100% MeOH → tert-butanol transition without proper dehydration gradients or PEG protection; PEGASOS's PEG-mediated dehydration step physically stabilizes the tissue matrix.
2. **Fluorescence preservation for large samples:** PEGASOS preserves GFP-family fluorescent proteins (including YFP) significantly better than standard uDISCO, because the PEG-based dehydration is gentler and the final RI-matching solvent (ethyl cinnamate, RI ≈ 1.558) is compatible with yellow/green fluorophores. The bleaching step with H₂O₂/methanol is included here to remove autofluorescence from the large CNS sample without destroying YFP signal when performed at 4 °C.
3. **Complete CNS (35–40 mm) compatibility:** PEGASOS was originally validated on whole mouse brains and spinal cords, including combined CNS preparations. The tert-butanol gradient in PEGASOS is preceded by a PEG400-methanol dehydration series that prevents the abrupt osmotic shock responsible for the original protocol's failure.
4. **Dual-channel strategy:** Endogenous YFP (Thy1-YFP line H or G) labels sparse corticospinal and long-range projection neurons with high signal-to-noise, enabling unambiguous 3D tracing. β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) immunolabeling with Alexa Fluor 647 provides a spectrally distinct (far-red) pan-axonal reference network for spatial context in brainstem and spinal cord segments. These two channels are spectrally well-separated for light-sheet imaging.
5. **Deep immunolabeling compatibility:** PEGASOS includes a detergent-based permeabilization phase compatible with whole-mount antibody staining of large samples when combined with extended incubation times and elevated temperature (37 °C).

---

## Protocol Steps

### 1 Post-fixation Verification and Pre-treatment

1.1 Verify complete post-fixation: confirm sample has been immersed in 4% (wt/vol) PFA in 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4) at 4 °C for ≥ 24 hours (total CNS, brain + spinal cord, 35–40 mm). Rinse 3 × 10 min in 0.1 M PBS at RT before proceeding. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 10 min)

1.2 Wash with 0.1 M PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) to begin membrane permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min, gentle rocking)

---

### 2 Autofluorescence Bleaching (H₂O₂/Methanol — Critical Correction Step)

2.1 Dehydrate sample stepwise into methanol: incubate sequentially in 20%, 40%, 60%, 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O, 1 hour each step, on a rocking platform. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)

2.2 Incubate in 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

2.3 Prepare fresh bleaching solution: 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH). Incubate sample fully submerged. This step removes lipofuscin and heme-based autofluorescence while YFP signal is protected at 4 °C. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)

2.4 Rehydrate sample: wash sequentially in 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O, 30 min each step. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min per step)

2.5 Wash 3 × 20 min in 0.1 M PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 20 min)

---

### 3 Whole-Mount Immunolabeling (β-III Tubulin / TUJ1 + Alexa Fluor 647)

3.1 Permeabilization and blocking: incubate in blocking/permeabilization buffer [0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 0.1 M PBS]. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours, gentle shaking)

3.2 Primary antibody incubation: incubate with anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) antibody (rabbit monoclonal, e.g., Abcam ab18207 or equivalent) diluted 1:300 in blocking buffer [0.2% gelatin, 0.5% Triton X-100, 0.01% NaN₃ in PBS]. Use sufficient volume to fully submerge the complete CNS (≥ 5 mL). (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking, protected from light)

3.3 Wash primary antibody: wash 5 × 2 hours in PBST [0.1 M PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 0.01% (wt/vol) heparin sodium salt]. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 2 hours)

3.4 Secondary antibody incubation: incubate with donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500 dilution) in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 5 days, gentle shaking, protected from light)

3.5 Wash secondary antibody: wash 5 × 2 hours in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 2 hours)

3.6 Post-fixation of antibody complexes: incubate in 4% (wt/vol) PFA in 0.1 M PBS to crosslink antibody-antigen complexes and stabilize fluorescence. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.7 Wash 3 × 20 min in 0.1 M PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 20 min)

---

### 4 PEGASOS Dehydration — PEG400/Methanol Gradient (Shrinkage Prevention Core Step)

4.1 Prepare PEG400/methanol (PEG-MeOH) stock: mix PEG400 (MW 400, Sigma 202398) with anhydrous methanol at the following ratios. Incubate sample in each step sequentially:

4.1a 25% (vol/vol) PEG400 in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours, gentle rocking)

4.1b 50% (vol/vol) PEG400 in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours, gentle rocking)

4.1c 75% (vol/vol) PEG400 in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours, gentle rocking)

4.1d 100% PEG400 (neat). (Temperature: RT, Time: overnight ≥ 12 hours, gentle rocking)

4.2 Transition to tert-butanol (tBuOH) gradient using PEG400/tBuOH mixtures to prevent abrupt osmotic shock (critical correction vs. original failed protocol):

4.2a 25% (vol/vol) tert-butanol in PEG400. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 4 hours) [Note: warm tBuOH to 37 °C to prevent solidification; maintain sample at 37 °C throughout tBuOH steps]

4.2b 50% (vol/vol) tert-butanol in PEG400. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 4 hours)

4.2c 75% (vol/vol) tert-butanol in PEG400. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 4 hours)

4.2d 100% tert-butanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 2 × 6 hours)

---

### 5 Delipidation with BB-PEG (PEGASOS Lipid Removal Step)

5.1 Prepare BB-PEG solution: dissolve PEG-methacrylate (average Mn ~360, Sigma 409510) in tert-butanol at 30% (vol/vol); add 0.1% (vol/vol) N,N,N′,N′-tetramethylethylenediamine (TEMED) as catalyst. This is the PEGASOS "BB-PEG" delipidation reagent. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 2 × 12 hours, gentle shaking)

5.2 Wash residual BB-PEG: incubate in 100% tert-butanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 2 × 2 hours)

---

### 6 Refractive Index Matching with Ethyl Cinnamate (ECi)

6.1 Transition from tert-butanol to ethyl cinnamate (ECi, RI = 1.558, Sigma W243000): incubate in 50% (vol/vol) ECi in tert-butanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours, gentle rocking, protected from light)

6.2 Incubate in 100% ECi (neat). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)

6.3 Replace with fresh 100% ECi. Monitor sample visually: complete CNS (35–40 mm) should become fully transparent. If residual opacity remains in spinal cord, extend incubation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours additional, protected from light)

---

### 7 Sample Mounting and Imaging Preparation

7.1 Transfer cleared CNS into a custom imaging chamber (e.g., FEP tube, 4 mm inner diameter, or 3D-printed holder) filled with 100% ECi. Ensure the full 35–40 mm length is accommodated without bending. Seal chamber ends with optical-grade silicone or parafilm. (Temperature: RT, Time: allow 2 hours equilibration before imaging)

7.2 Measure RI of ECi batch with a refractometer; confirm RI = 1.558 ± 0.002. Adjust light-sheet microscope immersion objective and detection objective to ECi-compatible long-working-distance objectives (e.g., CLARITY/ECi-compatible 2×, 4×, or 12× objectives). (Temperature: RT)

7.3 For light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM): configure dual-channel acquisition:
- Channel 1: 488 nm excitation / 525 ± 25 nm emission → YFP (long-range projection fibers)
- Channel 2: 638 nm excitation / 680 ± 30 nm emission → Alexa Fluor 647 / TUJ1 (pan-axonal reference network)
Acquire tile scans along the full rostro-caudal axis (brain → spinal cord terminus) with ≥ 10% tile overlap for stitching. Recommended z-step: 2–5 µm for projection tracing; 1 µm for terminal field analysis in spinal segments. (Temperature: RT)

---

### 8 Sample Storage (if imaging is delayed)

8.1 Store cleared CNS fully submerged in 100% ECi in a sealed, light-protected glass vial at RT. Avoid exposure to UV light or humidity. Samples are stable for ≥ 6 months under these conditions. (Temperature: RT, protected from light)
