**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10 / 4G8 + Alexa Fluor (anti-mouse 488 or 546), DAPI, Thioflavin-S (as Congo red analog for amyloid; mapped to Congo red in Marker list)]

> **Note on dye mapping:** "Congo red" is selected from the Marker list as the amyloid-specific histochemical label (Thioflavin-S is the fluorescent equivalent used in iDISCO+ compatible protocols); "6E10 / 4G8" is selected from the Marker list as the primary antibody against Aβ peptide; "Alexa Fluor" is selected from the Dye list as the secondary antibody fluorophore; "DAPI" is selected from the Dye list for cytoarchitectural reference and atlas registration.

---

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) it achieves excellent clearing of whole adult mouse brains (~10 × 8 × 6 mm) within a practical timeframe via organic-solvent delipidation (DCM/DBE); (2) its methanol-based pretreatment and detergent-mediated antibody penetration are well-validated for large-volume immunolabeling of aggregated protein targets such as Aβ plaques; (3) the DBE RI-matching medium (RI ≈ 1.56) is compatible with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM), which is the optimal modality for whole-brain 3-D mapping; (4) the dual-target strategy—anti-Aβ immunolabeling (6E10/4G8 + Alexa Fluor secondary) for all soluble/insoluble Aβ species combined with Congo red (fluorescent mode, i.e., Thioflavin-S) for dense-core fibrillar plaques—provides complementary, spectrally separable channels that enable plaque-load quantification, morphological subtyping, and regional density mapping across cortex, hippocampus, thalamus, amygdala, and other regions; (5) DAPI nuclear staining provides a whole-brain cytoarchitectural reference channel essential for atlas co-registration and automated region-of-interest segmentation.

---

## Protocol Steps

### 0 Pre-clearing Verification
0.1 Confirm that the 5XFAD whole brain has been immersion-fixed in 4% (wt/vol) PFA / PBS at 4 °C for 24 h, followed by post-fixation in 4% PFA / PBS. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 h)
0.2 Wash brain 3 × in 1× PBS to remove residual PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h per wash)
0.3 Transfer brain to fresh 1× PBS and store at 4 °C until start of protocol. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: ≤ 48 h)

---

### 1 Pretreatment — Methanol Dehydration Series
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O (ddH₂O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
1.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

---

### 2 Bleaching (Endogenous Pigment Removal)
2.1 Prepare chilled bleaching solution: 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 vol 30% H₂O₂ : 5 vol MeOH). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 h, on a gentle rocker, protected from light)

---

### 3 Rehydration Series
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
3.5 Incubation with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
3.6 Repeat wash with fresh 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

---

### 4 Permeabilization and Blocking
4.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 h, on a gentle rocker)
4.2 Incubation with Blocking Solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 h, on a gentle rocker)

---

### 5 Primary Antibody Labeling — Channel 1: Anti-Aβ (6E10 / 4G8)
5.1 Prepare primary antibody solution: anti-Aβ antibody 6E10 (mouse monoclonal, Biolegend 803001) at 1:200 dilution AND anti-Aβ antibody 4G8 (mouse monoclonal, Biolegend 800701) at 1:200 dilution (can be combined in the same incubation) in PTwH [0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 0.1% (wt/vol) heparin sodium salt in 1× PBS] supplemented with 5% (vol/vol) NDS and 5% (vol/vol) DMSO. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 7 days, on a gentle rocker, protected from light)
5.2 Wash brain 5 × with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h per wash)
5.3 Additional overnight wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 h)

---

### 6 Secondary Antibody Labeling — Channel 1
6.1 Prepare secondary antibody solution: donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 546 (Thermo Fisher A10036) at 1:400 dilution in PTwH supplemented with 3% (vol/vol) NDS and 5% (vol/vol) DMSO. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 5 days, on a gentle rocker, protected from light)
6.2 Wash brain 5 × with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h per wash)
6.3 Additional overnight wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 h)

---

### 7 Congo Red / Thioflavin-S Staining — Channel 2 (Dense-Core Fibrillar Amyloid)
7.1 Prepare 0.05% (wt/vol) Thioflavin-S solution in 50% (vol/vol) ethanol / 1× PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: RT, Time: —)
7.2 Incubation of brain in 0.05% (wt/vol) Thioflavin-S solution with gentle agitation, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 h)
7.3 Differentiation wash 1: incubation with 80% (vol/vol) ethanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
7.4 Differentiation wash 2: repeat incubation with fresh 80% (vol/vol) ethanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
7.5 Wash 3 × with 1× PBS to remove residual ethanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min per wash)

---

### 8 Nuclear Counterstain — Channel 3 (Cytoarchitectural Reference / Atlas Registration)
8.1 Prepare DAPI solution at 5 µg/mL in PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: —)
8.2 Incubation with DAPI solution with gentle agitation, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 h)
8.3 Wash 3 × with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h per wash)
8.4 Final wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

---

### 9 Organic-Solvent Dehydration (Pre-clearing)
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)
9.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

---

### 10 Delipidation — Dichloromethane (DCM)
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) DCM / 33% (vol/vol) methanol (2:1 vol/vol DCM:MeOH) in a glass vial with a sealed cap, in a fume hood. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 h, on a gentle rocker)
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (two changes) to remove residual methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min per change)
> ⚠ Use glass containers only; DCM dissolves polystyrene/polypropylene plastics.

---

### 11 Refractive Index Matching — Dibenzyl Ether (DBE)
11.1 Remove DCM completely; transfer brain immediately to 100% (vol/vol) DBE (Sigma-Aldrich 108014, RI ≈ 1.562) in a glass vial, without shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 h)
11.2 Replace with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE and incubate until brain is fully transparent (appears optically clear). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 h, protected from light)
> The brain is ready for imaging when it appears fully transparent and has sunk to the bottom of the vial.

---

### 12 Sample Storage Prior to Imaging
12.1 Store cleared brain in 100% (vol/vol) DBE in a sealed glass vial, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: ≤ 4 weeks; for longer storage use 4 °C)
12.2 Do NOT expose to aqueous solutions or humidity after DBE equilibration, as this will cause re-opacification.

---

### 13 Imaging Setup (Light-Sheet Fluorescence Microscopy)
13.1 Mount cleared brain in a custom 3-D-printed or FEP-tube sample holder filled with 100% (vol/vol) DBE as immersion medium (RI ≈ 1.562). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min equilibration before imaging)
13.2 Acquire Channel 1 (Alexa Fluor 546, Aβ immunolabeling): excitation 543/561 nm, emission 570–620 nm bandpass filter. (Temperature: RT, Time: per acquisition schedule)
13.3 Acquire Channel 2 (Thioflavin-S, dense-core plaques): excitation 405/445 nm, emission 460–510 nm bandpass filter. (Temperature: RT, Time: per acquisition schedule)
13.4 Acquire Channel 3 (DAPI, nuclear reference): excitation 405 nm, emission 415–450 nm bandpass filter. (Temperature: RT, Time: per acquisition schedule)
13.5 Set z-step size to ≤ 3 µm for whole-brain acquisition to ensure adequate sampling for plaque counting and volumetric quantification; use 1–2 µm z-step for high-resolution regional sub-volumes (cortex, hippocampus, amygdala, thalamus). (Temperature: RT, Time: per acquisition schedule)

---

### 14 Post-imaging Data Processing Notes
14.1 Register acquired 3-D image stacks to the Allen Mouse Brain Common Coordinate Framework (CCFv3) using DAPI/nuclear channel as structural reference (tools: ANTs, Elastix, or brainreg). (Temperature: —, Time: —)
14.2 Perform automated plaque segmentation and counting using thresholding + connected-component analysis or deep-learning-based tools (e.g., ilastik, ClearMap, or custom U-Net) on Alexa Fluor 546 and Thioflavin-S channels. (Temperature: —, Time: —)
14.3 Export regional plaque density, plaque load (% volume), and spatial distribution maps per brain region (cortex, hippocampus, thalamus, amygdala, and other CCF-registered regions) for statistical analysis. (Temperature: —, Time: —)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10 / 4G8 + Alexa Fluor (two spectrally distinct secondaries, e.g., Alexa Fluor 546 & Alexa Fluor 647), Congo red]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because it is the gold-standard solvent-based whole-brain clearing method optimized for immunolabeling of intact rodent brains (~10×8×6 mm), offering deep antibody penetration via methanol dehydration/rehydration and detergent-based permeabilization, excellent compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes, and well-validated performance in AD mouse models. The dual-labeling strategy pairs two complementary Aβ-recognition approaches on the same tissue:
- **6E10** (recognizes Aβ residues 1–16, N-terminal epitope) conjugated via anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 546 secondary: detects total Aβ/APP-derived deposits including diffuse and compact plaques.
- **4G8** (recognizes Aβ residues 17–24, mid-domain epitope) conjugated via anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 647 secondary: preferentially labels compact/dense-core plaques and also detects intracellular Aβ.
- **Congo red** (chemical amyloid dye, cross-links β-sheet fibrils): provides an orthogonal, antibody-independent third channel to validate fibrillar amyloid identity and serves as a spatial cross-reference for plaque burden quantification.

This three-channel strategy enables: (1) co-localization analysis of 6E10 vs. 4G8 signals across cortex, hippocampus, and other vulnerable regions; (2) comparison of plaque size distributions and regional load between the two antibody-defined populations; (3) Congo red as an independent structural anchor. iDISCO+ preserves Alexa Fluor signals through DBE-based RI matching (n ≈ 1.56), compatible with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) for whole-brain 3D acquisition.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Pre-treatment & Dehydration**

1.1 Wash fixed whole brain (4% PFA post-fixed, PBS-stored) with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 2 washes)

1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (second change) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**2 Bleaching**

2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 vol 30% H₂O₂ : 5 vol MeOH) to quench endogenous peroxidase and reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)

**3 Rehydration**

3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.5 Incubation with 1× PBS with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**4 Permeabilization**

4.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in 1× PBS] with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4.2 Incubation with blocking solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) in 1× PBS] with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

**5 Congo Red Pre-staining (Chemical Amyloid Labeling — Channel 3)**

5.1 Wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes × 2 washes)

5.2 Incubation with 0.1% (wt/vol) Congo red dissolved in 80% (vol/vol) ethanol aqueous solution (saturated solution filtered before use) with gentle agitation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5.3 Differentiation wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) KOH in 80% (vol/vol) ethanol to remove non-specific background. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes × 2 washes)

5.4 Wash with 1× PBS to remove residual ethanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3 washes)

**6 Primary Antibody Incubation**

6.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail in PTwH buffer [0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10 µg/mL heparin in 1× PBS] supplemented with 5% (vol/vol) NDS and 3% (vol/vol) DMSO:
- Anti-Aβ 6E10 (mouse monoclonal, BioLegend 803001 or equivalent), dilution 1:300
- Anti-Aβ 4G8 (mouse monoclonal, BioLegend 800701 or equivalent), dilution 1:300
Note: Both 6E10 and 4G8 are mouse-derived; use directly conjugated primary antibodies (6E10-Alexa Fluor 546 and 4G8-Alexa Fluor 647 direct conjugates, or use species-specific Fab fragment secondaries to avoid cross-reactivity — see Step 7).
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days with gentle shaking on roller)

6.2 Wash with PTwH buffer with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 5 washes over 24 hours total, changing every ~5 hours)

**7 Secondary Antibody Incubation**

7.1 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail in PTwH + 5% NDS:
- Donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 546 (Thermo Fisher A10036), 1:500 — for 6E10 (applied as Fab-blocked sequential step if needed)
- Donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (Thermo Fisher A31571), 1:500 — for 4G8
Note: To distinguish two mouse primaries, use sequential labeling with Fab fragment blocking between steps, or use directly conjugated primary antibodies (recommended). If direct conjugates are used, omit Step 7 and proceed to Step 8.
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days with gentle shaking)

7.2 Wash with PTwH buffer with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 5 washes over 24 hours total)

**8 Post-labeling Fixation**

8.1 Post-fix labeled brain with 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde in 1× PBS to stabilize antibody-antigen complexes and Congo red staining. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

8.2 Wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3 washes)

**9 Dehydration for Clearing**

9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (second change) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**10 Delipidation**

10.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol (1 vol DCM : 2 vol MeOH) with gentle shaking in a fume hood. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (two changes) to complete lipid extraction, with gentle shaking in a fume hood. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes × 2)

**11 Refractive Index Matching**

11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014, n = 1.562) without shaking, in a sealed glass vial protected from light. Replace with fresh DBE after first 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, then fresh DBE for additional 12–24 hours until brain is fully transparent)

11.2 Verify optical transparency visually; brain should appear glass-like. Store in fresh DBE in sealed glass vial protected from light until imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 4 weeks for storage)

**12 Imaging Preparation**

12.1 Mount cleared brain in a glass imaging chamber filled with DBE (n ≈ 1.56). Use agarose-free mounting; secure brain with DBE-compatible silicone spacers or custom 3D-printed holder compatible with light-sheet objectives. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes equilibration before imaging)

12.2 Acquire whole-brain 3D datasets on a light-sheet fluorescence microscope (e.g., LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope II or Miltenyi UltraMicroscope Blaze) using:
- Channel 1: 561 nm excitation / 585–625 nm emission → Alexa Fluor 546 (6E10, N-terminal Aβ)
- Channel 2: 638 nm excitation / 660–720 nm emission → Alexa Fluor 647 (4G8, mid-domain Aβ)
- Channel 3: 532 nm excitation / 590–650 nm emission (or brightfield-assisted) → Congo red (fibrillar amyloid, birefringence or fluorescence mode)
Use 4× objective (overview) and 12× or 25× objective (regional detail, cortex/hippocampus). Step size: 3–5 µm for whole brain; 1–2 µm for high-resolution regional stacks. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4–12 hours per whole-brain acquisition depending on resolution)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10 + Alexa Fluor 647, Congo red, DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected as the optimal clearing method for this application for the following reasons: (1) It is well-validated for whole adult mouse brain (~10×8×6 mm) immunolabeling and clearing, achieving deep antibody penetration through organic solvent-based delipidation; (2) It is the most widely used and benchmarked method for 3D amyloid pathology mapping in AD mouse models including 5XFAD; (3) The methanol dehydration/rehydration cycle combined with dibenzyl ether (DBE) as the final RI-matching medium (RI ≈ 1.56) provides excellent tissue transparency and geometric stability for volumetric quantification; (4) It is compatible with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM), which is the gold standard for whole-brain 3D atlas construction.

**Dual-target labeling strategy rationale:**
- **Primary target — 6E10 antibody + Alexa Fluor 647 secondary:** 6E10 is a pan-amyloid antibody recognizing human Aβ residues 1–16, the gold standard for immunolabeling amyloid plaques in 5XFAD brains. Alexa Fluor 647 (far-red, ~650/668 nm) is chosen for its minimal tissue autofluorescence overlap, deep tissue penetration, and photostability under LSFM.
- **Secondary target — Congo red:** Congo red is a small-molecule dye that directly intercalates into β-sheet amyloid fibrils, providing an orthogonal, antibody-independent confirmation of amyloid deposits. It serves as the second verification channel to distinguish true fibrillar amyloid from non-specific immunolabeling or autofluorescent particles. Congo red fluorescence can be detected in the 560–620 nm channel under LSFM.
- **Nuclear counterstain — DAPI:** DAPI provides whole-brain cytoarchitectural reference for atlas registration and region-of-interest delineation.

This dual-target strategy (immunolabeling + chemical dye) ensures that only structures positive in both channels are scored as true amyloid plaques, maximizing specificity and eliminating false positives from autofluorescence or non-specific binding.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Pre-treatment and Bleaching**
1.1 Wash fixed whole brain (post-fixed in 4% PFA/PBS, 4 °C, overnight already completed) with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 10 min)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.7 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.8 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 vol 30% H₂O₂ : 5 vol MeOH) to bleach endogenous peroxidases and reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 16 hours)

**2 Rehydration**
2.1 Incubation with 100% methanol with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with 1× PBS with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.7 Incubation with 1× PBS, second wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 Permeabilization and Blocking**
3.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in 1× PBS] with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with blocking solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) in 1× PBS] with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours)

**4 Primary Antibody Incubation (6E10)**
4.1 Prepare primary antibody solution: anti-Aβ antibody 6E10 (BioLegend #803001 or equivalent) at 1:200 dilution in PTwH buffer [0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10 µg/mL heparin in 1× PBS] supplemented with 5% (vol/vol) NDS and 3% (vol/vol) DMSO. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 7 days, with gentle rocking)
4.2 Wash with PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight wash)

**5 Secondary Antibody Incubation (Alexa Fluor 647)**
5.1 Prepare secondary antibody solution: donkey anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (Thermo Fisher #A31571) at 1:400 dilution in PTwH buffer supplemented with 3% (vol/vol) NDS. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 5 days, with gentle rocking, protected from light)
5.2 Wash with PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight wash, protected from light)

**6 Congo Red Staining**
6.1 Prepare Congo red working solution: 0.5% (wt/vol) Congo red dissolved in 80% (vol/vol) ethanol/H₂O, filtered through 0.22 µm membrane. (Temperature: RT, preparation step)
6.2 Incubation with Congo red working solution with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
6.3 Differentiation wash with 80% (vol/vol) ethanol in H₂O to remove non-specific background staining. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)
6.4 Wash with 1× PBS to rehydrate. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

**7 Nuclear Counterstain (DAPI)**
7.1 Incubation with DAPI solution at 5 µg/mL in PTwH buffer, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
7.2 Wash with PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour, protected from light)

**8 Dehydration (Pre-clearing)**
8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous) with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.6 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous), second change, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**9 Delipidation**
9.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
9.2 Incubation with 100% DCM (anhydrous) with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)
9.3 Incubation with 100% DCM (anhydrous), second change, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)
9.4 Check tissue: brain should sink to the bottom of the vial, indicating complete delipidation. If floating, extend DCM incubation by 15 min increments.

**10 Refractive Index Matching and Storage**
10.1 Transfer brain to glass vial. Incubation with 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich #108014, RI ≈ 1.559) without shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
10.2 Replace with fresh 100% DBE. Incubation without shaking until brain is fully transparent (typically overnight), protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–16 hours)
10.3 Long-term storage in 100% DBE in sealed glass vials, protected from light. (Temperature: RT or 4 °C, Time: up to several months)

**11 Pre-imaging Preparation**
11.1 Mount cleared brain in a custom imaging chamber or FEP tube filled with 100% DBE (RI ≈ 1.559) compatible with the light-sheet objective (e.g., LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope II or Miltenyi UltraMicroscope Blaze with 2×/0.5 NA or 4×/0.35 NA objectives with DBE-compatible immersion). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min equilibration)
11.2 Acquire whole-brain tile-scan z-stacks using three channels: Channel 1 — DAPI (405 nm excitation / 450 nm emission), Channel 2 — Congo red (561 nm excitation / 600 nm emission), Channel 3 — Alexa Fluor 647 (638 nm excitation / 680 nm emission). Z-step: 3–5 µm for whole-brain atlas; 1 µm for high-resolution regional quantification. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4–12 hours per brain depending on resolution)
11.3 Post-acquisition: register whole-brain datasets to Allen Mouse Brain Atlas (CCFv3) using elastix or ANTs registration pipeline. Quantify plaque number, volume, density, and clustering per brain region using Imaris, Fiji/3D Objects Counter, or custom Python/napari pipeline. Score plaques as true positives only if co-positive in both Congo red (Channel 2) and 6E10/Alexa Fluor 647 (Channel 3) channels to eliminate false positives from autofluorescence.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10 / 4G8 + Alexa Fluor (anti-mouse secondary), Congo red, DAPI / Hoechst / PI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected as the optimal clearing method for this application for the following reasons: (1) It employs methanol-based dehydration and dibenzyl ether (DBE) as the final RI-matching medium, achieving excellent transparency in large (10×8×6 mm) intact mouse brains; (2) The organic solvent-based pipeline is highly compatible with deep antibody penetration when combined with extended incubation and detergent-based permeabilization, addressing the core problem of poor deep-tissue antibody penetration observed in the original attempt; (3) DBE (RI ≈ 1.56) provides superior refractive index matching for light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM), enabling whole-brain volumetric imaging with minimal spherical aberration; (4) The methanol dehydration step also serves as an antigen retrieval step that partially unmasks epitopes in PFA-fixed tissue, improving 6E10/4G8 immunoreactivity for Aβ plaques.

**Dual-target labeling strategy:**
- **Primary amyloid target:** Anti-Aβ antibody **6E10** (recognizes human Aβ residues 1–16; highly validated in 5XFAD) conjugated to or detected via **Alexa Fluor** secondary antibody (e.g., Alexa Fluor 647 for deep-red channel, minimal tissue autofluorescence). This provides epitope-specific, quantitative immunolabeling of all Aβ species including diffuse and dense-core plaques.
- **Orthogonal amyloid validation target:** **Congo red** (chemical dye for β-sheet amyloid fibrils), applied post-clearing/pre-RI-matching as a cross-validation label in a spectrally distinct channel. Congo red labels compact/neuritic plaques independently of antibody access, providing mutual verification of plaque identity and compensating for any residual antibody penetration gaps in deep tissue.
- **Nuclear counterstain:** **DAPI** (or Hoechst 33342) for cytoarchitectural reference, brain region delineation, and cell density normalization during quantitative analysis.

**Key protocol modifications vs. original failed attempt:**
- Extended primary antibody incubation from 1 day → **7 days at 37 °C** with gentle rocking
- Extended secondary antibody incubation from 1 day → **5 days at 37 °C**
- Addition of PTwH wash buffer (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 2 µg/mL heparin) to reduce non-specific binding
- Methanol dehydration series for antigen unmasking and lipid removal prior to immunolabeling (iDISCO+ pre-treatment)
- H₂O₂ bleaching step to quench endogenous peroxidase and reduce autofluorescence

---

## Protocol Steps

### 1 Pre-treatment and Permeabilization

1.1 Wash fixed whole brain (post-fixed in 4% PFA, stored in PBS) with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 2 washes)

1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O (freshly prepared). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.8 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH) to bleach endogenous pigments and quench autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

1.9 Rehydration: Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.10 Rehydration: Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.11 Rehydration: Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.12 Rehydration: Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.13 Rehydration: Incubation with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 2 washes)

1.14 Incubation with permeabilization buffer: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine, pH 7.4. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, gentle rocking)

1.15 Incubation with blocking buffer: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS), 2 µg/mL heparin (PTwH + DMSO + NDS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, gentle rocking)

---

### 2 Primary Antibody Immunolabeling (Anti-Aβ: 6E10)

2.1 Prepare primary antibody solution: Anti-Aβ antibody 6E10 (mouse monoclonal, Biolegend 803001 or equivalent) diluted 1:300 in PTwH buffer (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 2 µg/mL heparin) supplemented with 5% (vol/vol) NDS and 3% (vol/vol) DMSO. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle rocking on orbital shaker at 40 rpm)

2.2 Wash with PTwH buffer (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 2 µg/mL heparin). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 2 washes, then overnight wash at 37 ℃ with rocking)

2.3 Additional PTwH wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 4 washes)

---

### 3 Secondary Antibody Labeling (Alexa Fluor)

3.1 Prepare secondary antibody solution: Donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 647 (Jackson ImmunoResearch or Thermo Fisher, 1:500 dilution) in PTwH buffer supplemented with 3% (vol/vol) NDS and 3% (vol/vol) DMSO. Protect from light hereafter. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, gentle rocking, protected from light)

3.2 Wash with PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 2 washes, then overnight wash at 37 ℃ with rocking, protected from light)

3.3 Additional PTwH wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 4 washes, protected from light)

---

### 4 Nuclear Counterstain (DAPI)

4.1 Incubation with DAPI solution: 5 µg/mL DAPI in 1× PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, gentle rocking, protected from light)

4.2 Wash with 1× PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3 washes, protected from light)

---

### 5 Congo Red Staining (Orthogonal Amyloid Validation)

5.1 Prepare Congo red working solution: 0.5% (wt/vol) Congo red dissolved in 80% (vol/vol) ethanol containing 0.5% (wt/vol) NaCl (saturated Congo red solution, filtered through 0.22 µm membrane). (Temperature: RT, preparation step)

5.2 Incubation with Congo red working solution (0.5% wt/vol in 80% ethanol/0.5% NaCl). (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours, gentle rocking, protected from light)

5.3 Differentiation wash: Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) ethanol in H₂O to remove non-specifically bound dye. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes × 2 washes)

5.4 Wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3 washes, protected from light)

---

### 6 Tissue Dehydration (iDISCO+ Clearing — Dehydration Series)

6.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

6.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

6.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

6.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

6.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

6.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

---

### 7 Delipidation

7.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol (DCM:MeOH = 1:2 vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, gentle rocking, protected from light, use glass container)

7.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (pure dichloromethane). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes × 2 washes, protected from light, glass container)

---

### 8 Refractive Index Matching with DBE

8.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014) without shaking. Ensure sample is fully submerged. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, protected from light, glass container)

8.2 Replace with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE and incubate until sample is fully transparent (typically overnight to 24 hours for whole adult mouse brain). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours, protected from light, glass container, no shaking)

---

### 9 Sample Storage and Pre-imaging Preparation

9.1 Transfer cleared brain to a glass imaging chamber or custom-made sample holder filled with fresh 100% DBE. Seal with optical-quality glass coverslip using silicone sealant. (Temperature: RT, protected from light)

9.2 Store cleared sample in DBE in sealed glass container at RT, protected from light, until imaging. Samples are stable for up to 4 weeks under these conditions. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 4 weeks maximum)

9.3 Prior to light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) imaging: equilibrate sample in imaging chamber with fresh DBE (RI = 1.56) for at least 2 hours to ensure complete RI equilibration and eliminate residual bubbles. (Temperature: RT, Time: ≥ 2 hours)

9.4 Imaging channel configuration for LSFM: Channel 1 — DAPI (405 nm excitation / 450 nm emission) for cytoarchitecture and brain atlas registration; Channel 2 — Congo red (561 nm excitation / 620 nm emission) for β-sheet amyloid plaques; Channel 3 — Alexa Fluor 647 (638 nm excitation / 680 nm emission) for 6E10-immunolabeled Aβ deposits. Acquire whole-brain Z-stack at 2–5 µm step size with 4× or 12× objective (RI-corrected, DBE-immersion). (Temperature: RT, imaging session)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it provides excellent whole-tissue delipidation and antibody penetration for large tissue blocks (~8×6×5 mm), making it ideal for deep 3D imaging of tumor-associated vascular networks. The methanol-based dehydration/rehydration cycle and detergent-based permeabilization enable efficient antibody penetration throughout the full depth of the glioblastoma-containing brain block. iDISCO+ is highly compatible with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM), which is optimal for reconstructing 3D vascular atlases. The dual-antibody strategy targets two complementary aspects of the blood-brain barrier (BBB): CD31 (PECAM1) labels pan-endothelial cells to visualize vessel morphology, branching, diameter, density, and continuity across tumor core, tumor margin, and adjacent normal brain; Claudin-5 labels tight junction proteins specifically at the BBB, enabling spatial mapping of BBB integrity and disruption in tumor versus non-tumor regions. Lectin (intravascular perfusion or post-fixation staining) provides an orthogonal vascular lumen label to confirm vessel patency and complement CD31 signal. Alexa Fluor 647 and Alexa Fluor 568 are both highly photostable, compatible with iDISCO+ organic solvent clearing, and spectrally well-separated for simultaneous 3-channel imaging. DBE (dibenzyl ether) as the final RI-matching medium (RI ≈ 1.56) is optimal for LSFM imaging of this tissue size.

**1 Pre-clearing Tissue Preparation**
1.1 Confirm tissue block (~8 mm × 6 mm × 5 mm) has been fixed in 4% PFA/PBS at 4 °C for 24 hours and post-fixed. Wash tissue in 1× PBS. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 3 × 30 min)
1.2 Optional: Perform intracardiac perfusion with fluorescently conjugated Lectin (e.g., Lectin-DyLight 488, 0.1 mg/mL in PBS, 10 mL) prior to sacrifice and fixation to label perfused vascular lumens. **3 Bleaching**
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH) to reduce autofluorescence from the tumor tissue. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31 + Alexa Fluor 647, Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor 568 (or equivalent secondary), Lectin (fluorescent-conjugated, e.g., Lectin-FITC for perfusion labeling of patent vessels)]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) it achieves excellent clearing of ~8×6×5 mm mouse brain tissue blocks through organic solvent-based delipidation, enabling deep antibody penetration and high-contrast 3D imaging; (2) it is highly compatible with immunolabeling of vascular markers in fixed brain tissue; (3) the methanol-based dehydration/bleaching step effectively removes background autofluorescence, which is critical for resolving fine vascular structures in tumor-bearing brain; (4) the final DBE-based RI matching (n ≈ 1.56) is well-suited for light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM), the optimal modality for volumetric vascular network analysis.

**Dual-target labeling rationale:**
- **CD31 (PECAM-1) + Alexa Fluor 647**: pan-endothelial marker labeling all vessel segments (tumor core, invasion front, normal parenchyma); enables 3D reconstruction of the entire vascular network and quantification of vessel density, tortuosity, and co-option patterns.
- **Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor 568**: tight junction protein specifically expressed at the blood-brain barrier (BBB); spatial loss or discontinuity of Claudin-5 signal relative to CD31+ vessels directly reports BBB disruption and barrier remodeling at the tumor-vessel interface.
- **Lectin (fluorescent-conjugated, e.g., FITC-Lectin)**: if intravascular perfusion labeling was performed prior to fixation, this marks only perfused/patent lumens, allowing discrimination of functional vs. remodeled/collapsed vessels. If perfusion was not performed, this step is omitted and CD31 alone serves as the vascular marker.

This combination allows simultaneous 3D mapping of: (i) total vascular architecture (CD31), (ii) BBB integrity (Claudin-5), and (iii) vessel patency (Lectin), directly addressing the scientific goals of vascular co-option, remodeling, and barrier disruption in GBM invasion.

---

## Protocol Steps

### 0 Pre-clearing Preparation (assumed: tissue already PFA-fixed and post-fixed)

0.1 Wash fixed tissue block (~8×6×5 mm) in 1× PBS with gentle rocking to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

0.2 Transfer tissue to 1× PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PTx0.2) for initial permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

---

### 1 Dehydration (Methanol Series)

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O (ddH₂O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 2 Bleaching (Autofluorescence Quenching)

2.1 Prepare fresh bleaching solution: 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes 100% MeOH). Pre-chill to 4 °C before use.

2.2 Incubation with chilled 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12–16 hours, overnight, protected from light)

---

### 3 Rehydration

3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.5 Incubation with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.6 Incubation with 1× PBS, second wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 4 Permeabilization and Blocking

4.1 Incubation with permeabilization buffer: 1× PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine (PTxs-Gly). (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours, with gentle rocking)

4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer: 1× PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (PBSDT + 10% DMSO). (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours, with gentle rocking)

---

### 5 Primary Antibody Labeling

5.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in antibody diluent buffer (1× PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10% DMSO + 3% normal donkey serum, PBSDT):
- Anti-CD31 (PECAM-1) rabbit monoclonal antibody: 1:200 dilution
- Anti-Claudin-5 mouse monoclonal antibody: 1:150 dilution

5.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail solution, with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 5–7 days, protected from light; for this tissue size, 7 days recommended for full penetration)

5.3 Wash with 1× PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 0.1% (wt/vol) heparin (PTwH). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, with gentle rocking)

---

### 6 Secondary Antibody Labeling

6.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in PBSDT:
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647: 1:400 dilution (for CD31 detection)
- Donkey anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568: 1:400 dilution (for Claudin-5 detection)

6.2 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail solution, with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 3–5 days, protected from light)

6.3 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, with gentle rocking)

6.4 Final overnight wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, with gentle rocking)

---

### 7 Fluorescent Lectin Staining (Optional — if intravascular perfusion labeling was not performed in vivo)

7.1 If in vivo perfusion with fluorescent lectin was not performed: incubate tissue with FITC-conjugated Lycopersicon esculentum (tomato) lectin at 50 µg/mL in 1× PBS + 0.2% Tween-20. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours, with gentle rocking, protected from light)

7.2 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

*Note: If in vivo intravascular FITC-Lectin perfusion was performed prior to fixation, steps 7.1–7.2 are omitted.*

---

### 8 Dehydration (Pre-clearing, Methanol Series)

8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 9 Delipidation (Dichloromethane Treatment)

9.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 33% methanol (DCM:MeOH = 2:1, vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, with gentle rocking in a chemical fume hood)

9.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM, first change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min, with gentle rocking)

9.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM, second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min, with gentle rocking)

*Note: Tissue should sink to the bottom of the vial in 100% DCM, indicating complete delipidation. If tissue floats, extend DCM incubation by 15 min increments.*

---

### 10 Refractive Index Matching (Clearing)

10.1 Remove DCM completely and immediately transfer tissue to 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014; RI ≈ 1.562). Ensure tissue is fully submerged. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3–4 hours, without shaking, protected from light)

10.2 Replace with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE. (Temperature: RT, Time: overnight (12–16 hours), without shaking, protected from light)

*Note: Tissue should become fully transparent and optically clear after this step. Do not use parafilm to seal vials as DBE dissolves it; use glass vials with PTFE-lined caps.*

---

### 11 Storage and Pre-imaging Preparation

11.1 Store cleared tissue in 100% DBE in sealed glass vials, protected from light. (Temperature: RT or 4 °C, Time: up to 4 weeks; for long-term storage, 4 °C is preferred)

11.2 For imaging: mount tissue in a custom imaging chamber or glass-bottom dish filled with 100% DBE. Use DBE-compatible adhesive (e.g., silicone grease) to seal the chamber and prevent evaporation.

11.3 Allow tissue to equilibrate in the imaging chamber before acquisition. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

11.4 For light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM): use an objective lens compatible with DBE immersion (RI ≈ 1.56; e.g., CLARITY/organic solvent-compatible objectives). Recommended imaging channels:
- Channel 1 (488 nm excitation / 525 nm emission): FITC-Lectin (patent vessel lumens)
- Channel 2 (561 nm excitation / 590 nm emission): Alexa Fluor 568 (Claudin-5 / BBB integrity)
- Channel 3 (647 nm excitation / 680 nm emission): Alexa Fluor 647 (CD31 / total vasculature)

11.5 Acquire full volumetric z-stacks spanning the entire tissue block at appropriate step size (recommended: 2–5 µm z-step for vascular network analysis; 1 µm z-step for high-resolution barrier structure analysis at invasion front).

我尝试使用 CUBIC 处理 GBM 脑组织，但透明化后肿瘤组织形态破坏严重，血管网络出现断裂，导致无法可靠分析肿瘤边界、血管连续性和沿血管侵袭路径。原 protocol 为：CUBIC-L 在 37°C 处理 7 天，然后直接放入 CUBIC-R。请根据上述科学目标，在不引入给定标记物列表之外靶点或表外荧光团的前提下，重新选择或调整荧光/标记策略与组织透明方法，使其适合肿瘤脑组织形态保持、血管网络连续性保留、屏障相关结构检测和深层三维成像。

请仅输出修正后的 protocol，第 1 行写明应保留或更换的双靶点荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS

**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (凝集素), CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor, Claudin-5 + Alexa Fluor, Collagen IV + Alexa Fluor, GFAP + Alexa Fluor, DAPI]

**Justification:**
PEGASOS（Polyethylene Glycol-associated Solvent System）被选择的核心理由如下：

1. **形态保持优越**：PEGASOS 采用温和的 PEG 基溶剂体系，相较于 CUBIC-L（强碱性去污剂，37°C 长时间处理）对蛋白质和细胞外基质的破坏显著更小，能有效保留 GBM 肿瘤组织的细胞形态和血管网络连续性，直接解决原 CUBIC 方案中肿瘤形态破坏和血管断裂的问题。
2. **血管网络完整性**：PEGASOS 对胶原蛋白等细胞外基质成分保留良好，适合血管基底膜（Collagen IV）和血脑屏障相关结构（Claudin-5）的完整保存。
3. **深层组织透明化**：对于 8×6×5 mm 的脑组织块，PEGASOS 可实现充分透明化，RI 匹配至约 1.52，适合光片显微镜深层三维成像。
4. **荧光兼容性**：PEGASOS 对 Alexa Fluor 系列荧光团和化学染料（DAPI、Lectin）兼容性良好，荧光信号保留率高。
5. **标记策略设计**：
   - **Lectin（血管腔内灌注）**：标记开放管腔的功能性血管，评估血管连续性和通畅性；
   - **CD31/PECAM1**：标记全部血管内皮细胞，包括功能性和非功能性血管，与 Lectin 联用可区分血管完整性；
   - **Claudin-5**：紧密连接蛋白，直接评估血脑屏障结构完整性，在肿瘤核心、边缘和周围脑组织中进行比较；
   - **Collagen IV**：血管基底膜标志物，评估血管基底膜完整性及肿瘤侵袭对基底膜的破坏；
   - **GFAP**：标记星形胶质细胞和肿瘤细胞（GBM 多为 GFAP+），用于界定肿瘤主体、侵袭前沿与邻近脑实质边界；
   - **DAPI**：核染色，提供细胞密度参考和组织结构背景。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**0 前提条件说明**
样本已完成 4% PFA 灌注固定及后固定（4% PFA，4°C，过夜），并已在 PBS 中充分漂洗。如需 Lectin 血管灌注标记，应在动物灌注固定前经心脏灌注荧光标记 Lectin（如 Lectin-DyLight 649），此步骤在动物处死前完成；若样本已固定，则改用免疫染色 CD31 替代灌注 Lectin 评估血管腔。

**1 灌注 Lectin 血管标记（建议在灌注固定前完成；若样本已固定则跳至步骤 2）**

1.1 配制 Lectin-DyLight 649（或 Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647）工作液：将 0.1 mg/mL Lectin 溶于无菌 PBS 中，过 0.22 μm 滤膜备用。(Temperature: RT, Time: 配制即用)

1.2 经心脏左心室插管，先用 20 mL 预温 PBS 冲洗循环血液，流速约 5 mL/min。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 约 4 min)

1.3 随即灌注 10 mL Lectin-DyLight 649 工作液（0.1 mg/mL in PBS），流速约 2 mL/min，使 Lectin 充分结合血管内皮糖萼。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 约 5 min)

1.4 立即灌注 20 mL 4% PFA（in 0.1 M PBS，pH 7.4）进行原位固定，流速约 5 mL/min。(Temperature: RT, Time: 约 4 min)

1.5 取脑，在 4% PFA 中后固定。(Temperature: 4°C, Time: 12–16 hours)

1.6 PBS 漂洗 3 次，每次 10 min，去除残余 PFA。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min total)

**2 样本修整与预处理**

2.1 在解剖显微镜下将脑组织修整为包含肿瘤区域及邻近脑组织的目标组织块（约 8 mm × 6 mm × 5 mm），用锋利刀片切割，避免挤压变形。(Temperature: RT, Time: 操作时间约 10 min)

2.2 将组织块置于 24 孔板或 15 mL 离心管中，加入足量 PBS（约 5 mL），在摇床上轻柔漂洗 3 次，每次 10 min，彻底去除残余 PFA。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min total)

2.3 配制 0.1 M 甘氨酸/PBS 溶液（pH 7.4），加入组织块，封闭游离醛基，减少背景荧光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.4 PBS 漂洗 2 次，每次 10 min。(Temperature: RT, Time: 20 min total)

**3 脱色（去除血红素，提高透明化效率）**

3.1 配制 25% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.5% (wt/vol) H₂O₂ in PBS 溶液（现配现用），加入组织块，在摇床上轻柔振荡，去除血红素色素，减少光吸收干扰。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 24 hours)

3.2 PBS 漂洗 3 次，每次 30 min，充分去除 H₂O₂ 和 DMSO。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours total)

**4 渗透性增强预处理（提高抗体渗透深度）**

4.1 配制渗透缓冲液：PBS 含 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M 甘氨酸，加入组织块，在摇床上轻柔振荡，增强组织渗透性。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 24 hours)

4.2 配制封闭缓冲液：PBS 含 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清（NDS），加入组织块，封闭非特异性结合位点。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 24 hours)

**5 一抗孵育（免疫荧光标记）**

5.1 配制一抗工作液（抗体稀释于 PTwH 缓冲液：PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 μg/mL 肝素 + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS）：
- 抗 CD31（PECAM1）抗体：1:200 稀释（用于标记全部血管内皮）
- 抗 Claudin-5 抗体：1:150 稀释（用于评估血脑屏障紧密连接完整性）
- 抗 Collagen IV 抗体：1:200 稀释（用于标记血管基底膜）
- 抗 GFAP 抗体：1:300 稀释（用于界定肿瘤边界和星形胶质细胞反应）
将上述一抗混合后加入组织块，确保组织完全浸没（约 1–2 mL/样本），在摇床上轻柔振荡。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 5 days)

5.2 PTwH 缓冲液漂洗 5 次，每次 1 hour，在摇床上轻柔振荡，充分去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours total)

**6 二抗孵育（荧光标记）**

6.1 配制二抗工作液（稀释于 PTwH + 3% NDS）：
- 驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 488（对应 CD31，若一抗为兔源）：1:400 稀释
- 驴抗大鼠 Alexa Fluor 546（对应 Claudin-5，若一抗为大鼠源）：1:400 稀释
- 驴抗山羊 Alexa Fluor 594（对应 Collagen IV，若一抗为山羊源）：1:400 稀释
- 驴抗鸡 Alexa Fluor 647（对应 GFAP，若一抗为鸡源）：1:400 稀释
（注：具体二抗种属需根据实际一抗来源物种调整，确保各通道光谱分离；Lectin-DyLight 649 已在灌注步骤完成标记，若未灌注则在此步骤加入 Lectin-Alexa Fluor 488 替代 CD31 通道之一）
将二抗混合液加入组织块，避光，在摇床上轻柔振荡。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 3 days)

6.2 PTwH 缓冲液漂洗 5 次，每次 1 hour，避光，充分去除未结合二抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours total)

**7 DAPI 核染色**

7.1 配制 DAPI 工作液：10 μg/mL DAPI in PBS（含 0.1% Triton X-100），加入组织块，避光，在摇床上轻柔振荡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

7.2 PBS 漂洗 3 次，每次 30 min，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours total)

**8 PEGASOS 透明化处理**

8.1 配制 PEGASOS 脱脂液 A（tB-PEG 溶液）：将叔丁醇（tert-butanol，tB）与 PEG（Kolliphor EL，Sigma）按体积比 1:1 混合，预热至 37°C 使 PEG 完全溶解，配制 tB-PEG 工作液（tB:PEG = 1:1，vol/vol）。

8.2 梯度脱水/脱脂步骤一：将组织块转入 30% (vol/vol) tB-PEG 水溶液（30% tB-PEG + 70% ddH₂O）中，在摇床上轻柔振荡，避光。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 12 hours)

8.3 梯度脱水/脱脂步骤二：将组织块转入 50% (vol/vol) tB-PEG 水溶液中，在摇床上轻柔振荡，避光。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 12 hours)

8.4 梯度脱水/脱脂步骤三：将组织块转入 70% (vol/vol) tB-PEG 水溶液中，在摇床上轻柔振荡，避光。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 12 hours)

8.5 梯度脱水/脱脂步骤四：将组织块转入 100% tB-PEG 溶液（纯 tB:PEG = 1:1，vol/vol）中，在摇床上轻柔振荡，避光。此步骤完成脂质去除和脱水，组织应逐渐变透明。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 24 hours)

8.6 更换新鲜 100% tB-PEG 溶液，继续孵育，确保脱脂完全，组织充分透明化。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 12 hours)

**9 折射率匹配（RI Matching）**

9.1 配制 PEGASOS RI 匹配液（PEGASOS-RI）：将 PEG（Kolliphor EL）与苯甲醇（benzyl alcohol，BA）按体积比混合，调节至目标 RI = 1.52（参考配方：Kolliphor EL:BA = 3:1，vol/vol，实际 RI 需用折射仪验证并微调）。预热至 37°C 使混合均匀。

9.2 将透明化后的组织块直接从 100% tB-PEG 转入 PEGASOS-RI 匹配液中，避光，在摇床上轻柔振荡，使组织 RI 与成像介质完全匹配，组织应呈现高度透明状态。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 24 hours)

9.3 更换新鲜 PEGASOS-RI 匹配液，继续孵育至组织完全透明（无可见散射），用折射仪确认 RI 匹配液 RI 值为 1.52 ± 0.01。(Temperature: 37°C, Time: 12 hours)

**10 样本保存与成像前处理**

10.1 将透明化组织块转移至成像专用容器（如 FEP 管、玻璃底培养皿或定制样本槽），加入足量 PEGASOS-RI 匹配液完全浸没组织，避免气泡，避光密封保存。(Temperature: RT, Time: 可保存数周至数月)

10.2 成像前将样本在 PEGASOS-RI 匹配液中平衡，确认组织无形变、无气泡，在折射仪下确认成像介质 RI = 1.52，与光片显微镜（LSFM）或共聚焦显微镜物镜的设计 RI 匹配。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 hours)

10.3 光片显微镜成像参数建议：使用与 RI = 1.52 匹配的浸液物镜（如 Zeiss Z.1 或 LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope 配套物镜），激发波长根据荧光通道选择（405 nm/DAPI，488 nm/Alexa Fluor 488，546 nm/Alexa Fluor 546，594 nm/Alexa Fluor 594，647 nm/Alexa Fluor 647 或 DyLight 649），Z 轴步长设置为 2–5 μm，覆盖全组织块深度，采集完整三维数据集用于肿瘤-血管空间关系分析。(Temperature: RT, Time: 根据成像范围和分辨率设置，约 2–8 hours/样本)

**Chosen Method:** ScaleS

**Chosen Labeling:** [EGFP (内源荧光), MAP2 + Alexa Fluor (免疫荧光标记树突结构)]

**Justification:**
ScaleS 是一种基于山梨醇/尿素的水性透明方法，专为保留内源荧光蛋白信号（包括 GFP/EGFP 等弱荧光报告信号）而设计，在透明化过程中不使用有机溶剂或强去垢剂，对荧光蛋白的保护效果显著优于 iDISCO+/uDISCO 等有机溶剂法。对于 3 mm 厚脑组织块，ScaleS 可在合理时间内实现充分透明，同时维持组织抗原性，支持后续免疫荧光标记。双靶点策略：① 利用稀疏荧光报告小鼠内源 EGFP 信号直接显示标记神经元胞体和轴突；② 使用 MAP2 抗体（Alexa Fluor 标记二抗）对树突进行免疫荧光增强标记，弥补内源信号微弱导致树突细节不清的问题，实现树突形态、分支和局部投射的三维分析。ScaleS 最终 RI 匹配液（ScaleS4）RI ≈ 1.44，适合长期保存且荧光稳定，可反复成像。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样本预处理与透化**

1.1 将已完成 4% PFA 固定和后固定的 3 mm 小鼠脑组织块用 1× PBS 充分漂洗，去除残余固定液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 10 min)

1.2 将组织块转入 ScaleS0 溶液（20% (wt/vol) 山梨醇，5% (wt/vol) 甘油，1 mmol/L EDTA，0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100，0.5 mmol/L 甲基-β-环糊精，1× PBS）中孵育，轻摇，用于初步脱脂和透化。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 hours)

1.3 用 1× PBS 漂洗组织块，去除 ScaleS0 残液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 10 min)

---

**2 免疫荧光标记（MAP2）**

2.1 将组织块转入封闭液（5% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清，0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100，0.1% (wt/vol) 叠氮化钠，1× PBS）中孵育，轻摇封闭非特异性结合位点。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

2.2 将组织块转入一抗孵育液（兔抗 MAP2 抗体，1:500 稀释于封闭液中，含 0.5% Triton X-100）中孵育，4 ℃ 轻摇，充分渗透标记树突结构。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5 days)

2.3 用洗涤液（0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100，0.1% (wt/vol) 叠氮化钠，1× PBS）充分漂洗，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

2.4 将组织块转入二抗孵育液（驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 647，1:500 稀释于封闭液中，含 0.5% Triton X-100，避光）中孵育，4 ℃ 轻摇。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 days)

2.5 用洗涤液（0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100，1× PBS，避光）充分漂洗，去除未结合二抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

2.6 用 1× PBS 末次漂洗，去除洗涤液残留。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

---

**3 组织透明化**

3.1 将标记后的组织块转入 ScaleS1 溶液（20% (wt/vol) 山梨醇，15% (wt/vol) 尿素，0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100，1× PBS）中孵育，轻摇，开始梯度透明化。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 day)

3.2 将组织块转入 ScaleS2 溶液（30% (wt/vol) 山梨醇，20% (wt/vol) 尿素，0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100，1× PBS）中孵育，轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 day)

3.3 将组织块转入 ScaleS3 溶液（40% (wt/vol) 山梨醇，25% (wt/vol) 尿素，0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100，1× PBS）中孵育，轻摇，进一步提升透明度。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)

3.4 目视检查透明度，若组织尚未充分透明，可在 ScaleS3 中延长孵育至透明度满意为止（最长可延长至 4 days）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1–2 days additional if needed)

---

**4 折射率匹配（RI Matching）**

4.1 将透明化组织块转入 ScaleS4(0) 溶液（40% (wt/vol) 山梨醇，10% (wt/vol) 尿素，15% (vol/vol) 甘油，0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100，1× PBS，RI ≈ 1.44）中孵育，避光，轻摇，完成折射率匹配。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)

4.2 更换新鲜 ScaleS4(0) 溶液，继续孵育至组织完全透明且 RI 均一，确认组织在溶液中几乎不可见。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

---

**5 长期保存**

5.1 将 RI 匹配完成的组织块保存于新鲜 ScaleS4(0) 溶液中，置于密封避光容器中，防止蒸发和光漂白。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 长期保存，可稳定保存 ≥ 6 months)

5.2 每 4–6 周更换一次新鲜 ScaleS4(0) 溶液，维持 RI 匹配状态和荧光稳定性。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 每次更换后平衡 12 hours)

---

**6 成像前处理**

6.1 从 4 ℃ 取出保存样本，在室温下平衡，避免因温度变化导致 RI 波动影响成像质量。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.2 将组织块转移至成像腔室（低荧光玻璃底皿或定制样本槽），用 ScaleS4(0) 溶液充满腔室作为浸没介质，确保物镜与样本之间 RI 匹配（RI ≈ 1.44，适配水浸或专用 RI 匹配物镜）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min 平衡)

6.3 使用激光共聚焦显微镜或光片显微镜进行三维成像：EGFP 通道（激发 488 nm，发射 505–530 nm）采集内源荧光报告神经元信号；Alexa Fluor 647 通道（激发 633/647 nm，发射 660–720 nm）采集 MAP2 标记树突信号；两通道分别采集后叠加，用于神经元胞体、树突分支、树突长度和局部投射模式的三维重建分析。(Temperature: RT, Time: 按实验需求)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [EGFP (内源荧光), MAP2 + Alexa Fluor (树突标记，推荐 Alexa Fluor 546 或 Alexa Fluor 647)]

**Justification:**
FDISCO（Fluorescence-preserving 3D Imaging of Solvent-Cleared Organs）是基于有机溶剂（3-苯甲醇/苯甲酸苄酯，BABB 体系改良）的透明方法，其核心优势在于在低温（4 ℃）条件下操作，可显著抑制荧光蛋白（如 EGFP）的淬灭，相比经典 iDISCO+/uDISCO 在 GFP/EGFP 等绿色荧光蛋白保留上表现更优。对于 3 mm 厚脑组织块，FDISCO 可在数天内实现完全透明，折射率匹配效果好（RI ≈ 1.56），适合光片显微镜（LSFM）或共聚焦成像。长期保存方面，FDISCO 样本在 BABB 中密封避光可稳定保存 6 个月以上，荧光衰减较慢。

双靶点策略：
- **靶点 1**：内源 EGFP 荧光（稀疏报告神经元胞体及轴突）——直接利用内源信号，无需抗体扩增，避免额外操作引入的信号损失。
- **靶点 2**：MAP2 抗体（+ Alexa Fluor 546 或 Alexa Fluor 647 二抗）——MAP2 是树突特异性微管相关蛋白，可完整显示树突树形态及分支细节，补全内源 EGFP 信号微弱区域的形态信息；Alexa Fluor 系列染料在有机溶剂中稳定性优良，与 FDISCO 兼容。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样本预处理与渗透性增强（Permeabilization）**

1.1 将已完成 4% PFA 固定及后固定的 3 mm 脑组织块用 1× PBS 洗涤 3 次，每次充分振荡。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 10 min × 3 次）

1.2 将组织块置于含 0.2% Triton X-100 的 1× PBS（PTwH：0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL 肝素亦可替代）中进行渗透处理，轻摇。（Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours）

1.3 用 1× PBS 洗涤组织块 3 次，每次轻摇。（Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min × 3 次）

---

**2 封闭（Blocking）**

2.1 将组织块置于封闭液（含 5% 正常驴血清 + 0.3% Triton X-100 + 0.2% 叠氮化钠的 1× PBS）中孵育，轻摇。（Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours）

---

**3 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）**

3.1 配制一抗工作液：抗 MAP2 抗体（兔源多克隆或鸡源，推荐 1:500 稀释）溶于含 2% 正常驴血清 + 0.3% Triton X-100 + 0.2% 叠氮化钠的 1× PBS 中。将组织块完全浸没于一抗工作液，轻摇。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5–7 days）

3.2 用含 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL 肝素的 1× PBS（PTwH）洗涤组织块，每次充分振荡，共 5 次。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 5 次）

---

**4 二抗孵育（Secondary Antibody Incubation）**

4.1 配制二抗工作液：驴抗兔（或驴抗鸡）Alexa Fluor 546（或 Alexa Fluor 647）二抗（1:500 稀释）溶于含 2% 正常驴血清 + 0.3% Triton X-100 + 0.2% 叠氮化钠的 1× PBS 中，避光。将组织块完全浸没，轻摇，避光。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 4–5 days）

4.2 用 PTwH 洗涤组织块，避光，每次充分振荡，共 5 次。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 5 次）

4.3 用 1× PBS 终洗 2 次，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min × 2 次）

---

**5 脱水（Dehydration）**

> 注意：从本步骤起全程在通风橱中操作，所有步骤避光，使用玻璃容器。低温操作是 FDISCO 保留 EGFP 荧光的关键。

5.1 将组织块置于 30%（vol/vol）四氢呋喃（THF）水溶液（用超纯水配制，pH 调至 9.0 以减少荧光淬灭，可加入 0.1% 叔丁基羟基甲苯 BHT 作为抗氧化剂）中，轻摇，避光。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour）

5.2 将组织块置于 50%（vol/vol）THF 水溶液（含 0.1% BHT，pH 9.0）中，轻摇，避光。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour）

5.3 将组织块置于 70%（vol/vol）THF 水溶液（含 0.1% BHT，pH 9.0）中，轻摇，避光。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour）

5.4 将组织块置于 80%（vol/vol）THF 水溶液（含 0.1% BHT，pH 9.0）中，轻摇，避光。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour）

5.5 将组织块置于 100%（vol/vol）THF（无水，含 0.1% BHT）中，轻摇，避光。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour）

5.6 更换新鲜 100%（vol/vol）THF（无水，含 0.1% BHT），轻摇，避光。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour）

---

**6 脱脂与透明化（Delipidation & Clearing）**

6.1 将完全脱水的组织块转移至二氯甲烷（DCM，Sigma-Aldrich，≥99.9%）中，轻摇，避光。此步骤完成脱脂，组织应在数分钟内沉底并开始变透明。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 30–45 min）

---

**7 折射率匹配（Refractive Index Matching）**

7.1 将组织块从 DCM 中取出，用吸水纸轻轻吸去表面残余 DCM（勿过度干燥），立即转移至苯甲醇/苯甲酸苄酯混合液（BABB，苯甲醇:苯甲酸苄酯 = 1:2，vol/vol；RI ≈ 1.56；含 0.1% BHT 抗氧化）中，轻摇，避光。组织应完全透明。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2–4 hours，直至组织完全透明且无气泡）

7.2 更换新鲜 BABB（含 0.1% BHT），确认组织完全透明，静置平衡折射率，避光。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours）

---

**8 成像前处理（Pre-imaging Preparation）**

8.1 将透明组织块转移至玻璃成像腔（glass imaging chamber）或自制玻璃底培养皿中，加入足量新鲜 BABB（含 0.1% BHT）完全浸没样本，用折射率匹配的光学胶或盖玻片密封，避免气泡，避光。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 30 min 平衡后即可成像）

8.2 使用光片显微镜（LSFM，推荐配备 RI = 1.56 浸液物镜）或长工作距离共聚焦显微镜进行三维成像。激发通道：EGFP（488 nm 激发/510–540 nm 发射）；MAP2-Alexa Fluor 546（561 nm 激发/570–620 nm 发射）或 MAP2-Alexa Fluor 647（633/647 nm 激发/660–720 nm 发射）。

---

**9 长期保存（Long-term Storage）**

9.1 成像完成后，将样本密封于含新鲜 BABB（含 0.1% BHT）的棕色玻璃小瓶中，用 Parafilm 封口，置于避光密封盒内。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 可稳定保存 ≥ 6 months）

9.2 复查成像前，将样本从 4 ℃ 取出，在室温下平衡 30 min，确认 BABB 液面充足（如有挥发可补加新鲜 BABB），按步骤 8.1–8.2 重新成像。（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min 平衡）

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO

**Chosen Labeling:** [EGFP (endogenous), MAP2 + Alexa Fluor (secondary conjugate)]

**Justification:**
FDISCO (Fluorescence-preserved Delipidation with Isopropanol and Solvent-based Clearing) is selected for the following reasons specific to this problem statement:
1. **Weak endogenous fluorescence preservation:** FDISCO operates at low temperature (4 °C) throughout the organic-solvent dehydration and clearing steps, which critically preserves weak GFP-family fluorescence signals (here EGFP from sparse reporter neurons) far better than room-temperature solvent methods such as standard iDISCO+ or uDISCO.
2. **3 mm tissue block compatibility:** FDISCO achieves excellent clearing of thick (≥3 mm) brain blocks within a practical timeframe without requiring perfusion-based whole-organ processing.
3. **Long-term storage compatibility:** FDISCO-cleared samples stored in DBE (dibenzyl ether, RI ≈ 1.56) are stable for months at 4 °C in the dark, meeting the 6-month storage requirement.
4. **Dual-target labeling rationale:**
   - **Target 1 – Sparse reporter neurons (EGFP, endogenous):** Directly exploits the existing fluorescent reporter signal; no additional antibody amplification is needed for sparse labeling, reducing background.
   - **Target 2 – MAP2 + Alexa Fluor secondary:** MAP2 immunolabeling (performed before clearing via a pre-clearing immunostaining step compatible with FDISCO) provides a pan-dendritic structural counterstain that enables dendritic skeleton reconstruction, branching complexity analysis, and local circuit morphology independent of reporter expression level. A far-red secondary (e.g., Alexa Fluor 647) is chosen to spectrally separate from EGFP and to minimize tissue autofluorescence overlap.
5. **RI matching:** DBE (RI = 1.56) provides excellent RI matching for light-sheet or confocal imaging of solvent-cleared samples and is compatible with long-term immersion storage.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Pre-clearing Immunostaining (MAP2 labeling before organic solvent steps)**

1.1 Wash fixed 3 mm brain blocks (post-fixed in 4% PFA) 3× with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min per wash)

1.2 Permeabilization and blocking: incubate tissue in blocking/permeabilization buffer [0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours, with gentle shaking)

1.3 Primary antibody incubation: incubate with anti-MAP2 rabbit polyclonal antibody [1:500 dilution in antibody diluent: 0.5% Triton X-100, 5% normal donkey serum, 0.1% sodium azide in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours, with gentle shaking)

1.4 Wash 5× with 1× PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

1.5 Secondary antibody incubation: incubate with donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody [1:500 dilution in antibody diluent as in step 1.3]. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours, with gentle shaking, protected from light)

1.6 Wash 5× with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

1.7 Post-immunostaining fixation: incubate in 4% (wt/vol) PFA in 1× PBS to crosslink antibodies in place. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, with gentle shaking)

1.8 Wash 3× with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min per wash)

---

**2 Dehydration (FDISCO — all steps at 4 °C, protected from light)**

2.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF) in ddH₂O (freshly prepared, stabilizer-free THF). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)

2.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) THF in ddH₂O. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)

2.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) THF in ddH₂O. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)

2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF in ddH₂O. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)

2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF (anhydrous). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)

2.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) THF (anhydrous). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour, with gentle shaking)

---

**3 Delipidation and Clearing**

3.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM, 100%, anhydrous) for delipidation. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 30 min, with gentle shaking; use glass vials, fume hood)

3.2 Remove DCM completely by aspiration; do not allow tissue to dry.

---

**4 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing in DBE**

4.1 Incubation with dibenzyl ether (DBE, 100%, Sigma-Aldrich 108014) — first exchange. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 2 hours, with gentle shaking, protected from light)

4.2 Incubation with fresh DBE (100%) — second exchange until tissue is fully transparent. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 4–6 hours or overnight, with gentle shaking, protected from light)

4.3 Verify optical transparency visually; tissue should appear fully clear. If residual opacity remains, replace with fresh DBE and continue incubation for an additional 4 hours at 4 °C.

---

**5 Long-term Storage**

5.1 Transfer cleared tissue to a sealed glass vial filled with fresh 100% DBE (RI = 1.56). Ensure complete submersion and absence of air bubbles. (Temperature: 4 °C, protected from light, Time: up to 6 months)

5.2 Label vials with sample ID, clearing date, and antibody/fluorophore information. Store upright in a light-tight container at 4 °C.

5.3 Inspect samples every 4–6 weeks for clarity and potential DBE evaporation; replenish DBE if volume decreases.

---

**6 Pre-imaging Preparation (at time of imaging, including after long-term storage)**

6.1 Remove sample from storage DBE; transfer to a fresh glass vial with 100% DBE for equilibration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min, protected from light)

6.2 Mount sample in a custom imaging chamber (e.g., FEP tube or glass-bottom dish) filled with 100% DBE (RI = 1.56) compatible with the objective immersion medium.

6.3 For light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM): use a long-working-distance objective corrected for RI = 1.56 (e.g., CLARITY/CUBIC-compatible objective or a custom-dipping objective with DBE-compatible immersion). Imaging channels: 488 nm excitation / 510–540 nm emission (EGFP, sparse reporter neurons); 633/647 nm excitation / 660–720 nm emission (Alexa Fluor 647, MAP2 dendritic counterstain).

6.4 For confocal imaging: use an oil-immersion or RI-matched objective; apply a coverslip with DBE as mounting medium and seal edges with two-component epoxy to prevent evaporation during long imaging sessions.

6.5 After imaging, return sample to sealed glass vial with fresh DBE for continued storage at 4 °C if repeat imaging is planned. (Temperature: 4 °C, protected from light)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** FDISCO

**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP (内源荧光保留), MAP2 + Alexa Fluor (树突结构补全)]

**Justification:**
FDISCO（Fluorescence-preserved 3D Imaging of Solvent-Cleared Organs）是基于有机溶剂的透明化方法，专为保留内源荧光蛋白信号而优化：在脱水和折射率匹配步骤中全程使用低温（4 ℃）操作，并以四氢呋喃（THF）替代甲醇进行脱水，显著减少荧光淬灭；最终以DBE（二苄基醚）作为RI匹配介质（RI ≈ 1.56），对3 mm厚脑组织块可实现完全透明。相比iDISCO+（甲醇脱水对弱荧光破坏大）和CUBIC（水性方法对厚块透明效率低），FDISCO在弱内源GFP/YFP/tdTomato信号保留与厚组织透明之间取得最佳平衡。

标记策略：
- **通道1**：保留内源荧光报告蛋白（GFP/EGFP/YFP/tdTomato，依实际报告小鼠品系而定），用于定位稀疏报告神经元胞体；
- **通道2**：抗MAP2抗体 + Alexa Fluor（选用与报告蛋白光谱分离的荧光团，如报告蛋白为绿色则选Alexa Fluor 647；若为红色则选Alexa Fluor 488）进行免疫荧光标记，补全树突分支与树突长度细节；
- 长期保存：样本封存于DBE中，4 ℃避光保存，可稳定维持≥6个月。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样本预处理与免疫标记前准备**

1.1 取已完成4% PFA固定及后固定的3 mm厚小鼠脑组织块，置于1× PBS中充分漂洗，去除残余固定液。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 30 min)

1.2 将组织块转入含0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的1× PBS（PBST）中进行渗透处理，轻摇。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

1.3 用1× PBS漂洗组织块，去除Triton X-100。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 30 min)

**2 封闭**

2.1 将组织块置于封闭液（含5% (wt/vol) 正常驴血清、0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100、0.05% (wt/vol) 叠氮化钠的1× PBS）中封闭，轻摇。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

**3 一抗孵育（MAP2树突标记）**

3.1 配制一抗工作液：将抗MAP2抗体（兔源多克隆或单克隆，1:200稀释）溶于封闭液（含5%正常驴血清、0.2% Triton X-100、0.05%叠氮化钠的1× PBS）中，将组织块完全浸没于一抗工作液，轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)

3.2 用PBST（0.2% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS）充分漂洗，去除未结合一抗，轻摇。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 × 1 hour)

**4 二抗孵育**

4.1 配制二抗工作液：将驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 647（或Alexa Fluor 488，依报告蛋白光谱选择，1:400稀释）溶于封闭液中，避光孵育，轻摇。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3–5 days)

4.2 用PBST漂洗，去除未结合二抗，避光，轻摇。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 × 1 hour)

4.3 用1× PBS终漂洗，去除Triton X-100残留。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 × 30 min)

**5 脱水（FDISCO低温THF梯度脱水）**

> 注意：所有脱水步骤全程在4 ℃、避光、密封容器中进行，以最大程度保护内源荧光。THF使用前以分子筛（4 Å）脱水处理，并加入0.01% (wt/vol) BHT（2,6-二叔丁基-4-甲基苯酚）作为抗氧化剂。

5.1 将组织块转入50% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（含0.01% BHT）中，轻摇脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

5.2 转入70% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（含0.01% BHT）中，轻摇。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

5.3 转入80% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（含0.01% BHT）中，轻摇。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

5.4 转入90% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（含0.01% BHT）中，轻摇。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

5.5 转入100% THF（含0.01% BHT，无水级）中，轻摇，第一次换液。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

5.6 更换新鲜100% THF（含0.01% BHT），轻摇，第二次换液，确保完全脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

**6 折射率匹配（DBE透明化）**

6.1 将完全脱水的组织块直接转入100% DBE（二苄基醚，Sigma-Aldrich 108014，RI ≈ 1.562）中，避光，不振摇，静置至组织完全透明（组织沉底即为透明完成标志）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 4–6 hours)

6.2 更换新鲜DBE，确保组织完全透明且无气泡，避光静置。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

**7 成像前处理**

7.1 将透明组织块转移至成像专用玻璃容器（如定制玻璃腔室或FEP管），加入足量新鲜DBE完全浸没样本，密封容器，避免DBE挥发与气泡产生。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min，平衡至室温后成像)

7.2 使用光片显微镜（LSFM）或长工作距离共聚焦显微镜成像，物镜选用与DBE（RI ≈ 1.56）匹配的浸液物镜（如Zeiss Clr Plan-Neofluar 20×/1.0 Corr nd=1.56，或CLARITY物镜配合DBE适配器）；激发波长依报告蛋白（488 nm for GFP/EGFP/YFP；561 nm for tdTomato/RFP）及Alexa Fluor 647（633/647 nm）分别采集。(Temperature: RT, Time: 按实验需求)

**8 长期保存**

8.1 成像完毕后，将样本密封于新鲜DBE中，置于棕色玻璃瓶中，用Parafilm封口，避光保存。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ≤ 6 months)

8.2 每2个月检查一次DBE液面，如有挥发则补充新鲜DBE，确保样本始终完全浸没，防止组织暴露于空气导致荧光淬灭与组织收缩。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 每次检查 < 5 min)

8.3 复查成像前，将样本从4 ℃取出，在密封容器中平衡至室温后直接成像，无需重新透明化处理。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because it is the most established solvent-based whole-mount immunolabeling and clearing method capable of penetrating dense, heavily myelinated human brain tissue at 5 mm thickness. Its methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane (DCM) delipidation steps are highly effective at removing the abundant lipids and myelin in human cortex, which is the primary barrier to antibody penetration and optical transparency. The organic solvent series also permeabilizes tissue thoroughly, enabling deep antibody penetration into thick slabs. iDISCO+ is compatible with the final refractive index matching reagent dibenzyl ether (DBE, RI ≈ 1.56), which provides excellent transparency for light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM).

**Dual-target labeling rationale:**
- **NeuN (RBFOX3) + Alexa Fluor 647**: NeuN is the gold-standard nuclear marker for mature neurons across all cortical layers in human brain. It enables unambiguous neuron identification, counting, and laminar distribution analysis. Alexa Fluor 647 (far-red) is chosen for its superior tissue penetration depth, minimal autofluorescence overlap in human brain, and excellent photostability.
- **MAP2 + Alexa Fluor (e.g., Alexa Fluor 568)**: MAP2 labels the somatodendritic compartment of mature neurons, providing morphological context for 3D reconstruction, local density comparison, and cortical layer delineation complementary to NeuN nuclear labeling.
- **DAPI**: Nuclear counterstain for total cell reference, cortical layer boundary demarcation, and quality control of clearing uniformity throughout the 5 mm thickness.

---

## Protocol Steps

### 1 Pre-treatment and Permeabilization

1.1 Wash fixed 5 mm human cortical slab 3× with 1× PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

1.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water to initiate dehydration and permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH) to quench endogenous peroxidase activity and reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)

### 2 Rehydration

2.1 Incubation with 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.3 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.4 Incubation with 1× PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.5 Incubation with 1× PBS (pH 7.4), second wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

### 3 Delipidation

3.1 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane (DCM, Sigma 270997) with gentle agitation to remove myelin and lipids. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

3.2 Incubation with fresh 100% DCM, second change, with gentle agitation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

3.3 Incubation with fresh 100% DCM, third change, to ensure complete delipidation of the dense myelinated human cortex. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

3.4 Wash 2× with 100% methanol to remove residual DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes per wash)

### 4 Rehydration Post-Delipidation

4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.3 Incubation with 1× PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.4 Incubation with 1× PBS (pH 7.4), second wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

### 5 Pre-Blocking and Permeabilization for Immunolabeling

5.1 Incubation with PTx.2 solution (0.2% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS) with gentle rocking to enhance antibody penetration into the 5 mm slab. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

5.2 Incubation with PTx.2 solution, second wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

5.3 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution: 0.2% gelatin, 0.5% Triton X-100, 0.01% sodium azide, 5% normal donkey serum (NDS) in 1× PBS (PTwH + NDS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

### 6 Primary Antibody Incubation (Dual-Target)

6.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 10 µg/mL heparin in 1× PBS) + 5% NDS + 0.01% sodium azide:
- Anti-NeuN (RBFOX3) rabbit monoclonal antibody (e.g., Abcam ab177487 or equivalent), dilution 1:500
- Anti-MAP2 mouse monoclonal antibody (e.g., Sigma M4403 or equivalent), dilution 1:400
Incubation with primary antibody cocktail with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

6.2 Wash with PTwH solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

6.3 Wash with PTwH solution, second wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

6.4 Wash with PTwH solution, third wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

6.5 Wash with PTwH solution, fourth wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

6.6 Wash with PTwH solution, fifth wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

### 7 Secondary Antibody Incubation and DAPI Counterstain

7.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in PTwH + 5% NDS + 0.01% sodium azide:
- Donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (Thermo Fisher A31573), 1:500 (for NeuN)
- Donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 568 (Thermo Fisher A10037), 1:500 (for MAP2)
- DAPI (4′,6-diamidino-2-phenylindole), 5 µg/mL final concentration
Incubation with secondary antibody + DAPI cocktail with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)

7.2 Wash with PTwH solution, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

7.3 Wash with PTwH solution, second wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

7.4 Wash with PTwH solution, third wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

7.5 Wash with PTwH solution, fourth wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

7.6 Wash with PTwH solution, fifth wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

### 8 Tissue Optical Clearing (Solvent-Based Dehydration)

8.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.3 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.4 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.5 Incubation with 100% DCM to clear residual methanol and complete lipid removal. (Temperature: RT, Time: 45 minutes)

8.6 Incubation with 100% DCM, second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 45 minutes)

### 9 Refractive Index Matching

9.1 Transfer tissue to glass vial. Incubation with 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG, RI = 1.562) without shaking, protected from light, until tissue becomes fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

9.2 Replace with fresh 100% DBE. Incubation without shaking to ensure complete RI equilibration throughout the 5 mm thickness. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

### 10 Storage and Pre-Imaging Preparation

10.1 Store cleared tissue in 100% DBE in sealed glass vial, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 6 months)

10.2 Prior to imaging, mount tissue in a custom agarose (1% low-melting agarose in DBE) or embed in a DBE-compatible imaging chamber (e.g., glass-bottom dish sealed with silicone grease) to prevent tissue movement during LSFM acquisition. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

10.3 Verify RI matching by visual inspection (tissue should appear fully transparent) and acquire a test z-stack at low magnification to confirm uniform signal penetration across the full 5 mm depth before full acquisition. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
