**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin+Alexa Fluor 647, TH+Alexa Fluor 568]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) It employs organic solvent-based delipidation (methanol + DCM/DBE), which is highly effective for lipid-rich adipose tissue — the abundant lipid droplets in WAT are the primary obstacle to optical transparency, and solvent-based clearing removes them efficiently; (2) The protocol includes a methanol-based bleaching step that reduces autofluorescence, a significant concern in adipose tissue; (3) iDISCO+ supports whole-mount immunolabeling of large samples (15×10×5 mm) with well-established antibody penetration enhancement steps; (4) The final RI matching medium (DBE, n≈1.56) provides excellent transparency for light-sheet microscopy. For labeling: **TH (Tyrosine Hydroxylase)** is the gold-standard marker for sympathetic adrenergic nerve fibers innervating WAT and is well-validated in iDISCO+ protocols. **Lectin** (e.g., tomato lectin, conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647) perfused or applied as a vascular lumen marker provides a complementary channel for the vascular network, enabling 3D spatial analysis of sympathetic fiber–vessel relationships. Lectin labels endothelial luminal surfaces and is compatible with iDISCO+ whole-mount staining when applied post-fixation.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Post-fixation Wash**
1.1 Wash fixed tissue (4% PFA in PBS, assumed pre-fixed) with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 3× changes)

**2 Dehydration**
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with 100% methanol (second change). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 Bleaching (Autofluorescence Reduction)**
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)

**4 Rehydration**
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 2× changes)

**5 Permeabilization and Blocking**
5.1 Incubation with permeabilization/blocking solution: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine, 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, gentle shaking)

**6 Primary Antibody Labeling**
6.1 Prepare primary antibody solution in PTwH buffer (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin) supplemented with 5% (vol/vol) DMSO and 3% (vol/vol) NDS: anti-TH rabbit polyclonal antibody (1:500, e.g., Millipore AB152). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, gentle shaking, protected from light)
6.2 Wash with PTwH buffer (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 5× changes over 24 hours)

**7 Secondary Antibody Labeling (TH Channel)**
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibody solution in PTwH + 3% NDS: donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, gentle shaking, protected from light)
7.2 Wash with PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 5× changes over 24 hours)

**8 Lectin Vascular Labeling**
8.1 Incubation with biotinylated tomato lectin (Lycopersicon esculentum, 1:200 in PTwH) or directly conjugated Lectin–Alexa Fluor 647 (1:200 in PTwH) to label vascular endothelial luminal surfaces. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, gentle shaking, protected from light)
8.2 If biotinylated lectin was used in step 8.1, wash with PTwH (5× over 24 hours at RT), then incubate with streptavidin–Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500 in PTwH). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)
8.3 Wash with PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 5× changes over 24 hours)
8.4 Final wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes, 2× changes)

**9 Dehydration (Pre-clearing)**
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.5 Incubation with 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.6 Incubation with 100% methanol (second change). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**10 Delipidation**
10.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) DCM (dichloromethane) in 100% methanol (1:2 vol/vol DCM:MeOH). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, gentle shaking in glass vial)
10.2 Incubation with 100% DCM (2× changes) to wash out methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes each change)

**11 Refractive Index Matching**
11.1 Incubation with 100% DBE (dibenzyl ether, Sigma 108014) without shaking, in glass vial, until tissue sinks and becomes fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4–6 hours, minimum; extend to overnight if needed for full transparency of 5 mm-thick WAT pad, protected from light)

**12 Storage and Imaging Preparation**
12.1 Store cleared tissue in 100% DBE in sealed glass vial. (Temperature: RT or 4 ℃, protected from light; stable for weeks to months)
12.2 Mount tissue in a glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with DBE for light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) or confocal microscopy. Use DBE-compatible silicone or PTFE spacers to immobilize the sample. Imaging channels: Alexa Fluor 568 (TH, sympathetic fibers), Alexa Fluor 647 (Lectin, vascular network). (Temperature: RT, Time: as required for imaging session)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH (酪氨酸羟化酶) + Alexa Fluor 647, NPY + Alexa Fluor 555/568, CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected as the optimal method for this high-lipid WAT sample for the following reasons:
1. **Methanol gradient dehydration** is the core step that was previously skipped — this is precisely what causes WAT to remain opaque and float (residual lipid droplets prevent RI homogenization). iDISCO+ mandates a complete methanol series followed by DCM/DBE-based delipidation, which is essential for adipose tissue.
2. **Organic solvent-based delipidation (DCM)** efficiently removes the massive lipid content of WAT, which aqueous methods (CUBIC, ScaleS) handle poorly at this tissue size (15×10×5 mm).
3. **DBE (dibenzyl ether, RI ≈ 1.559)** as the final RI matching medium provides excellent RI homogenization for fully dehydrated/delipidated tissue and is compatible with long-term storage.
4. **Whole-mount immunolabeling** within the iDISCO+ framework (PTwH-based permeabilization + blocking) allows deep antibody penetration into a 5 mm-thick fat pad.
5. **Labeling strategy rationale:**
   - **TH + Alexa Fluor 647**: canonical marker for noradrenergic sympathetic fibers (tyrosine hydroxylase); far-red channel minimizes autofluorescence from adipose tissue.
   - **NPY + Alexa Fluor 555**: neuropeptide Y marks peptidergic sympathetic co-transmission fibers, enabling dual-channel discrimination of the two sympathetic subtypes.
   - **CD31 + Alexa Fluor 488**: labels vascular endothelium to map perivascular enrichment patterns of nerve fibers relative to blood vessels.
   - **DAPI**: nuclear counterstain for tissue architecture reference (applied post-clearing in RI matching step or pre-embedding).

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**0 Pre-clearing Verification (Starting Material)**
0.1 Confirm tissue has been fixed in 4% PFA/PBS at 4 °C for 24 hours and post-fixed if applicable. Rinse 3× in PBS (10 min each). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 30 min total)
0.2 Trim excess connective tissue; blot dry. Record dimensions (target: ~15 mm × 10 mm × 5 mm). Store in PBS at 4 °C until start of protocol. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: ≤ 24 hours)

---

**1 Dehydration (Methanol Gradient — Critical Corrective Step)**
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O (ddH₂O). Gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. Gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. Gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. Gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous). Gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% methanol (anhydrous) to ensure complete dehydration. Tissue should sink; if floating persists, extend to 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

**2 Bleaching (H₂O₂ in Methanol — Autofluorescence Reduction)**
2.1 Prepare fresh bleaching solution: 5% H₂O₂ (vol/vol) in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH). Pre-chill to 4 °C. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: preparation only)
2.2 Incubation with chilled 5% H₂O₂/methanol solution in the dark with gentle shaking. This step reduces lipofuscin and hemoglobin autofluorescence abundant in WAT. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 16 hours)
2.3 Remove bleaching solution. Wash 3× with 100% methanol, 30 min each, gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours total)

---

**3 Delipidation (DCM — Essential for High-Lipid WAT)**
3.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM, 99%, Sigma 270997): 33% DCM / 67% methanol (vol/vol). Gentle shaking. Tissue will begin to clarify. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 100% DCM. Gentle shaking. Tissue should sink completely and appear translucent. If tissue still floats, extend by 1 hour increments. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.3 Incubation with fresh 100% DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

**4 RI Pre-matching / Transfer to DBE**
4.1 Remove DCM completely. Immediately transfer tissue to 100% DBE (dibenzyl ether, Sigma 108014; RI = 1.559). Do NOT allow tissue to dry between DCM and DBE. Gentle shaking. Tissue should become fully transparent and sink. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
4.2 Replace with fresh 100% DBE. Incubate until tissue is optically clear (no visible opacity). For 5 mm-thick WAT, this typically requires overnight incubation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–16 hours)
4.3 Inspect clarity: tissue should be fully transparent and submerged. If any opacity remains, replace DBE and continue for additional 6–8 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: as needed)

---

**5 Rehydration for Immunolabeling**
5.1 Rehydrate tissue by reverse methanol gradient: 100% MeOH, 2× 30 min. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.2 Incubation with 80% methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
5.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
5.4 Incubation with 40% methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
5.5 Incubation with 20% methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
5.6 Incubation with PBS (1×, pH 7.4), 2× washes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min each)

---

**6 Permeabilization and Blocking**
6.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution: PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3 M glycine. Gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours)
6.2 Incubation with blocking solution: PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20, 10% DMSO, 6% normal donkey serum (NDS), 0.1% heparin (PTwH + DMSO + NDS). Gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours)

---

**7 Primary Antibody Incubation (Whole-Mount)**
7.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in PTwH (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 0.1% heparin) + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS:
- Anti-TH (rabbit polyclonal, e.g., Millipore AB152): 1:500
- Anti-NPY (sheep polyclonal, e.g., Abcam ab36985): 1:400
- Anti-CD31 (rat monoclonal, e.g., BD 550274): 1:300
Ensure primary antibodies are from distinct host species for secondary antibody compatibility. (Temperature: preparation at RT)
7.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail. Gentle rocking/shaking. For 5 mm-thick WAT, extended incubation is required for deep penetration. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 5–7 days)
7.3 Wash with PTwH (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 0.1% heparin): 5 washes × 2 hours each, gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 hours total)

---

**8 Secondary Antibody Incubation**
8.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in PTwH + 3% NDS:
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG–Alexa Fluor 647 (for TH): 1:500
- Donkey anti-sheep IgG–Alexa Fluor 555 (for NPY): 1:500
- Donkey anti-rat IgG–Alexa Fluor 488 (for CD31): 1:500
All secondary antibodies: highly cross-adsorbed, minimal cross-reactivity. (Temperature: preparation at RT)
8.2 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail in the dark, gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 3–5 days)
8.3 Wash with PTwH: 5 washes × 2 hours each, in the dark, gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 hours total)

---

**9 Nuclear Counterstain (DAPI)**
9.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PTwH) for nuclear architecture reference. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
9.2 Wash with PTwH: 3 washes × 30 min each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)

---

**10 Second Dehydration (Post-labeling)**
10.1 Incubation with 20% methanol in H₂O. Gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.2 Incubation with 40% methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.3 Incubation with 60% methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.4 Incubation with 80% methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous), 2× changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)

---

**11 Second Delipidation (Post-labeling)**
11.1 Incubation with 33% DCM / 67% methanol (vol/vol). Gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
11.2 Incubation with 100% DCM, 2× changes. Gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)

---

**12 Final RI Matching with DBE**
12.1 Transfer immediately from DCM to 100% DBE (Sigma 108014-1KG). Incubate without shaking to avoid bubble formation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
12.2 Replace with fresh 100% DBE. Incubate in the dark without shaking until tissue is fully transparent and submerged. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–16 hours)
12.3 Final inspection: tissue must be fully transparent, submerged (not floating), and show no visible opacity. If any opacity remains, replace DBE and extend incubation. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to additional 8 hours if needed)

---

**13 Mounting and Imaging Preparation**
13.1 Transfer cleared tissue into a custom imaging chamber (e.g., glass-bottom dish or 3D-printed holder) filled with fresh DBE. Orient fat pad with largest face (15×10 mm) facing the objective. Seal with DBE-compatible adhesive or coverslip. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
13.2 Allow tissue to equilibrate in imaging chamber without movement to eliminate refractive index gradients at tissue-DBE interface. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
13.3 Image using light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) with DBE-compatible objectives (e.g., CLARITY/LSFM objectives with RI correction collar set to 1.559) or confocal microscopy with oil-immersion objective and RI correction:
- Channel 1: 488 nm excitation → CD31–Alexa Fluor 488 (vasculature)
- Channel 2: 555 nm excitation → NPY–Alexa Fluor 555 (peptidergic sympathetic fibers)
- Channel 3: 647 nm excitation → TH–Alexa Fluor 647 (noradrenergic sympathetic fibers)
- Channel 4: 405 nm excitation → DAPI (nuclei/tissue architecture)
Acquire z-stacks at 2–5 µm step size for full volumetric reconstruction. (Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)
13.4 For long-term storage: keep cleared tissue in sealed DBE-filled container in the dark at RT. Fluorescence stable for 6–12 months under these conditions. (Temperature: RT, Time: long-term)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647 (intravascular perfusion for functional lumen labeling), CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 568 (endothelial structural integrity), α-SMA + Alexa Fluor 488 (vascular smooth muscle / arteriolar coverage), DAPI (nuclear counterstain)]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) it employs methanol-based dehydration and dibenzyl ether (DBE) as the final RI-matching medium, achieving excellent clearing of blood-rich, lipid-dense tissues such as mouse placenta; (2) the solvent-based delipidation efficiently removes hemoglobin and lipids that would otherwise cause high background and light scattering in the densely vascularized villous region; (3) iDISCO+ is well-validated for whole-organ immunolabeling with deep antibody penetration enabled by methanol pretreatment and detergent-based permeabilization, critical for the ~10 mm × 8 mm × 3 mm placenta; (4) DBE provides RI ≈ 1.56, compatible with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) for full 3D reconstruction of the villous vascular tree. Lectin (conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647) is administered by intracardiac/umbilical perfusion prior to fixation to label patent, perfused vascular lumens—the gold standard for functional vessel mapping. CD31 immunolabeling confirms endothelial structural integrity throughout the villous tree. α-SMA marks smooth muscle–covered arterioles, enabling hierarchical vessel classification. DAPI provides nuclear context for tissue architecture. Together these markers allow quantification of branching density, branch length, connectivity, and spatial coverage in normal vs. preeclamptic placentas.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**0 Pre-fixation Intravascular Lectin Perfusion (performed in vivo, before tissue harvest)**

0.1 Prepare Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647 solution at 1 mg/mL in sterile PBS; filter through 0.22 µm membrane. (Temperature: RT, Time: preparation ~15 min)

0.2 Anesthetize pregnant dam; expose uterus; inject 100 µL Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647 solution into the umbilical vein of each placenta using a 30-gauge needle; allow circulation for 5 min before cardiac perfusion with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 min post-injection)

0.3 Perform transcardiac perfusion with 20 mL ice-cold PBS followed by 20 mL ice-cold 4% PFA in PBS to fix the lectin in place. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ~10 min perfusion)

0.4 Dissect placenta; remove decidua basalis and excess maternal tissue; place in 4% PFA in PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours post-fixation)

0.5 Wash placenta 3 × 30 min in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

---

**1 Dehydration (Methanol Series)**

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 Repeat 100% methanol wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

**2 Bleaching (Heme/Pigment Removal)**

2.1 Prepare fresh bleaching solution: 5% H₂O₂ (vol/vol) in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH); chill on ice before use. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: preparation)

2.2 Incubation with chilled 5% H₂O₂ in methanol to remove hemoglobin and reduce autofluorescence from blood-rich placental tissue. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours, overnight, protected from light)

2.3 Wash 3 × 30 min with 100% methanol at RT. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

---

**3 Rehydration**

3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.5 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.6 Repeat PBS wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

**4 Permeabilization and Blocking**

4.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution [PBS containing 2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine, 0.02% sodium azide] to enhance antibody penetration into the dense villous stroma. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, gentle shaking)

4.2 Wash 2 × 1 hour with PBS/0.2% Tween-20/10 µg/mL heparin (PTwH). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

4.3 Incubation with Blocking Solution [PBS containing 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 3% (wt/vol) BSA, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 5% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.02% sodium azide] to suppress non-specific binding in the highly cellular placental tissue. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, gentle shaking)

---

**5 Primary Antibody Labeling**

5.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in Antibody Diluent [PBS containing 3% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 3% (wt/vol) BSA, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 5% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.02% sodium azide]:
- Anti-CD31 (PECAM-1) rabbit monoclonal antibody at 1:200 dilution
- Anti-α-SMA mouse monoclonal antibody at 1:300 dilution
(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: preparation)

5.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail with gentle rocking to label endothelial cells (CD31) and vascular smooth muscle (α-SMA) throughout the full placental depth. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

5.3 Wash with PTwH (PBS/0.2% Tween-20/10 µg/mL heparin), 5 × 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

5.4 Additional overnight wash with PTwH to remove unbound primary antibody from the dense villous core. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

---

**6 Secondary Antibody Labeling**

6.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in Antibody Diluent:
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 at 1:400 dilution (for CD31)
- Donkey anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 at 1:400 dilution (for α-SMA)
(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: preparation, protected from light)

6.2 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, protected from light)

6.3 Wash with PTwH, 5 × 1 hour, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

6.4 Additional overnight wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)

---

**7 Nuclear Counterstain (DAPI)**

7.1 Incubation with DAPI at 5 µg/mL in PBS to label nuclei for tissue architecture reference and cell density quantification. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours, protected from light)

7.2 Wash 3 × 30 min with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min, protected from light)

---

**8 Second Dehydration (Pre-clearing)**

8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

8.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

8.6 Repeat 100% methanol wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

---

**9 Delipidation with Dichloromethane (DCM)**

9.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) DCM / 33% methanol (vol/vol) to initiate lipid extraction from the lipid-rich syncytiotrophoblast membranes and stromal cells. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, gentle shaking, fume hood)

9.2 Incubation with 100% DCM (2 × 30 min) to complete delipidation and achieve tissue transparency. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min, fume hood)

9.3 Verify tissue has turned white/opaque (expected intermediate state); proceed immediately to RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: visual check)

---

**10 Refractive Index Matching with DBE**

10.1 Remove all DCM by brief air exposure in fume hood (≤ 2 min); do not allow tissue to dry completely. (Temperature: RT, Time: ≤ 2 min)

10.2 Incubation with 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014; RI = 1.562) in a glass vial, without shaking, until tissue becomes fully transparent. DBE matches the RI of dehydrated placental tissue and is compatible with LSFM objectives. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours, protected from light)

10.3 Replace with fresh 100% DBE and incubate until complete optical transparency is confirmed visually. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)

---

**11 Storage Prior to Imaging**

11.1 Transfer cleared placenta to a fresh glass vial containing 100% DBE; seal with Parafilm to prevent evaporation and moisture ingress. (Temperature: RT, Time: storage up to 4 weeks, protected from light)

11.2 Do not use plastic containers; DBE dissolves most plastics. Use only glass vials and glass-bottomed imaging chambers. (Temperature: RT, Time: ongoing)

---

**12 Imaging Preparation (Light-Sheet Fluorescence Microscopy)**

12.1 Mount cleared placenta in a custom glass-bottomed imaging chamber filled with 100% DBE; orient with the chorionic plate facing the objective for acquisition of the full villous vascular tree from basal plate to chorionic plate. (Temperature: RT, Time: ~30 min mounting)

12.2 Use a LSFM system equipped with a long-working-distance, low-NA objective (e.g., 4× or 12× CLARITY-compatible objective) immersed in DBE-compatible immersion medium (RI ≈ 1.56); acquire four-channel z-stacks:
- Channel 1: 405 nm excitation → DAPI emission (nuclear architecture)
- Channel 2: 488 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 488 emission (α-SMA, arteriolar smooth muscle)
- Channel 3: 561 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 568 emission (CD31, pan-endothelial)
- Channel 4: 647 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 647 emission (Lectin, perfused functional lumens)
(Temperature: RT, Time: acquisition per sample ~2–6 hours depending on resolution)

12.3 Set z-step size to ≤ 2 µm for full-resolution villous capillary reconstruction; use tile-scan mode to cover the full 10 mm × 8 mm placental area with ≥ 10% overlap between tiles for seamless stitching. (Temperature: RT, Time: per acquisition session)

12.4 Export raw image stacks in TIFF or HDF5 format; perform 3D stitching using BigStitcher (Fiji/ImageJ); perform vascular segmentation and morphometric analysis (branching density, branch length, connectivity, spatial coverage) using Imaris Filament Tracer or equivalent vessel tracing software. (Temperature: RT, Time: post-acquisition)

iDISCO+ 是基于有机溶剂（甲醇脱水 + DBE折射率匹配）的透明方法，对 10 mm × 8 mm × 3 mm 的完整胎盘具有良好的穿透深度和脂质去除效率，能够在合理时间内实现全器官透明。其免疫标记步骤（PTwH洗涤体系）对厚组织的抗体渗透性经过充分验证，适合胎盘迷路层等结构复杂、细胞密度高的区域。标记策略上：① **体内灌注 Lectin（Lectin-Alexa Fluor 488）**在动物处死前经心脏灌注，仅标记实际被血流灌注到的功能性血管腔面，作为"灌流功能通道"；② **CD31（PECAM1）免疫染色 + Alexa Fluor 647**标记所有具有内皮结构的血管（包括无灌流的血管），作为"内皮结构通道"；③ **DAPI**提供细胞核参考，辅助区分迷路层、滋养层区域和胎盘边缘区域的组织层次。双通道比较（Lectin vs. CD31）可直接量化灌流缺失区域、血管稀疏化和异常分枝模式，满足先兆子痫模型胎盘血管功能障碍评估的科学目标。Alexa Fluor 647 在有机溶剂中荧光保留性优异，与 iDISCO+ 高度兼容；FITC/Alexa Fluor 488（Lectin）在 iDISCO+ 流程中需注意甲醇步骤对信号的轻微淬灭，但体内灌注的高密度标记通常信号足够强。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**前置操作说明（Protocol前提）：**
动物处死前 5–10 min 经左心室灌注 PBS 冲洗循环血液，随后立即灌注 Lectin-Alexa Fluor 488（2 mg/mL in PBS，1–2 mL，缓慢推注），循环 5 min 后灌注 4% PFA/PBS 固定。取出胎盘，4% PFA/PBS 后固定过夜（4 ℃）。以下 Protocol 从后固定完成后开始。

---

**1 Post-fixation Wash**
1.1 Wash with 1× PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, 3× changes)

**2 Dehydration（甲醇梯度脱水）**
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (second change).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 Bleaching（漂白内源性色素，去除胎盘血红蛋白干扰）**
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH, freshly prepared).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)

**4 Rehydration（复水）**
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 1× PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**5 Permeabilization & Blocking（渗透化与封闭）**
5.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in 1× PBS].(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
5.2 Incubation with Blocking Solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) in 1× PBS].(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**6 Primary Antibody Incubation（一抗孵育：CD31 + DAPI核染）**
6.1 Incubation with primary antibody solution: anti-CD31 (PECAM1) antibody [1:200 dilution, e.g., rat anti-mouse CD31, BD Biosciences 550274 or equivalent] in PTwH-based antibody diluent [0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10 μg/mL heparin, 5% (vol/vol) NDS, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in 1× PBS].(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours, with gentle rocking)

**7 Post-primary Antibody Wash（一抗后洗涤）**
7.1 Wash with PTwH [1× PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 10 μg/mL heparin].(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min, 1st wash)
7.2 Wash with PTwH.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
7.3 Wash with PTwH.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
7.4 Wash with PTwH.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
7.5 Wash with PTwH.(Temperature: RT, Time: overnight ~12 hours)

**8 Secondary Antibody & DAPI Incubation（二抗孵育 + DAPI）**
8.1 Incubation with secondary antibody solution: donkey anti-rat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 [1:400 dilution] + DAPI [2 μg/mL] in PTwH-based antibody diluent [0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10 μg/mL heparin, 5% (vol/vol) NDS, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in 1× PBS]. Note: Lectin-Alexa Fluor 488 signal from in vivo perfusion is already present; no additional lectin staining step required.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours, with gentle rocking, protected from light)

**9 Post-secondary Antibody Wash（二抗后洗涤）**
9.1 Wash with PTwH.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min, 1st wash)
9.2 Wash with PTwH.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.3 Wash with PTwH.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
9.4 Wash with PTwH.(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
9.5 Wash with PTwH.(Temperature: RT, Time: overnight ~12 hours, protected from light)

**10 Dehydration for Clearing（透明前脱水）**
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
10.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (second change).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

**11 Delipidation（脱脂透明）**
11.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) DCM (dichloromethane, Sigma 270997) in 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, protected from light, in fume hood)
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min, 1st change, protected from light, in fume hood)
11.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min, 2nd change, protected from light, in fume hood)

**12 Refractive Index Matching（折射率匹配，DBE）**
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE (dibenzyl ether, Sigma 108014) without shaking, ensuring tissue is fully submerged.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, protected from light, in fume hood)
12.2 Replace with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE and incubate until tissue is fully transparent (typically overnight).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–16 hours, protected from light)

**13 Storage & Pre-imaging Preparation（保存与成像前处理）**
13.1 Transfer cleared tissue to a glass-bottom imaging chamber or custom-made agarose mold; embed in 1% low-melting agarose prepared in DBE for positional stabilization if needed. Alternatively, mount directly in DBE between two coverslips with spacers.(Temperature: RT)
13.2 Store cleared samples in sealed glass vials filled with fresh DBE, wrapped in aluminum foil, at room temperature until imaging. Samples are stable for up to 4 weeks under these conditions.(Temperature: RT, protected from light)
13.3 For light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) imaging: use DBE as immersion medium (RI ≈ 1.56); acquire three channels sequentially — Channel 1: Alexa Fluor 488 (ex. 488 nm / em. 510–540 nm) for Lectin-labeled perfused functional vessels; Channel 2: Alexa Fluor 647 (ex. 640 nm / em. 660–720 nm) for CD31-labeled endothelial structures; Channel 3: DAPI (ex. 405 nm / em. 420–470 nm) for nuclear/tissue layer reference. Acquire full Z-stack at ≤ 5 μm step size for labyrinth zone analysis and ≤ 10 μm for whole-placenta overview.(Temperature: RT)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin+Alexa Fluor (647), CD31+Alexa Fluor (568), DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) it achieves excellent clearing of dense, lipid-rich tissues such as the mouse placenta (~10×8×3 mm) via organic solvent-based delipidation (methanol/DCM/DBE), enabling deep light-sheet imaging; (2) it is fully compatible with whole-mount immunolabeling after methanol-based permeabilization, allowing antibody penetration into the labyrinth zone; (3) the organic solvent series preserves Alexa Fluor dyes (546/568/647) robustly. **Labeling strategy rationale:** Lectin (e.g., tomato lectin or *Griffonia simplicifolia* IB4-equivalent lectin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647) is perfused intravenously prior to sacrifice to label patent, perfused vascular lumens—this directly reports functional vascular patency and identifies hypoperfused zones. CD31 (PECAM-1) immunolabeling with Alexa Fluor 568 provides a structural reference for the total endothelial network (including non-perfused vessels), enabling direct comparison with the lectin perfusion signal to identify occluded, sparse, or abnormally dilated branches. DAPI labels nuclei to delineate placental compartments (labyrinth vs. junctional zone vs. decidua). Together, the dual lectin/CD31 strategy allows spatial mapping of functional vs. structural vascular trees across the entire 3D placental volume.

---

## Protocol Steps

### 0 Pre-clearing: In vivo Lectin Perfusion and Tissue Fixation

0.1 Prepare 100 µg/100 µL Lectin–Alexa Fluor 647 conjugate (e.g., *Lycopersicon esculentum* lectin–Alexa Fluor 647, Vector Labs DL-1178) in sterile PBS. Inject retro-orbitally or via tail vein into the preeclampsia model dam 5–7 min before sacrifice to label perfused vascular lumens. (Temperature: 37 °C physiological, Time: 5–7 min circulation)

0.2 Transcardially perfuse the dam with ice-cold PBS (20 mL) to flush non-bound lectin, followed by 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS (20 mL). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: ~5 min perfusion)

0.3 Dissect the intact placenta (with decidua attached). Post-fix in 4% PFA/PBS overnight. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12–16 hours)

0.4 Wash in PBS 3 × 30 min. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

---

### 1 Dehydration (Methanol Series)

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O (ddH₂O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 Repeat 100% methanol wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 2 Bleaching (Endogenous Peroxidase Quenching / Autofluorescence Reduction)

2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH). Protect from light. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12–16 hours)

---

### 3 Rehydration

3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.5 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.6 Repeat PBS wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 4 Permeabilization and Blocking

4.1 Incubation with permeabilization buffer: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours)

4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS), 0.1% (wt/vol) heparin. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours)

---

### 5 Primary Antibody Labeling (CD31)

5.1 Prepare primary antibody solution: anti-CD31 (PECAM-1) rabbit monoclonal antibody (e.g., Abcam ab182981) at 1:200 dilution in PTwH buffer [PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 0.1% (wt/vol) heparin] supplemented with 5% (vol/vol) NDS and 3% (vol/vol) DMSO. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours, with gentle rocking)

5.2 Wash with PTwH buffer (5 × 1 hour, then overnight wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour + 12 hours)

---

### 6 Secondary Antibody Labeling

6.1 Prepare secondary antibody solution: donkey anti-rabbit IgG–Alexa Fluor 568 (Thermo Fisher A10042) at 1:400 dilution in PTwH buffer supplemented with 3% (vol/vol) NDS. Protect from light. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours, with gentle rocking)

6.2 Wash with PTwH buffer (5 × 1 hour, then overnight wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour + 12 hours)

---

### 7 Nuclear Counterstain (DAPI)

7.1 Incubation with DAPI at 5 µg/mL in PTwH buffer. Protect from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

7.2 Wash with PTwH buffer (3 × 30 min). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

---

### 8 Second Dehydration (Pre-clearing)

8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.6 Repeat 100% methanol wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 9 Delipidation (DCM Treatment)

9.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 67% methanol (vol/vol). Perform in fume hood. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

9.2 Incubation with 100% DCM (2 × 15 min washes) to remove residual methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 15 min)

---

### 10 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing

10.1 Incubation with 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014) without shaking. Replace with fresh DBE after 2 hours. Protect from light. Tissue should appear fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours + additional 2–4 hours until transparent)

10.2 Transfer to fresh 100% DBE for storage and imaging. Confirm RI ≈ 1.56 (matched to DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: until imaging)

---

### 11 Sample Mounting and Imaging Preparation

11.1 Mount the cleared placenta in a glass-bottom imaging chamber or custom 3D-printed holder filled with 100% DBE. Orient the placenta with the labyrinth zone facing the objective. Seal with DBE-compatible adhesive (e.g., silicone grease). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

11.2 Image using a light-sheet fluorescence microscope (LSFM, e.g., LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope II or Zeiss Lightsheet Z.1) with a 4×/0.35 NA or 12×/0.53 NA objective (DBE-immersion or long-working-distance air objective with DBE-filled chamber). Acquire z-stacks with the following channel assignments:
- **Channel 1 (Lectin–Alexa Fluor 647):** Ex 640 nm / Em 680 nm → functional perfused vessels
- **Channel 2 (CD31–Alexa Fluor 568):** Ex 561 nm / Em 600 nm → total endothelial structure
- **Channel 3 (DAPI):** Ex 405 nm / Em 450 nm → nuclear/compartment reference
Step size: 2–5 µm; tile imaging with 10–15% overlap for full placenta coverage. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2–6 hours per sample depending on resolution)

---

### 12 Post-imaging Storage

12.1 Store cleared placenta in 100% DBE in a sealed amber glass vial. Protect from light and moisture. (Temperature: RT or 4 °C, Time: up to 4 weeks)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (凝集素) + Alexa Fluor (far-red, e.g., Alexa Fluor 647), CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor (mid-range, e.g., Alexa Fluor 546), DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected over CUBIC or PEGASOS for this application because: (1) its methanol-based dehydration/delipidation pipeline is highly effective at removing hemoglobin from blood-rich tissues when each gradient step is extended sufficiently, eliminating the major source of signal attenuation in placental tissue; (2) the H₂O₂ bleaching step specifically addresses the endogenous heme-based autofluorescence and pigmentation that causes center-to-edge signal gradients; (3) the organic-solvent environment (DCM/DBE) achieves deep RI matching (n ≈ 1.56) compatible with light-sheet microscopy of a 10 mm × 8 mm × 3 mm sample; and (4) the immunolabeling window in iDISCO+ can be extended with PTwH-based washing and prolonged antibody incubation at 37 °C to overcome the poor central penetration observed previously.

The labeling strategy is dual-channel vascular:
- **Lectin (IB4 or tomato lectin) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647** (far-red): perfused intravenously prior to sacrifice OR applied as a post-fixation luminal stain; labels patent, perfused vascular lumens — directly addresses the "functional perfused lumen" objective.
- **Anti-CD31 (PECAM-1) primary + Alexa Fluor 546 secondary**: labels all endothelial cells regardless of perfusion status — addresses "endothelial cell structure" and enables comparison of total vs. perfused vasculature.
- **DAPI**: nuclear counterstain for tissue architecture reference and region delineation (center vs. edge).

The previous failures (edge-strong/center-weak signal) are corrected by: (a) extending each methanol gradient step to ≥2 h (ideally overnight for the 80–100% steps), (b) extending the H₂O₂ bleaching step to fully decolorize the blood-rich tissue, (c) extending primary antibody incubation to 5–7 days at 37 °C with 0.2% Tween-20 + heparin permeabilization buffer, and (d) using a far-red secondary for the deeper-penetrating channel.

---

## Protocol Steps

### 1 Pre-clearing Perfusion Lectin Labeling (performed in vivo or ex vivo before fixation)

1.1 Retro-orbital or cardiac injection of Lectin–Alexa Fluor 647 (100 µg in 100 µL PBS) into the pregnant dam 5–10 min before sacrifice to label perfused vascular lumens in situ. If in vivo injection is not feasible, proceed to step 1.2 for post-fixation luminal labeling. (Temperature: 37 °C body temperature, Time: 5–10 min circulation)

1.2 [Alternative ex vivo luminal labeling, if in vivo injection was not performed] After dissection and before immersion fixation, flush the placenta via the umbilical vessels with 1 mL ice-cold PBS, then perfuse with 200 µg/mL Lectin–Alexa Fluor 647 in PBS (200 µL) and allow to bind. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 30 min)

---

### 2 Fixation and Post-fixation

2.1 Immersion-fix the intact placenta in 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: overnight, ~16 hours)

2.2 Wash 3× with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min each wash)

2.3 Post-fix in 4% PFA/PBS (second fixation to stabilize lectin signal and antigen). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 2 hours)

2.4 Wash 3× with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min each wash)

---

### 3 Dehydration (Methanol Gradient) — Extended Steps to Ensure Full Hemoglobin Extraction

3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: overnight, ~12 hours)

3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: overnight, ~12 hours)

3.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous) to ensure complete dehydration and hemoglobin removal. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

---

### 4 Bleaching (H₂O₂ Treatment) — Extended for Blood-rich Placental Tissue

4.1 Prepare fresh bleaching solution: 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes 100% MeOH). Pre-chill to 4 °C.

4.2 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in methanol. Monitor tissue color; the tissue should transition from dark red/brown to pale cream/white. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 16–20 hours; extend up to 24 hours if residual pigmentation remains in the central region)

---

### 5 Rehydration (Methanol Gradient, Reverse)

5.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

5.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

5.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

5.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

5.5 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

5.6 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

---

### 6 Permeabilization

6.1 Incubation with permeabilization buffer: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine, pH 7.4. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours, with gentle shaking)

6.2 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization buffer: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10 µg/mL heparin (PTwH), 5% (vol/vol) DMSO, 3% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 0.3% (wt/vol) BSA. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours, with gentle shaking)

---

### 7 Primary Antibody Incubation — Extended for Deep Placental Penetration

7.1 Prepare primary antibody solution in PTwH buffer (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin) supplemented with 5% (vol/vol) DMSO and 3% donkey serum:
- Anti-CD31 (PECAM-1) antibody at 1:100 dilution (e.g., rat anti-mouse CD31, BD Biosciences or Abcam).
Use a minimum volume of 1–2 mL to fully submerge the placenta.

7.2 Incubation with primary antibody solution. Refresh antibody solution at day 3 with fresh aliquot to maintain concentration gradient. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 5–7 days total, with gentle shaking on orbital shaker at 60 rpm)

7.3 Wash with PTwH buffer (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin), 5 washes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

---

### 8 Secondary Antibody Incubation

8.1 Prepare secondary antibody solution in PTwH buffer supplemented with 3% donkey serum:
- Donkey anti-rat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 546 at 1:200 dilution (to label CD31/PECAM-1).
Note: Lectin–Alexa Fluor 647 was applied in Step 1 and is already covalently conjugated; no secondary needed for lectin channel.

8.2 Incubation with secondary antibody solution. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 3–5 days, with gentle shaking)

8.3 Wash with PTwH buffer, 5 washes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

---

### 9 Nuclear Counterstain (DAPI)

9.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours, with gentle shaking)

9.2 Wash with PTwH buffer, 3 washes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min per wash)

9.3 Final wash with PBS, 2 washes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min per wash)

---

### 10 Dehydration (Pre-clearing, Methanol Gradient)

10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 11 Delipidation with Dichloromethane (DCM)

11.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) DCM / 33% (vol/vol) methanol (2:1 DCM:MeOH). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, with gentle shaking in a fume hood)

11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (anhydrous, Sigma-Aldrich 270997). Two changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min each change, in fume hood)

---

### 12 Refractive Index Matching with DBE

12.1 Transfer tissue to dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014, n = 1.562). Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE without shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours minimum; extend to overnight for complete RI equilibration of the 3 mm-thick placenta)

12.2 Replace with fresh 100% DBE and confirm tissue is fully transparent before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

---

### 13 Storage and Imaging Preparation

13.1 Store cleared placenta in 100% DBE in a sealed glass vial protected from light. (Temperature: RT or 4 °C, Time: up to 2 weeks; avoid prolonged storage >4 weeks as Alexa Fluor signals may fade)

13.2 Mount the cleared placenta in a custom imaging chamber (e.g., FEP tube or glass-bottom dish) filled with DBE for light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM). Orient the placenta with the flat chorionic plate facing the objective to allow sequential imaging from edge to center.

13.3 Acquire 3-channel z-stacks:
- Channel 1: DAPI (405 nm excitation) — nuclear architecture, tissue zonation reference.
- Channel 2: Alexa Fluor 546 (561 nm excitation) — CD31⁺ total endothelial network.
- Channel 3: Alexa Fluor 647 (638 nm excitation) — Lectin⁺ perfused vascular lumens.

13.4 For 3D vascular network reconstruction and quantification of branching density, perfusion continuity, vascular rarefaction, and abnormal branching patterns between edge and center regions, import z-stacks into Imaris (Bitplane) or Fiji/ImageJ with the MorphoLibJ or TubeMap plugin for skeletonization and morphometric analysis.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, Ki67 (MKI67) + Alexa Fluor (488), SYCP3/γH2AX → 用 PCNA + Alexa Fluor (555) 替代减数分裂标记, Phalloidin + Alexa Fluor (647)]

具体标记组合（从限制列表中选取）：
- **PCNA + Alexa Fluor（次级抗体标记，555 通道）**：标记 DNA 复制/减数分裂前期活跃增殖细胞（精原细胞→精母细胞过渡群体），作为减数分裂阶段主标记的替代（限制列表内最接近减数分裂阶段标记的 marker）
- **Ki67 (MKI67) + Alexa Fluor（488 通道）**：标记所有增殖期生殖细胞，识别活跃分裂的精原细胞和精母细胞群体
- **Phalloidin + Alexa Fluor（647 通道）**：标记 F-Actin，显示曲细精管管壁肌样细胞骨架及各级生殖细胞的细胞形态轮廓，提供管腔结构参考
- **DAPI**：核形态参考，辅助识别各级生殖细胞核形态（精原细胞圆核、精母细胞大核、精子细胞变形核）

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ 选择理由：①完整小鼠睾丸（8×5×4 mm）属于中等体积致密组织，iDISCO+ 的甲醇梯度脱水 + DBE 折射率匹配方案对该尺度组织透明效果经过充分验证；②iDISCO+ 的有机溶剂体系（DCM/DBE）能有效去除睾丸组织中丰富的脂质（支持细胞富含脂滴），实现深层透明；③iDISCO+ 对抗体穿透性优化（甲醇预处理增强通透性），适合曲细精管高度盘曲、细胞层次复杂的结构；④DBE 折射率（RI≈1.56）与光片显微镜匹配良好，适合全器官三维成像。标记策略说明：睾丸组织中减数分裂阶段的经典标记（SYCP3、γH2AX）不在限制列表内；在限制列表范围内，**PCNA** 在精母细胞减数分裂前期 S 期/DNA 合成阶段高表达，结合 **Ki67** 可区分增殖期生殖细胞群体，两者联合作为减数分裂阶段生殖细胞的主标记；**Phalloidin** 标记 F-Actin 提供曲细精管三维结构轮廓；**DAPI** 仅作核形态辅助参考，不替代主标记。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样本预处理与通透性增强（脱水前处理）**

1.1 将已完成 4% PFA 固定及后固定的完整小鼠睾丸用 1× PBS 洗涤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 10 min)

1.2 去除睾丸白膜（tunica albuginea）外层结缔组织，保留完整实质，用 PBS 漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 5 min)

1.3 将样本置于 50% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS 溶液中孵育，启动脱水并增强组织通透性。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**2 梯度脱水（甲醇系列）**

2.1 转入 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS 溶液孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.2 转入 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS 溶液孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.3 转入 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS 溶液孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.4 转入 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS 溶液孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.5 转入 100% 甲醇孵育（第一次）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.6 转入新鲜 100% 甲醇孵育（第二次），确保完全脱水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 漂白（H₂O₂/甲醇）**

3.1 配制漂白液：5% H₂O₂ 甲醇溶液（1 体积 30% H₂O₂ + 5 体积 100% 甲醇，新鲜配制，预冷至 4 ℃）。将样本转入漂白液，避光孵育，以降低组织自发荧光。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

**4 梯度复水（甲醇→PBS）**

4.1 转入 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS 溶液孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.2 转入 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS 溶液孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.3 转入 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS 溶液孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.4 转入 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS 溶液孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.5 转入 1× PBS 洗涤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

**5 通透化与封闭（PTwH 缓冲液体系）**

5.1 配制 PTwH 缓冲液：1× PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 10 μg/mL 肝素钠（heparin sodium）。用 PTwH 洗涤样本。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

5.2 配制封闭液：PTwH + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) 驴血清（donkey serum）+ 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100。将样本转入封闭液，轻摇孵育，以封闭非特异性结合位点并进一步增强通透性。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**6 一抗孵育（主标记：Ki67 + PCNA）**

6.1 配制一抗工作液（溶于 PTwH + 5% DMSO + 3% 驴血清）：
- 兔抗 Ki67（MKI67）抗体，终浓度 1:200
- 小鼠抗 PCNA 抗体，终浓度 1:300
将样本完全浸没于一抗工作液中，轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

6.2 用 PTwH 洗涤，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

**7 二抗孵育（荧光标记）**

7.1 配制二抗工作液（溶于 PTwH + 3% 驴血清，避光操作）：
- 驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 488（识别 Ki67），终浓度 1:400
- 驴抗小鼠 Alexa Fluor 555（识别 PCNA），终浓度 1:400
- Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 647（F-Actin 标记），终浓度 1:100（直接加入二抗工作液）
将样本转入二抗工作液，避光轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

7.2 用 PTwH 洗涤，去除未结合二抗，避光操作。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

**8 DAPI 核染色（辅助核形态参考）**

8.1 配制 DAPI 工作液：1× PBS 中加入 DAPI，终浓度 5 μg/mL。将样本转入 DAPI 工作液，避光孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

8.2 用 1× PBS 洗涤，去除多余 DAPI。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

**9 脱水（透明前梯度脱水）**

9.1 转入 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS 溶液孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.2 转入 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS 溶液孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.3 转入 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS 溶液孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.4 转入 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS 溶液孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.5 转入 100% 甲醇孵育（第一次），避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.6 转入新鲜 100% 甲醇孵育（第二次），确保完全脱水，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**10 脱脂（DCM 处理）**

10.1 转入 33% (vol/vol) DCM（二氯甲烷，Sigma 270997）/甲醇混合液孵育，避光，通风橱操作。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

10.2 转入 100% DCM 孵育（第一次），充分脱脂，避光，通风橱操作。(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)

10.3 转入新鲜 100% DCM 孵育（第二次），避光，通风橱操作。(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)

**11 折射率匹配（DBE 透明）**

11.1 将样本从 DCM 中取出，用吸水纸轻轻吸去表面残余 DCM（勿过度干燥），立即转入 100% DBE（苯甲酸苄酯/苯甲醇 = 1:2，vol/vol；或直接使用苯甲酸二苄酯，Sigma 108014，RI ≈ 1.56），避光，不振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

11.2 更换新鲜 100% DBE，继续孵育至样本完全透明（呈玻璃状透明），避光，不振荡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours)

**12 成像前处理与保存**

12.1 将透明完成的睾丸样本转移至成像腔室（玻璃底培养皿或定制样本槽），用 100% DBE 完全浸没样本，确保无气泡，避光密封。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min 平衡)

12.2 成像前检查样本透明度，若局部不透明可在 DBE 中延长孵育至完全透明。(Temperature: RT, Time: 最长 48 hours)

12.3 使用光片显微镜（LSFM/SPIM，推荐物镜：5× 或 10× 长工作距离物镜，浸没介质为 DBE 兼容型）进行三维成像：
- 通道 1（DAPI，405 nm 激发）：核形态参考
- 通道 2（Alexa Fluor 488，488 nm 激发）：Ki67 阳性增殖生殖细胞
- 通道 3（Alexa Fluor 555，561 nm 激发）：PCNA 阳性减数分裂前期细胞
- 通道 4（Alexa Fluor 647，638 nm 激发）：Phalloidin F-Actin 曲细精管结构轮廓
(Temperature: RT, Time: 按成像需求)

12.4 长期保存：将样本置于新鲜 DBE 中，4 ℃ 避光密封保存，可保存数周至数月。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 长期保存)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, Ki67 (MKI67) + Alexa Fluor 647, SYCP3/联会复合体蛋白 → 此处从Marker列表选用 PCNA + Alexa Fluor (作为生殖细胞增殖/减数分裂替代标记); 实际靶点映射如下：生殖细胞特异性RNA解旋酶 → 以 **Ki67 (MKI67)** 标记增殖生殖细胞群体（Alexa Fluor 647）；减数分裂联会复合体蛋白 → 以 **PCNA** 标记减数分裂前期精母细胞（Alexa Fluor）；**DAPI** 作为核形态辅助通道]

> **精确靶点映射说明（依据限制列表）：**
> - **生殖细胞特异性RNA解旋酶信号** → 列表中无直接对应抗体，选用 **Ki67 (MKI67)** 作为活跃增殖生殖细胞（精原细胞→精母细胞）的群体标记，结合 **Alexa Fluor 647** 二抗。
> - **减数分裂联会复合体蛋白（SYCP3等）** → 列表中最接近的替代为 **PCNA**（在减数分裂前期精母细胞中高表达），结合 **Alexa Fluor**（546 nm通道）二抗。
> - **DAPI** 作为核形态/细胞层次辅助通道。

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ 是针对完整器官（8 mm × 5 mm × 4 mm 的小鼠睾丸属于中等体积样本）进行全组织免疫标记与透明化的金标准方法。其核心优势如下：①甲醇梯度脱水+二苯醚（DBE）折射率匹配可将睾丸致密结缔组织（白膜、间质）充分透明化；②有机溶剂体系对Alexa Fluor系列荧光素（647、546）保留良好，信噪比高；③预处理中的H₂O₂漂白步骤可消除睾丸内源性血红素自发荧光；④整体免疫标记（whole-mount immunolabeling）无需切片，完整保留曲细精管三维空间构型，满足精子发生波和生精上皮三维排列的观察需求；⑤DAPI可在最终RI匹配液（DBE）中保持核信号，辅助判断细胞层次和核形态（圆形精子细胞、长形精子细胞、精原细胞核型差异）。光片显微镜（LSFM）为推荐成像方式。

---

## Protocol Steps

### 1 样本预处理（Pre-treatment）

1.1 将已完成4% PFA固定及后固定的完整小鼠睾丸置于1.5 mL PBS中，于4℃保存待用；使用精细剪刀在白膜（tunica albuginea）上沿赤道面轻划3–4条长约1 mm的浅切口（不切穿实质），以促进后续试剂渗透。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 操作约10 min)

1.2 用PBS洗涤样本3次，每次10 min，室温轻摇，去除残余固定液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 10 min)

---

### 2 脱水（Methanol Dehydration）

2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol（无水甲醇），轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol（无水甲醇），第二次更换，确保完全脱水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 3 漂白（Bleaching）

3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol（1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes 无水MeOH），完全浸没样本，避光。此步骤消除睾丸间质细胞及血管中的内源性血红素自发荧光。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

---

### 4 复水（Methanol Rehydration）

4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.5 Incubation with PBS（1×），轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.6 Incubation with PBS（1×），第二次更换。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 5 通透化与封闭（Permeabilization & Blocking）

5.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution（PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine），轻摇。此步骤充分打开睾丸致密生精上皮的细胞间连接，提高大分子抗体渗透效率。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5.2 Incubation with Blocking Solution（PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum，含0.1% (wt/vol) heparin），轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

---

### 6 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）

6.1 配制一抗工作液：
- **Anti-Ki67 (MKI67) 兔多克隆抗体**（标记增殖生殖细胞群体，精原细胞至精母细胞），终浓度 **1:200**；
- **Anti-PCNA 小鼠单克隆抗体**（标记减数分裂前期精母细胞，PCNA在细线期至粗线期高表达），终浓度 **1:200**；
溶于 Antibody Solution（PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum，含0.1% (wt/vol) heparin）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours，轻摇，每24 h更换一次抗体工作液以保证渗透)

6.2 一抗孵育后，用PBS/0.2% Tween-20（PTwH：PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 0.1% (wt/vol) heparin）洗涤，每次30 min，共5次，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 30 min)

---

### 7 二抗孵育（Secondary Antibody Incubation）

7.1 配制二抗工作液：
- **Donkey anti-Rabbit IgG conjugated Alexa Fluor 647**（对应Ki67，生殖细胞群体通道），终浓度 **1:400**；
- **Donkey anti-Mouse IgG conjugated Alexa Fluor 546**（对应PCNA，减数分裂精母细胞通道），终浓度 **1:400**；
溶于 Antibody Solution（同6.1配方，不含一抗）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours，轻摇，避光)

7.2 二抗孵育后，用PTwH洗涤，每次30 min，共5次，轻摇，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 30 min)

---

### 8 核染料标记（Nuclear Counterstain — DAPI）

8.1 Incubation with DAPI（4′,6-diamidino-2-phenylindole）工作液，终浓度 **5 µg/mL**，溶于PBS，避光轻摇。DAPI标记所有细胞核，用于区分精原细胞（基底层大核）、精母细胞（粗线期染色质致密）、圆形精子细胞（小圆核）及长形精子细胞（拉长核），辅助判断生精上皮细胞层次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours，避光)

8.2 用PBS洗涤3次，每次15 min，轻摇，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 15 min)

---

### 9 脱水（Pre-clearing Dehydration）

9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O，轻摇，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O，轻摇，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O，轻摇，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O，轻摇，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol（无水甲醇），轻摇，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol（无水甲醇），第二次更换，确保完全脱水，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 10 脱脂（Delipidation with DCM）

10.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 66% (vol/vol) methanol（DCM:MeOH = 1:2 vol/vol），轻摇，避光。此步骤去除睾丸间质脂质，显著提升透明度。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM（二氯甲烷，纯品），轻摇，避光。更换2次，每次30 min，直至样本沉底（密度增大，表明脂质充分去除）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

---

### 11 折射率匹配（Refractive Index Matching with DBE）

11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE（dibenzyl ether，苯甲醚，Sigma-Aldrich 108014），完全浸没样本，不振摇，避光静置。DBE折射率 RI ≈ 1.559，与脱水脱脂后组织折射率匹配，实现完全透明化。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

11.2 更换新鲜100% (vol/vol) DBE，继续静置，直至样本完全透明（肉眼可见曲细精管结构）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours，避光)

---

### 12 样本保存与成像前处理（Storage & Pre-imaging Preparation）

12.1 将透明化完成的睾丸转移至玻璃小瓶（避免DBE溶解塑料容器），加入新鲜DBE完全浸没，密封避光保存。(Temperature: RT, Time: 可保存至成像，建议1–4周内完成成像)

12.2 成像前，将样本转移至光片显微镜（LSFM）专用玻璃样品池（如LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope配套石英池），以DBE（RI = 1.559）作为浸没介质，使用与DBE折射率匹配的物镜（如Olympus MVPLAPO 2×/0.5 NA，或Nikon 10×/0.3 NA CLARITY物镜配合DBE适配器）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 成像前平衡30 min)

12.3 成像通道设置建议：
- **通道1**：405 nm激发 → DAPI（核形态，细胞层次辅助）；
- **通道2**：561 nm激发 → Alexa Fluor 546（PCNA，减数分裂精母细胞定位）；
- **通道3**：638 nm激发 → Alexa Fluor 647（Ki67，生殖细胞群体分布）；
采用Z-stack全器官扫描，步长建议 **2–5 µm**（光片厚度约4–6 µm），覆盖完整睾丸体积（约8 mm × 5 mm × 4 mm）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 单样本扫描约2–6 hours，依分辨率设置)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, Ki67 (MKI67) + Alexa Fluor 647, PCNA + Alexa Fluor 647, γH2AX (via Cleaved Caspase-3 slot → here mapped to DNA/Chromatin marker) — 具体选择：DAPI（核形态/层次参考）、Ki67 (MKI67) + Alexa Fluor（标记增殖精原细胞/精母细胞）、PCNA + Alexa Fluor（标记S期/DNA合成活跃细胞）、α-SMA + Alexa Fluor（标记管周肌样细胞，界定管壁边界）]

> **最终标记组合（严格限于列表内）：**
> - **DAPI**（核染料，辅助信号：区分精原细胞/精母细胞/精子细胞核形态与层次排列）
> - **Ki67 (MKI67) + Alexa Fluor**（增殖细胞标记：精原细胞有丝分裂、精母细胞减数分裂前期）
> - **PCNA + Alexa Fluor**（DNA合成期标记：精原细胞S期及减数分裂前DNA复制）
> - **α-SMA + Alexa Fluor**（管周肌样细胞标记：精确界定曲细精管管壁，构建三维管网骨架）

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ 是目前最适合完整小鼠睾丸（~8×5×4 mm）三维成像的透明方法：①甲醇脱水+二苯醚（DBE）折射率匹配可将该尺寸样本完全透明化，适配光片显微镜全器官扫描；②有机溶剂路线对抗体穿透性优异，可实现深层曲细精管内生殖细胞的免疫标记；③与光片显微镜（LSFM）配合，可在单次扫描中获取完整曲细精管网络的三维图像。标记策略上：**α-SMA** 标记管周肌样细胞层，提供曲细精管三维管网骨架；**Ki67** 和 **PCNA** 分别标记有丝分裂/减数分裂活跃细胞，结合 **DAPI** 核形态（精原细胞核大而圆、精母细胞染色质凝集、精子细胞核拉长），可在三维空间中区分生精细胞层次并定位减数分裂精母细胞的管段分布，从而建立精子发生波的三维图谱。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样本预处理与固定后洗涤**

1.1 将已固定（4% PFA/PBS）完整睾丸置于1.5 mL PBS中，在摇床上充分洗涤，去除残余固定液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3次，共3 hours)

1.2 用PBS再次洗涤，确认样本无残余PFA。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min × 2次，共1 hour)

**2 脱水（Dehydration）**

2.1 置于20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.2 置于40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.3 置于60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.4 置于80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.5 置于100% 甲醇中孵育，第一次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.6 置于100% 甲醇中孵育，第二次，确保完全脱水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 漂白（Bleaching）**

3.1 配制漂白液：5% H₂O₂ in 甲醇（1体积30% H₂O₂ + 5体积100%甲醇），新鲜配制，预冷至4℃。将样本置于漂白液中孵育，去除内源性色素（睾丸含血红素），提高透明度和成像质量。(Temperature: 4℃, Time: 12 hours)

**4 复水（Rehydration）**

4.1 置于80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.2 置于60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.3 置于40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.4 置于20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.5 置于PBS中洗涤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 2次，共2 hours)

**5 通透与封闭（Permeabilization & Blocking）**

5.1 置于通透液（0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS，PTx.2）中孵育，增强抗体穿透性。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

5.2 置于通透液（PTx.2）中继续孵育，完整睾丸需延长通透时间以确保深层曲细精管可及。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 24 hours)

5.3 配制封闭液：6% 正常驴血清（NDS）+ 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.3 M 甘氨酸 in PBS（PTxGS）。将样本置于封闭液中孵育，封闭非特异性结合位点。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

**6 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）**

6.1 配制一抗工作液（in PTxGS封闭液中）：
- 兔抗 α-SMA（1:200，标记管周肌样细胞）
- 大鼠抗 Ki67/MKI67（1:200，标记增殖生殖细胞）
- 小鼠抗 PCNA（1:200，标记DNA合成期细胞）

将完整睾丸置于一抗混合液中，轻柔摇动孵育。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 48 hours)

6.2 用PTx.2（0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS）洗涤，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 5次，共5 hours)

**7 二抗孵育（Secondary Antibody Incubation）**

7.1 配制二抗工作液（in PTxGS中）：
- 驴抗兔-Alexa Fluor 488（1:400，检测α-SMA，绿色通道，管网骨架）
- 驴抗大鼠-Alexa Fluor 546（1:400，检测Ki67，橙色通道，增殖细胞）
- 驴抗小鼠-Alexa Fluor 647（1:400，检测PCNA，远红通道，S期细胞）

将样本置于二抗混合液中，避光孵育。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 48 hours)

7.2 用PTx.2洗涤，去除未结合二抗，避光操作。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 5次，共5 hours)

**8 核染料标记（Nuclear Counterstain with DAPI）**

8.1 配制DAPI工作液：1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS（0.1% Triton X-100）。将样本置于DAPI工作液中孵育，标记所有细胞核，用于辅助判断精原细胞（大圆核）、精母细胞（染色质凝集核）、精子细胞（拉长核）的层次分布。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

8.2 用PBS洗涤，去除游离DAPI。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3次，共3 hours)

**9 脱水（二次脱水，Pre-clearing Dehydration）**

9.1 置于20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.2 置于40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.3 置于60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.4 置于80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.5 置于100% 甲醇中孵育，第一次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.6 置于100% 甲醇中孵育，第二次，确保完全脱水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**10 脱脂（Delipidation with DCM）**

10.1 置于33% (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷（DCM）/甲醇混合液中孵育，开始脱脂。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

10.2 置于100% DCM中孵育，完全脱脂，样本应沉入管底（表明脱水脱脂完全）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min × 2次，共30 min)

**11 折射率匹配（Refractive Index Matching with DBE）**

11.1 弃去DCM，立即加入100% 二苯醚（DBE，Sigma 108014，RI = 1.562），无需摇动，静置孵育。样本逐渐透明化，曲细精管网络结构清晰可见。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

12.1 将透明化完整睾丸转移至成像腔室（玻璃底培养皿或定制折射率匹配腔），用DBE填充腔室，确保样本完全浸没，避免气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min，平衡)

12.3 样本如需短期保存，置于密封容器中，用DBE浸没，避光保存。(Temperature: 4℃, Time: 最长2周)

12.4 成像参数建议（光片显微镜LSFM）：
- 物镜：5× 或 10× 长工作距离水浸/溶剂兼容物镜（RI匹配DBE）
- 激发通道：405 nm（DAPI）、488 nm（Alexa Fluor 488/α-SMA）、561 nm（Alexa Fluor 546/Ki67）、647 nm（Alexa Fluor 647/PCNA）

- 扫描方向：沿睾丸长轴（8 mm方向）进行双侧照明扫描，减少条纹伪影。
(Temperature: RT, Time: 单次全器官扫描约2–6 hours，依分辨率而定)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, Alexa Fluor (anti-DDX4/MVH + Alexa Fluor 488, anti-SYCP3 + Alexa Fluor 647)]

**Justification:**
FDISCO（Fluorescence-preserved Dichloromethane-based Solvent Clearing with Optimized conditions）是一种基于有机溶剂的快速透明方法，在低温（4 ℃）条件下进行脱水和透明，相比标准 iDISCO+ 室温操作，可显著减少荧光信号淬灭和组织结构损伤。针对本问题的关键改进点如下：

1. **结构保留**：FDISCO 全程在 4 ℃ 低温操作，避免了室温有机溶剂处理导致的曲细精管结构破坏和精子细胞脱落；同时省去或缩短漂白（H₂O₂ decoloration）步骤——睾丸组织色素较少，无需 48 h 漂白，从而消除了原方案中过度漂白对组织结构和荧光的双重损伤。
2. **荧光保留**：低温有机溶剂处理对 Alexa Fluor 系列荧光团（488、647）的保护优于室温 iDISCO+，可维持生殖细胞双通道信号强度。
3. **标记策略**：选用 **抗 DDX4（MVH，生殖细胞特异性 RNA 解旋酶）+ Alexa Fluor 488** 标记全体生殖细胞分布；**抗 SYCP3（减数分裂联会复合体蛋白）+ Alexa Fluor 647** 标记减数分裂精母细胞区域；**DAPI** 标记细胞核，显示曲细精管内多层生精细胞的空间层次。三通道组合可同时满足生殖细胞总体分布、减数分裂阶段定位和细胞核三维排列的科学目标，且均在给定标记物/荧光团列表范围内（Alexa Fluor、DAPI）。
4. **样本尺寸适配**：完整小鼠睾丸（8 mm × 5 mm × 4 mm）在 FDISCO 流程中通过梯度甲醇脱水 + DCM 脱脂 + DBE RI 匹配，可实现充分透明，适合光片显微镜三维成像。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**0 前提条件（已完成步骤，确认后进入透明流程）**
0.1 样本已在 4% PFA/PBS 中完成灌注固定及后固定（4 ℃，过夜），PBS 充分漂洗（3 × 30 min，4 ℃）。睾丸白膜保持完整，去除附睾及多余结缔组织。

---

**1 渗透性处理（Permeabilization）**
1.1 在 PBS 中配制含 0.2% Triton X-100、20% DMSO、0.3 M 甘氨酸的渗透缓冲液（PTxG），将样本置于 2 mL 离心管中，加入足量 PTxG。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 用 PBS/0.2% Tween-20/0.1% Triton X-100/0.1% 脱氧胆酸钠/0.05% NP-40（PBSDT）漂洗样本。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

---

**2 封闭（Blocking）**
2.1 配制封闭液：PBS 中含 6% 正常驴血清（NDS）、0.2% Triton X-100、0.3 M 甘氨酸、5% DMSO（PBSDT-封闭液），将样本浸入封闭液。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

---

**3 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）**
3.1 配制一抗孵育液：PBSDT 中含 3% NDS、5% DMSO；加入以下一抗：
- 兔抗 DDX4（MVH）抗体，1:500 稀释（对应生殖细胞特异性 RNA 解旋酶）
- 小鼠抗 SYCP3 抗体，1:300 稀释（对应减数分裂联会复合体蛋白）

将样本置于 2 mL 离心管中，加入足量一抗孵育液，轻柔摇动。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
3.2 用 PBSDT 漂洗样本，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

---

**4 二抗及核染料孵育（Secondary Antibody & Nuclear Dye Incubation）**
4.1 配制二抗孵育液：PBSDT 中含 3% NDS；加入以下二抗及核染料：
- 驴抗兔 IgG-Alexa Fluor 488，1:500 稀释（标记 DDX4 信号）
- 驴抗小鼠 IgG-Alexa Fluor 647，1:500 稀释（标记 SYCP3 信号）
- DAPI，终浓度 5 µg/mL（标记细胞核）

将样本置于避光 2 mL 离心管中，轻柔摇动。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
4.2 用 PBSDT 避光漂洗样本，去除未结合二抗和游离 DAPI。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)
4.3 用 PBS 终漂洗样本。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

---

**5 脱水（Dehydration）——全程 4 ℃、避光**
5.1 将样本转入 15 mL 离心管，加入 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液，轻柔摇动。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
5.2 加入 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液，轻柔摇动。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
5.3 加入 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液，轻柔摇动。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
5.4 加入 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液，轻柔摇动。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
5.5 加入 100% 甲醇，轻柔摇动。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
5.6 再次更换 100% 甲醇，确保完全脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

> **注意**：FDISCO 方案中不进行 H₂O₂ 漂白（decoloration）步骤。睾丸组织内源色素极少，省去该步骤可完全避免原方案中 48 h 漂白对曲细精管结构和荧光信号的破坏。

---

**6 脱脂（Delipidation）——全程 4 ℃、避光、通风橱操作**
6.1 将样本转入玻璃瓶，加入二氯甲烷（DCM，Sigma 270997）至完全浸没，轻柔摇动。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 hours)
6.2 弃去 DCM，再次加入新鲜 DCM，轻柔摇动。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 hours)

---

**7 折射率匹配（Refractive Index Matching）——全程 4 ℃、避光**
7.1 弃去 DCM，立即加入苯甲酸苄酯/苯甲醇（DBE，Sigma 108014；RI ≈ 1.559）至完全浸没样本，轻柔摇动。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 hours)
7.2 更换新鲜 DBE，继续孵育至样本完全透明（肉眼观察透明度）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

---

**8 样本保存与成像前处理（Storage & Pre-imaging）**
8.1 将透明样本转入玻璃成像腔（imaging chamber）或定制玻璃毛细管中，加入 DBE 完全浸没，用透明硅胶密封，避光保存。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 可保存至成像，建议 1 周内完成成像)
8.2 成像前将样本在 DBE 中于室温平衡，去除气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
8.3 使用光片显微镜（LSFM）或共聚焦显微镜进行三维成像：
- 物镜：长工作距离浸油物镜（RI 匹配 DBE，如 Zeiss LSFM 5×/0.16 或 12×/0.53 CLARITY 物镜）
- 激发/发射通道：DAPI（405 nm 激发/450 nm 发射）、Alexa Fluor 488（488 nm 激发/525 nm 发射）、Alexa Fluor 647（638 nm 激发/680 nm 发射）
- 采集方向：建议沿睾丸长轴（8 mm 方向）进行 Z 轴扫描，步长 2–5 µm，以完整覆盖曲细精管三维结构。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Hu C/D (anti-HuC/D antibody + Alexa Fluor 647), PGP9.5 (anti-PGP9.5 antibody + Alexa Fluor 568), DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) it employs methanol-based dehydration and dibenzyl ether (DBE) as the final RI-matching medium (RI ≈ 1.56), achieving excellent optical transparency in thick, lipid-rich tubular gut tissue (~3 mm diameter, 6 cm length); (2) it is highly compatible with immunolabeling of intracellular antigens after methanol-based permeabilization, which is essential for reaching enteric ganglia embedded within the muscularis and submucosa; (3) the solvent-based clearing preserves antigen epitopes accessible to whole-mount antibody penetration when combined with the iDISCO+ permeabilization/blocking protocol; (4) the cleared tissue is ideally suited for light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM), enabling full-volume 3D reconstruction of both myenteric and submucosal plexus networks across the entire colon segment.

Labeling strategy rationale:
- **Hu C/D** (pan-neuronal RNA-binding protein, cytoplasmic): gold-standard marker for enteric neuron soma in all ganglia layers; conjugated to **Alexa Fluor 647** (far-red, minimal tissue autofluorescence in gut).
- **PGP9.5** (protein gene product 9.5 / UCHL1, pan-neuronal/pan-axonal): labels both neuron soma and all nerve fiber processes, enabling visualization of internodal fiber strands and network connectivity; conjugated to **Alexa Fluor 568** (spectrally separated from AF647).
- **DAPI**: nuclear counterstain to delineate tissue layers (mucosa, submucosa, muscularis) and provide anatomical reference for plexus depth assignment. Applied before dehydration as an aqueous pre-label.

---

## Protocol Steps

### 0 Pre-clearing Preparation (starting from PFA-fixed, post-fixed colon segment)

0.1 Gently flush the lumen of the ~6 cm colon segment with 1× PBS (pH 7.4) using a blunt-tip syringe to remove residual luminal contents. Keep the segment as an intact tube; do not open longitudinally. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 minutes)

0.2 Post-fix in 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in 1× PBS if not already completed. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: overnight / 12 hours)

0.3 Wash 3 × 30 min in 1× PBS with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 minutes)

---

### 1 Nuclear Counterstain (DAPI, aqueous pre-label before dehydration)

1.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in 1× PBS with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

1.2 Wash 3 × 30 min in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 minutes)

---

### 2 Dehydration (Methanol Series)

2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.6 Repeat 100% (vol/vol) methanol wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 3 Bleaching (H₂O₂ in Methanol — reduces gut autofluorescence)

3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH). Wrap tube in foil to exclude light. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 hours)

---

### 4 Rehydration (Methanol Series, reverse)

4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.5 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.6 Incubation with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.7 Repeat 1× PBS wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 5 Permeabilization and Blocking

5.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution: 0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS (PTxwH). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5.2 Incubation with Blocking Solution: 0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) + 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

---

### 6 Primary Antibody Incubation

6.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in Blocking Solution:
- Anti-HuC/D (mouse monoclonal, e.g., Invitrogen A-21271 or equivalent), 1:200 dilution
- Anti-PGP9.5 (rabbit polyclonal, e.g., Abcam ab10404 or equivalent), 1:300 dilution
Diluted in PTxwH + 5% NDS + 0.01% sodium azide.

6.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail solution. Gently rock or rotate. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)

6.3 Wash with PTxwH (0.2% gelatin + 0.5% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS + 0.01% sodium azide), 5 × 1 hour washes with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

6.4 Additional overnight wash in PTxwH. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: overnight / 12 hours)

---

### 7 Secondary Antibody Incubation

7.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in PTxwH + 5% NDS:
- Donkey anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500 dilution (for HuC/D detection)
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568, 1:500 dilution (for PGP9.5 detection)
Protect from light throughout all subsequent steps.

7.2 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3–5 days)

7.3 Wash with PTxwH, 5 × 1 hour washes. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

7.4 Additional overnight wash in PTxwH. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: overnight / 12 hours)

7.5 Final wash in 1× PBS, 2 × 30 min. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 minutes)

---

### 8 Second Dehydration (Methanol Series, pre-clearing)

8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.6 Repeat 100% (vol/vol) methanol wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 9 Delipidation with Dichloromethane (DCM)

9.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 67% methanol (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

9.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

9.3 Repeat 100% (vol/vol) DCM wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

> Note: Perform DCM steps in a chemical fume hood. DCM is denser than methanol; tissue will sink when fully dehydrated/delipidated, indicating readiness for RI matching.

---

### 10 Refractive Index Matching with Dibenzyl Ether (DBE)

10.1 Remove DCM completely and immediately transfer tissue to 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014; RI ≈ 1.562). Ensure tissue is fully submerged. Do not seal with parafilm (DCM residue must evaporate). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

10.2 Replace with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE. Tissue should appear fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: overnight / 12 hours)

10.3 Inspect transparency. If not fully clear, continue incubation in fresh DBE. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to additional 24 hours)

---

### 11 Sample Mounting and Storage Prior to Imaging

11.1 Transfer the cleared colon segment into a custom glass imaging chamber or a 5 mm inner-diameter glass capillary/cuvette filled with 100% DBE. Orient the colon segment longitudinally along the imaging axis for light-sheet acquisition, or coil gently for confocal tile-scan acquisition.

11.2 Seal the chamber with optical-quality glass coverslip using DBE-compatible silicone sealant (e.g., Kwik-Sil or equivalent solvent-resistant adhesive). Avoid air bubbles. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes curing)

11.3 Store in the dark in DBE-filled sealed glass container at RT until imaging. Avoid plastic containers (DBE dissolves most plastics). (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 4 weeks)

---

### 12 Imaging Parameters (Recommended)

12.1 For light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM): use an objective lens compatible with DBE immersion (RI = 1.56; e.g., CLARITY/LSFM objectives with RI correction collar set to 1.56). Recommended channels: DAPI (405 nm excitation), Alexa Fluor 568 (561 nm excitation, PGP9.5 / pan-neuronal fibers + soma), Alexa Fluor 647 (638 nm excitation, HuC/D / neuron soma). Acquire Z-stacks with ≤ 2 µm Z-step for myenteric plexus layer resolution and ≤ 1 µm for submucosal plexus. (Temperature: RT, Time: per acquisition session)

12.2 For confocal tile-scan (alternative): use a 10× or 20× objective with RI correction immersion medium matched to DBE (RI = 1.56). Acquire overlapping tiles with ≥ 10% overlap for stitching. Use Z-step of 1–2 µm. (Temperature: RT, Time: per acquisition session)
