**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [EGFP (内源), tdTomato (内源), MAP2]

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is the gold-standard solvent-based clearing method for whole mouse brain (~10×8×6 mm), offering excellent lipid removal, deep antibody penetration (enabled by methanol dehydration + detergent permeabilization), and strong preservation of endogenous fluorescent proteins (EGFP and tdTomato both survive the iDISCO+ protocol when fixation is adequate). The organic solvent final RI-matching medium (DBE, n≈1.56) is well-matched to light-sheet microscopy, which is the appropriate modality for whole-brain 3D atlas construction at this scale. Endogenous EGFP and tdTomato signals are used directly to trace long-range projections from amygdala/PFC without additional amplification antibodies, minimizing background. MAP2 immunolabeling is added as a pan-dendritic/neuronal process marker to provide structural reference in projection terminal zones (thalamus, NAc, etc.), enabling spatial co-registration of tracer terminals with local neuronal architecture. MAP2 antibody penetration into whole brain is feasible with iDISCO+'s methanol-based permeabilization and extended incubation at 37 °C.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Post-fixation Wash**
1.1 Wash fixed whole brain (4% PFA in PBS, perfusion-fixed) with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3 washes)

**2 Pretreatment – Dehydration with Methanol Series**
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (second change). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 Bleaching (H₂O₂ Treatment)**
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)

**4 Rehydration**
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**5 Permeabilization & Blocking**
5.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution [0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, gentle shaking)
5.2 Incubation with Blocking Solution [0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide, 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, gentle shaking)

**6 Primary Antibody Incubation (MAP2)**
6.1 Incubation with primary antibody solution: anti-MAP2 rabbit polyclonal antibody (1:500 dilution; e.g., Abcam ab32454 or equivalent) in Antibody Diluent [0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking, protected from light)

**7 Primary Antibody Wash**
7.1 Wash with Washing Buffer [0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
7.2 Wash with Washing Buffer (second wash). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
7.3 Wash with Washing Buffer (third wash). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
7.4 Wash with Washing Buffer (fourth wash). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
7.5 Wash with Washing Buffer (fifth wash). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
7.6 Wash with Washing Buffer (overnight wash). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours, gentle shaking)

**8 Secondary Antibody Incubation**
8.1 Incubation with secondary antibody solution: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated antibody (1:500 dilution; e.g., Thermo Fisher A-31573) in Antibody Diluent [0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, gentle shaking, protected from light)
> *Note: Alexa Fluor 647 (far-red, ~647/668 nm) is spectrally separated from EGFP (~488/507 nm) and tdTomato (~554/581 nm), enabling three-channel simultaneous imaging.*

**9 Secondary Antibody Wash**
9.1 Wash with Washing Buffer [0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
9.2 Wash with Washing Buffer (second wash). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
9.3 Wash with Washing Buffer (third wash). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
9.4 Wash with Washing Buffer (fourth wash). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
9.5 Wash with Washing Buffer (fifth wash). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
9.6 Wash with Washing Buffer (overnight wash). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours, gentle shaking)
9.7 Final wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**10 Dehydration (Pre-clearing)**
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (second change). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**11 Delipidation with DCM**
11.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 33% (vol/vol) methanol mixture. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, gentle agitation in glass vial)
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (first change). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
11.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (second change). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
> *Note: Use glass vials throughout DCM steps; ensure complete methanol displacement before proceeding.*

**12 Refractive Index Matching with DBE**
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE; Sigma-Aldrich 108014, RI ≈ 1.559) without shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours, protected from light)
12.2 Replace with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE and incubate until brain is fully transparent and uniformly clear. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours, protected from light, no shaking)
> *Note: Brain should appear fully transparent and amber-tinted. Do not over-incubate beyond 48 hours to minimize fluorescence quenching.*

**13 Storage / Pre-imaging**
13.1 Store cleared brain in 100% DBE in sealed glass vial. (Temperature: RT, protected from light, up to 2 weeks before imaging)
13.2 Mount brain in DBE-filled imaging chamber (e.g., custom glass cuvette or 3D-printed holder) compatible with light-sheet microscope (e.g., LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope II, Zeiss Lightsheet Z.1, or equivalent). Ensure brain is fully submerged and immobilized with agarose-free mounting (use DBE-compatible adhesive or holder). (Temperature: RT)
13.3 Acquire whole-brain 3D image stacks using three excitation channels: 488 nm (EGFP), 561 nm (tdTomato), 647 nm (Alexa Fluor 647 / MAP2) with appropriate emission filters (525/50 nm, 600/50 nm, 680/30 nm respectively). Recommended objective: 4× or 12× with long working distance, immersion in DBE (RI = 1.56). Z-step: 2–5 µm for whole-brain atlas; 1 µm for high-resolution terminal zone analysis. (Temperature: RT)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS

**Chosen Labeling:** [EGFP (内源), tdTomato (内源), MAP2 + Alexa Fluor (远红外, 如 Alexa Fluor 647)]

**Justification:**
PEGASOS（Polyethylene Glycol-associated Solvent System）是专为完整小鼠全脑设计的有机溶剂透明化方案，具有以下关键优势：

1. **充分脱脂**：采用叔丁醇（tert-butanol, tB）梯度脱水脱脂，对完整全脑（~10×8×6 mm）脱脂效率远优于单纯SDS水相处理，可彻底消除脂质导致的浑浊，解决原SWITCH流程透明化不彻底的核心问题。
2. **内源荧光保留**：PEGASOS在叔丁醇脱水过程中对EGFP和tdTomato均有良好保留（优于uDISCO的二苯醚体系），且最终RI匹配液（BB-PEG）为水性/PEG基，进一步保护荧光蛋白活性。
3. **抗体渗透性**：PEGASOS流程在脱脂后组织疏松多孔，配合适当的渗透增强步骤，抗MAP2抗体可有效渗透至全脑深部，解决原流程远红抗体信号弱的问题。
4. **均一RI匹配**：BB-PEG（苯甲醇/苯甲酸苄酯/PEG）RI≈1.52，与脱水组织完美匹配，背景极低，适合光片显微镜三维成像。
5. **标记策略**：保留内源EGFP（神经元投射示踪）和tdTomato（环路标记），联合MAP2抗体（Alexa Fluor 647标记）显示树突骨架，三通道覆盖长程投射+局部树突结构，完全满足杏仁核-前额叶-丘脑-伏隔核环路分析需求，且所有荧光团均在给定列表范围内。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样品预处理与渗透性增强**

1.1 将已完成PFA固定及后固定的完整小鼠全脑用1× PBS在室温下充分漂洗，去除残余固定液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

1.2 将脑组织转入含0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的1× PBS中，4°C轻摇孵育，增强后续抗体渗透性。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

---

**2 抗体标记（免疫荧光染色）**

2.1 封闭：将组织转入封闭液（5% (wt/vol) 正常驴血清 + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) 叠氮化钠，溶于1× PBS）中，4°C轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

2.2 一抗孵育：将组织转入含抗MAP2一抗（1:200稀释，溶于封闭液）的溶液中，4°C轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)

2.3 一抗洗涤：用含0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的1× PBS（PTwH）漂洗，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

2.4 二抗孵育：将组织转入含抗兔/抗鼠 Alexa Fluor 647标记二抗（1:400稀释，溶于封闭液）的溶液中，4°C避光轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5 days)

2.5 二抗洗涤：用PTwH充分漂洗，去除未结合二抗，避光操作。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, 随后4°C过夜)

---

**3 脱水（叔丁醇梯度）**

3.1 将组织转入30% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液（tB，预热至37°C）中，37°C水浴轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.2 将组织转入50% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中，37°C水浴轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.3 将组织转入70% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中，37°C水浴轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.4 将组织转入80% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中，37°C水浴轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.5 将组织转入90% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中，37°C水浴轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.6 将组织转入96% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中，37°C水浴轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.7 将组织转入100% 叔丁醇（无水）中，37°C水浴轻摇孵育，重复两次，确保完全脱水脱脂。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 × 12 hours)

---

**4 透明化（BB-PEG RI匹配液浸泡）**

4.1 配制BB-PEG透明化液：将苯甲醇（Benzyl Alcohol, BA）与苯甲酸苄酯（Benzyl Benzoate, BB）按1:2 (vol/vol) 混合，加入75% (wt/vol) PEG-400，充分混匀，最终RI≈1.52，避光保存备用。(Temperature: RT, 配制步骤)

4.2 将完全脱水的组织直接转入BB-PEG透明化液中，37°C避光静置孵育，直至组织完全透明（通常全脑需2–3天）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48–72 hours)

4.3 观察透明化效果：组织应呈现高度透明、无浑浊区域；若仍有局部浑浊，可延长至96 hours，期间每24小时更换新鲜BB-PEG。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 最长 96 hours)

---

**5 折射率匹配与成像前处理**

5.1 将透明化完成的组织在新鲜BB-PEG中室温静置平衡，确保组织内外RI完全均一（RI = 1.52），避光保存。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5.2 将组织转移至成像专用玻璃样品槽（底部用低荧光光学胶封底），加入足量BB-PEG作为成像介质，确保组织完全浸没，避免气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour 平衡)

5.3 成像前检查：在光片显微镜（推荐488 nm激发EGFP、561 nm激发tdTomato、633/647 nm激发Alexa Fluor 647）下预扫描，确认三通道信号均匀、背景低、无折射率失配伪影。(Temperature: RT, Time: 成像前检查)

---

**6 样品保存（成像后）**

6.1 成像完成后，将样品密封于BB-PEG中，避光、室温保存，可维持荧光信号数周至数月。(Temperature: RT, Time: 长期保存，避光密封)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [c-Fos (C-FoS) + Alexa Fluor 647, NeuN (NeuN/RBFOX3) + Alexa Fluor 568, TH (酪氨酸羟化酶) + Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) it achieves deep, uniform clearing of large intact tissues including whole mouse brain (~1.5 cm × 1 cm × 0.8 cm) and tongue (~1.5 cm) via organic solvent-based delipidation, enabling single-pass light-sheet imaging of the entire tongue–brain circuit; (2) its methanol-based dehydration and dibenzyl ether (DBE) RI-matching step are well-validated for preserving immunofluorescence signal across large volumes; (3) the protocol includes a dedicated whole-mount immunolabeling phase with detergent permeabilization and serum blocking, which is essential for penetrating dense CNS and muscle tissue to label activity-dependent markers. For the labeling strategy: **c-Fos + Alexa Fluor 647** serves as the primary activity-dependent marker to capture anesthesia-arousal–activated neuronal ensembles across MTN, LC, PVT, NAcSh and other arousal/motor/visceral nuclei — this is the scientifically critical channel and cannot be replaced by nuclear dyes; **NeuN + Alexa Fluor 568** provides a pan-neuronal reference to normalize c-Fos+ cell counts and define regional neuronal density; **TH + Alexa Fluor 488** labels catecholaminergic neurons in LC and other monoaminergic nuclei central to arousal circuitry; **DAPI** is used solely as a cytoarchitectural/registration reference for atlas alignment and is explicitly not used as a substitute for the activity-dependent primary label. iDISCO+ is compatible with all three antibody targets and preserves Alexa Fluor dyes reliably through the DBE clearing pipeline.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Pre-treatment and Permeabilization**
1.1 Wash fixed brain and tongue samples (post-fixed in 4% PFA/PBS) with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled H₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (second change) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.8 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH) to quench endogenous peroxidase and reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.9 Rehydration: incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.10 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.11 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.12 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.13 Incubation with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)
1.14 Incubation with PBS/0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PTx0.2) for initial permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)
1.15 Incubation with permeabilization solution: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.16 Incubation with blocking solution: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**2 Primary Antibody Labeling**
2.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in PTwH (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin) + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (vol/vol) NDS:
— Anti-c-Fos rabbit polyclonal (e.g., Synaptic Systems #226 003), 1:1000 dilution
— Anti-NeuN mouse monoclonal (e.g., Millipore MAB377), 1:500 dilution
— Anti-TH rabbit polyclonal (e.g., Millipore AB152; use only if multiplexing allows species separation — alternatively use anti-TH chicken antibody, 1:500)
Note: ensure primary antibodies are raised in different host species to allow spectrally distinct secondary labeling. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle rocking)
2.2 Wash with PTwH (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight)

**3 Secondary Antibody Labeling**
3.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in PTwH + 3% (vol/vol) NDS:
— Donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (for c-Fos detection), 1:500 dilution
— Donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 568 (for NeuN detection), 1:500 dilution
— Donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 488 (for TH detection), 1:500 dilution
Protect from light throughout all subsequent steps. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, with gentle rocking, protected from light)
3.2 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight, protected from light)

**4 Nuclear Counterstain (Registration Reference Only)**
4.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PTwH) as cytoarchitectural reference for atlas registration; this step does not substitute the c-Fos activity-dependent primary label. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, protected from light)
4.2 Wash with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 minutes, protected from light)
4.3 Final wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 minutes, protected from light)

**5 Dehydration for Clearing**
5.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
5.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
5.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
5.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)
5.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (second change). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

**6 Delipidation**
6.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol (1 volume DCM : 2 volumes MeOH) with gentle shaking in a fume hood. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, protected from light)
6.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (two changes) to complete delipidation; samples should sink to the bottom of the vial when clearing is complete. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 15 minutes, protected from light)

**7 Refractive Index Matching**
7.1 Transfer samples into 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014; RI = 1.562) without shaking. Ensure samples are fully submerged. Replace DBE once after initial equilibration. (Temperature: RT, Time: ≥ 3 hours for initial immersion, then overnight for full RI equilibration, protected from light)
7.2 Confirm optical transparency visually; samples should appear fully transparent and colorless/faintly yellow. If residual opacity remains, extend DBE incubation by an additional 12–24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 24 additional hours if needed)

**8 Storage and Pre-imaging Preparation**
8.1 Store cleared samples in fresh 100% DBE in sealed glass vials (avoid plastic containers; DBE dissolves polystyrene). Wrap vials in aluminum foil to protect fluorescence. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 4 weeks; for longer storage transfer to 4 ℃)
8.2 Prior to light-sheet imaging, mount samples in a custom-fabricated FEP (fluorinated ethylene propylene) tube or glass imaging chamber filled with 100% DBE (RI = 1.562) to match the immersion medium of the objective (use a DBE-compatible long-working-distance objective, e.g., CLARITY/LSFM objective with RI ≈ 1.56). (Temperature: RT, Time: equilibrate in imaging chamber for ≥ 1 hour before acquisition)
8.3 For brain–tongue spatial relationship preservation, image brain and tongue sequentially in the same DBE-filled chamber, maintaining their relative anatomical orientation; use fiducial landmarks (e.g., tongue base attachment point) for post-acquisition 3D co-registration. (Temperature: RT, Time: as required for full volumetric acquisition)
8.4 Acquire images using a light-sheet fluorescence microscope (LSFM) with the following channel assignments:
— 405 nm excitation → DAPI (cytoarchitecture / atlas registration)
— 488 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 488 / TH (catecholaminergic neurons, LC)
— 561 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 568 / NeuN (pan-neuronal reference)
— 638 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 647 / c-Fos (primary activity-dependent signal)
Collect z-stacks at ≤ 5 µm step size for whole-brain volumes and ≤ 3 µm for tongue to resolve individual c-Fos+ neurons and neuromuscular structures. (Temperature: RT, Time: per acquisition schedule)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [C-Fos + Alexa Fluor 647, Npas4 (IEGs) + Alexa Fluor 546 (as secondary-conjugated Alexa Fluor dye), DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) It is the gold-standard whole-mount immunolabeling + clearing pipeline for intact mouse brain (~1.5 cm scale), with well-validated antibody penetration via methanol-based permeabilization and detergent washes; (2) It preserves antigenicity of IEG proteins (c-Fos, Npas4) sufficiently for immunostaining, which is mandatory since IEG expression must be detected by antibody rather than transgenic reporters; (3) The organic solvent clearing (DCM/DBE) achieves high transparency in large tissues including the tongue; (4) Two spectrally distinct Alexa Fluor secondaries (Alexa Fluor 647 and Alexa Fluor 546) allow simultaneous dual-IEG detection (single-positive, double-positive, region-specific populations) across MTN, LC, PVT, NAcSh and other regions; (5) DAPI is included as a nuclear counterstain for whole-brain registration and cell counting (auxiliary channel), applied before dehydration as a small-molecule dye that penetrates fixed tissue. The tongue (~1.5 cm) is processed in parallel with the brain using the same protocol with extended incubation times.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**0 Pre-clearing Preparation**

0.1 Confirm tissue fixation: both brain (~1.5 cm × 1 cm × 0.8 cm) and tongue (~1.5 cm) should be post-fixed in 4% PFA in 0.1 M PBS overnight at 4 °C, then washed 3 × 1 h in PBS at RT before proceeding. (Temperature: 4 °C → RT, Time: overnight + 3 × 1 h)

0.2 Wash tissues in PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PTx0.2) to begin permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 h)

---

**1 DAPI Nuclear Staining (Auxiliary Channel for Registration and Cell Counting)**

1.1 Incubate tissues in DAPI solution (5 µg/mL in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100) with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 h)

1.2 Wash in PTx0.2 (3 × 2 h) to remove excess DAPI. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 2 h)

---

**2 Dehydration (Methanol Series)**

2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O (ddH₂O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

2.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

---

**3 Bleaching (Endogenous Peroxidase Quenching and Tissue Whitening)**

3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH, freshly prepared). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 h)

---

**4 Rehydration (Methanol Series, Reverse)**

4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

4.5 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

4.6 Incubation with PBS, second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

---

**5 Permeabilization**

5.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PTx0.2). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

5.2 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine, pH 7.0. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 h for brain; 36 h for tongue)

---

**6 Blocking**

6.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS). (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 h for brain; 36 h for tongue)

---

**7 Primary Antibody Incubation (Dual IEG Labeling)**

7.1 Prepare Primary Antibody Solution in PTwH (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin) supplemented with 5% (vol/vol) DMSO and 3% (vol/vol) NDS:
- Anti-c-Fos rabbit monoclonal antibody (e.g., Cell Signaling #2250 or Synaptic Systems #226 003), dilution 1:500
- Anti-Npas4 goat polyclonal antibody (e.g., Santa Cruz sc-393314 or equivalent validated IEG antibody), dilution 1:200
Both antibodies must be from different host species to allow spectrally distinct secondary labeling.

7.2 Incubate tissues in Primary Antibody Solution with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 7 days for brain; 7–10 days for tongue — replace solution every 2–3 days)

7.3 Wash in PTwH (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin), 5 × 1 h, then overnight wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 h + overnight)

---

**8 Secondary Antibody Incubation**

8.1 Prepare Secondary Antibody Solution in PTwH + 3% (vol/vol) NDS:
- Donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (Thermo Fisher A31573), dilution 1:500 → labels c-Fos
- Donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 546 (Thermo Fisher A11056), dilution 1:500 → labels Npas4
Alexa Fluor 647 and Alexa Fluor 546 are spectrally well-separated for simultaneous dual-channel light-sheet imaging.

8.2 Incubate tissues in Secondary Antibody Solution with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 5 days for brain; 5–7 days for tongue)

8.3 Wash in PTwH, 5 × 1 h, then overnight wash, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 h + overnight)

8.4 Final wash in PBS, 2 × 1 h, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 h)

---

**9 Dehydration (Pre-clearing, Methanol Series)**

9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

9.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 h)

---

**10 Delipidation / Clearing**

10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol (DCM:MeOH = 2:1 vol/vol), in a sealed glass vial, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 h for brain; 4 h for tongue)

10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (two changes), in sealed glass vials, to remove residual methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min × 2)

---

**11 Refractive Index Matching**

11.1 Transfer tissues to dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014), 100% (vol/vol), in sealed glass vials, protected from light, without shaking. Tissues should sink and become fully transparent within this step. (Temperature: RT, Time: ≥ 3 h for brain; ≥ 4 h for tongue — can be extended to overnight for complete RI matching; RI ≈ 1.558)

11.2 Replace DBE with fresh 100% DBE and confirm full optical transparency of both brain and tongue before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 h additional if needed)

---

**12 Storage and Pre-imaging Preparation**

12.1 Store cleared tissues in 100% DBE in sealed glass vials, wrapped in aluminum foil, until imaging. Avoid plastic containers (DBE dissolves most plastics). (Temperature: RT or 4 °C, Time: up to 2–4 weeks; fluorescence stable for weeks in DBE)

12.2 For light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) imaging: mount tissues in DBE-filled glass imaging chambers or custom 3D-printed holders compatible with DBE. Use an objective lens with RI correction for DBE (RI = 1.558), such as a CLARITY/organic solvent-compatible objective (e.g., Olympus XLPLN10XSVMP or LaVision Ultramicroscope objectives).

12.3 Imaging channel assignment:
- Channel 1 (405 nm excitation): DAPI → nuclear counterstain for whole-brain atlas registration and cell counting
- Channel 2 (561 nm excitation): Alexa Fluor 546 → Npas4 (IEG signal)
- Channel 3 (638 nm excitation): Alexa Fluor 647 → c-Fos (IEG signal)
Acquire all three channels sequentially per z-plane to enable single-positive (c-Fos only or Npas4 only), double-positive (c-Fos⁺/Npas4⁺), and region-specific neuronal population analysis across MTN, LC, PVT, NAcSh and other anesthesia-arousal relevant regions.

**Justification:** iDISCO+是目前最成熟的全脑免疫标记透明化方案，采用甲醇脱水+二苯醚（DBE）折射率匹配，对完整小鼠脑（~1.5 cm量级）具有优异的抗体渗透性和荧光保存能力。其甲醇脱水步骤同时适用于舌头软组织，两种组织可在同一流程中处理。科学目标核心为麻醉唤醒后全脑活化神经元定位，c-Fos作为经典即刻早期基因（IEG）标记物是首选靶点，配合Alexa Fluor 647（远红通道，组织穿透最深）实现全脑范围检测；NeuN标记全脑神经元总体分布，提供细胞密度背景参考；Phalloidin-AF488标记舌肌F-actin纤维，提供舌头三维肌肉结构参考；DAPI提供细胞核信号用于解剖配准。iDISCO+的DBE折射率（RI≈1.56）与光片显微镜（LSFM）高度匹配，适合全脑+舌头整体三维成像。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**0 前提条件说明**
样本已完成4% PFA灌注固定及后固定（4℃，过夜），PBS充分漂洗。脑组织和舌头分别处理，但可在同一批次平行操作，以下步骤适用于两种组织，特殊差异处注明。

---

**1 预处理：脱色与渗透性增强**

1.1 PBS漂洗：将脑组织和舌头分别置于5 mL PBS中振荡漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3次)

1.2 甲醇梯度脱水（20% MeOH/PBS）：样本置于20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS溶液中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 甲醇梯度脱水（40% MeOH/PBS）：转入40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS溶液中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 甲醇梯度脱水（60% MeOH/PBS）：转入60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS溶液中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 甲醇梯度脱水（80% MeOH/PBS）：转入80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS溶液中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 甲醇梯度脱水（100% MeOH）：转入100% (vol/vol) 甲醇中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.7 100% MeOH第二次孵育：更换新鲜100% (vol/vol) 甲醇，振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.8 过氧化氢漂白：配制5% H₂O₂/甲醇溶液（1体积30% H₂O₂ + 5体积100% MeOH），样本置于冰上孵育（脑组织漂白可去除血红素背景荧光，舌头同步处理）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)

1.9 甲醇梯度复水（100% MeOH）：漂白后转入新鲜100% (vol/vol) 甲醇振荡漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.10 甲醇梯度复水（80% MeOH/PBS）：转入80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS振荡漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.11 甲醇梯度复水（60% MeOH/PBS）：转入60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS振荡漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.12 甲醇梯度复水（40% MeOH/PBS）：转入40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS振荡漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.13 甲醇梯度复水（20% MeOH/PBS）：转入20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS振荡漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.14 PBS漂洗：转入PBS振荡漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 2次)

---

**2 渗透性增强处理（PTwH预处理）**

2.1 配制PTwH缓冲液：PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 10 μg/mL肝素（heparin），用于后续所有漂洗步骤。

2.2 PTwH漂洗：样本置于PTwH缓冲液中振荡漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 2次)

2.3 渗透性增强孵育：样本置于含0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M甘氨酸的PBS溶液中振荡孵育（增强大组织抗体渗透，舌头肌肉组织同样受益）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

2.4 封闭孵育：转入含0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清（NDS）的PBS溶液中振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

---

**3 一抗孵育（免疫标记活化神经元及神经元总体）**

3.1 配制一抗工作液：在PTwH + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (vol/vol) NDS缓冲液中加入：
- 兔抗c-Fos抗体（Synaptic Systems #226 003 或同等品），1:1000稀释
- 小鼠抗NeuN抗体（Millipore MAB377），1:500稀释
（注：两种一抗宿主种属不同，可同步孵育）

3.2 一抗孵育（脑组织）：脑组织置于一抗工作液中，轻柔振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

3.3 一抗孵育（舌头）：舌头置于同批一抗工作液中，轻柔振荡孵育（舌头肌肉组织较致密，延长孵育时间确保渗透）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)

3.4 PTwH漂洗：一抗孵育结束后，转入PTwH缓冲液振荡漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 5次，每次间隔至少1 hour，共24 hours)

---

**4 二抗孵育及化学染料标记**

4.1 配制二抗工作液：在PTwH + 3% (vol/vol) NDS缓冲液中加入：
- 驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 647（Thermo Fisher A31573），1:500稀释（标记c-Fos，远红通道，穿透最深）
- 驴抗小鼠 Alexa Fluor 568（Thermo Fisher A10037），1:500稀释（标记NeuN，红色通道）
- Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488（Thermo Fisher A12379），1:200稀释（标记F-actin，绿色通道，主要用于舌肌结构）
- DAPI，1 μg/mL终浓度（蓝色通道，细胞核）

4.2 二抗及染料孵育（脑组织）：脑组织置于二抗工作液中，避光轻柔振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)

4.3 二抗及染料孵育（舌头）：舌头置于同批二抗工作液中，避光轻柔振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4 days)

4.4 PTwH漂洗：二抗孵育结束后，转入PTwH缓冲液避光振荡漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 5次，共24 hours)

4.5 PBS终漂洗：转入PBS避光振荡漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 2次)

---

**5 脱水（透明化前脱水）**

5.1 甲醇梯度脱水（20% MeOH/PBS）：样本置于20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS中避光振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.2 甲醇梯度脱水（40% MeOH/PBS）：转入40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS避光振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.3 甲醇梯度脱水（60% MeOH/PBS）：转入60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS避光振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.4 甲醇梯度脱水（80% MeOH/PBS）：转入80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/PBS避光振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.5 甲醇梯度脱水（100% MeOH，第一次）：转入100% (vol/vol) 甲醇避光振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.6 甲醇梯度脱水（100% MeOH，第二次）：更换新鲜100% (vol/vol) 甲醇避光振荡孵育，确保完全脱水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

**6 脱脂透明化（DCM/MeOH处理）**

6.1 DCM/MeOH脱脂：配制二氯甲烷（DCM）/甲醇 = 2:1 (vol/vol) 混合液，样本置于其中避光振荡孵育（脱除脂质，提升透明度）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

6.2 100% DCM漂洗：转入100% (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷（DCM，Sigma 270997）避光振荡漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min × 2次)

---

**7 折射率匹配（RI Matching，DBE）**

7.1 DBE折射率匹配：将完全脱水脱脂的脑组织和舌头分别转入100% (vol/vol) 苯甲酸苄酯/苯甲醚（DBE，Sigma 108014，RI≈1.56）中，避光静置孵育（不振荡，防止气泡），直至组织完全透明。脑组织需较长时间，舌头因体积相近可同步完成。(Temperature: RT, Time: 脑组织：4–6 hours；舌头：3–4 hours，以组织完全透明为准)

7.2 DBE长期保存（可选）：若不立即成像，样本可在新鲜DBE中避光密封保存。(Temperature: RT, Time: 最长2–4周，建议尽快成像以保存荧光)

---

**8 成像前处理**

8.1 成像腔室准备：使用与DBE兼容的成像腔室（如FEP管或玻璃底培养皿），用DBE充满腔室，避免气泡。

8.2 样本定位：将脑组织和舌头分别固定于成像腔室中，脑组织可采用背侧朝上或腹侧朝上定向，舌头平铺放置，确保两者均完全浸没于DBE中。

8.3 光片显微镜成像参数建议：
- 物镜：2×或4×长工作距离物镜（与DBE RI匹配，如LaVision BioTec或Miltenyi Ultramicroscope配套物镜）
- 激发/发射通道：
  - DAPI：405 nm激发 / 420–470 nm发射
  - Phalloidin-AF488：488 nm激发 / 505–545 nm发射（舌肌结构）
  - NeuN-AF568：561 nm激发 / 580–630 nm发射（神经元总体）
  - c-Fos-AF647：638 nm激发 / 660–720 nm发射（活化神经元，优先采集）
- 步进：全脑建议Z步距3–5 μm；舌头建议Z步距5–10 μm

8.4 成像后数据处理建议：使用Imaris、ClearMap或brainreg进行全脑c-Fos阳性神经元三维定位及脑区配准（Allen Mouse Brain Atlas），结合NeuN通道进行细胞密度归一化，舌头Phalloidin通道用于三维肌肉结构重建及解剖参考。(Temperature: RT, Time: 按实际成像时间)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Alexa Fluor 647, C-Fos, Npas4 (IEGs), NeuN (RBFOX3), TH (酪氨酸羟化酶), DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected as the optimal method for this study for the following reasons:
1. **Whole-organ compatibility:** iDISCO+ has been extensively validated for intact mouse brain (~1.5 cm × 1 cm × 0.8 cm) and peripheral tissues including tongue, achieving high transparency through organic solvent-based delipidation (DCM/methanol) combined with DBE refractive index matching.
2. **Deep antibody penetration:** The methanol-based pretreatment and detergent permeabilization steps in iDISCO+ enable antibody penetration into deep brain regions (MTN, LC, PVT, NAcSh) that are critical for this study.
3. **Dual IEG labeling:** iDISCO+ supports multiplexed immunolabeling, allowing simultaneous detection of two immediate early genes (C-Fos and Npas4) with spectrally distinct Alexa Fluor secondaries to distinguish two activity-dependent expression patterns.
4. **Fluorescence preservation:** DBE-based RI matching preserves Alexa Fluor 647 signal far better than direct DBE immersion without proper gradient dehydration; the H₂O₂ bleaching step removes autofluorescence without destroying antigenicity when performed correctly.
5. **Correction of original protocol failures:** The original protocol lacked gradient dehydration/rehydration, permeabilization, blocking, long antibody incubation, and washing steps. iDISCO+ addresses all these deficiencies with a well-established, peer-validated workflow.
6. **NeuN** provides neuronal counterstaining for quantification of total neurons vs. activated neurons; **TH** labels catecholaminergic neurons in LC and other nuclei relevant to anesthesia arousal circuits; **DAPI** provides nuclear reference for registration.
7. **Alexa Fluor 647** (far-red) is chosen for C-Fos (primary IEG channel) to maximize tissue penetration depth and minimize autofluorescence background in deep brain regions.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Sample Preparation and Pre-treatment**

1.1 Retrieve PFA-fixed and post-fixed brain and tongue samples from storage buffer (PBS). Confirm complete fixation (tissue firm, not soft). Rinse briefly in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 min × 3 washes)

1.2 Transfer samples to fresh 1× PBS and wash to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

**2 Gradient Methanol Dehydration**

2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

2.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

**3 Autofluorescence Bleaching**

3.1 Prepare chilled bleaching solution: 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes 100% MeOH, freshly prepared on ice). Incubate samples fully submerged. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours, protected from light, no shaking)

**4 Gradient Methanol Rehydration**

4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

4.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

4.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

4.5 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

4.6 Incubation with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

4.7 Incubation with fresh 1× PBS, second wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

**5 Permeabilization**

5.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in 1× PBS, pH 7.4]. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, gentle rocking, brain and tongue separately to ensure full immersion)

5.2 Incubation with fresh Permeabilization Solution (second change, same composition as 5.1). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, gentle rocking)

**6 Blocking**

6.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, gentle rocking, protected from light)

6.2 Incubation with fresh Blocking Solution (second change, same composition as 6.1). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, gentle rocking, protected from light)

**7 Primary Antibody Incubation**

7.1 Prepare Primary Antibody Solution in PTwH buffer [0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10 μg/mL heparin in 1× PBS] supplemented with 5% (vol/vol) NDS and 3% (vol/vol) DMSO. Include the following primary antibodies at validated concentrations:
- Anti-C-Fos rabbit polyclonal (e.g., Synaptic Systems 226 003): 1:1000
- Anti-Npas4 guinea pig polyclonal (e.g., Synaptic Systems 272 004): 1:500
- Anti-NeuN mouse monoclonal (e.g., Millipore MAB377): 1:500
- Anti-TH rabbit polyclonal (e.g., Millipore AB152, use only if C-Fos is detected with non-rabbit host; adjust host species to avoid cross-reactivity — use anti-TH chicken, e.g., Aves Labs TYH): 1:500
Incubate brain and tongue samples fully submerged with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days for whole brain; 5 days for tongue, protected from light, gentle rocking)

**8 Primary Antibody Washing**

8.1 Wash with PTwH buffer [0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10 μg/mL heparin in 1× PBS]. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking)

8.2 Wash with fresh PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, gentle rocking)

8.3 Wash with fresh PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours, gentle rocking)

8.4 Wash with fresh PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 8 hours, gentle rocking)

8.5 Wash with fresh PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, gentle rocking, overnight)

8.6 Wash with fresh PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, gentle rocking)

**9 Secondary Antibody Incubation**

9.1 Prepare Secondary Antibody Solution in PTwH buffer supplemented with 3% (vol/vol) NDS. Include the following secondary antibodies (all highly cross-adsorbed, donkey-raised):
- Donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (targets C-Fos): 1:500
- Donkey anti-guinea pig Alexa Fluor 568 (targets Npas4): 1:500 [Note: use Alexa Fluor series as permitted by Dye list]
- Donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 488 (targets NeuN): 1:500
- Donkey anti-chicken Alexa Fluor 555 (targets TH): 1:500
- DAPI: 1 μg/mL (add during last 24 hours of secondary incubation)
Incubate samples fully submerged with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days for whole brain; 4 days for tongue, protected from light, gentle rocking)

**10 Secondary Antibody Washing**

10.1 Wash with PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking, protected from light)

10.2 Wash with fresh PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, gentle rocking, protected from light)

10.3 Wash with fresh PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours, gentle rocking, protected from light)

10.4 Wash with fresh PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 8 hours, gentle rocking, protected from light)

10.5 Wash with fresh PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, gentle rocking, overnight, protected from light)

10.6 Wash with fresh PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, gentle rocking, protected from light)

**11 Gradient Methanol Dehydration (Pre-clearing)**

11.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking, protected from light)

11.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking, protected from light)

11.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking, protected from light)

11.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking, protected from light)

11.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking, protected from light)

11.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, gentle rocking, protected from light)

**12 Delipidation with DCM**

12.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 67% (vol/vol) methanol (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, gentle rocking in fume hood, protected from light)

12.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (two changes). First change: (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min, fume hood, protected from light)

12.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM, second change. Samples should sink to the bottom of the tube when fully delipidated. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min, fume hood, protected from light)

**13 Refractive Index Matching with DBE**

13.1 Remove DCM completely by aspiration. Immediately transfer samples to 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014) without any intermediate wash. Incubate until samples become fully transparent (brain typically requires longer than tongue). (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours minimum; extend to 12–24 hours for whole brain if not fully transparent, protected from light, no shaking, sealed container to prevent evaporation)

13.2 Replace with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for final RI equilibration and long-term storage. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours minimum before imaging, protected from light, sealed container)

**14 Sample Mounting and Imaging Preparation**

14.1 Transfer cleared brain and tongue to imaging chamber (e.g., custom 3D-printed holder or glass-bottom dish) filled with 100% DBE (RI ≈ 1.559). Orient brain with dorsal side up for standard coronal/sagittal acquisition; orient tongue longitudinally for nerve tract imaging. Seal chamber with optical-grade glass coverslip using silicone grease to prevent DBE evaporation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min equilibration before imaging)

14.2 Acquire 3D images using light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM, e.g., LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope II or Miltenyi Biotec UltraMicroscope Blaze) with an objective compatible with DBE immersion (e.g., MVPLAPO 2× or 4× with DBE-compatible dipping cap). Use the following channel assignments:
- 488 nm excitation / 525 nm emission: NeuN-Alexa Fluor 488 (total neurons)
- 561 nm excitation / 600 nm emission: TH-Alexa Fluor 555 (catecholaminergic neurons, LC)
- 561 nm excitation / 620 nm emission: Npas4-Alexa Fluor 568 (IEG pattern 2)
- 638 nm excitation / 680 nm emission: C-Fos-Alexa Fluor 647 (IEG pattern 1, primary activity marker)
- 405 nm excitation / 450 nm emission: DAPI (nuclear reference)
Acquire z-stacks with ≤5 μm step size for whole brain; ≤3 μm for tongue nerve regions. (Temperature: RT, Time: variable per sample size and resolution)

14.3 For long-term storage post-imaging, keep samples in sealed DBE-filled containers at RT, protected from light. Samples remain stable for several months under these conditions. (Temperature: RT, protected from light)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD]
**Justification:** FDISCO（改良有机溶剂透明法）采用四氢呋喃（THF）脱水/脱脂结合二苄醚（DBE）折射率匹配，在低温（4 ℃）条件下操作，可显著减少荧光淬灭，对脂溶性示踪剂 DiI（激发/发射 ~549/565 nm）和 DiD（激发/发射 ~644/665 nm）的荧光保留优于室温有机溶剂法。DiI 和 DiD 均为脂溶性碳菁染料，可沿神经元膜顺行/逆行扩散，无需抗体即可直接追踪感觉神经投射通路；两者发射光谱分离良好（>100 nm），可在同一样本中双通道区分不同投射路径。完整脊髓（~3 cm）、丘脑（~5×4×4 mm）和体感皮层（~10×8×2 mm）均为软组织，FDISCO 可在数天内完成透明，适合光片显微镜三维成像。注意：DiI/DiD 在有机溶剂中扩散速率降低但荧光可保留，低温操作是关键。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 DiI / DiD 脂溶性示踪剂标记（固定后注射/晶体植入）
1.1 将 DiI 晶体（或 10 mg/mL DiI in DMSO）以微量注射器（~50–200 nL/位点）注射至目标感觉神经入口（如背根神经节注射位点或脊髓背角指定节段），用于标记第一条感觉投射通路。(Temperature: RT, Time: 注射操作 ~30 min/样本)
1.2 将 DiD 晶体（或 10 mg/mL DiD in DMSO）以同样方式注射至第二条目标感觉投射通路的起始位点（如不同节段背根神经节或对侧位点）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 注射操作 ~30 min/样本)
1.3 将标记后样本置于 4% PFA / PBS 中孵育，使 DiI/DiD 沿神经膜顺行/逆行扩散至脊髓、丘脑及体感皮层。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 14–21 days，每隔 3–4 天更换新鲜 4% PFA)
1.4 扩散完成后，在荧光体视镜下确认 DiI（红色）和 DiD（远红色）信号已到达目标脑区（丘脑、体感皮层），记录标记质量。(Temperature: RT, Time: ~30 min 检查)

2 样本后固定与预处理
2.1 将完整脊髓、丘脑和体感皮层分别置于新鲜 4% PFA / PBS 中后固定。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 用 1× PBS 洗涤样本 3 次，每次 10 min，去除残余 PFA。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 10 min)
2.3 将样本转移至含 0.1% NaN₃ 的 1× PBS 中短期保存，直至透明处理开始。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ≤ 48 hours)

3 脱水（THF 梯度，低温保护荧光）
3.1 将样本置于 50% (vol/vol) THF（无水四氢呋喃，含 0.01% BHT 抗氧化剂）/ ddH₂O 中孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 脊髓 12 hours；丘脑/皮层 6 hours)
3.2 将样本置于 70% (vol/vol) THF / ddH₂O 中孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 脊髓 12 hours；丘脑/皮层 6 hours)
3.3 将样本置于 80% (vol/vol) THF / ddH₂O 中孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 脊髓 8 hours；丘脑/皮层 4 hours)
3.4 将样本置于 90% (vol/vol) THF / ddH₂O 中孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 脊髓 8 hours；丘脑/皮层 4 hours)
3.5 将样本置于 100% THF（无水，含 0.01% BHT）中孵育，第一次换液。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 脊髓 8 hours；丘脑/皮层 4 hours)
3.6 将样本置于新鲜 100% THF（无水，含 0.01% BHT）中孵育，第二次换液，确保完全脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 脊髓 8 hours；丘脑/皮层 4 hours)

4 脱脂与透明化（DBE）
4.1 将完全脱水的样本直接转入 100% DBE（二苄醚，Sigma 108014）中孵育，不振荡，避光。样本应在数分钟至数小时内逐渐透明。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 脊髓 24–48 hours；丘脑 12–24 hours；体感皮层 6–12 hours)
4.2 更换新鲜 100% DBE，继续孵育至样本完全透明（目视无白色不透明区域）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 脊髓 12–24 hours；丘脑/皮层 6–12 hours)

5 折射率匹配（RI Matching）
5.1 透明后样本保存于 100% DBE 中（RI ≈ 1.559），DBE 本身即为成像介质，无需额外 RI 匹配步骤。确认样本完全浸没于 DBE 中，密封避光保存。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 至成像前，可保存 ≤ 2 weeks)

6 成像前处理与安装
6.1 将透明样本从 4 ℃ 取出，在室温下平衡 30 min，避免温差导致 DBE 析出气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
6.2 将样本转移至定制玻璃成像腔（FEP 管或玻璃底培养皿），用 100% DBE 完全填充腔体，确保样本方向正确（脊髓纵轴平行于光片传播方向；丘脑和皮层以最大平面朝向物镜）。(Temperature: RT, Time: ~20 min 操作)
6.3 用硅胶或石蜡膜密封成像腔，防止 DBE 挥发和样本移动。(Temperature: RT, Time: ~10 min)
6.4 使用光片显微镜（LSFM）配置以下通道进行三维成像：DiI 通道：激发 561 nm，发射 580–620 nm 带通滤片；DiD 通道：激发 640 nm，发射 660–720 nm 带通滤片。选用与 DBE（RI 1.559）匹配的长工作距离物镜（如 Olympus XLPLN10XSVMP，RI 1.45–1.52，或配合定制浸液）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 成像时间依样本大小，脊髓全长扫描约 4–12 hours；丘脑/皮层约 1–3 hours/样本)
6.5 成像完成后，将样本转回 100% DBE 密封避光保存，可用于后续重复成像或存档。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 长期保存)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD, DAPI]

**Justification:**
FDISCO（Fluorescence-preserved 3D Imaging of Solvent-Cleared Organs）是基于有机溶剂的透明方法，在低温（4 °C）条件下进行脱水和折射率匹配，可在保留脂溶性荧光染料（如 DiI、DiD）信号的同时实现高透明度。与 iDISCO+ 相比，FDISCO 在 4 °C 操作可显著减少 DiI/DiD 等花菁类脂溶性示踪剂的荧光淬灭，使其成为本实验的最优选择。DiI（激发/发射 ~549/565 nm）和 DiD（激发/发射 ~644/665 nm）光谱分离良好，可双通道独立追踪两条躯体感觉通路（如脊髓丘脑束与背柱-内侧丘系通路）。DAPI 仅作为结构配准辅助信号，用于标记细胞核以辅助三维空间定位，不作为主要通路标记。样本尺寸（脊髓 ~3 cm、丘脑 ~5×4×4 mm、皮层 ~10×8×2 mm）均在 FDISCO 处理能力范围内，适合后续光片显微镜成像。

1 示踪剂注射与组织固定前准备（假设已完成体内 DiI/DiD 注射及 4% PFA 灌注固定）
1.1 确认样本已经 4% PFA（磷酸缓冲液配制，pH 7.4）灌注固定，取出脊髓（~3 cm）、丘脑（~5×4×4 mm）及体感皮层（~10×8×2 mm），置于 4% PFA 中后固定。（Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours）
1.2 用 0.1 M PBS（pH 7.4）漂洗样本 3 次，每次 10 min，去除残余 PFA。（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min total）

2 DAPI 核染色（透明前水相染色，作为配准辅助信号）
2.1 将样本置于含 5 µg/mL DAPI 的 0.1 M PBS 溶液中孵育，轻摇。（Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours）
2.2 用 0.1 M PBS 漂洗样本 3 次，每次 15 min，去除游离 DAPI。（Temperature: RT, Time: 45 min total）

3 脱水（梯度叔丁醇/THF，4 °C 低温保护 DiI/DiD 荧光）
3.1 将样本置于 30% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇（tert-butanol，TBA）水溶液中孵育，轻摇。（Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 4 hours）
3.2 将样本置于 50% (vol/vol) TBA 水溶液中孵育，轻摇。（Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 4 hours）
3.3 将样本置于 70% (vol/vol) TBA 水溶液中孵育，轻摇。（Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 4 hours）
3.4 将样本置于 80% (vol/vol) TBA 水溶液中孵育，轻摇。（Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 4 hours）
3.5 将样本置于 90% (vol/vol) TBA 水溶液中孵育，轻摇。（Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 4 hours）
3.6 将样本置于 96% (vol/vol) TBA 水溶液中孵育，轻摇。（Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 4 hours）
3.7 将样本置于 100% TBA（无水）中孵育，轻摇，重复 2 次，每次 4 hours，确保完全脱水。（Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 8 hours total）

4 脱脂与透明化（二苯醚 DBE，4 °C）
4.1 将完全脱水的样本转移至二苯醚（Diphenyl ether，DBE；Sigma-Aldrich 108014）中，轻摇，进行脱脂与折射率匹配（RI ≈ 1.558）。脊髓样本（最大尺寸）需延长孵育时间。（Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours）
4.2 更换新鲜 DBE，继续孵育至样本完全透明（肉眼观察透明度，脊髓可能需额外 12–24 hours）。（Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12–24 hours）

5 折射率匹配（RI Matching）
5.1 确认样本在 DBE 中已完全透明，DBE 本身即为最终折射率匹配介质（RI ≈ 1.558），无需额外更换介质。将透明样本保存于新鲜 DBE 中，避光密封。（Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 保存至成像，最长 2 周）

6 成像前处理与安装
6.1 将透明样本从 DBE 中取出，用吸水纸轻轻吸去表面多余 DBE，迅速转移至成像腔室（玻璃底培养皿或定制样本槽）。（Temperature: RT, Time: 操作时间 < 5 min）
6.2 向成像腔室中加入足量 DBE 完全浸没样本，用折射率匹配的光学胶（如 Norland Optical Adhesive 或硅胶垫）固定样本方向，确保脊髓长轴与成像方向平行。（Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min）
6.3 使用光片显微镜（LSFM/SPIM）进行三维成像：通道设置为 DAPI（405 nm 激发）、DiI（561 nm 激发，检测 570–620 nm）、DiD（638 nm 激发，检测 660–720 nm）；物镜选用长工作距离浸油物镜（RI 匹配 DBE），步长设置为 2–5 µm（脊髓）或 1–2 µm（丘脑/皮层）。（Temperature: RT, Time: 依样本大小，脊髓约 2–4 hours/样本）

7 数据后处理
7.1 使用 Imaris 或 BigStitcher 对三维图像进行拼接与配准，以 DAPI 通道作为结构参考，分别重建 DiI 和 DiD 标记通路的三维路径。（Temperature: RT, Time: 离线处理）
7.2 分析 DiI 与 DiD 通道在脊髓上行束、丘脑中继核团及体感皮层终末区的路径分布、终末投射范围及双通道空间重叠程度（使用 Imaris Coloc 或 ImageJ Colocalization 插件）。（Temperature: RT, Time: 离线处理）

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD, TO-PRO-3]

**Justification:** FDISCO (an organic solvent-based clearing method using tetrahydrofuran/THF dehydration followed by dibenzyl ether/DBE as RI matching medium) is selected because: (1) it is fully compatible with lipophilic carbocyanine dyes DiI and DiD — unlike iDISCO+ or uDISCO which use methanol that can strip or quench lipophilic tracers, FDISCO operates at low temperature (4 °C throughout) and avoids harsh oxidative bleaching steps, thereby preserving DiI/DiD fluorescence signals critical for long-range axonal pathway tracing; (2) it achieves high transparency in large CNS tissues (complete spinal cord, thalamus, somatosensory cortex) with excellent RI matching (DBE, n ≈ 1.56) suitable for light-sheet microscopy; (3) the low-temperature protocol minimizes dye diffusion artifacts, which is essential for maintaining spatial precision of lipophilic tracer labeling at injection sites and terminal fields. DiI (ex ~549 nm / em ~565 nm) and DiD (ex ~644 nm / em ~665 nm) serve as the two primary pathway tracers for two distinct somatosensory pathways (e.g., dorsal column–medial lemniscal vs. spinothalamic tract), providing well-separated spectral channels. TO-PRO-3 (ex ~642 nm — note: imaged in a separate session or spectrally unmixed; alternatively used at low concentration as a far-red nuclear counterstain) is added as an auxiliary nuclear/cytoarchitectural marker to enable registration of thalamic relay nuclei (VPL, VPM, Po) and cortical laminae without replacing pathway tracing. TO-PRO-3 is compatible with organic solvent clearing when applied prior to dehydration and is detectable in the far-red channel (distinct from DiI green/orange channel). The three-channel strategy (DiI / DiD / TO-PRO-3) thus fulfills both pathway tracing and anatomical atlas registration requirements.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**0 Pre-clearing Tissue Preparation (assumes PFA-fixed samples)**

0.1 Confirm fixation: tissues (whole spinal cord, thalamic block, somatosensory cortex slab) were perfused transcardially with ice-cold PBS followed by 4% PFA in 0.1 M PBS, then post-fixed in 4% PFA at 4 °C for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)

0.2 Wash fixed tissues 3 × 30 min in 0.1 M PBS to remove residual PFA. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 3 × 30 min)

0.3 Verify DiI and DiD injection sites under epifluorescence stereomicroscope before clearing to confirm successful labeling of the two target pathways. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)

---

**1 Auxiliary Nuclear Staining with TO-PRO-3 (pre-dehydration)**

1.1 Permeabilize tissues in 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in 0.1 M PBS with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)

1.2 Wash 3 × 1 hour in 0.1 M PBS with gentle rocking to remove detergent. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

1.3 Incubate tissues in TO-PRO-3 iodide solution at 1 µM final concentration in 0.1 M PBS (diluted from 1 mM stock in DMSO, 1:1000) with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 48 hours)

1.4 Wash 3 × 2 hours in 0.1 M PBS, protected from light, to remove unbound TO-PRO-3. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 3 × 2 hours)

---

**2 Dehydration with Tetrahydrofuran (THF)**

2.1 Incubate tissues in 30% (vol/vol) THF in ddH₂O (freshly prepared, stabilizer-free THF, Sigma-Aldrich 186562), protected from light, with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)

2.2 Incubate tissues in 50% (vol/vol) THF in ddH₂O, protected from light, with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)

2.3 Incubate tissues in 70% (vol/vol) THF in ddH₂O, protected from light, with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)

2.4 Incubate tissues in 80% (vol/vol) THF in ddH₂O, protected from light, with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)

2.5 Incubate tissues in 100% (vol/vol) THF (anhydrous), protected from light, with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)

2.6 Repeat incubation in fresh 100% (vol/vol) THF (anhydrous), protected from light, with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 1 hour)

> Note: All THF steps are performed in a fume hood. Containers must be tightly sealed to prevent water absorption. Tissues should appear visibly dehydrated and slightly shrunken after this stage.

---

**3 Delipidation and Clearing with Dichloromethane (DCM)**

3.1 Transfer tissues to 100% dichloromethane (DCM, Sigma-Aldrich 270997) in a sealed glass vial, protected from light, with gentle inversion mixing. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 30 min)

3.2 Replace with fresh 100% DCM and incubate again, protected from light. Tissues should sink to the bottom of the vial when fully dehydrated and delipidated. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 30 min)

> Note: DCM step is critical for complete lipid removal and must be performed in a fume hood with appropriate chemical safety precautions. Do not exceed 1 hour total DCM exposure to minimize DiI/DiD signal loss.

---

**4 Refractive Index Matching with Dibenzyl Ether (DBE)**

4.1 Remove DCM completely and immediately transfer tissues to 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014, n = 1.559), in a sealed glass vial, protected from light, without shaking. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 2 hours)

4.2 Replace with fresh 100% DBE and continue incubation, protected from light, without shaking, until tissues are fully transparent. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 4–6 hours or until optically clear)

> Note: Spinal cord may require up to 12 hours total in DBE due to its larger volume and myelin content. Monitor transparency visually. Thalamic block and cortical slab typically clear within 4–6 hours.

4.3 Final storage in fresh 100% DBE in sealed glass vials, protected from light, until imaging. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: up to 2 weeks)

---

**5 Sample Mounting for Light-Sheet Microscopy**

5.1 Transfer cleared tissue from DBE storage vial to a custom glass-bottom imaging chamber or FEP tube (refractive index ≈ 1.34, compatible with DBE immersion objectives). Fill chamber completely with fresh 100% DBE to eliminate air bubbles. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)

5.2 Orient tissue for the desired imaging axis: for spinal cord, orient longitudinally along the rostro-caudal axis; for thalamus and cortex, orient to allow coronal or sagittal sectioning planes. Secure with low-melting agarose (1% in DBE-equilibrated medium) if necessary, or use tissue holders compatible with DBE. (Temperature: RT, Time: 20 min)

5.3 Allow tissue to equilibrate in the imaging chamber at RT before imaging to minimize thermal drift. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

---

**6 Light-Sheet Imaging Parameters**

6.1 Image DiI signal using 561 nm excitation laser, emission filter 580–620 nm bandpass, with light-sheet illumination. Acquire z-stack at 2–5 µm step size for whole spinal cord; 1–2 µm step size for thalamic nuclei and cortical terminal fields. (Temperature: RT, Time: per acquisition schedule)

6.2 Image DiD signal using 638 nm (or 647 nm) excitation laser, emission filter 660–720 nm bandpass. Acquire z-stack with identical step size and field of view as DiI channel for co-registration. (Temperature: RT, Time: per acquisition schedule)

6.3 Image TO-PRO-3 nuclear signal using 638 nm excitation laser with emission filter 700–750 nm bandpass (spectrally separated from DiD by linear unmixing if needed, or imaged sequentially). Acquire z-stack at 3–5 µm step size for cytoarchitectural reference and atlas registration. (Temperature: RT, Time: per acquisition schedule)

6.4 Export raw image stacks in TIFF or HDF5 format. Perform 3D reconstruction and channel overlay using Imaris, Fiji/BigStitcher, or ClearMap software. Register TO-PRO-3 channel to Allen Mouse Brain Atlas (CCFv3) for thalamic nucleus and cortical area identification. Overlay DiI and DiD channels to map spatial convergence, divergence, or partial overlap of the two somatosensory pathways at spinal entry zones, ascending tracts, thalamic relay nuclei (VPL, VPM, Po), and cortical terminal fields (S1BF, S1FL, S1HL). model_response:
**Chosen Method:** SeeDB2

**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD]

**Justification:** SeeDB2 is an aqueous-based, non-delipidation clearing method that achieves high refractive index matching (RI ≈ 1.52) using fructose/thioglycerol solutions without organic solvents or detergent-based lipid extraction. This is critically important here because DiI and DiD are lipophilic carbocyanine tracers that are anchored in and diffuse through lipid membranes — any delipidation step (as in iDISCO+, uDISCO, CUBIC-L, or SDS-based CLARITY) would dissolve the membrane lipids and completely destroy the tracer signal. SeeDB2 preserves membrane integrity while still achieving excellent optical transparency sufficient for light-sheet imaging of the complete mouse spinal cord (~3 cm), thalamus (~5×4×4 mm), and somatosensory cortex (~10×8×2 mm). The progressive fructose gradient ensures gentle, uniform dehydration/RI matching without osmotic shock, minimizing tissue distortion across these morphologically distinct samples. The thioglycerol additive suppresses fluorescence quenching and reduces background autofluorescence. DiI (excitation ~549 nm / emission ~565 nm) and DiD (excitation ~644 nm / emission ~665 nm) are spectrally well-separated, enabling dual-channel imaging of two distinct sensory pathways (e.g., spinothalamic tract vs. dorsal column–medial lemniscal pathway) in the same tissue with minimal spectral crosstalk. No antibody incubation or exogenous fluorophore conjugation is required, eliminating the uneven signal distribution problem observed in the original protocol.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Pre-clearing Verification and Sample Preparation
1.1 Confirm that DiI and DiD tracer injections were performed prior to perfusion fixation and that post-fixation in 4% PFA/PBS is complete (minimum 24 h at 4 °C for spinal cord, 12 h for thalamus and cortex). Rinse samples 3× in 0.01 M PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 3 × 10 min)
1.2 Transfer samples to fresh 4% PFA/PBS for additional post-fixation to ensure complete crosslinking and tracer immobilization, particularly for the full-length spinal cord. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 24 hours)
1.3 Wash samples 3× in 0.01 M PBS (pH 7.4) to remove residual PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 15 min)
1.4 Optional nuclear counterstain: incubate samples in DAPI solution (5 µg/mL in PBS) to label cell nuclei for anatomical reference. Note: DAPI is compatible with SeeDB2 aqueous conditions. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.5 Wash samples 3× in 0.01 M PBS (pH 7.4) to remove excess DAPI. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 20 min)

2 SeeDB2 Clearing — Progressive Fructose/Thioglycerol Gradient
2.1 Incubation in SeeDB2 Solution 1: 20% (wt/vol) fructose in distilled water supplemented with 0.5% (vol/vol) thioglycerol (α-thioglycerol). Ensure samples are fully submerged with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 8 hours)
2.2 Incubation in SeeDB2 Solution 2: 40% (wt/vol) fructose in distilled water with 0.5% (vol/vol) thioglycerol. Replace solution completely; use sufficient volume (≥5× sample volume). (Temperature: RT, Time: 8 hours)
2.3 Incubation in SeeDB2 Solution 3: 60% (wt/vol) fructose in distilled water with 0.5% (vol/vol) thioglycerol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.4 Incubation in SeeDB2 Solution 4: 80% (wt/vol) fructose in distilled water with 0.5% (vol/vol) thioglycerol. For the full-length spinal cord (~3 cm), extend incubation time to ensure uniform penetration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.5 Incubation in SeeDB2 Solution 5: 100% (wt/vol) fructose (saturated, ~115% wt/vol at RT) in distilled water with 0.5% (vol/vol) thioglycerol. This is the standard SeeDB2 final solution (RI ≈ 1.49). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.6 Incubation in SeeDB2G (SeeDB2 final RI-matching solution): 115% (wt/vol) fructose in distilled water with 0.5% (vol/vol) thioglycerol (RI ≈ 1.52). Prepare by dissolving fructose at 60 °C, then cool to RT before use. Replace solution once after 12 h. For the full-length spinal cord, extend total incubation to 48 h with one solution change at 24 h. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours for spinal cord; 24 hours for thalamus and cortex)
2.7 Verify optical transparency by visual inspection against a printed grid pattern. Tissue should appear glassy and transparent. If residual opacity remains in the spinal cord center, replace with fresh SeeDB2G and continue for an additional 12–24 h. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 24 additional hours if needed)

3 Refractive Index Matching and Mounting
3.1 Transfer cleared samples to fresh SeeDB2G (115% wt/vol fructose, 0.5% thioglycerol, RI ≈ 1.52) in imaging chambers or custom-made agarose molds. Allow samples to equilibrate and confirm RI uniformity. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 For light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM): mount samples in SeeDB2G within a FEP (fluorinated ethylene propylene) tube or custom imaging cuvette compatible with the immersion objective (use an objective with RI correction for RI ≈ 1.52, e.g., CLARITY/SeeDB2-compatible objectives). Seal with optical adhesive or Parafilm to prevent evaporation and crystallization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
3.3 For confocal imaging of thalamus and cortex: embed samples in 1% low-melting-point agarose prepared in SeeDB2G, cast in a glass-bottom dish, and overlay with SeeDB2G to prevent dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 20 min)
3.4 Allow final equilibration in the imaging chamber before acquisition to eliminate any residual RI gradients at the sample surface. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

4 Imaging Parameters and Storage
4.1 Imaging channels: DiI — excitation 543–561 nm laser, emission 570–620 nm bandpass filter; DiD — excitation 633–647 nm laser, emission 660–720 nm bandpass filter; DAPI (if used) — excitation 405 nm, emission 415–480 nm. Acquire z-stacks at ≤5 µm step size for spinal cord overview and ≤2 µm for thalamus/cortex terminal fields.
4.2 For long-term storage prior to imaging: keep samples in SeeDB2G in sealed containers protected from light at 4 °C. Avoid freeze-thaw cycles. DiI/DiD signal is stable for at least 4 weeks under these conditions. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: up to 4 weeks)
4.3 If crystallization of fructose occurs upon cooling, warm samples briefly to 37 °C until crystals dissolve, then return to RT before imaging. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 15–30 min)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [CGRP (Calcitonin Gene-Related Peptide) via anti-CGRP primary antibody + Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody (感觉神经主标记), PGP9.5 via anti-PGP9.5 primary antibody + Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated secondary antibody (泛神经纤维对照标记), DAPI (细胞核背景参考)]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+采用甲醇梯度脱水+二苯醚（DBE）作为最终RI匹配介质（RI≈1.56），对富含脂质的白色脂肪组织具有强力脱脂能力，可有效解决scWAT脂质含量高导致的透明不均和深层信号衰减问题。iDISCO+的有机溶剂体系同时兼容抗体免疫标记（通过预处理步骤保护抗原），是目前在脂肪组织神经纤维三维成像中验证最充分的方法之一。标记策略上：①抗CGRP抗体特异性标记降钙素基因相关肽阳性感觉神经纤维（C纤维和Aδ纤维），是确认感觉神经身份的金标准，不可被脂溶性示踪剂替代；②PGP9.5（泛神经标记物，即Hu C/D / PGP9.5）标记全部神经纤维网络，用于与感觉神经成分进行空间对照，量化感觉神经在整体脂肪神经支配中的占比；③DAPI提供细胞核背景，辅助组织结构定位。两种抗体选用光谱分离良好的Alexa Fluor 647（远红）和Alexa Fluor 568（橙红）荧光素，适合光片显微镜（LSFM）或共聚焦深层成像，最大限度减少串色。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样品预处理与抗原修复前准备（Pre-treatment）**

1.1 将已完成4% PFA固定及后固定的scWAT组织块（约1 cm × 1 cm × 0.5 cm）置于PBS中，4℃充分漂洗，去除残余固定液。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 1 hour, PBS洗涤)

1.2 将组织转入含0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的PBS（PTx.2）中进行渗透性预处理，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

**2 脱水（Methanol Gradient Dehydration）**

2.1 将组织置于20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中，轻摇脱水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.2 将组织置于40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.3 将组织置于60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.4 将组织置于80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.5 将组织置于100% 甲醇中，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.6 再次更换100% 甲醇，轻摇，确保完全脱水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 脱脂与漂白（Delipidation & Bleaching）**

3.1 配制H₂O₂/甲醇漂白液：将30% H₂O₂与100%甲醇按1:5 (vol/vol) 混合，预冷至4℃。将组织转入该溶液，避光静置，以去除内源性过氧化物酶活性并辅助脱脂漂白。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 hours，过夜)

**4 复水（Rehydration）**

4.1 将组织置于100% 甲醇中，轻摇复水第一步。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.2 将组织置于80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.3 将组织置于60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.4 将组织置于40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.5 将组织置于20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中，轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.6 将组织置于PBS中漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

**5 渗透性增强处理（Permeabilization）**

5.1 将组织置于含0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的PBS（PTx.2）中，轻摇渗透。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

5.2 将组织置于iDISCO+渗透液（含0.16% Triton X-100、20% DMSO、0.3 M甘氨酸的PBS）中，轻摇，以增强大体积组织的抗体渗透性。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5.3 将组织置于封闭液（含0.16% Triton X-100、10% DMSO、6%正常驴血清的PBS）中，轻摇封闭非特异性结合位点。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**6 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）**

6.1 配制一抗孵育液（PTwH + 5%正常驴血清 + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL肝素）：
- 抗CGRP抗体（兔源多克隆，如Sigma C8198或Abcam ab81887），终浓度1:400（约5 µg/mL）；
- 抗PGP9.5抗体（鸡源多克隆，如Abcam ab72911），终浓度1:500；
将组织置于上述混合一抗孵育液中，轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days，每日轻摇换液一次)

6.2 用PTwH（含0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL肝素的PBS）充分洗涤，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour，再过夜洗涤一次)

**7 二抗孵育（Secondary Antibody Incubation）**

7.1 配制二抗孵育液（PTwH + 5%正常驴血清 + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL肝素）：
- 驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 647（标记CGRP感觉神经），终浓度1:500（约4 µg/mL）；
- 驴抗鸡 Alexa Fluor 568（标记PGP9.5泛神经），终浓度1:500；
- DAPI，终浓度1 µg/mL（细胞核背景标记）；
将组织置于上述混合二抗孵育液中，避光轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 4–5 days，每日轻摇)

7.2 用PTwH充分洗涤，去除未结合二抗，避光操作。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour，再过夜洗涤一次)

**8 脱水（Pre-clearing Dehydration）**

8.1 将组织置于20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中，避光轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.2 将组织置于40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中，避光轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.3 将组织置于60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中，避光轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.4 将组织置于80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O溶液中，避光轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.5 将组织置于100% 甲醇中，避光轻摇。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.6 再次更换100% 甲醇，避光轻摇，确保完全脱水。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**9 透明化（Clearing with DCM/DBE）**

9.1 将组织置于二氯甲烷（DCM，Sigma 270997）中，避光轻摇，进行中间溶剂置换，组织沉底即表明脱脂透明化充分。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours，或至组织完全沉底)

9.2 将组织转入100% 二苯醚（DBE，Sigma 108014，RI≈1.562）中，避光静置，完成最终透明化与RI匹配。不振摇，防止气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 过夜（12–16 hours），至组织完全透明)

**10 RI匹配与成像前处理（RI Matching & Pre-imaging）**

10.1 更换新鲜100% DBE，将透明组织转入适配光片显微镜（LSFM，如LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope II或Miltenyi UltraMicroscope）或长工作距离共聚焦显微镜的成像腔室中，确保组织完全浸没于DBE（RI≈1.562），与物镜浸液RI匹配。避光静置平衡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2–4 hours)

10.2 使用折射率匹配的玻璃底成像皿或定制样品架固定组织，避免组织漂移。成像通道建议：DAPI（405 nm激发），Alexa Fluor 568（561 nm激发，PGP9.5泛神经），Alexa Fluor 647（638 nm激发，CGRP感觉神经）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 成像前静置平衡至少30 min)

**11 样品保存（Storage）**

11.1 成像完毕后，将样品密封于新鲜DBE中，避光、室温保存，可保存数周至数月（注意DBE有毒，需密封防挥发）。(Temperature: RT，避光密封保存, Time: 长期保存可达3个月)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [CGRP antibody + Alexa Fluor 647, PGP9.5 antibody + Alexa Fluor 568, Lectin + Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) it achieves excellent deep-tissue antibody penetration via organic solvent-based delipidation, which is critical for the lipid-rich scWAT (~1 cm × 1 cm × 0.5 cm); (2) it is highly compatible with whole-mount immunolabeling of neural markers, enabling simultaneous detection of CGRP (sensory nerve identity) and PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal marker) in 3D; (3) the methanol/DCM/DBE pipeline efficiently removes the abundant lipid content of adipose tissue, which would otherwise severely impede antibody penetration and cause strong light scattering; (4) the cleared tissue in DBE (RI ≈ 1.56) is well-suited for light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM), enabling volumetric imaging of the entire block. Labeling strategy: **CGRP + Alexa Fluor 647** (far-red, primary sensory nerve channel); **PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 568** (pan-neuronal network channel); **Lectin + Alexa Fluor 488** (vascular reference channel for perivascular zone analysis); **DAPI** (nuclear/structural reference for lobule septum identification). CGRP and PGP9.5 together allow direct comparison of sensory vs. total innervation density, branching complexity, terminal coverage, and regional distribution in 3D.

---

## Protocol Steps

### 1 Pre-treatment and Bleaching (Endogenous Peroxidase Quenching / Background Reduction)

1.1 Wash fixed scWAT tissue (post 4% PFA fixation, PBS-rinsed) in 1× PBS with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

1.2 Incubation in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O (freshly prepared). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 Incubation in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 Incubation in 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.7 Incubation in 100% methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.8 Incubation in chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 vol 30% H₂O₂ : 5 vol MeOH) to quench endogenous peroxidase and reduce autofluorescence from adipose tissue. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)

---

### 2 Rehydration

2.1 Incubation in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.2 Incubation in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.3 Incubation in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.4 Incubation in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.5 Incubation in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.6 Incubation in 1× PBS, second wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 3 Permeabilization and Blocking

3.1 Incubation in Permeabilization Solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in 1× PBS] with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

3.2 Incubation in Blocking Solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) in 1× PBS] with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

---

### 4 Primary Antibody Incubation

4.1 Prepare Primary Antibody Solution in PTwH buffer [1× PBS, 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10 µg/mL heparin] supplemented with 5% (vol/vol) DMSO and 3% (vol/vol) NDS:
- Anti-CGRP (rabbit polyclonal, e.g., Sigma C8198 or Abcam ab81887): 1:400 dilution
- Anti-PGP9.5 (chicken polyclonal, e.g., Abcam ab72911): 1:500 dilution
*(Note: CGRP and PGP9.5 are raised in different host species to allow simultaneous dual-channel immunolabeling.)*

4.2 Incubation with primary antibody solution with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

4.3 Wash in PTwH buffer (1× PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight)

---

### 5 Vascular Labeling (Lectin Staining — Auxiliary Channel)

5.1 Incubation with Lectin–Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate (e.g., Lycopersicon esculentum lectin, Vector Labs DL-1174; 1:200 dilution) in PTwH buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

5.2 Wash in PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

---

### 6 Secondary Antibody Incubation

6.1 Prepare Secondary Antibody Solution in PTwH + 3% NDS:
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG–Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500; for CGRP detection)
- Donkey anti-chicken IgY–Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500; for PGP9.5 detection)

6.2 Incubation with secondary antibody solution with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)

6.3 Wash in PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight)

---

### 7 Nuclear Counterstain (Auxiliary Channel — Structural Reference)

7.1 Incubation with DAPI (5 µg/mL in 1× PBS) to label nuclei for lobule septum and tissue architecture reference. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

7.2 Wash in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

---

### 8 Dehydration (Pre-clearing)

8.1 Incubation in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.2 Incubation in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.3 Incubation in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.4 Incubation in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.5 Incubation in 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.6 Incubation in 100% methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 9 Delipidation

9.1 Incubation in 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 67% methanol (vol/vol) to initiate lipid extraction from adipose tissue. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

9.2 Incubation in 100% DCM (two changes) for complete delipidation of scWAT. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

*(Note: Perform DCM steps in a fume hood; use glass vials. Tissue should sink and appear translucent/white at this stage.)*

---

### 10 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing

10.1 Incubation in 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014; RI ≈ 1.562) without shaking, protected from light. Replace with fresh DBE after first 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, first incubation)

10.2 Incubation in fresh 100% DBE without shaking, protected from light, until tissue is fully transparent (typically 12–24 hours for 0.5 cm-thick scWAT). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours)

*(Note: Tissue should appear fully optically transparent and amber-tinted. Do not over-incubate in DBE as prolonged exposure may quench Alexa Fluor dyes.)*

---

### 11 Storage and Pre-imaging Preparation

11.1 Transfer cleared tissue to fresh 100% DBE in a sealed glass vial, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: store up to 2 weeks maximum)

11.2 Mount tissue in a custom imaging chamber (e.g., glass-bottom dish or 3D-printed holder) filled with 100% DBE. Orient tissue to allow imaging from both dorsal and ventral surfaces to capture central zone, peripheral zone, perivascular regions, and interlobular septa.

11.3 Equilibrate mounted sample in DBE before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

11.4 Image using light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM; e.g., LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope II or Zeiss Lightsheet Z.1) with a long-working-distance objective (e.g., 4×/0.35 NA or 12×/0.53 NA CLARITY objective) compatible with RI 1.56 immersion medium (DBE or equivalent RI-matched immersion oil).
- Channel 1: Alexa Fluor 488 (Lectin — vascular reference; Ex 488 nm / Em 525 nm)
- Channel 2: Alexa Fluor 568 (PGP9.5 — pan-neuronal network; Ex 561 nm / Em 593 nm)
- Channel 3: Alexa Fluor 647 (CGRP — sensory nerve fibers; Ex 638 nm / Em 680 nm)
- Channel 4: DAPI (nuclear/structural reference; Ex 405 nm / Em 450 nm)

11.5 Acquire z-stacks at 2–5 µm step size across the full tissue depth for volumetric reconstruction. For high-resolution analysis of terminal branching and perivascular zones, acquire sub-regions at 1 µm z-step with 12× objective.

11.6 Post-acquisition: perform 3D reconstruction and co-registration of all channels using Imaris (Bitplane) or arivis Vision4D. Quantify CGRP⁺ fiber density, branching complexity (Sholl analysis), terminal coverage area, and CGRP⁺/PGP9.5⁺ fiber ratio in each defined region of interest (central zone, peripheral zone, perivascular zone, interlobular septa) using filament tracing and surface rendering modules.
