**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 568, Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected as the optimal clearing method for this application for the following reasons: (1) The tissue is a solid, lipid-rich pancreatic tumor (~12×8×5 mm) with dense fibrotic stroma — iDISCO+'s organic solvent-based delipidation (methanol/DCM/DBE) achieves deep, uniform clearing of such dense, fibrous tissue far more effectively than aqueous methods (CUBIC, ScaleS, SeeDB2); (2) iDISCO+ is fully compatible with whole-mount immunolabeling of large tissue blocks, enabling deep antibody penetration via methanol pretreatment and detergent-based permeabilization; (3) The DBE-based RI matching (n ≈ 1.56) renders the tissue highly transparent for light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM), which is ideal for 3D mapping of the entire tumor volume; (4) The organic solvent pipeline preserves antigenicity sufficiently for the selected antibody targets when combined with the standard iDISCO+ blocking/permeabilization protocol.

**Labeling strategy rationale:**
- **β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647**: Pan-neuronal marker labeling all neuronal processes including axon bundles, nerve trunks, and fine branches — primary marker for PNI nerve architecture mapping.
- **PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 568**: Protein gene product 9.5, a pan-neuronal/axonal marker complementary to TUJ1, enhancing detection of fine axonal structures and peripheral nerve fibers within the tumor microenvironment.
- **Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor 488**: Labels tumor epithelial cells (pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is CK+), defining tumor cell boundaries and enabling spatial analysis of nerve–tumor relationships (encasement, invasion, perineural spread).
- **DAPI**: Nuclear counterstain for tissue architecture reference and cell density mapping.

---

## Protocol Steps

### 0 Pre-clearing Verification
0.1 Confirm tissue has been fixed in 4% PFA/PBS at 4 °C for 24–48 hours and post-fixed if required. Trim excess non-tumor tissue; final block dimensions ≤ 12 mm × 8 mm × 5 mm. Store in PBS at 4 °C until start of protocol. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: hold until use)

---

### 1 Dehydration (Methanol Series)
1.1 Wash tissue in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)
1.2 Incubation in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation in 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.7 Repeat incubation in fresh 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 2 Bleaching (H₂O₂ Treatment to Reduce Autofluorescence)
2.1 Incubation in chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH). Tissue should be fully submerged; use a sealed tube to prevent evaporation. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 16 hours)

---

### 3 Rehydration (Reverse Methanol Series)
3.1 Incubation in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Incubation in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.6 Repeat wash in fresh 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 4 Permeabilization and Blocking
4.1 Incubation in Permeabilization Solution [0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS] with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Incubation in Blocking Solution [0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS), 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS] with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours)

---

### 5 Primary Antibody Labeling
5.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in Antibody Diluent [0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 5% (vol/vol) NDS, 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS]:
- Anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) rabbit monoclonal antibody: 1:200 dilution
- Anti-PGP9.5 chicken polyclonal antibody: 1:300 dilution
- Anti-Pan-Cytokeratin mouse monoclonal antibody (AE1/AE3): 1:200 dilution
(Temperature: 4 °C, Time: preparation on ice)
5.2 Incubation of tissue in primary antibody cocktail with gentle rocking on orbital shaker. Use sufficient volume to fully submerge tissue (≥ 2 mL). (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 72 hours)
5.3 Wash in PTwH [0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10 µg/mL heparin in 1× PBS] with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight wash)

---

### 6 Secondary Antibody Labeling
6.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in Antibody Diluent [0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 5% (vol/vol) NDS, 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS]:
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647: 1:400 dilution (for TUJ1 detection)
- Donkey anti-chicken IgY conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568: 1:400 dilution (for PGP9.5 detection)
- Donkey anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488: 1:400 dilution (for Pan-CK detection)
(Temperature: 4 °C, Time: preparation on ice, protect from light)
6.2 Incubation of tissue in secondary antibody cocktail with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours)
6.3 Wash in PTwH with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight wash)

---

### 7 Nuclear Counterstain (DAPI)
7.1 Incubation in DAPI solution [5 µg/mL DAPI in 1× PBS with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100]. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
7.2 Wash in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

---

### 8 Tissue Clearing — Dehydration (Post-labeling Methanol Series)
8.1 Incubation in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.2 Incubation in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.3 Incubation in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.4 Incubation in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.5 Incubation in 100% methanol (anhydrous), protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.6 Repeat incubation in fresh 100% methanol (anhydrous), protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 9 Delipidation (DCM Treatment)
9.1 Incubation in 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 67% methanol (vol/vol), protected from light. Use a sealed glass vial; perform in fume hood. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
9.2 Incubation in 100% DCM (anhydrous), protected from light. Tissue should sink to the bottom of the vial when clearing is complete. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

---

### 10 Refractive Index Matching (DBE Immersion)
10.1 Transfer tissue to dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014) in a glass vial. Ensure tissue is fully submerged. Protect from light. Do NOT use plastic containers (DBE dissolves most plastics). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
10.2 Replace with fresh DBE and continue incubation until tissue is fully transparent (optically clear). For a tumor block of this size, extended incubation may be required. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12–24 hours)
10.3 Verify optical transparency by visual inspection against a printed grid pattern. Tissue should appear fully transparent with no opaque regions. (Temperature: RT, Time: visual check)

---

### 11 Sample Mounting and Imaging Preparation
11.1 Transfer cleared tissue into a custom glass-bottom imaging chamber or a 1.5 mm borosilicate glass cuvette filled with DBE. Orient the tissue with the largest flat face down for optimal light-sheet illumination of the tumor–nerve interface. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min equilibration)
11.2 Seal the chamber with optical adhesive or silicone grease to prevent DBE evaporation and maintain RI matching (n ≈ 1.56) during imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)
11.3 Image using a light-sheet fluorescence microscope (LSFM) equipped with a long-working-distance, low-NA objective (e.g., 4× or 12× CLARITY objective) compatible with DBE immersion (RI = 1.56). Recommended imaging channels: 405 nm (DAPI/nuclear), 488 nm (Alexa Fluor 488/Pan-CK/tumor epithelium), 561 nm (Alexa Fluor 568/PGP9.5/nerve), 647 nm (Alexa Fluor 647/TUJ1/nerve). Acquire z-stacks at 2–5 µm step size for full 3D reconstruction. (Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)

---

### 12 Post-imaging Storage
12.1 Store cleared tissue in sealed glass vial containing fresh DBE, wrapped in aluminum foil to protect fluorescence. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: up to 6 months)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 647, TH + Alexa Fluor 546, Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor 488]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) it employs organic solvent-based delipidation (methanol/DCM/DBE) that efficiently clears dense, fibrotic pancreatic tumor stroma (desmoplastic ECM-rich tissue) within a manageable timeframe; (2) it is well-validated for whole-organ immunolabeling of neural markers including PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal, marks all nerve fibers including sensory, motor, and autonomic) and TH (tyrosine hydroxylase, the rate-limiting enzyme in catecholamine synthesis, gold-standard sympathetic-specific marker); (3) the methanol pretreatment step enhances antibody penetration into fibrotic tissue; (4) DBE as the final RI-matching medium (RI ≈ 1.56) is compatible with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) and provides excellent transparency for a ~12 × 8 × 5 mm specimen; (5) three-channel multiplexing allows simultaneous visualization of pan-neural network (PGP9.5/AF647), sympathetic fibers specifically (TH/AF546), and tumor epithelial boundary reference (Pan-CK/AF488), directly enabling the spatial comparison of fiber subtypes across tumor core, margin, fibrotic stroma, perivascular, and residual normal pancreas zones. TH cannot be replaced by a lipophilic tracer (DiI/DiO) because tracers label axonal membranes non-specifically and cannot confirm sympathetic identity; PGP9.5 alone cannot distinguish sympathetic from sensory/parasympathetic fibers. Pan-Cytokeratin delineates ductal/epithelial tumor boundaries without requiring a separate transgenic model.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Post-fixation Verification and Pre-treatment**
1.1 Verify tissue fixation: confirm sample (12 mm × 8 mm × 5 mm intact pancreatic tumor) was immersion-fixed in 4% (wt/vol) PFA in 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4) for 24 hours at 4 ℃. If not yet fixed, perform fixation now. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Wash fixed tissue with 1× PBS (pH 7.4) with gentle rocking to remove residual PFA. Perform 3 × 30-minute washes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 minutes)
1.3 Transfer tissue into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube or glass vial. Ensure tissue is fully submerged in all subsequent solutions (use ~3–5 mL per step for this tissue size).

**2 Dehydration (Methanol Gradient)**
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous) with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous) to ensure complete dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 Bleaching (Endogenous Peroxidase Quenching and Autofluorescence Reduction)**
3.1 Prepare fresh bleaching solution: 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes 100% MeOH). Pre-chill to 4 ℃. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: preparation only)
3.2 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol to reduce autofluorescence from fibrotic stroma and red blood cells. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)

**4 Rehydration (Methanol Gradient)**
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 1× PBS (pH 7.4) with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.6 Repeat wash with fresh 1× PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**5 Permeabilization and Blocking**
5.1 Prepare Permeabilization/Blocking Solution (PBS-GT): 0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS (pH 7.4). Filter sterilize (0.22 µm). (Temperature: RT, Time: preparation only)
5.2 Incubation with PBS-GT permeabilization/blocking solution with gentle rocking to block non-specific binding and enhance antibody penetration into desmoplastic stroma. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**6 Primary Antibody Immunolabeling**
6.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in PBS-GT solution:
- Anti-PGP9.5 (rabbit polyclonal, e.g., Abcam ab10404), dilution 1:500 → detects pan-neuronal marker (all nerve fiber subtypes)
- Anti-TH (chicken polyclonal, e.g., Abcam ab76442 or Aves Labs TYH), dilution 1:400 → detects tyrosine hydroxylase, sympathetic-specific marker
- Anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (mouse monoclonal, e.g., Sigma C2562 clone PCK-26), dilution 1:300 → delineates tumor epithelial/ductal boundaries
Note: Use three primary antibodies from three distinct host species (rabbit, chicken, mouse) to enable species-specific secondary antibody multiplexing without cross-reactivity. (Temperature: RT, Time: preparation only)
6.2 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail in PBS-GT with gentle rocking at 37 ℃. Given the tissue size (~12 × 8 × 5 mm) and dense fibrotic stroma, extended incubation is required for full penetration. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
6.3 Wash with PBS-GT (0.2% gelatin, 0.5% Triton X-100, 0.01% NaN₃ in PBS) to remove unbound primary antibodies. Perform 5 × 1-hour washes with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)
6.4 Perform additional overnight wash with PBS-GT to ensure complete removal of unbound primary antibodies from the dense fibrotic core. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**7 Secondary Antibody Immunolabeling**
7.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in PBS-GT:
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (e.g., Thermo Fisher A31573), dilution 1:500 → labels PGP9.5 (pan-neural, far-red channel)
- Donkey anti-chicken IgY conjugated to Alexa Fluor 546 (e.g., Jackson ImmunoResearch 703-165-155 or equivalent), dilution 1:500 → labels TH (sympathetic-specific, red/orange channel)
- Donkey anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (e.g., Thermo Fisher A21202), dilution 1:500 → labels Pan-Cytokeratin (tumor boundary reference, green channel)
Note: All Alexa Fluor dyes are compatible with iDISCO+ organic solvent clearing and DBE RI-matching medium; they are photostable and retain signal through dehydration/clearing steps. (Temperature: RT, Time: preparation only)
7.2 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail in PBS-GT with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
7.3 Wash with PBS-GT to remove unbound secondary antibodies. Perform 5 × 1-hour washes with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)
7.4 Perform additional overnight wash with PBS-GT, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
7.5 Final wash with 1× PBS (pH 7.4), 2 × 30 minutes, to remove gelatin/detergent before dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 minutes)

**8 Second Dehydration (Methanol Gradient)**
8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous) with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous) to ensure complete dehydration before delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**9 Delipidation (DCM Treatment)**
9.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 67% methanol (vol/vol) mixture with gentle rocking in a chemical fume hood. DCM removes residual lipids and enhances transparency of the desmoplastic stroma. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
9.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (anhydrous, Sigma 270997) with gentle rocking in a chemical fume hood. Tissue should sink to the bottom of the vial when fully delipidated (typically within 15–45 minutes for this tissue size). (Temperature: RT, Time: 45 minutes)
9.3 Verify tissue has sunk (indicating complete delipidation). If tissue still floats, extend DCM incubation by 15-minute increments until sinking is observed.

**10 Refractive Index Matching (DBE Clearing)**
10.1 Remove DCM completely and immediately add 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG, RI ≈ 1.562) without washing. Incubation with DBE without shaking, protected from light. DBE provides RI matching compatible with LSFM objectives and renders the fibrotic pancreatic tumor fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
10.2 Replace with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE and continue incubation without shaking, protected from light, until tissue is fully transparent (typically 4–8 hours total for this tissue size). (Temperature: RT, Time: 8 hours)

**11 Sample Storage and Pre-imaging Preparation**
11.1 Transfer cleared, transparent tissue into a clean glass vial filled with fresh 100% DBE. Seal tightly with parafilm to prevent evaporation and moisture ingress. Store protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 6 months)
11.2 For imaging preparation: mount tissue in a custom 3D-printed or agarose-free holder submerged in DBE within a glass-bottom imaging chamber compatible with the light-sheet microscope (e.g., LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope II or Miltenyi Biotec UltraMicroscope Blaze). Use DBE-compatible silicone tubing and avoid plastic components that dissolve in DBE. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
11.3 Imaging parameters recommendation: Use LSFM with 4× (overview, whole-tumor architecture) and 12× or 25× (detail, fiber morphology, branching, PNI foci) objectives with DBE-immersion correction. Acquire z-stacks with ≤5 µm step size for 4× and ≤2 µm step size for higher magnification objectives. Channels: AF488 (488 nm excitation / 525 nm emission — Pan-CK tumor boundary), AF546 (561 nm excitation / 585 nm emission — TH sympathetic fibers), AF647 (638 nm excitation / 680 nm emission — PGP9.5 pan-neural network). (Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)
11.4 Post-acquisition 3D image analysis: register multi-channel z-stacks using Imaris or napari; segment tumor core, margin, fibrotic stroma, perivascular zones, and residual normal pancreas using Pan-CK channel as anatomical reference; quantify PGP9.5⁺ total fiber density and TH⁺ sympathetic fiber density, branching complexity (fractal dimension), fiber orientation, and spatial enrichment index per anatomical zone to assess sympathetic contribution to PNI and tumor neural remodeling. (Temperature: RT, Time: per analysis session)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for this 12 mm × 8 mm × 5 mm pancreatic tumor block because: (1) its methanol-based dehydration and delipidation pipeline achieves deep, homogeneous clearing of dense, fibrotic pancreatic tumor stroma that is notoriously resistant to aqueous methods; (2) the organic-solvent backbone (DCM/DBE) provides RI matching at ~1.56, enabling high-resolution light-sheet imaging throughout the full tissue depth; (3) the immunolabeling-first strategy (whole-mount antibody staining before clearing) allows simultaneous labeling of two independent channels — β-III Tubulin/TUJ1 (pan-neuronal axonal marker, Alexa Fluor 647) to map the entire intratumoral and peritumoral nerve fiber network, and Pan-Cytokeratin (Alexa Fluor 555) to delineate tumor epithelial structures, ductal remnants, and the invasive front; (4) DAPI provides nuclear counterstaining for spatial orientation and cell density assessment across tumor core, invasive front, and residual normal pancreas zones. This dual-channel strategy directly enables 3D quantification of nerve-tumor distance relationships, nerve fiber trajectory relative to tumor boundaries, and perineural invasion topology — all core objectives of the stated scientific goal.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Pre-treatment and Permeabilization**

1.1 Wash fixed tissue (post-fixed in 4% PFA) 3× with 1× PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min each wash)

1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.7 Incubation with 100% methanol (second change).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.8 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH) to quench endogenous peroxidase and reduce autofluorescence.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

1.9 Rehydration: incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.10 Rehydration: incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.11 Rehydration: incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.12 Rehydration: incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.13 Rehydration: incubation with 1× PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.14 Incubation with PBS/0.2% Triton X-100 (PTx0.2) for initial permeabilization.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.15 Incubation with permeabilization solution: PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

1.16 Incubation with blocking solution: PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% normal donkey serum (NDS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

---

**2 Primary Antibody Labeling**

2.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in PTwH (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin) + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS: anti-β-III Tubulin/TUJ1 (rabbit polyclonal, 1:200) + anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (mouse monoclonal, 1:150).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours, with gentle rocking)

2.2 Wash with PTwH (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin), 5 washes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each wash)

---

**3 Secondary Antibody Labeling**

3.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in PTwH + 3% NDS: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:400) + donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 555 (1:400). Protect from light hereafter.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, with gentle rocking, light-protected)

3.2 Wash with PTwH, 5 washes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours each wash)

---

**4 Nuclear Counterstaining**

4.1 Incubation with DAPI (5 µg/mL in PTwH) for nuclear counterstaining to delineate tumor core, invasive front, and residual normal pancreas zones.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, light-protected)

4.2 Wash with PTwH, 3 washes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each wash)

4.3 Final wash with 1× PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

---

**5 Dehydration for Clearing**

5.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.5 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5.6 Incubation with 100% methanol (second change) to ensure complete dehydration.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

**6 Delipidation**

6.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) DCM (dichloromethane, Sigma 270997) in methanol (1 volume DCM : 2 volumes MeOH) for delipidation of dense pancreatic stroma.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, with gentle rocking)

6.2 Incubation with 100% DCM, 2 washes to remove residual methanol and lipids.(Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min each wash)

---

**7 Refractive Index Matching**

7.1 Incubation with 100% DBE (dibenzyl ether, Sigma 108014-1KG) without shaking, first change, until tissue sinks and becomes fully transparent (RI ≈ 1.56).(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours, light-protected)

7.2 Incubation with 100% DBE (dibenzyl ether), second change, for complete RI equilibration throughout the 12 mm × 8 mm × 5 mm tissue block.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, light-protected)

---

**8 Storage and Pre-imaging Preparation**

8.1 Transfer cleared tissue to a glass vial filled with fresh 100% DBE. Seal tightly with Parafilm to prevent evaporation. Store in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Time: up to 6 months)

8.2 Prior to imaging, mount tissue in a custom 3D-printed or agarose-free DBE-compatible imaging chamber (e.g., glass-bottom dish sealed with silicone gasket) filled with 100% DBE to maintain RI matching throughout light-sheet acquisition.

8.3 For light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM): use objectives compatible with DBE (RI = 1.56), e.g., CLARITY/CUBIC-compatible long-working-distance objectives with immersion correction collar set to 1.56. Acquire: Channel 1 — DAPI (405 nm excitation / 450 nm emission); Channel 2 — Alexa Fluor 555/Pan-Cytokeratin (561 nm excitation / 590 nm emission); Channel 3 — Alexa Fluor 647/TUJ1 (638 nm excitation / 680 nm emission). Tile acquisition with ≥10% overlap for full-volume stitching of the entire tumor block.(Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)

8.4 Post-acquisition: perform 3D image stitching (e.g., BigStitcher/Fiji), channel alignment, and 3D rendering (e.g., Imaris or napari) to generate spatial maps of nerve fiber trajectories relative to Pan-Cytokeratin-positive tumor epithelium, enabling quantification of nerve-tumor distance in tumor core, invasive front, and residual normal pancreas compartments.(Temperature: RT, Time: per analysis session)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+

**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5 (Hu C/D / PGP9.5) + Alexa Fluor (secondary, e.g., Alexa Fluor 647), TH (酪氨酸羟化酶) + Alexa Fluor (secondary, e.g., Alexa Fluor 546), Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor (secondary, e.g., Alexa Fluor 488), DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected over the previously used PEGASOS for the following reasons specific to this problem:

1. **Superior delipidation for dense fibrotic pancreatic tumor stroma:** iDISCO+ uses a methanol gradient followed by dichloromethane (DCM) for highly efficient lipid extraction. Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is characterized by a dense desmoplastic stroma with high lipid and collagen content. The DCM step in iDISCO+ is far more aggressive and complete than the 24-hour PEGASOS delipidation that was previously insufficient.

2. **Built-in decoloration (H₂O₂ bleaching):** iDISCO+ includes a mandatory H₂O₂/methanol bleaching step that eliminates endogenous peroxidase activity and tissue autofluorescence — a critical fix for the weak signal problem, since pancreatic tissue has high intrinsic autofluorescence from lipofuscin, hemoglobin, and collagen. This step was absent in the previous PEGASOS run.

3. **Deep antibody penetration via methanol permeabilization:** The methanol dehydration series in iDISCO+ dramatically increases tissue permeability, enabling antibody penetration into the core of a 12 mm × 8 mm × 5 mm tumor mass — essential for detecting sparse perineural invasion (PNI) foci deep within the tissue.

4. **Labeling strategy rationale:**
   - **PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal marker):** Labels all nerve fibers (sensory, sympathetic, parasympathetic) to map total innervation density, distribution, and trajectory throughout tumor core, margin, fibrotic stroma, perivascular, and residual normal pancreas zones.
   - **TH (tyrosine hydroxylase):** Sympathetic-specific marker; co-labeling with PGP9.5 allows dissection of sympathetic vs. non-sympathetic fiber remodeling within the tumor microenvironment.
   - **Pan-Cytokeratin:** Labels epithelial tumor cells and ductal structures, providing a clear tumor boundary reference for PNI assessment (nerve-in-relation-to-tumor-epithelium scoring) and delineating tumor core vs. normal residual pancreas.
   - **DAPI:** Nuclear counterstain for tissue architecture reference and cell density mapping; compatible with iDISCO+ when applied post-clearing in the rehydration/RI-matching phase or as a pre-clearing nuclear stain.

5. **RI matching with DBE:** Dibenzyl ether (DBE) provides RI = 1.56, excellent transparency for this tissue size, and long-term sample preservation.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Pre-treatment and Dehydration**

1.1 Wash fixed tissue (post-fixed in 4% PFA) with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water (dH₂O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in dH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in dH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in dH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.7 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

**2 Decoloration / Bleaching (Autofluorescence Reduction)**

2.1 Prepare fresh bleaching solution: 5% H₂O₂ (vol/vol) in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes 100% MeOH). Incubate tissue submerged in this solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours, overnight, protected from light)

2.2 Wash with 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 20 min)

---

**3 Delipidation**

3.1 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane (DCM, Sigma 270997). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, on gentle shaker)

3.2 Incubation with fresh 100% DCM, second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, on gentle shaker)

3.3 Incubation with 100% DCM, third change, to ensure complete lipid extraction from the dense desmoplastic stroma. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, on gentle shaker)

---

**4 Rehydration**

4.1 Incubation with 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in dH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in dH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in dH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.5 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in dH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.6 Incubation with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

---

**5 Permeabilization and Blocking**

5.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, on gentle shaker)

5.2 Incubation with blocking solution: PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS), 0.1% (wt/vol) heparin. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, on gentle shaker)

---

**6 Primary Antibody Incubation**

6.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in PTwH buffer (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin) with 5% (vol/vol) NDS and 3% (vol/vol) DMSO:
- Anti-PGP9.5 (rabbit polyclonal, e.g., Abcam ab10404): 1:500 dilution
- Anti-TH (chicken polyclonal, e.g., Abcam ab76442): 1:500 dilution
- Anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (mouse monoclonal, e.g., Sigma C2562): 1:300 dilution

Incubate tissue fully submerged in antibody cocktail with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

6.2 Wash with PTwH buffer (PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight wash on rocker)

---

**7 Secondary Antibody Incubation**

7.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in PTwH buffer with 3% (vol/vol) NDS:
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (for PGP9.5): 1:500 dilution
- Donkey anti-chicken IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 546 (for TH): 1:500 dilution
- Donkey anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (for Pan-Cytokeratin): 1:500 dilution

Incubate tissue fully submerged in secondary antibody cocktail. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, protected from light)

7.2 Wash with PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour, then overnight wash on rocker, protected from light)

---

**8 Nuclear Counterstain (DAPI)**

8.1 Incubation with DAPI solution (2 µg/mL DAPI in 1× PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, protected from light, on gentle shaker)

8.2 Wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min, protected from light)

---

**9 Post-immunolabeling Dehydration**

9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in dH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in dH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in dH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in dH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

9.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

9.6 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, protected from light)

---

**10 Clearing with DCM**

10.1 Incubation with 100% DCM (Sigma 270997). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, on gentle shaker, protected from light)

10.2 Incubation with fresh 100% DCM, second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, on gentle shaker, protected from light)

---

**11 Refractive Index Matching**

11.1 Transfer tissue to 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG, RI = 1.56) in a glass vial. Incubate without shaking until tissue sinks and becomes fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24–48 hours, protected from light)

11.2 Replace with fresh 100% DBE and incubate for final RI equilibration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)

---

**12 Mounting and Imaging Preparation**

12.1 Mount cleared tissue in a glass-bottom imaging chamber or custom 3D-printed holder filled with 100% DBE. Seal with silicone grease to prevent evaporation and DBE leakage. (Temperature: RT)

12.2 Image using a light-sheet fluorescence microscope (LSFM) or confocal microscope with objectives compatible with RI = 1.56 (e.g., CLARITY/immersion objectives or long-working-distance air objectives with DBE-compatible correction). Recommended channels: 405 nm (DAPI/nuclear), 488 nm (Pan-Cytokeratin/Alexa Fluor 488), 561 nm (TH/Alexa Fluor 546), 647 nm (PGP9.5/Alexa Fluor 647). (Temperature: RT)

12.3 For long-term storage prior to imaging, keep samples in 100% DBE in sealed glass vials at RT, protected from light. Samples are stable for several months under these conditions. (Temperature: RT, protected from light)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (灌流标记功能性血管腔面，conjugated with Alexa Fluor 647，经心脏灌注), CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 568 (标记全部血管内皮结构), Collagen IV + Alexa Fluor 488 (标记血管基底膜/壁结构), DAPI (细胞核对比)]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ 是针对 ~8×6×4 mm 完整肿瘤组织块的最优选择：①有机溶剂脱脂效率高，可在 5–7 天内完成毫米级肿瘤组织的完全透明化；②甲醇脱水 + DBE（二苄基醚）RI 匹配（n≈1.56）与光片显微镜完美兼容，可实现全肿瘤三维成像；③iDISCO+ 的免疫标记方案（甲醇预处理增强抗体渗透）对 CD31 和 Collagen IV 等血管标志物渗透效果经文献充分验证；④双通道血管标记策略：心脏灌注 Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647 仅标记灌注时管腔开放（功能性）的血管，术后 CD31 免疫染色标记全部内皮（含无灌流血管），两者比值直接量化灌流比例；Collagen IV 标记基底膜可独立显示血管壁完整性及管径；DAPI 提供肿瘤核心/边缘区域的细胞密度参考。四通道组合可同时定量血管密度、分支数、管径、曲率、连续性、灌流比例及核心/边缘差异，完整覆盖抗血管生成治疗血管正常化评估的所有科学目标。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**0 前提条件（样本准备，实验前已完成）**
0.1 实验动物经尾静脉或眼眶后静脉注射 Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647（Vector Labs，2 mg/kg，100 µL PBS），循环 5 min 后立即心脏灌注 PBS（10 mL）再灌注 4% PFA（20 mL）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 灌注约 5 min)
0.2 取脑，分离肿瘤组织块（~8×6×4 mm），置于 4% PFA（0.1 M PBS，pH 7.4）中后固定。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
0.3 PBS（0.1 M，pH 7.4）洗涤 3 次，每次 10 min，去除残余 PFA。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×10 min)

---

**1 脱水（Dehydration）**
1.1 置于 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 置于 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 置于 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 置于 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 置于 100% 甲醇中振荡孵育，换液一次（共 2 次）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 hour)

---

**2 漂白（Bleaching，去除内源性色素/血红素，改善光穿透）**
2.1 配制漂白液：5% H₂O₂ 溶于 100% 甲醇（1 vol 30% H₂O₂ + 5 vol MeOH），预冷至 4 ℃。将样本置于新鲜漂白液中，避光孵育。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)
2.2 100% 甲醇洗涤 3 次，每次 20 min，去除残余 H₂O₂。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×20 min)

---

**3 复水（Rehydration，为免疫染色做准备）**
3.1 置于 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 置于 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 置于 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 置于 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 置于 PBS（0.1 M，pH 7.4）中振荡孵育，换液 2 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min)

---

**4 通透与封闭（Permeabilization & Blocking）**
4.1 置于 PTwH 缓冲液（PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL 肝素）中振荡洗涤 2 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min)
4.2 置于通透液（PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 0.3 M 甘氨酸）中振荡孵育，增强大组织块抗体渗透。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
4.3 置于封闭液（PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL 肝素 + 5% 正常驴血清 + 3% BSA + 0.3% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO）中振荡孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

---

**5 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）**
5.1 配制一抗工作液（稀释于 PTwH + 5% 正常驴血清 + 3% BSA + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO）：
- 抗 CD31（PECAM-1）兔多克隆抗体（Abcam ab28364），1:200 稀释；
- 抗 Collagen IV 山羊多克隆抗体（Abcam ab769），1:200 稀释。
将样本置于一抗工作液中，轻柔摇动孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
5.2 PTwH 缓冲液洗涤 5 次，每次 1 h，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5×1 hour)

---

**6 二抗孵育（Secondary Antibody Incubation）**
6.1 配制二抗工作液（稀释于 PTwH + 3% BSA + 0.2% Triton X-100）：
- 驴抗兔 IgG-Alexa Fluor 568（Thermo Fisher A10042），1:500 稀释（标记 CD31）；
- 驴抗山羊 IgG-Alexa Fluor 488（Thermo Fisher A11055），1:500 稀释（标记 Collagen IV）；
- DAPI（1 µg/mL，终浓度）同步加入用于细胞核标记。
将样本置于二抗工作液中，避光轻柔摇动孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
6.2 PTwH 缓冲液洗涤 5 次，每次 1 h，避光操作。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5×1 hour)
6.3 PBS 洗涤 2 次，去除 Tween-20 残留，为脱水做准备。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min)

---

**7 二次脱水（Post-labeling Dehydration）**
7.1 置于 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中振荡孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
7.2 置于 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中振荡孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
7.3 置于 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中振荡孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
7.4 置于 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中振荡孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
7.5 置于 100% 甲醇中振荡孵育，换液 2 次，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×1 hour)

---

**8 脱脂（Delipidation）**
8.1 配制二氯甲烷（DCM）/甲醇混合液（33% DCM + 67% MeOH，vol/vol），将样本置于其中振荡孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
8.2 置于 100% DCM 中振荡孵育 2 次，换液，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2×30 min)

---

**9 RI 匹配与透明化（Refractive Index Matching & Clearing）**
9.1 将样本转移至 100% DBE（二苄基醚，Sigma-Aldrich 108014，n≈1.559）中，静置孵育（不振荡，防止气泡），避光，直至组织完全透明（通常 4–8 h，视组织厚度而定）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
9.2 更换新鲜 DBE，继续静置孵育，确认组织完全透明、无白色不透明区域。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

---

**10 保存与成像前处理（Storage & Pre-imaging Preparation）**
10.1 将透明样本转移至玻璃样品瓶（避免 DBE 溶解塑料容器），密封，避光保存于 RT；短期保存（≤2 周）可直接用于成像，长期保存（>2 周）置于 4 ℃ 避光保存。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 长期保存)
10.2 成像前将样本置于 DBE 填充的玻璃成像腔（光片显微镜专用石英比色皿或自制玻璃腔）中，确保样本完全浸没于 DBE（n=1.559），与光片显微镜物镜（推荐使用 RI 匹配物镜，如 Zeiss LSFM 5×/0.16 或 12×/0.53 浸液物镜，浸液为 DBE 或 BABB）匹配。(Temperature: RT, Time: 平衡 30 min 后成像)
10.3 成像通道建议：
- 405 nm 激发 → DAPI（细胞核，肿瘤核心/边缘区域划定）；
- 488 nm 激发 → Alexa Fluor 488（Collagen IV，血管基底膜/管径/壁完整性）；
- 561 nm 激发 → Alexa Fluor 568（CD31，全部血管内皮，含无灌流血管）；
- 647 nm 激发 → Alexa Fluor 647（Lectin 灌注，功能性灌流血管）。
CD31 通道与 Lectin 通道配准后计算灌流比例（Lectin⁺/CD31⁺ 血管体积比），结合 Collagen IV 通道定量管径、曲率、分支数，DAPI 通道划定肿瘤核心/边缘 ROI，完成抗血管生成治疗血管正常化的全定量分析。(Temperature: RT, Time: 按成像需求)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (灌流功能性血管腔面标记，体内灌注), CD31 + Alexa Fluor 647 (血管内皮结构), Collagen IV + Alexa Fluor (基底膜/血管壁完整性辅助), DAPI (细胞核定位/肿瘤区域界定)]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ 是针对固定完整组织（8 mm × 6 mm × 4 mm 脑胶质瘤）进行深层免疫标记与透明化的金标准方法。其甲醇梯度脱水 + DBE（二苄基醚）折射率匹配体系能有效去除脂质、实现深层抗体渗透，适合该尺寸的实体肿瘤组织。关键标记策略如下：① **体内灌注 Lectin**（如 Lectin-FITC 或 Lectin-Alexa Fluor 488，尾静脉注射后心脏灌流固定）作为功能性灌流血管的直接腔面标记，仅标记实际被血流灌注的血管腔，是回答"功能性血管"科学问题的最直接探针；② **CD31（PECAM-1）抗体 + Alexa Fluor 647** 标记全部血管内皮细胞（包括未灌流的结构性血管），用于揭示完整血管内皮网络；③ **Collagen IV 抗体 + Alexa Fluor 568** 标记基底膜，辅助分析血管剪枝、管径均一性及异常分支；④ **DAPI** 标记细胞核，界定肿瘤核心区与边缘区。Lectin（腔面）与 CD31（内皮）的双通道空间重叠分析可直接量化结构性血管与功能性灌流血管的差异，满足抗血管生成治疗后血管正常化评估的全部科学目标。iDISCO+ 对 Alexa Fluor 系列荧光素保存优异，与光片显微镜（LSFM）成像高度兼容。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**0 体内灌注标记（透明化前，动物处死前操作）**

0.1 配制 Lectin-FITC（或 Lectin-Alexa Fluor 488）灌注液：将 Lectin（番茄凝集素，Lycopersicon esculentum，Vector Labs）溶于无菌 PBS，终浓度 1 mg/mL，过 0.22 μm 滤膜除菌。(Temperature: RT, Time: 现配现用)

0.2 经小鼠尾静脉缓慢注射 Lectin 溶液 100–200 μL，循环 5–10 min 使其充分结合血管腔内皮糖萼。(Temperature: RT, Time: 循环 5–10 min)

0.3 经心脏灌注 PBS 20 mL 冲洗循环血液，随后灌注 4% PFA（溶于 0.1 M PBS，pH 7.4）20 mL 固定组织。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 灌注约 5–8 min)

0.4 取出脑胶质瘤组织，置于 4% PFA 中后固定。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

0.5 用 PBS 洗涤组织 3 × 30 min，去除残余 PFA。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

---

**1 脱水（Dehydration）**

1.1 置于 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.2 置于 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 置于 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 置于 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 置于 100% 甲醇中孵育，换液一次（共 2 次）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

---

**2 漂白（Bleaching）**

2.1 配制漂白液：5% H₂O₂ 溶于甲醇（1 体积 30% H₂O₂ + 5 体积 100% MeOH），冰上预冷。将组织置于漂白液中孵育，以减少组织自发荧光背景（注意：Lectin-FITC 信号在此步骤可能部分淬灭，若使用 Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647 则更耐漂白；建议 Lectin 选用 Alexa Fluor 647 标记版本以提高耐受性）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

---

**3 复水（Rehydration）**

3.1 置于 100% 甲醇中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.2 置于 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.3 置于 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.4 置于 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.5 置于 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.6 置于 PBS/0.2% Tween-20（PTw）中洗涤，换液 2 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

---

**4 通透化（Permeabilization）**

4.1 置于 PBS/0.2% Tween-20/20% DMSO/0.3 M 甘氨酸（PTwDG）溶液中孵育，增强大尺寸组织的抗体渗透性。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4.2 置于 PBS/0.2% Tween-20/10% DMSO/6% 正常驴血清（PTwDS）封闭液中孵育，减少非特异性结合。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

---

**5 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）**

5.1 配制一抗工作液（溶于 PTwDS 封闭液）：
- 抗 CD31 抗体（兔抗小鼠 CD31/PECAM-1，如 Abcam ab28364），稀释比 1:200；
- 抗 Collagen IV 抗体（兔抗小鼠 Collagen IV，如 Abcam ab6586），稀释比 1:300。
将组织置于一抗混合工作液中孵育（轻柔摇动）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

5.2 用 PTwT（PBS/0.2% Tween-20/0.1% Triton X-100）洗涤，每次 1 h，共 5 次换液洗涤。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

---

**6 二抗孵育（Secondary Antibody Incubation）**

6.1 配制二抗工作液（溶于 PTwDS 封闭液）：
- 驴抗兔 IgG-Alexa Fluor 647（用于 CD31 检测），稀释比 1:400；
- 驴抗兔 IgG-Alexa Fluor 568（用于 Collagen IV 检测，需与 CD31 一抗来源物种区分，若两者均为兔源，则需将其中一个替换为不同物种来源抗体，如大鼠抗 CD31 + 驴抗大鼠 Alexa Fluor 647，兔抗 Collagen IV + 驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 568）；
- DAPI（终浓度 5 μg/mL，用于细胞核标记）。
将组织置于二抗混合工作液中孵育，避光，轻柔摇动。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

6.2 用 PTwT 洗涤，每次 1 h，共 5 次换液洗涤，避光操作。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

6.3 用 PBS 终洗 2 次，去除残余洗涤剂。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

---

**7 脱水（Pre-clearing Dehydration）**

7.1 置于 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

7.2 置于 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

7.3 置于 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

7.4 置于 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

7.5 置于 100% 甲醇中孵育，换液 2 次，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

---

**8 脱脂（Delipidation）**

8.1 配制二氯甲烷（DCM）/甲醇混合液（33% DCM / 67% MeOH，vol/vol）。将组织置于该混合液中孵育，在通风橱中操作，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

8.2 置于 100% DCM 中孵育，换液 2 次，充分脱脂，在通风橱中操作，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

---

**9 折射率匹配（Refractive Index Matching / Clearing）**

9.1 将组织转移至 100% DBE（二苄基醚，Sigma-Aldrich 108014，RI ≈ 1.562）中孵育，不振荡，避光，直至组织完全透明（通常 4–8 h，视组织厚度而定）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6–12 hours)

9.2 更换新鲜 DBE，继续孵育至组织完全透明、无白色不透明区域残留，避光保存备用。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

---

**10 成像前处理与保存（Imaging Preparation & Storage）**

10.1 将透明组织转移至成像腔室（如定制玻璃腔室或 FEP 管），用 DBE 充满腔室，确保组织完全浸没于 DBE 中（RI ≈ 1.562），与光片显微镜（LSFM）或共聚焦显微镜的浸液物镜（DBE 兼容物镜，如 Olympus XLPLN10XSVMP2 或 Miltenyi Biotec LSFM 专用物镜）匹配。(Temperature: RT, Time: 成像前平衡 30 min)

10.2 成像通道建议分配：
- **Ch1（488 nm 激发）**：Lectin-Alexa Fluor 488（功能性灌流血管腔面）；
- **Ch2（561 nm 激发）**：Collagen IV-Alexa Fluor 568（基底膜/血管壁）；
- **Ch3（647 nm 激发）**：CD31-Alexa Fluor 647（全部血管内皮结构）；
- **Ch4（405 nm 激发）**：DAPI（细胞核/肿瘤区域定位）。
按上述通道顺序采集全组织 Z-stack 图像，步长建议 2–5 μm（光片）或 3–5 μm（共聚焦）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 依成像系统而定)

10.3 短期保存：将透明组织置于 DBE 中，密封避光，4 ℃ 保存，可稳定保存 1–4 周（注意 DBE 对塑料容器有腐蚀性，使用玻璃容器）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 最长 4 weeks)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin+Alexa Fluor 647, CD31 (PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) it achieves excellent clearing of dense tumor tissue (~8×6×4 mm brain glioma block) via organic solvent-based delipidation (methanol/DCM/DBE), yielding high transparency suitable for light-sheet microscopy; (2) it is fully compatible with whole-mount immunolabeling of large tissue blocks through its methanol-based permeabilization and detergent-enhanced antibody penetration; (3) the organic solvent pipeline preserves Alexa Fluor dyes robustly. The dual-channel vascular strategy is scientifically critical: **Lectin (perfused intravenously pre-sacrifice, conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647)** labels only patent, perfused luminal surfaces, directly reporting functional perfusion status; **anti-CD31/PECAM1 (Alexa Fluor 555)** labels the total endothelial network including non-perfused, collapsed, or remodeled vessels. Comparing these two channels enables quantification of perfusion deficits, vascular normalization index, vessel density, diameter, and branching complexity across tumor core, invasive margin, and peritumoral brain — precisely matching the stated scientific objectives. DAPI provides nuclear context for regional boundary delineation. Note: Lectin (e.g., tomato lectin, Vector Labs) must be administered intravenously (i.v.) ~5–10 min before sacrifice and cardiac perfusion to label perfused vessels in vivo; the conjugated lectin signal is then preserved through the iDISCO+ pipeline.

---

## Protocol Steps

### 0 Pre-fixation In Vivo Lectin Perfusion (performed before tissue harvest)

0.1 Prepare 100 µg tomato lectin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (Vector Labs DL-1178 or equivalent) dissolved in 100 µL sterile PBS. Inject intravenously (tail vein or retro-orbital) into the anesthetized tumor-bearing mouse. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min circulation)

0.2 Perform transcardial perfusion with ice-cold PBS (20 mL) to flush non-bound lectin from the vasculature, followed by transcardial perfusion with ice-cold 4% PFA in PBS (20 mL). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ~5 min perfusion)

0.3 Dissect the brain with glioma, post-fix in 4% PFA in PBS overnight. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 hours)

0.4 Wash tissue 3× in PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 10 min each wash)

0.5 Trim the glioma-containing tissue block to ~8 mm × 6 mm × 4 mm under a dissection microscope, keeping tumor core, invasive margin, and adjacent normal brain intact. Store in PBS at 4 ℃ until proceeding.

---

### 1 Dehydration (Methanol Series)

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 2 Bleaching (Peroxide Treatment to Reduce Autofluorescence)

2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH, freshly prepared). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

---

### 3 Rehydration (Methanol Series, Reverse)

3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.5 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.6 Repeat wash with fresh PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 4 Permeabilization and Blocking

4.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution [0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in PBS (PTxwH)]. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4.2 Incubation with Blocking Solution [0.2% (wt/vol) gelatin, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.01% (wt/vol) sodium azide in PBS]. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

---

### 5 Primary Antibody Labeling (Whole-Mount Immunostaining)

5.1 Prepare primary antibody solution: anti-CD31/PECAM1 rabbit monoclonal antibody (e.g., Abcam ab182981) at 1:200 dilution in PTxwH blocking buffer [0.2% gelatin, 0.5% Triton X-100, 10% normal donkey serum, 0.01% sodium azide in PBS]. Note: Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647 signal from in vivo perfusion does not require additional primary antibody step. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours, with gentle rocking)

5.2 Wash tissue 5× in PTxwH [0.2% gelatin, 0.5% Triton X-100, 0.01% sodium azide in PBS]. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each wash)

---

### 6 Secondary Antibody Labeling and Nuclear Counterstain

6.1 Prepare secondary antibody solution: donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 555 (e.g., Thermo Fisher A31572) at 1:400 dilution in PTxwH blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, with gentle rocking, protected from light)

6.2 Add DAPI to the secondary antibody solution at a final concentration of 5 µg/mL to co-incubate for nuclear labeling. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, co-incubated with secondary antibody in step 6.1)

6.3 Wash tissue 5× in PTxwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each wash)

6.4 Final wash 2× in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min each wash)

---

### 7 Dehydration (Second Methanol Series, Pre-Clearing)

7.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

7.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

7.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

7.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

7.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

7.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

---

### 8 Delipidation (DCM Treatment)

8.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol (1:2 DCM:MeOH). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, with gentle rocking in fume hood)

8.2 Incubation with 100% DCM (two changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min each, in fume hood)

---

### 9 Refractive Index Matching (Clearing in DBE)

9.1 Transfer tissue to 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014) in a glass vial. Ensure tissue is fully submerged. Do not seal with rubber — use glass or PTFE caps. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, without shaking, protected from light, in fume hood)

9.2 Replace with fresh 100% DBE and continue incubation until tissue is fully transparent (typically an additional 3–12 hours depending on tissue density). Monitor transparency visually. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3–12 hours, protected from light)

9.3 Store cleared tissue in 100% DBE in sealed glass vials until imaging. (Temperature: RT or 4 ℃, Time: up to 2 weeks, protected from light)

---

### 10 Sample Mounting and Imaging Preparation

10.1 Transfer cleared tissue block into a custom glass-bottom imaging chamber or a 3D-printed sample holder compatible with the light-sheet microscope (e.g., LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope II or Zeiss Lightsheet Z.1). Fill chamber with 100% DBE (RI ≈ 1.562) as immersion and mounting medium.

10.2 Orient the sample with the tumor core facing the objective to allow sequential z-stack acquisition from tumor core through invasive margin to peritumoral brain. Secure with low-melting agarose (1% in DBE-equilibrated solution) if needed, or use custom holders.

10.3 Acquire 3D z-stacks using the following channel assignments:
- **Channel 1 (DAPI):** Ex 405 nm / Em 420–470 nm — nuclear counterstain for regional boundary delineation.
- **Channel 2 (Alexa Fluor 555 / CD31):** Ex 561 nm / Em 570–620 nm — total endothelial network (all vessels including non-perfused).
- **Channel 3 (Alexa Fluor 647 / Lectin):** Ex 638 nm / Em 650–720 nm — functionally perfused vessel lumens only.

10.4 Set z-step size to ≤ 3 µm for full resolution of microvascular architecture. Use tile scanning with ≥ 10% overlap for large-volume reconstruction across the full 8×6×4 mm block.

10.5 Post-acquisition: perform 3D image stitching (e.g., BigStitcher in Fiji/ImageJ), vessel segmentation (e.g., Imaris Filament Tracer or ilastik), and co-registration of CD31 and Lectin channels to generate the dual-channel vascular atlas. Quantify vessel density, diameter distribution, branching complexity, perfusion fraction (Lectin⁺/CD31⁺ ratio), perfusion-deficient zones (CD31⁺/Lectin⁻ regions), and vascular normalization index across tumor core, invasive margin, and peritumoral brain compartments.

iDISCO+ 采用甲醇梯度脱水 + DCM 脱脂 + DBE 折射率匹配，对 8 mm × 6 mm × 4 mm 的脑胶质瘤组织具有优异的深层透明效果，且有机溶剂体系能有效去除脂质、降低散射，适合深层三维光片成像。相比原 FDISCO 方案，iDISCO+ 的 THF 梯度每步时间更充分（1–2 h），且保留了关键的 DCM 脱脂步骤，可解决原方案中透明不均匀和血管网络显示不完整的核心问题。

标记策略：
- **术前尾静脉灌注 Lectin-Alexa Fluor**（如 Lectin-DyLight 649 或 Lectin + Alexa Fluor 647 二抗体系）：标记功能性灌流血管腔面，区分有灌流与无灌流血管，直接支持灌流比例定量；
- **CD31 (PECAM1) 免疫染色 + Alexa Fluor 568**：标记全部血管内皮细胞，包括无灌流血管，用于血管密度、分支、管径、曲率、连续性分析；
- **Collagen IV 免疫染色 + Alexa Fluor 488**：标记基底膜，辅助判断血管壁完整性与正常化程度；
- **DAPI**：细胞核定位，区分肿瘤核心与边缘区域。

三通道（488/568/647 nm）分离良好，背景低，满足多参数血管形态定量需求。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**0 术前活体灌注（处死前，功能性血管标记）**

0.1 配制 Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647（1 mg/mL in PBS，0.2 μm 滤膜过滤），经尾静脉缓慢注射 100 μL，循环 5 min 后心脏灌注 PBS 冲洗，随即取脑。(Temperature: 37 ℃ 体温环境, Time: 5 min 循环)

0.2 心脏灌注 4% PFA（in 0.1 M PBS，pH 7.4）固定，取出完整脑胶质瘤组织，置于 4% PFA 中后固定。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

0.3 PBS（0.1 M，pH 7.4）洗涤 3 次，每次 10 min，去除残余 PFA。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 10 min)

---

**1 脱水（Dehydration，甲醇梯度）**

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol（无水甲醇）, 换液两次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 2 hours)

---

**2 漂白（Bleaching，去除内源性色素/血红素，降低背景）**

2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol（1 vol 30% H₂O₂ : 5 vol MeOH）.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

---

**3 复水（Rehydration）**

3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.5 Incubation with PBS（0.1 M，pH 7.4）, 换液两次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

---

**4 通透化（Permeabilization）**

4.1 Incubation with PBS/0.2% Triton X-100（PTx0.2）.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

4.2 Incubation with permeabilization solution：PBS/0.16% Triton X-100/20% DMSO/0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4.3 Incubation with blocking solution：PBS/0.2% Tween-20/10% DMSO/5% normal donkey serum（PTwH + 10% DMSO + 5% NDS）.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

---

**5 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）**

5.1 配制一抗混合液：
- Anti-CD31 (PECAM1) rabbit monoclonal antibody（1:200）
- Anti-Collagen IV rabbit/goat polyclonal antibody（1:200，与 CD31 选用不同宿主物种以便二抗区分）
溶于 PTwH（PBS/0.2% Tween-20/0.1% heparin）+ 5% NDS + 3% DMSO。

5.2 Incubation with primary antibody solution（Anti-CD31 1:200 + Anti-Collagen IV 1:200 in PTwH/5% NDS/3% DMSO）.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours，轻摇)

5.3 PTwH 洗涤 5 次，每次 1 h，末次过夜洗涤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour + overnight)

---

**6 二抗孵育（Secondary Antibody Incubation）**

6.1 配制二抗混合液：
- Donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 568（1:500，标记 CD31）
- Donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 488（1:500，标记 Collagen IV）
溶于 PTwH + 5% NDS + 3% DMSO。（Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647 已于活体灌注时标记，无需二抗）

6.2 Incubation with secondary antibody solution（Alexa Fluor 568 anti-rabbit 1:500 + Alexa Fluor 488 anti-goat 1:500 in PTwH/5% NDS/3% DMSO）.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours，避光轻摇)

6.3 PTwH 洗涤 5 次，每次 1 h，末次过夜洗涤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour + overnight，避光)

---

**7 DAPI 核染（Cell Nucleus Counterstaining）**

7.1 Incubation with DAPI（2 μg/mL in PBS）.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours，避光)

7.2 PBS 洗涤 3 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

---

**8 脱水（Second Dehydration，透明前处理）**

8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol（无水甲醇）, 换液两次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

---

**9 脱脂（Delipidation，DCM 步骤——修正原方案跳过 DCM 的关键错误）**

9.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) DCM（二氯甲烷，Sigma 270997）in 100% methanol（DCM:MeOH = 1:2 vol/vol）.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours，通风橱，轻摇)

9.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM（纯二氯甲烷），换液两次，至组织沉底（密度增大）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min，通风橱)

---

**10 折射率匹配（RI Matching，DBE 浸泡）**

10.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE（苯甲酸苄酯/苯甲醇 = 2:1 vol/vol，RI ≈ 1.559；Sigma DBE 108014）, 换液一次，至组织完全透明（无白色混浊区域）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 第一次换液 2 hours，第二次换液 overnight（12–16 hours），避光)

10.2 确认透明均匀性：在白光下目视检查，组织应完全透明，无不透明核心区域；若仍有混浊，继续更换新鲜 DBE 孵育 12 h。(Temperature: RT, Time: 视透明程度 12 hours（如需）)

---

**11 成像前处理（Mounting for Light-Sheet / Confocal Imaging）**

11.1 将透明组织转移至 DBE 填充的玻璃成像腔（FEP 管或定制玻璃槽），确保组织完全浸没于 DBE（RI = 1.559），与光片显微镜物镜（LSFM，推荐 RI 匹配物镜如 Zeiss LSFM 5×/0.16 或 12×/0.53 CLARITY 物镜）匹配。(Temperature: RT, Time: 平衡 30 min)

11.2 成像通道设置：
- 405 nm 激发 → DAPI（细胞核，区域定位）
- 488 nm 激发 → Alexa Fluor 488（Collagen IV，基底膜）
- 561 nm 激发 → Alexa Fluor 568（CD31，全部内皮）
- 638/647 nm 激发 → Alexa Fluor 647（Lectin，功能性灌流腔面）

11.3 采集完整 Z-stack 三维图像，层间距 ≤ 2 μm（用于管径、曲率、分支定量），覆盖肿瘤核心至边缘全区域。(Temperature: RT, Time: 按样本大小，约 2–6 hours/样本)

---

**12 样本保存（Post-Imaging Storage）**

12.1 成像完毕后，将样本密封于新鲜 DBE 中，避光、室温保存（短期）或 4 ℃ 保存（长期，≤ 6 个月）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 长期保存)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato/RFP (内源荧光，直接保留), Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ 是目前针对完整小鼠脑组织（~12×8×6 mm）最成熟、应用最广泛的溶剂基透明方法，具有以下优势：
1. **透明效率高**：有机溶剂（甲醇脱水 + DBE折射率匹配）可将完整脑组织完全透明化，满足全脑尺度三维成像需求；
2. **抗体穿透性强**：iDISCO+ 的甲醇预处理和去脂步骤显著提升抗体在厚组织中的渗透深度，适合完整脑组织的免疫标记；
3. **tdTomato/RFP 信号保留**：iDISCO+ 标准流程中 tdTomato 在 DBE 中具有可接受的荧光保留（相较 uDISCO 的 BABB 体系更温和），可直接定位转移灶；
4. **标记策略设计**：
   - **tdTomato/RFP 内源信号**：直接标记转移癌细胞位置、数量、体积及侵袭边界；
   - **Pan-Cytokeratin（广谱细胞角蛋白）+ Alexa Fluor 647**：验证上皮来源转移癌细胞身份（乳腺癌细胞高表达 CK），与 tdTomato 双色验证，排除非特异背景；Alexa Fluor 647 在 DBE 中荧光稳定，与 tdTomato（~580 nm）光谱分离良好，适合双通道光片显微镜成像；
   - **DAPI**：标记细胞核，提供脑组织整体结构参考，辅助判断侵袭模式中的细胞密度分布。

---

## Protocol Steps

### 1 样本预处理（Pre-treatment）

1.1 取已完成 4% PFA 固定及后固定的完整小鼠脑组织，置于 1× PBS 中充分漂洗，去除残余固定液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

1.2 将脑组织转移至 1× PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 中孵育，进行初步通透处理。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

---

### 2 脱水（Dehydration）

2.1 将样本置于 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.2 将样本置于 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.3 将样本置于 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.4 将样本置于 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.5 将样本置于 100% 甲醇中孵育，换液一次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

---

### 3 漂白（Bleaching，用于降低脑组织自发荧光）

3.1 将样本置于新鲜配制的 5% H₂O₂ 甲醇溶液（1 体积 30% H₂O₂ + 5 体积 100% 甲醇）中孵育，以降低脑组织内源性自发荧光背景，提高信噪比。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

---

### 4 复水（Rehydration）

4.1 将样本置于 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.2 将样本置于 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.3 将样本置于 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.4 将样本置于 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.5 将样本置于 1× PBS 中漂洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

---

### 5 通透与封闭（Permeabilization & Blocking）

5.1 将样本置于 PBS/0.2% Gelatin/0.5% Triton X-100/0.01% Thimerosal（PTwH + Gelatin 封闭液）中孵育，进行充分通透与封闭，减少非特异性抗体结合。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

---

### 6 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）

6.1 配制一抗工作液：将抗 Pan-Cytokeratin 抗体（兔源多克隆或单克隆，如 Abcam ab9377 或同类产品）以 1:200 稀释于 PTwH + 5% DMSO + 3% donkey serum 封闭液中，终体积足以完全浸没样本（建议 1–2 mL）。

6.2 将样本置于上述一抗工作液中孵育，轻柔摇动（30–40 rpm 旋转摇床）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)

6.3 用 PTwH 漂洗样本，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour，随后 37 ℃过夜漂洗 1 次)

---

### 7 二抗孵育（Secondary Antibody Incubation）

7.1 配制二抗工作液：将驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 647 二抗（如 Thermo Fisher A-31573）以 1:400 稀释于 PTwH + 3% donkey serum 中；同时加入 DAPI（终浓度 5 µg/mL）用于核染色。

7.2 将样本置于上述二抗工作液中孵育，轻柔摇动，避光。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)

7.3 用 PTwH 漂洗样本，去除未结合二抗，避光操作。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour，随后 37 ℃过夜漂洗 1 次)

---

### 8 脱水（再次脱水，Dehydration for Clearing）

8.1 将样本置于 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.2 将样本置于 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.3 将样本置于 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.4 将样本置于 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液中孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8.5 将样本置于 100% 甲醇中孵育，换液一次，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)

---

### 9 去脂（Delipidation）

9.1 将样本置于二氯甲烷（DCM，Sigma 270997）中孵育，充分去除脂质，使组织完全透明化，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

---

### 10 折射率匹配（Refractive Index Matching）

10.1 将样本从 DCM 中取出，用吸水纸轻轻吸去表面残余 DCM（勿过度干燥），立即转入苯甲酸苄酯/苯甲醇（DBE，dibenzyl ether，Sigma 108014）中孵育，直至样本完全透明（RI ≈ 1.558），避光，不振荡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 过夜至完全透明，通常 12–24 hours)

10.2 更换新鲜 DBE，继续孵育以确保折射率完全均一，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4–6 hours)

---

### 11 保存与成像前处理（Storage & Pre-imaging Preparation）

11.1 将透明化完成的样本保存于 DBE 中，置于密封玻璃容器（避免 DBE 溶解塑料），避光，4 ℃保存，可保存数周至数月。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 长期保存)

11.2 成像前将样本转移至成像腔室（推荐使用玻璃底培养皿或定制光片显微镜样本槽），用 DBE 充满腔室作为浸没介质（RI ≈ 1.558），使用与 DBE 折射率匹配的物镜（如 CLARITY/LSFM 专用长工作距离物镜，RI 1.45–1.56 校正）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 成像前平衡 30 min)

11.3 推荐成像方案：使用光片荧光显微镜（LSFM/SPIM）进行全脑三维扫描；激发通道设置：
- **DAPI**：405 nm 激发 / 420–470 nm 发射（核参考通道）；
- **tdTomato/RFP**：561 nm 激发 / 580–620 nm 发射（转移癌细胞定位通道）；
- **Alexa Fluor 647**：638 nm 激发 / 660–720 nm 发射（Pan-Cytokeratin 上皮标记验证通道）。
三通道顺序采集，Z 步距建议 2–5 µm，覆盖全脑体积，用于后续三维重建及转移灶定量分析。(Temperature: RT, Time: 根据样本体积和分辨率设置，全脑扫描通常需要 2–8 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato/RFP (内源荧光，主通道), Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor 647 (上皮身份验证), CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 488 (血管周围区域定位)]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ 是目前最成熟的有机溶剂基全脑透明方案，对 ~12 mm × 8 mm × 6 mm 的完整小鼠脑组织具有优异的透明效果，可在 2–3 周内完成全流程。其甲醇脱水 + DBE 折射率匹配路线能将脑组织折射率均一化至 ~1.56，非常适合光片显微镜（LSFM）三维成像。关键优势如下：
1. **tdTomato/RFP 保留**：iDISCO+ 标准流程中 H₂O₂ 漂白步骤可省略（或缩短），tdTomato 在甲醇脱水后仍有一定保留，但为最大化保留，本方案采用改良版——在脱水前完成免疫标记（整体免疫染色），以抗 RFP 抗体（Alexa Fluor 568）信号增强内源 tdTomato，确保单细胞级别检测灵敏度。
2. **Pan-Cytokeratin** 是验证上皮来源转移癌细胞的金标准标志物，可识别单个散在细胞、微小转移灶和大转移结节，满足题目"上皮身份验证"要求，且不可被核染料或血管探针替代。
3. **CD31** 标记脑血管网络，用于分析转移灶与血管周围区域的空间关系，与 Pan-Cytokeratin 和 tdTomato 通道光谱分离良好（488/568/647 nm 三通道）。
4. iDISCO+ 整体免疫染色方案已有大量文献验证可穿透完整小鼠脑组织，抗体孵育时间充足可保证均一标记。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样本预处理与预洗**
1.1 将已 4% PFA 固定的完整小鼠脑组织（12 mm × 8 mm × 6 mm）置于 1× PBS 中充分漂洗，去除残余固定液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)
1.2 将组织转入含 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 的 1× PBS（PTx0.2）中振荡孵育，增强后续抗体渗透性。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**2 脱色（H₂O₂ 漂白，可选——用于降低脑组织自发荧光背景）**
2.1 配制 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ 于甲醇中（1 体积 30% H₂O₂ + 5 体积 100% MeOH），将组织置于该溶液中孵育以降低内源性过氧化物酶活性及自发荧光。**注意：tdTomato 对甲醇敏感，此步骤时间严格控制，不可延长。**(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 用 100% MeOH 漂洗 2 次，再用 PTx0.2 复水漂洗 3 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次 30 min)

**3 渗透性增强预处理**
3.1 将组织置于含 0.2% Triton X-100、20% DMSO、0.3 M 甘氨酸的 1× PBS（PTxD）中振荡孵育，进一步提高大分子抗体的组织渗透性。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 将组织转入含 0.2% Triton X-100、10% DMSO、6% 正常驴血清（NDS）的 1× PBS（封闭液）中振荡孵育，封闭非特异性结合位点。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**4 一抗孵育（整体免疫染色）**
4.1 配制一抗工作液：于含 0.2% Tween-20、10 μg/mL 肝素、5% DMSO、3% NDS 的 1× PBS（PTwH + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS）中加入以下一抗：
- 抗 RFP/tdTomato 兔多克隆抗体（1:500，用于信号增强内源 tdTomato）
- 抗 Pan-Cytokeratin 小鼠单克隆抗体（AE1/AE3 克隆，1:200）
- 抗 CD31（PECAM1）大鼠单克隆抗体（1:300）

将组织完全浸没于一抗工作液中，轻柔振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
4.2 用 PTwH（含 0.2% Tween-20、10 μg/mL 肝素的 1× PBS）漂洗，每次更换新鲜 PTwH，共 5 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次 1 hour，最后一次过夜 12 hours)

**5 二抗孵育**
5.1 配制二抗工作液：于 PTwH + 3% NDS 中加入以下二抗（均为驴来源，最小交叉吸附）：
- 驴抗兔 IgG-Alexa Fluor 568（1:500，标记 RFP/tdTomato 增强信号）
- 驴抗小鼠 IgG-Alexa Fluor 647（1:500，标记 Pan-Cytokeratin）
- 驴抗大鼠 IgG-Alexa Fluor 488（1:500，标记 CD31）

将组织完全浸没于二抗工作液中，避光轻柔振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
5.2 用 PTwH 漂洗，共 5 次，最后一次过夜，全程避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次 1 hour，最后一次过夜 12 hours)

**6 脱水（梯度甲醇）**
6.1 将组织置于 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液中振荡孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.2 将组织置于 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液中振荡孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.3 将组织置于 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液中振荡孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.4 将组织置于 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇水溶液中振荡孵育，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.5 将组织置于 100% 甲醇中振荡孵育，避光，共 2 次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次 1 hour)

**7 脱脂（二氯甲烷处理）**
7.1 将组织置于 66% (vol/vol) 二氯甲烷（DCM）/ 33% 甲醇混合液中振荡孵育，避光，实现脱脂。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
7.2 将组织转入 100% DCM 中振荡漂洗 2 次，充分去除甲醇及脂质，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 每次 15 min)

**8 折射率匹配（RI Matching）**
8.1 将脱脂后的组织转入 100% 苯甲酸苄酯/苯甲醇（DBE，Sigma 108014）中，不振荡，避光静置，直至组织完全透明（RI ≈ 1.56）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3–6 hours，至完全透明)
8.2 更换新鲜 DBE，将透明组织转入成像专用玻璃容器（如 5 mL 玻璃小瓶）中，避光保存备用。(Temperature: RT, Time: 至成像前，可保存数周)

**9 成像前处理**
9.1 将透明脑组织置于 DBE 填充的成像腔（agarose-free，玻璃底成像皿或定制光片显微镜样品槽）中，确保组织完全浸没于 DBE（RI = 1.56），与光片显微镜物镜（推荐使用 RI = 1.56 匹配的特种物镜，如 Miltenyi Biotec LSFM 配套物镜或 Olympus XLPLN10XSVMP2）的折射率一致。(Temperature: RT, Time: 平衡 30 min)
9.2 成像通道设置建议：
- **通道 1（主通道）**：激发 561 nm / 发射 580–620 nm，检测 tdTomato 内源信号及 Alexa Fluor 568 增强信号（转移癌细胞定位）
- **通道 2（上皮身份验证）**：激发 633/647 nm / 发射 660–720 nm，检测 Pan-Cytokeratin-Alexa Fluor 647（上皮来源确认）
- **通道 3（血管参考）**：激发 488 nm / 发射 505–545 nm，检测 CD31-Alexa Fluor 488（血管周围区域定位）

采集完整脑组织三维图像，Z 步距建议 2–5 μm（单细胞分辨率），用于后续三维重建及空间分布分析。(Temperature: RT, Time: 依成像范围而定，通常 4–12 hours/脑)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato/RFP (内源荧光), Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor (647), CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor (568), DAPI]

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for the following reasons: (1) 完整小鼠脑组织（12×8×6 mm）需要深层脂质去除，iDISCO+ 的甲醇梯度脱水 + 二氯甲烷（DCM）脱脂方案对厚实脑组织穿透力强，透明效果优异；(2) iDISCO+ 对 tdTomato/RFP 内源荧光具有良好保留能力（相比 CUBIC 等水性方法，有机溶剂体系在 DBE 折射率匹配后对红色荧光蛋白信号保留充分）；(3) iDISCO+ 的免疫标记步骤（甲醇预处理增强抗体渗透）适合对完整脑组织进行深层抗体标记，可实现 Pan-Cytokeratin（验证上皮性肿瘤细胞身份）和 CD31（标记血管，用于分析血管周围侵袭模式）的全脑深层染色；(4) DBE（苯甲酸苄酯/苯甲醇）折射率匹配介质（RI≈1.56）与光片显微镜成像高度兼容，适合全脑三维空间图谱构建；(5) 相比 CUBIC 或 ScaleS，iDISCO+ 总体流程时间更短，适合完整脑组织的高效处理。标记策略：tdTomato/RFP 内源信号定位转移癌细胞簇；Pan-Cytokeratin（Alexa Fluor 647）验证上皮性肿瘤细胞身份；CD31（Alexa Fluor 568）标记血管网络以分析血管周围侵袭；DAPI 标记细胞核以显示脑实质结构和转移灶边界。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 样本预处理与脱水（Pretreatment & Dehydration）
1.1 将已完成 4% PFA 固定及后固定的完整小鼠脑组织用 1× PBS 洗涤 3 次，每次 10 mL。（Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min/次，共 30 min）
1.2 用 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本，置于摇床上轻摇。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）
1.3 用 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）
1.4 用 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）
1.5 用 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）
1.6 用 100% 甲醇孵育样本，重复 2 次，每次更换新鲜甲醇。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour/次，共 2 次）

2 漂白（Bleaching，用于降低脑组织自发荧光背景）
2.1 配制漂白液：5% H₂O₂ 溶于 100% 甲醇（1 体积 30% H₂O₂ + 5 体积 100% 甲醇），新鲜配制，预冷至 4 ℃。将样本置于漂白液中孵育，避光。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours）
2.2 漂白后用 100% 甲醇洗涤样本 3 次，每次更换新鲜甲醇。（Temperature: RT, Time: 20 min/次，共 60 min）

3 脱脂（Delipidation）
3.1 将样本转入二氯甲烷（DCM，Sigma 270997）中孵育，轻摇，使脂质充分溶解。（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours）
3.2 更换新鲜 DCM，继续孵育。（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours）
3.3 将样本转入 100% 甲醇中洗涤 2 次，以去除残余 DCM。（Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min/次，共 30 min）

4 复水（Rehydration）
4.1 用 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）
4.2 用 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）
4.3 用 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）
4.4 用 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）
4.5 用 1× PBS 洗涤样本 2 次。（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min/次，共 1 hour）

5 封闭与渗透处理（Blocking & Permeabilization）
5.1 配制封闭/渗透液（PTwH-Donkey Block）：1× PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 10 μg/mL 肝素（heparin）+ 5% (vol/vol) 驴血清（donkey serum）+ 0.5% (wt/vol) Triton X-100。将样本置于封闭液中孵育，轻摇，4 ℃。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours）

6 一抗孵育（Primary Antibody Incubation）
6.1 配制一抗孵育液（PTwH 稀释液）：1× PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 10 μg/mL 肝素 + 5% (vol/vol) 驴血清。
加入以下一抗：
- 兔抗 Pan-Cytokeratin 抗体（验证上皮性肿瘤细胞身份），稀释比 1:200；
- 大鼠抗 CD31（PECAM1）抗体（标记血管），稀释比 1:200。
将样本置于一抗孵育液中，4 ℃ 轻摇孵育。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days）
6.2 用 PTwH 洗涤液（1× PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 μg/mL 肝素）洗涤样本，每天更换洗涤液，共洗涤 5 次。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour/次，共 5 hours；或 4 ℃ 过夜洗涤 2 次）

7 二抗孵育（Secondary Antibody Incubation）
7.1 配制二抗孵育液（PTwH 稀释液 + 5% 驴血清）。
加入以下二抗：
- 驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 647（对应 Pan-Cytokeratin 一抗），稀释比 1:400；
- 驴抗大鼠 Alexa Fluor 568（对应 CD31 一抗），稀释比 1:400。
将样本置于二抗孵育液中，4 ℃ 轻摇孵育，避光。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5 days）
7.2 用 PTwH 洗涤液洗涤样本 5 次，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour/次，共 5 hours）

8 DAPI 核染色（Nuclear Counterstaining）
8.1 将 DAPI 溶于 1× PBS，终浓度 5 μg/mL，将样本置于 DAPI 溶液中孵育，轻摇，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours）
8.2 用 1× PBS 洗涤样本 3 次，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min/次，共 90 min）

9 脱水（Second Dehydration，透明前处理）
9.1 用 20% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）
9.2 用 40% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）
9.3 用 60% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）
9.4 用 80% (vol/vol) 甲醇/ddH₂O 溶液孵育样本，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour）
9.5 用 100% 甲醇孵育样本 2 次，每次更换新鲜甲醇，避光。（Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour/次，共 2 hours）

10 DCM 脱脂透明（Final Delipidation & Clearing）
10.1 将样本转入 DCM 中孵育，轻摇，避光，使组织完全透明化。（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours）
10.2 更换新鲜 DCM，继续孵育至组织完全透明（组织沉入管底为透明完成标志）。（Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours）

11 折射率匹配（Refractive Index Matching，RI Matching）
11.1 将透明后的样本转入 100% DBE（苯甲酸苄酯/苯甲醇 = 2:1 vol/vol，RI ≈ 1.56；Sigma 108014）中孵育，不振摇，避光，直至样本完全透明且无气泡。（Temperature: RT, Time: 4–6 hours，或至样本完全透明）
11.2 更换新鲜 DBE，将样本转入成像专用玻璃容器（如玻璃毛细管或定制成像腔）中，确保样本完全浸没于 DBE 中，密封避光保存。（Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours，成像前平衡）

12 样本保存与成像前处理（Storage & Pre-imaging Preparation）
12.1 将样本密封于 DBE 中，避光，4 ℃ 短期保存（≤2 周）；如需长期保存，可置于 -20 ℃ 避光保存，成像前恢复至 RT 平衡 2 hours。（Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 最长 2 weeks）
12.2 成像前将样本置于与光片显微镜（如 LaVision BioTec Ultramicroscope II 或 Zeiss Lightsheet Z.1）兼容的 DBE 浸没物镜成像腔中，确认以下通道设置：
- 通道 1（tdTomato/RFP）：激发 561 nm，发射 580–620 nm（转移癌细胞定位）；
- 通道 2（Alexa Fluor 568/CD31）：激发 561 nm，发射 600–650 nm（血管网络）；
- 通道 3（Alexa Fluor 647/Pan-Cytokeratin）：激发 638 nm，发射 660–720 nm（上皮性肿瘤标志物验证）；
- 通道 4（DAPI）：激发 405 nm，发射 420–480 nm（细胞核/脑实质结构）。
（Temperature: RT, Time: 成像前平衡 30 min）

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS

**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato/RFP (内源荧光，保留), Pan-Cytokeratin + Alexa Fluor (二抗偶联), DAPI, NeuN + Alexa Fluor (脑实质参考), GFAP + Alexa Fluor (转移灶边界/反应性星形胶质细胞)]

**Justification:**
PEGASOS（Polyethylene Glycol-associated Solvent System）选择理由如下：
1. **荧光保留**：PEGASOS采用温和的PEG-400/叔丁醇梯度脱水体系，相比iDISCO+/uDISCO的甲醇/二苯醚体系，对tdTomato/RFP等红色荧光蛋白的淬灭显著更低，可在完整脑组织中保留内源荧光信号。
2. **低形变**：PEGASOS全程水性-有机溶剂梯度过渡，组织收缩均匀且可逆，完整脑组织（12×8×6 mm）形变率<15%，优于CUBIC的膨胀变形和iDISCO+的过度收缩。
3. **电泳去脂问题规避**：原方案80V/96h电泳导致组织结构破坏，PEGASOS采用被动化学去脂（叔丁醇梯度+PEG-400），完全避免电场损伤，适合完整脑组织。
4. **免疫标记兼容性**：PEGASOS透明化后组织抗原性保留良好，支持Pan-Cytokeratin（上皮性肿瘤标志物）、NeuN（神经元参考）、GFAP（反应性星形胶质细胞/转移灶边界）的免疫荧光标记。
5. **RI匹配**：最终BB-PEG溶液（RI≈1.52）与光片显微镜/共聚焦成像兼容，透明度高，适合深层三维成像。

标记策略说明：
- **tdTomato/RFP**：内源荧光，直接利用，无需额外标记
- **Pan-Cytokeratin**：验证上皮来源转移癌细胞身份（乳腺癌脑转移核心标志物）
- **GFAP**：标记反应性星形胶质细胞，勾勒转移灶边界及侵袭前沿的脑实质反应
- **NeuN**：标记神经元，提供脑实质三维参考框架，定位微小转移灶
- **DAPI**：核染色，提供全局细胞密度参考，辅助识别微小转移细胞群

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样本预处理与质量确认**

1.1 取出已完成4% PFA固定及后固定的完整小鼠脑组织，置于PBS中，4℃保存备用。确认样本尺寸约12×8×6 mm，检查组织完整性，去除多余软脑膜和血管残留。(Temperature: 4℃, Time: 30 min)

1.2 用0.1 M PBS（pH 7.4）充分漂洗组织，去除残余固定液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×10 min)

1.3 将组织转入含0.1% Triton X-100的PBS（PBST）中进行预渗透，轻摇。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 24 hours)

---

**2 脱色处理（Decolorization）——去除血红素背景**

2.1 配制脱色液：25% (vol/vol) N,N,N',N'-四甲基乙二胺（TEMED）+ 25% (vol/vol) 氨基醇（aminoalcohol，即PEGASOS脱色液B1）溶于ddH₂O，pH调至9.0。将组织置于脱色液中，37℃轻摇孵育，每24 h更换一次新鲜脱色液，直至组织变为淡黄色/无色。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 2×24 hours = 48 hours)

2.2 用0.1 M PBS漂洗脱色后组织。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min)

---

**3 免疫荧光标记（Immunolabeling）**

3.1 封闭与渗透：将组织置于封闭液（5% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清 + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) 叠氮化钠溶于PBS）中，4℃轻摇孵育。(Temperature: 4℃, Time: 48 hours)

3.2 一抗孵育：配制一抗混合液于封闭液中（稀释比例如下），4℃轻摇孵育：
- 抗Pan-Cytokeratin抗体（兔源多克隆，1:200，用于验证上皮来源转移癌细胞）
- 抗GFAP抗体（鸡源多克隆，1:300，用于标记反应性星形胶质细胞及转移灶边界）
- 抗NeuN抗体（小鼠源单克隆，1:200，用于神经元参考框架）
(Temperature: 4℃, Time: 5 days)

3.3 一抗漂洗：用含0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的PBS（PBST）漂洗，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5×1 hour)

3.4 二抗孵育：配制二抗混合液于封闭液中，避光，4℃轻摇孵育：
- 驴抗兔-Alexa Fluor 647（1:400，标记Pan-Cytokeratin，远红通道，与tdTomato/RFP通道分离）
- 驴抗鸡-Alexa Fluor 488（1:400，标记GFAP，绿色通道）
- 驴抗小鼠-Alexa Fluor 546（1:400，标记NeuN，橙色通道，注意与tdTomato/RFP光谱分离，可根据实际荧光团选择调整）
(Temperature: 4℃, Time: 3 days)

3.5 二抗漂洗：用PBST漂洗，去除未结合二抗，避光操作。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5×1 hour)

3.6 DAPI核染色：将组织置于含DAPI（5 μg/mL）的PBS中，避光孵育。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3.7 DAPI漂洗：用PBS漂洗去除多余DAPI。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3×30 min)

---

**4 PEGASOS透明化处理——梯度脱水（叔丁醇梯度）**

4.1 将标记完成的组织置于30% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇（tert-butanol，tB）水溶液中，轻摇。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 4 hours)

4.2 置于50% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中，轻摇。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 4 hours)

4.3 置于70% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中，轻摇。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 8 hours)

4.4 置于80% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中，轻摇。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 8 hours)

4.5 置于90% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中，轻摇。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 8 hours)

4.6 置于96% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇水溶液中，轻摇。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 8 hours)

4.7 置于100% 叔丁醇中，轻摇，更换一次新鲜100%叔丁醇。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 2×8 hours = 16 hours)

> **注意**：叔丁醇在室温下为固态（熔点25.7℃），所有叔丁醇步骤须在37℃水浴或烘箱中进行，防止凝固。避光操作保护荧光信号。

---

**5 PEGASOS透明化处理——PEG-400/叔丁醇去脂与透明化（BB-PEG）**

5.1 配制BB-PEG溶液：将PEG-400（聚乙二醇400）与叔丁醇按体积比75:25混合，加入0.4% (wt/vol) Quadrol（N,N,N',N'-四（2-羟丙基）乙二胺）调节pH至9.0，充分混匀，37℃预热备用。

5.2 将组织从100%叔丁醇直接转入预热的BB-PEG溶液中，37℃轻摇孵育，每24 h更换一次新鲜BB-PEG，直至组织完全透明（通常需2-3次更换）。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 3×24 hours = 72 hours)

5.3 观察透明化程度：组织应呈现高度透明，可透过组织清晰看到下方文字或网格线。若透明度不足，继续更换BB-PEG延长孵育。(Temperature: 37℃, Time: 视透明度而定，最长额外24 hours)

---

**6 折射率匹配（RI Matching）**

6.1 将透明化完成的组织转入纯BB-PEG溶液（RI ≈ 1.52，与脑组织固体成分RI匹配）中，避光静置平衡，直至组织RI均一（组织内无散射条纹）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6.2 用折射率计确认BB-PEG溶液RI值在1.51–1.52范围内，必要时通过调整PEG-400/叔丁醇比例微调RI。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

---

**7 成像前处理与样本保存**

7.1 将RI匹配完成的透明脑组织转入成像专用样本池（imaging chamber），注入BB-PEG溶液作为成像介质，确保组织完全浸没，避免气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

7.2 用低熔点琼脂糖（1% (wt/vol)，溶于BB-PEG）或专用样本固定夹将组织固定于成像位置，防止漂移，保持背侧面朝上以利于转移灶定位。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

7.3 成像参数建议：
- 光片显微镜（LSFM）或双光子共聚焦显微镜
- 激发/发射通道：DAPI（405/450 nm）、Alexa Fluor 488-GFAP（488/520 nm）、tdTomato/RFP（561/590 nm）、Alexa Fluor 546-NeuN（561/570 nm，需与tdTomato光谱分离，建议改用Alexa Fluor 594或调整至546通道）、Alexa Fluor 647-Pan-Cytokeratin（647/680 nm）
- 物镜：长工作距离水浸或溶剂兼容物镜（如Olympus XLPLN10XSVMP，WD=8 mm，RI=1.52兼容）
- Z步距：2–5 μm（全脑扫描），0.5–1 μm（转移灶局部高分辨）

7.4 短期保存：透明样本可在BB-PEG溶液中4℃避光保存，有效期约2–4周，荧光信号稳定。(Temperature: 4℃, Time: 最长4 weeks)

7.5 长期保存：若需长期保存，将样本转入含0.02% (wt/vol) 叠氮化钠的BB-PEG溶液中，4℃避光密封保存。(Temperature: 4℃, Time: 最长3 months)
