**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1) + Alexa Fluor 647, Podocin (NPHS2) + Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it provides excellent antibody penetration through organic solvent-based delipidation (methanol/DCM/DBE), which is critical for labeling dense glomerular structures in a 500 μm kidney cortex slice. The methanol dehydration/rehydration cycle permeabilizes membranes effectively, enabling deep penetration of primary antibodies against Nephrin (NPHS1) — the key slit diaphragm transmembrane protein of the glomerular filtration barrier — and Podocin (NPHS2) — the scaffolding protein anchoring Nephrin at the slit diaphragm. Together, these two markers define the structural integrity of the podocyte slit diaphragm and the filtration barrier. Alexa Fluor dyes (647 and 555) are highly photostable, spectrally well-separated, and compatible with iDISCO+ organic solvent clearing. DAPI is added post-clearing in the rehydration step for nuclear counterstaining to provide morphological context. The final RI matching medium DBE (n ≈ 1.56) is optimal for light-sheet or confocal imaging of the cleared 500 μm slab with high SNR.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Fixation (Pre-clearing)**
1.1 Immerse freshly dissected 500 μm mouse kidney cortex slice in 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 4 hours)
1.2 Wash tissue 3× with 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4), 10 min per wash with gentle agitation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min total)

**2 Dehydration (Methanol Series)**
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 Bleaching**
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH) to reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

**4 Rehydration (Methanol Series)**
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.6 Repeat wash with fresh 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**5 Permeabilization and Blocking**
5.1 Incubation with permeabilization buffer: 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
5.2 Incubation with blocking buffer: 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) in 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**6 Primary Antibody Labeling**
6.1 Prepare primary antibody solution in PTwH buffer (0.2% Tween-20, 0.1% heparin sodium salt in 0.1 M PBS) + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (vol/vol) NDS:
- Anti-Nephrin (NPHS1) rabbit polyclonal antibody at 1:200 dilution
- Anti-Podocin (NPHS2) guinea pig polyclonal antibody at 1:200 dilution
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, with gentle shaking)
6.2 Wash tissue 5× with PTwH buffer (0.2% Tween-20, 0.1% heparin in PBS), 1 hour per wash with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours total)

**7 Secondary Antibody Labeling**
7.1 Prepare secondary antibody solution in PTwH buffer + 3% (vol/vol) NDS:
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 at 1:400 dilution (for Nephrin/NPHS1 detection)
- Donkey anti-guinea pig IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 555 at 1:400 dilution (for Podocin/NPHS2 detection)
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, with gentle shaking, protected from light)
7.2 Wash tissue 5× with PTwH buffer, 1 hour per wash with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours total)

**8 Nuclear Counterstaining (DAPI)**
8.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 μg/mL) in 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4) with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
8.2 Wash tissue 3× with 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4), 20 min per wash, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour total)

**9 Dehydration (Pre-clearing, Methanol Series)**
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous) with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol (anhydrous), protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**10 Delipidation**
10.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 67% (vol/vol) methanol (vol/vol) with gentle shaking in a sealed glass vial, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (anhydrous) to complete delipidation, with gentle shaking in a sealed glass vial, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min, 2× changes)

**11 Refractive Index Matching**
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014; RI ≈ 1.56) without shaking in a sealed glass vial, protected from light. Tissue should sink and become fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** SWITCH

**Chosen Labeling:** [NeuN (RBFOX3) + Alexa Fluor (secondary, e.g., Alexa Fluor 488), MAP2 + Alexa Fluor (secondary, e.g., Alexa Fluor 647), DAPI]

**Justification:**
- **SWITCH** is selected because it was specifically designed for dense, fixed human clinical tissue blocks. Its SDS-based active clearing combined with a glutaraldehyde-reinforced protein mesh ensures structural preservation and uniform antibody penetration throughout thick (≥2 mm) human brain specimens — critical for a 2×2×2 mm³ cortical block imaged at ~2 mm depth. SWITCH's "OFF/ON" buffer cycling enables homogeneous labeling even in densely packed human cortex, overcoming the diffusion barrier that defeats standard IHC or simpler clearing methods.
- **NeuN (RBFOX3)** is a gold-standard nuclear/perinuclear marker for mature neurons, providing robust somatic labeling in human cortex. **MAP2** labels the somatodendritic compartment of mature neurons, complementing NeuN and providing cytoplasmic/somatic context. Together they fulfill the requirement for two mature neuron-associated nuclear/somatic proteins in dense clinical tissue.
- **DAPI** is included for nuclear counterstaining to aid cytoarchitectural orientation and confirm tissue morphology preservation.
- **Alexa Fluor** dyes (488 and 647) are chosen as secondaries because they are highly photostable, bright, and compatible with light-sheet microscopy; their spectral separation (green/far-red) minimizes cross-talk.
- SWITCH's aqueous, non-organic workflow preserves tissue morphology far better than solvent-based methods (iDISCO+, uDISCO), which is explicitly required for clinical tissue morphology retention.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Post-fixation Reinforcement (SWITCH-OFF Crosslinking)**
1.1 Wash fixed tissue (assumed 4% PFA-fixed) in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 10 minutes)
1.2 Incubate tissue in SWITCH-OFF buffer: 0.1 M glycine + 4% acrylamide (wt/vol) in 1× PBS, pH 3.0, to suppress endogenous reactive sites. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.3 Transfer tissue to SWITCH-ON buffer: 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) + 0.1% glutaraldehyde (GA) in 1× PBS, pH 7.4, to re-crosslink and reinforce the protein mesh. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.4 Wash in 1× PBS to remove excess fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 20 minutes)

**2 Active Delipidation / Clearing (SWITCH Clearing)**
2.1 Incubate tissue in clearing buffer: 200 mM SDS + 50 mM sodium borate, pH 9.0, with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 70 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Replace with fresh clearing buffer (200 mM SDS + 50 mM sodium borate, pH 9.0) and continue incubation. (Temperature: 70 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Visually inspect tissue for translucency; if not sufficiently clear, repeat step 2.2 once. (Temperature: 70 ℃, Time: up to 24 hours additional)
2.4 Wash tissue thoroughly in 1× PBST (1× PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100) to remove residual SDS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)
2.5 Final wash in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 minutes)

**3 Immunolabeling — SWITCH-OFF Antibody Incubation**
3.1 Incubate tissue in SWITCH-OFF labeling buffer (0.1 M glycine + 0.1% Triton X-100 + 5% normal donkey serum (NDS) in 1× PBS, pH 3.0) to suppress non-specific binding and slow antibody–antigen kinetics for uniform penetration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
3.2 Add primary antibodies in SWITCH-OFF labeling buffer:
- Anti-NeuN (RBFOX3) rabbit monoclonal, 1:200 dilution
- Anti-MAP2 mouse monoclonal, 1:200 dilution
Incubate with gentle rocking to allow deep, uniform diffusion throughout the 2 mm block. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

**4 Immunolabeling — SWITCH-ON Antibody Binding**
4.1 Transfer tissue to SWITCH-ON labeling buffer (1× PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 + 5% NDS, pH 7.4) to restore physiological pH and activate antibody–antigen binding. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Wash in 1× PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS) to remove unbound primary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

**5 Secondary Antibody Labeling**
5.1 Incubate tissue in SWITCH-OFF labeling buffer (pH 3.0) containing secondary antibodies:
- Donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488, 1:300 dilution (for NeuN)
- Donkey anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 647, 1:300 dilution (for MAP2)
Incubate with gentle rocking for uniform penetration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
5.2 Transfer to SWITCH-ON labeling buffer (pH 7.4) to activate secondary antibody binding. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
5.3 Wash in 1× PBST to remove unbound secondary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

**6 Nuclear Counterstaining (DAPI)**
6.1 Incubate tissue in DAPI solution (5 µg/mL DAPI in 1× PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
6.2 Wash in 1× PBS to remove excess DAPI. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 minutes)

**7 Refractive Index (RI) Matching**
7.1 Incubate tissue in 30% (wt/vol) Histodenz (iodixanol) in 1× PBS (RI ≈ 1.44) as initial RI equilibration step. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
7.2 Transfer tissue to 50% (wt/vol) Histodenz in 1× PBS (RI ≈ 1.46) for intermediate equilibration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
7.3 Transfer tissue to 63% (wt/vol) Histodenz in 1× PBS (RI ≈ 1.48) as final RI matching solution, compatible with light-sheet microscopy objectives (RI ≈ 1.45–1.52). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
7.4 Confirm tissue is optically transparent and measure RI of final solution with a refractometer before imaging.

**8 Storage and Pre-imaging Preparation**
8.1 Store cleared, RI-matched tissue in 63% Histodenz in 1× PBS in a sealed container protected from light. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: up to 2 weeks)
8.2 Prior to imaging, mount tissue in a custom imaging chamber or FEP tube filled with 63% Histodenz solution, ensuring no air bubbles are introduced. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
8.3 Allow tissue to thermally equilibrate to the microscope stage temperature before initiating light-sheet acquisition. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) it achieves excellent whole-mount immunolabeling penetration in a 2 mm cardiac tissue block via methanol-based delipidation and detergent permeabilization, enabling deep antibody penetration; (2) it preserves Alexa Fluor dye signals robustly through organic solvent clearing steps; (3) the final DBE (dibenzyl ether) RI-matching medium (RI ≈ 1.56) is ideal for light-sheet microscopy of cardiac tissue. DAPI provides nuclear counterstaining for cytoarchitectural context. The four Alexa Fluor channels (488/546/647/750) are spectrally well-separated for simultaneous light-sheet or confocal acquisition.

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Tissue Fixation and Pre-treatment**
1.1 Immersion-fix freshly dissected mouse cardiac apex tissue (~2 mm thick) in 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Wash tissue 3× with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
1.3 Transfer tissue to fresh 1× PBS and store until proceeding. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: up to 24 hours)

**2 Dehydration (Methanol Series)**
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 Bleaching**
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ : 5 volumes MeOH) to reduce autofluorescence from cardiac tissue. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

**4 Rehydration**
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**5 Permeabilization and Blocking**
5.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution: 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in 1× PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
5.2 Incubation with blocking solution: 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) in 1× PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

6.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in PTwH buffer (0.2% Tween-20, 0.1% heparin sodium salt in 1× PBS) supplemented with 5% (vol/vol) NDS and 3% (vol/vol) DMSO:

- Anti-SM22α (goat polyclonal, e.g., Abcam ab10135): 1:200 dilution
- Anti-CD31/PECAM-1 (rat monoclonal, e.g., BD Biosciences 550274): 1:200 dilution
- Anti-Collagen IV (chicken polyclonal, e.g., Abcam ab181607): 1:200 dilution
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours, with gentle rocking)
6.2 Wash tissue 5× with PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

**7 Secondary Antibody Labeling**
7.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in PTwH buffer supplemented with 3% (vol/vol) NDS:
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG Alexa Fluor 546: 1:500 dilution (labels α-SMA)
- Donkey anti-goat IgG Alexa Fluor 647: 1:500 dilution (labels SM22α)
- Donkey anti-rat IgG Alexa Fluor 488: 1:500 dilution (labels CD31)
- Donkey anti-chicken IgG Alexa Fluor 750: 1:500 dilution (labels Collagen IV)
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, with gentle rocking, protected from light)
7.2 Wash tissue 5× with PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

**8 Nuclear Counterstaining**
8.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)
8.2 Wash tissue 3× with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes per wash)

9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in ddH₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**10 Delipidation**
10.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, 2× changes)
10.3 Note: Ensure complete DCM removal by observing tissue sinking to bottom of vial before proceeding.

11.1 Transfer tissue to 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014, RI ≈ 1.559) in a glass vial. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, protected from light, without shaking)
11.2 Replace with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE and incubate until tissue is fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)

12.1 Store cleared tissue in 100% DBE in sealed glass vials. (Temperature: RT, protected from light, Time: up to 4 weeks)
12.2 Mount tissue in a custom imaging chamber or FEP tube filled with 100% DBE for light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM); alternatively, mount between two coverslips with DBE spacer for confocal imaging.
12.3 Acquire images using the following channel assignments: 405 nm excitation → DAPI (nuclei); 488 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 488 (CD31, vasculature); 546 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 546 (α-SMA, SMC/myofibroblasts); 647 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 647 (SM22α, vSMC discrimination); 750 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 750 (Collagen IV, ECM remodeling). (Temperature: RT)

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) It employs organic solvent-based delipidation (methanol/DCM/DBE) that efficiently clears even dense connective-tissue-rich lung parenchyma at 1.5 mm thickness within a manageable timeframe; (2) It is highly compatible with whole-mount immunolabeling, enabling deep antibody penetration into a 1.5 mm block; (3) The final RI-matching medium DBE (RI ≈ 1.56) provides excellent transparency for light-sheet or confocal imaging of alveolar architecture. For the dual vascular targets: **CD31 (PECAM-1) immunolabeling** marks all endothelial cells (total vascular network), while **intravascular perfusion with FITC-conjugated Lectin** (performed in vivo or ex vivo before fixation) specifically labels the luminal surface of perfused/patent vessels — together providing the requested dual-target vascular readout. **DAPI** is added post-clearing as a nuclear/alveolar structural reference channel. iDISCO+ is well-validated for lung tissue and preserves Alexa Fluor dyes robustly through the organic solvent pipeline.

**0 Pre-fixation Intravascular Lectin Perfusion (in vivo, before tissue harvest)**
0.1 Prepare FITC-conjugated Lectin (e.g., *Lycopersicon esculentum* Lectin-FITC, Vector Labs FL-1171) at 0.1 mg/mL in sterile PBS. (Temperature: RT)
0.2 Anesthetize mouse and inject 100–150 µL FITC-Lectin solution retro-orbitally or via tail vein; allow circulation for 3–5 min. (Temperature: 37 °C body temp, Time: 5 min)
0.3 Transcardially perfuse with ice-cold PBS (10 mL) to flush non-bound lectin, followed by ice-cold 4% PFA in PBS (20 mL). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: ~5 min perfusion)
0.4 Dissect lung; cut a 1.5 mm coronal slab using a vibratome or razor blade guide. (Temperature: 4 °C)

**1 Post-fixation**
1.1 Immerse tissue slab in 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 4 hours)
1.2 Wash 3× with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min each wash)

**2 Pretreatment / Permeabilization**

2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.8 Rehydration: 60% methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.9 Rehydration: 40% methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**3 Primary Antibody Immunolabeling (CD31)**
3.1 Prepare primary antibody solution: anti-CD31 (PECAM-1) rabbit monoclonal antibody (e.g., Abcam ab182981) at 1:200 dilution in PTwH buffer (PBS / 0.2% Tween-20 / 0.1% heparin) supplemented with 5% NDS and 3% DMSO. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 48 hours, with gentle rocking)
3.2 Wash with PTwH buffer, 5× exchanges. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each wash)

5.1 Incubation with DAPI at 1 µg/mL in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)

6.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.5 Incubation with 100% methanol, first exchange. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.6 Incubation with 100% methanol, second exchange. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**7 Delipidation**
7.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) / 67% methanol (DCM:MeOH = 1:2). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, in fume hood)
7.2 Incubation with 100% DCM, first exchange. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)
7.3 Incubation with 100% DCM, second exchange. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)

8.1 Incubation with 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma-Aldrich 108014; RI ≈ 1.56), first exchange. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)
8.2 Incubation with fresh 100% DBE, second exchange until tissue is fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4–12 hours, protected from light)

**9 Storage / Pre-imaging Preparation**
9.1 Transfer cleared tissue slab into a glass-bottom imaging chamber or custom mount filled with fresh DBE. Seal with optical adhesive or Parafilm to prevent evaporation. (Temperature: RT, protected from light)
9.2 Equilibrate mounted sample before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
9.3 Image using light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) or confocal microscopy with the following channel assignments:
- **Channel 1 (488 nm excitation / 525 nm emission):** FITC-Lectin → perfused vascular lumens
- **Channel 2 (633/647 nm excitation / 668 nm emission):** Alexa Fluor 647 (anti-CD31) → total endothelium / vascular network
- **Channel 3 (405 nm excitation / 460 nm emission):** DAPI → nuclei / alveolar structural reference

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** Ce3D

**Chosen Labeling:** [B220 (PTPRC) + Alexa Fluor (e.g., anti-B220-Alexa Fluor 488), CD19 + Alexa Fluor (e.g., anti-CD19-Alexa Fluor 647), Ki67 (MKI67) + Alexa Fluor (e.g., anti-Ki67-Alexa Fluor 568), DAPI]

**Justification:** Ce3D (Clearing-Enhanced 3D) is an aqueous-based, detergent-free clearing method specifically optimized for immune tissues including lymph nodes and spleen. It preserves epitope integrity and is fully compatible with standard immunofluorescence antibody labeling, making it ideal for multi-channel 3D immunostaining of a 3 mm mouse lymph node. Ce3D uses N-methylacetamide and Histodenz to achieve high RI matching (~1.49) without organic solvents, thereby preserving fluorophore signals from Alexa Fluor dyes. For the dual B-cell marker strategy: **B220 (PTPRC)** is a pan-B-cell marker that delineates the overall B-cell follicle boundary, while **CD19** marks mature B cells and highlights follicular mantle zones; together they robustly outline lymphoid follicle architecture. **Ki67** marks proliferating cells in germinal centers (GCs), enabling identification of GC structures. **DAPI** provides nuclear counterstaining for overall tissue architecture. This combination allows simultaneous visualization of T/B cell zones and GC structures in a single 3 mm lymph node under light-sheet microscopy.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Tissue Fixation**

1.1 Perfuse mouse transcardially with ice-cold PBS (pH 7.4), then dissect the inguinal or mesenteric lymph node (~3 mm diameter) and immerse immediately in 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12–16 hours)

1.2 Wash tissue 3× with PBS (pH 7.4), 10 min each wash with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min total)

**2 Permeabilization and Blocking**

2.1 Incubate tissue in permeabilization/blocking buffer: PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS), and 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**3 Primary Antibody Labeling**

3.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in antibody incubation buffer (PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% NDS + 0.1% sodium azide):
- Anti-B220 (anti-CD45R/B220) unconjugated or directly conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488: 1:200 dilution
- Anti-CD19 unconjugated or directly conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647: 1:200 dilution
- Anti-Ki67 (MKI67) unconjugated or directly conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568: 1:300 dilution

3.2 Incubate tissue in primary antibody cocktail with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

3.3 Wash tissue 5× with PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 (PTwH), 1 hour each wash with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours total)

**4 Secondary Antibody Labeling (if unconjugated primaries are used)**

4.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in antibody incubation buffer (PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% NDS):
- Donkey anti-rat IgG–Alexa Fluor 488 (for B220): 1:500 dilution
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG–Alexa Fluor 647 (for CD19): 1:500 dilution
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG–Alexa Fluor 568 (for Ki67, if different host): 1:500 dilution
(Adjust host species according to primary antibody sources to avoid cross-reactivity.)

4.2 Incubate tissue in secondary antibody cocktail protected from light with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4.3 Wash tissue 5× with PTwH (PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100), 1 hour each wash, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours total)

**5 Nuclear Counterstaining with DAPI**

5.1 Incubate tissue in DAPI solution (5 µg/mL in PBS) with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

5.2 Wash tissue 3× with PBS, 30 min each wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 90 min total)

**6 Ce3D Optical Clearing**

6.1 Prepare Ce3D clearing solution: dissolve Histodenz (Sigma D2158) to 86% (wt/vol) in PBS, then add N-methylacetamide (NMA) to 40% (vol/vol), and add 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20; adjust to final RI = 1.49 (verify with refractometer). Prepare fresh and store at RT protected from light.

6.2 Transfer labeled lymph node into 500 µL Ce3D clearing solution in a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours) — initial equilibration step.

6.3 Replace with fresh Ce3D clearing solution (500 µL) and continue incubation with gentle rocking until tissue becomes fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24–48 hours)

Note: For a 3 mm lymph node, full clearing is typically achieved within 24–36 hours. Monitor visually; tissue should appear optically transparent.

**7 Refractive Index (RI) Matching**

7.1 Verify RI of the Ce3D solution using a hand-held refractometer; target RI = 1.490 ± 0.002 at RT. Adjust Histodenz concentration if necessary.

7.2 Transfer cleared lymph node into fresh Ce3D solution (final RI-matched imaging medium) in an imaging chamber or glass-bottom dish. Allow tissue to equilibrate. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1–2 hours)

**8 Sample Mounting and Imaging Preparation**

8.1 Mount the cleared lymph node in a custom imaging chamber (e.g., a silicone gasket on a #1.5 coverslip) filled with Ce3D solution. Gently position the tissue to minimize movement; seal with a coverslip and clear nail varnish or vacuum grease around the edges.

8.2 Allow the mounted sample to settle and fully equilibrate in Ce3D imaging medium before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

8.3 Image on a light-sheet fluorescence microscope (LSFM) using objectives compatible with RI ~1.49 (e.g., a cleared-tissue dipping objective or a water-dipping objective with RI correction collar). Recommended channels:
- DAPI: 405 nm excitation / 420–470 nm emission (nuclear architecture)
- Alexa Fluor 488 (B220): 488 nm excitation / 505–540 nm emission (pan-B-cell follicle boundary)
- Alexa Fluor 568 (Ki67): 561 nm excitation / 580–620 nm emission (germinal center proliferating cells)
- Alexa Fluor 647 (CD19): 638 nm excitation / 660–720 nm emission (mature B-cell follicle/mantle zone)

**9 Sample Storage**

9.1 Store cleared, mounted samples in Ce3D solution in sealed imaging chambers protected from light at 4 ℃ for short-term storage (up to 2 weeks). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: up to 14 days)

9.2 For longer-term storage, transfer tissue to fresh Ce3D solution in a sealed amber vial. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: up to 4 weeks; monitor for any loss of fluorescence signal before re-imaging)

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样品预处理（Post-fixation wash）**
1.1 将已4% PFA固定的成年小鼠全脑置于1× PBS中充分漂洗，去除残余固定液。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

**2 全脑免疫染色前渗透处理**
2.1 将脑组织置于含0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100的1× PBS（PBST）中振荡渗透。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 更换新鲜PBST继续渗透。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**3 封闭**
3.1 将脑组织置于封闭液（5% (vol/vol) 正常驴血清 + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) NaN₃ in 1× PBS）中振荡封闭。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**4 一抗孵育（β-III Tubulin / TUJ1）**
4.1 将脑组织置于含抗β-III Tubulin（TUJ1）兔多克隆抗体（1:500稀释于封闭液）的溶液中，轻柔振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
4.2 用PBST洗涤，去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

**5 二抗孵育（Alexa Fluor 647）**
5.1 将脑组织置于含驴抗兔 Alexa Fluor 647二抗（1:500稀释于封闭液）的溶液中，避光振荡孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
5.2 用PBST洗涤，去除未结合二抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)
5.3 用1× PBS终洗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

**6 脱水（THF梯度脱水）**
6.1 将脑组织置于50% (vol/vol) THF（四氢呋喃）水溶液（用NaOH调pH至9–10，以保护荧光蛋白）中振荡脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
6.2 将脑组织置于70% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（pH 9–10）中振荡脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
6.3 将脑组织置于80% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（pH 9–10）中振荡脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
6.4 将脑组织置于100% THF（无水，pH 9–10，加少量NaOH）中振荡脱水，第一次。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
6.5 将脑组织置于100% THF（无水，pH 9–10）中振荡脱水，第二次（更换新鲜THF）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

**7 脱脂（BABB预处理）**
7.1 将脑组织置于BABB（苯甲醇:苯甲酸苄酯 = 1:2, vol/vol）中振荡，完成脱脂并开始RI匹配，直至组织完全透明（通常30–60 min）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

**8 折射率匹配（RI Matching）**
8.1 将透明脑组织转移至新鲜BABB（RI ≈ 1.56）中，避光静置平衡，确保组织完全透明且无气泡。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
8.2 再次更换新鲜BABB，确认组织完全透明，准备成像。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 30 min)

**9 成像前处理与保存**
9.1 将透明脑组织转移至适配光片显微镜样品槽的BABB中，使用折射率匹配的浸没介质（RI = 1.56）固定样品位置，避免气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 即刻成像)
9.2 若需短期保存，将样品密封于BABB中，避光、4 ℃保存（建议1周内完成成像，以防荧光信号衰减）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ≤ 7 days)

**Justification:**
PEGASOS（Polyethylene Glycol-associated Solvent System）采用叔丁醇（tBA）梯度脱水结合PEG-DA/BB-PEG透明体系，对整肝等大体积实质器官透明效果优异，且在有机溶剂体系中对化学交联荧光信号（Alexa Fluor系列）保留良好，折射率可精确匹配至1.52，适合光片显微镜长工作距离成像。对形变不敏感（tBA脱水收缩均匀，结构拓扑保真）。

双靶点肝血窦内皮策略：**Stabilin-2**（HARE，肝血窦内皮特异性清道夫受体，高度特异标记肝血窦内皮细胞）与**LYVE-1**（透明质酸受体，肝血窦内皮特异性淋巴/窦内皮标志物）联合使用，可特异性覆盖肝血窦网络，避免CD31等通用标志物对肝血窦信号的低灵敏度问题。灌注Lectin-Alexa Fluor标记开放血管腔（门静脉、肝静脉及血窦），三通道联合实现全肝血管网拓扑完整重建。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**0 动物灌注与组织固定（成像前处理）**

0.1 麻醉小鼠后经左心室灌注预冷PBS（含50 U/mL肝素）至肝脏完全褪色，流速约5 mL/min。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3–5 min)

0.2 立即经心脏灌注Lectin-Alexa Fluor 647（1 mg/mL in PBS，200 µL total），使其充盈全肝血管腔，随后再灌注PBS 5 mL冲洗游离Lectin。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 min)

0.3 灌注4% PFA（in 0.1 M PBS，pH 7.4）固定，流速约3 mL/min，至肝脏变硬。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 min perfusion)

0.4 取出整肝，置于4% PFA中浸泡后固定。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

0.5 用PBS充分漂洗固定后肝脏，3次换液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

---

**1 脱色（Depigmentation，可选，小鼠肝脏含血红素，建议执行）**

1.1 将肝脏置于25% (vol/vol) 叔丁醇（tBA）水溶液中浸泡，轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

1.2 换用含3% H₂O₂的25% tBA水溶液脱色。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

1.3 用25% tBA水溶液漂洗2次。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 2 hours)

---

**2 脱水（Dehydration，tBA梯度）**

2.1 浸泡于30% (vol/vol) tBA水溶液（含0.1% Quadrol调pH至9.0）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2.2 浸泡于50% (vol/vol) tBA水溶液（含0.1% Quadrol）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2.3 浸泡于70% (vol/vol) tBA水溶液（含0.1% Quadrol）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2.4 浸泡于80% (vol/vol) tBA水溶液（含0.1% Quadrol）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2.5 浸泡于90% (vol/vol) tBA水溶液（含0.1% Quadrol）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2.6 浸泡于96% (vol/vol) tBA水溶液（含0.1% Quadrol）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2.7 浸泡于100% tBA（无水，含0.1% Quadrol），换液2次。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 × 12 hours)

---

**3 脱脂透明（Delipidation & Clearing，PEGASOS透明液）**

3.1 配制PEGASOS透明液：将PEG-DA（平均分子量250）与苯甲醇（BB）按3:1 (vol/vol) 混合，加入0.1% Quadrol，充分混匀，RI ≈ 1.52。

3.2 将脱水后肝脏转入PEGASOS透明液，轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

3.3 换新鲜PEGASOS透明液继续浸泡至肝脏完全透明（通常整肝需2–3次换液）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24–48 hours per exchange，共48–72 hours)

---

**4 免疫荧光标记（透明后抗体标记，整器官免疫染色）**

> 注：PEGASOS体系中抗体标记在透明前（步骤2之前）或透明后均可执行；对于整肝大体积样本，推荐在**脱水前（固定后PBS漂洗完成后）**进行免疫染色，以保证抗体渗透效率。以下步骤插入于步骤0.5之后、步骤1之前执行。

4.1 封闭：将肝脏置于封闭液（PBS含5% 正常驴血清、0.5% Triton X-100、0.1% Tween-20、0.1% Heparin）中孵育。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)

4.2 一抗孵育：加入抗**Stabilin-2**抗体（兔多克隆，1:200 in PTwH+5%驴血清）与抗**LYVE-1**抗体（大鼠单克隆，1:200 in PTwH+5%驴血清）混合液，轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)

4.3 PTwH漂洗（PBS含0.2% Tween-20、0.1% Heparin），每次1 h，共5次换液。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

4.4 二抗孵育：加入驴抗兔-Alexa Fluor 555（1:400，标记Stabilin-2）与驴抗大鼠-Alexa Fluor 488（1:400，标记LYVE-1）混合液（in PTwH+5%驴血清），避光轻摇。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5–7 days)

4.5 PTwH漂洗，每次1 h，共5次换液，避光。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

4.6 PBS漂洗2次，准备进入脱水步骤。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

---

**5 折射率匹配（RI Matching）**

5.1 透明完成后，将样本转入纯PEGASOS透明液（RI = 1.52）中平衡，确保RI均一。(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5.2 用折射率计确认样本周围液体RI = 1.52 ± 0.005，必要时补加PEGASOS液调整。(Temperature: RT, Time: 检测即时)

---

**6 保存与成像前处理**

6.1 将RI匹配后的透明肝脏转入新鲜PEGASOS透明液中，避光密封保存，可在成像前短期保存。(Temperature: RT, Time: 最长2 weeks)

6.2 成像前将样本置于与光片显微镜样品槽匹配的折射率浸没液（PEGASOS液或等RI苯甲醇/PEG-DA混合液，RI = 1.52）中，使用RI = 1.52专用物镜（如LaVision BioTec MI PLAN 2×/0.5 NA或Olympus XLPLN10XSVMP）进行光片成像。(Temperature: RT, Time: 成像前平衡30 min)

6.3 成像通道建议：CH1 = Alexa Fluor 488（LYVE-1，肝血窦内皮）；CH2 = Alexa Fluor 555（Stabilin-2，肝血窦内皮）；CH3 = Alexa Fluor 647（Lectin灌注，全血管腔包括门静脉/肝静脉/血窦）。三通道联合重建全肝血管网拓扑。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1) + Alexa Fluor 647, Podocin (NPHS2) + Alexa Fluor 568, Lectin + Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) it achieves excellent whole-organ clearing of a 3–4 mm mouse kidney via organic solvent-based delipidation (DCM/DBE), enabling deep antibody penetration and high transparency; (2) the methanol pretreatment and detergent-based immunolabeling protocol supports robust antibody penetration into dense renal parenchyma; (3) it is fully compatible with light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM). For the dual slit-diaphragm targets, **Nephrin (NPHS1)** and **Podocin (NPHS2)** are the two canonical proteins of the glomerular filtration barrier slit diaphragm — their co-labeling directly addresses the stated scientific goal of evaluating glomerular filtration barrier integrity. **Lectin (Alexa Fluor 488)** serves as the vascular reference channel (perfusion-compatible or post-fixation luminal labeling of endothelium), and **DAPI** provides nuclear reference. The four channels (488/568/647/DAPI) are spectrally well-separated for simultaneous light-sheet acquisition.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Sample Preparation and Pre-fixation**
1.1 Transcardially perfuse the mouse with ice-cold PBS (pH 7.4, ~20 mL) followed by 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS (~20 mL) to fix the tissue in situ. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ~5 min perfusion)
1.2 Dissect the whole kidney and immerse in 4% PFA/PBS in a 15 mL tube. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.3 Wash kidney 3× with PBS (1× PBS, pH 7.4). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

**2 Pretreatment / Methanol Dehydration (Antigen Retrieval & Permeabilization)**
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O (ddH₂O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with 100% methanol (anhydrous), second change. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.7 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 vol 30% H₂O₂ : 5 vol MeOH) to quench endogenous peroxidase and improve antibody penetration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

**3 Rehydration**
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Incubation with PBS (1×, pH 7.4). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.6 Incubation with PBS (1×, pH 7.4), second wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**4 Permeabilization and Blocking**
4.1 Incubation with Permeabilization Solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS] with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Incubation with Blocking Solution [0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) in PBS] with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**5 Primary Antibody Immunolabeling**
5.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in PTwH buffer [0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 0.1% (wt/vol) heparin in PBS] supplemented with 5% (vol/vol) NDS and 3% (vol/vol) DMSO:
- Anti-Nephrin (NPHS1) rabbit polyclonal antibody, 1:200 dilution
- Anti-Podocin (NPHS2) guinea pig polyclonal antibody, 1:200 dilution
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle shaking on orbital shaker)
5.2 Wash kidney 5× with PTwH buffer (0.2% Tween-20, 0.1% heparin in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

**6 Secondary Antibody Immunolabeling**
6.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in PTwH + 3% NDS:
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647, 1:400 dilution (for Nephrin/NPHS1)
- Donkey anti-guinea pig IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568, 1:400 dilution (for Podocin/NPHS2)
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, with gentle shaking, protected from light)
6.2 Wash kidney 5× with PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

**7 Vascular and Nuclear Labeling (Auxiliary Channels)**
7.1 Incubate with Lectin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (e.g., Lycopersicon esculentum lectin–Alexa Fluor 488, 50 µg/mL) in PTwH buffer to label vascular endothelium. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, protected from light)
7.2 Wash 3× with PTwH buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min per wash)
7.3 Incubate with DAPI (4′,6-diamidino-2-phenylindole, 5 µg/mL) in PBS for nuclear labeling. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)
7.4 Wash 3× with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min per wash)

8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

- Channel 2: 561 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 568 (Podocin/NPHS2)
- Channel 3: 638 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 647 (Nephrin/NPHS1)
- Channel 4: 405 nm excitation → DAPI (nuclei)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Tuj1 (β-III Tubulin), Sox10, DAPI, Hoechst]

**Justification:**
iDISCO+ is selected because: (1) It is optimized for whole-mount immunolabeling of embryonic tissues, including E14 mouse embryos, which are relatively small and amenable to organic-solvent-based clearing; (2) The methanol-based delipidation and dibenzyl ether (DBE) RI-matching provide excellent transparency for light-sheet microscopy; (3) iDISCO+ is well-validated for deep antibody penetration in whole embryos, enabling labeling of both central and peripheral nervous system structures; (4) Organic solvent steps are compatible with Alexa Fluor secondary antibodies, which are highly photostable.

**Labeling rationale:**
- **Tuj1 (β-III Tubulin / β-III Tubulin)**: Labels all neurons including early neuronal processes and immature axons — ideal for visualizing early-stage neurites and peripheral nerve fibers at E14.
- **Sox10**: Labels neural crest-derived peripheral glia and Schwann cell precursors, marking more mature peripheral nerve bundles and PNS development.
- **Hoechst**: Nuclear counterstain for whole-embryo registration, anatomical orientation, and co-registration across developmental stages; compatible with iDISCO+ post-clearing staining protocol.
- Secondary antibodies conjugated to **Alexa Fluor** dyes (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488 for Tuj1, Alexa Fluor 647 for Sox10) are used for multi-channel separation.

---

## Protocol Steps

### 1 Post-fixation Preparation
1.1 Collect E14 mouse embryo already fixed in 4% PFA/PBS overnight at 4 °C. Rinse embryo 3 × 10 min in PBS. (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 3 × 10 min)
1.2 Dissect extraembryonic membranes; keep embryo intact. Rinse once more in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min)

---

### 2 Pretreatment / Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation in 100% methanol (×2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
2.6 Bleaching: Incubation in chilled fresh 5% H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 vol 30% H₂O₂ : 5 vol MeOH). (Temperature: 4 °C, Time: 12 hours)
2.7 Rehydration — 80% methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.8 Rehydration — 60% methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.9 Rehydration — 40% methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.10 Rehydration — 20% methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.11 Rehydration — PBS (×2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)
2.12 Permeabilization: Incubation in PBS/0.2% Triton X-100 (PTx.2). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.13 Permeabilization: Incubation in PBS/0.2% Triton X-100 / 20% DMSO / 0.3 M glycine (permeabilization solution). (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours)

---

### 3 Blocking
3.1 Incubation in blocking solution: PBS / 0.2% Triton X-100 / 10% DMSO / 6% normal donkey serum (NDS). (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 24 hours)

---

### 4 Primary Antibody Labeling
4.1 Prepare primary antibody cocktail in PTwH (PBS / 0.2% Tween-20 / 10 µg/mL heparin) + 5% DMSO + 3% NDS:
- Anti-β-III Tubulin (Tuj1) rabbit monoclonal, 1:500
- Anti-Sox10 goat polyclonal, 1:300
4.2 Incubation of embryo in primary antibody cocktail with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 5 days)
4.3 Wash in PTwH (×5 changes, 1 hour each). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)
4.4 Final overnight wash in PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: overnight ~12 hours)

---

### 5 Secondary Antibody Labeling
5.1 Prepare secondary antibody cocktail in PTwH + 3% NDS:
- Donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488, 1:500 (for Tuj1)
- Donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500 (for Sox10)
5.2 Incubation of embryo in secondary antibody cocktail with gentle rocking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 °C, Time: 3 days)
5.3 Wash in PTwH (×5 changes, 1 hour each), protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)
5.4 Final overnight wash in PTwH, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: overnight ~12 hours)

---

### 6 Nuclear Counterstain (Hoechst)
6.1 Incubation in Hoechst 33342 (10 µg/mL in PTwH), protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
6.2 Wash in PTwH (×3 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

---

### 7 Dehydration (Pre-clearing)
7.1 Incubation in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
7.2 Incubation in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
7.3 Incubation in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
7.4 Incubation in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in H₂O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
7.5 Incubation in 100% methanol (×2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)

---

### 8 Delipidation
8.1 Incubation in dichloromethane (DCM) / methanol 2:1 (vol/vol) with gentle agitation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
8.2 Incubation in 100% DCM (×2 changes) to remove residual methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min each)

---

### 9 Refractive Index Matching
9.1 Transfer embryo to dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014) in a glass vial; ensure full submersion, no shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
9.2 Replace with fresh DBE and incubate until embryo is fully transparent (typically overnight). (Temperature: RT, Time: overnight ~12 hours)
9.3 Verify transparency visually; embryo is ready for imaging when fully clear.

---

### 10 Storage / Pre-imaging Preparation
10.1 Store cleared embryo in DBE in sealed glass vial, protected from light, until imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 2 weeks)
10.2 Mount embryo in DBE in a glass-bottom imaging chamber or FEP tube compatible with light-sheet microscope objective (e.g., LSFM with DBE-compatible long-working-distance objective, RI = 1.56).
10.3 Confirm channel assignments prior to acquisition:
- Channel 1: 405 nm excitation → Hoechst (nuclear reference / registration)
- Channel 2: 488 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 488 / Tuj1 (pan-neuronal, early neurites)
- Channel 3: 638 nm excitation → Alexa Fluor 647 / Sox10 (peripheral glia / mature nerve bundles)
10.4 Acquire whole-embryo tile scan with ≥10% overlap for stitching; use step size ≤ 5 µm (Z) for brain and spinal cord regions, ≤ 3 µm for peripheral nerve tracing. (Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)

**Chosen Method:** BoneClear
**Chosen Labeling:** [B220 (PTPRC) + Alexa Fluor 647, F4/80 (小鼠) + Alexa Fluor, DAPI]

**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically designed for decalcification-free optical clearing of intact bone tissue, making it the optimal choice for a ~1 mm mouse parietal bone with intact periosteum and marrow cavity. It employs an EDTA-free, alkaline-based clearing pipeline that preserves both fluorescence signals and bone marrow architecture without demineralization-induced tissue distortion. For dual immunotarget labeling: **B220 (PTPRC/CD45R)** marks pan-B-lineage and broadly serves as a pan-immune cell marker in bone marrow context (combined with CD45 backbone), while **F4/80** specifically labels myeloid-lineage macrophages/monocytes as the myeloid subset marker — both are well-validated for bone marrow immunofluorescence. **DAPI** provides nuclear counterstaining for 3D cytoarchitecture reference. Secondary antibodies conjugated to Alexa Fluor dyes (e.g., Alexa Fluor 647 and Alexa Fluor 555) are chosen for their superior photostability and compatibility with BoneClear's RI-matching medium. The BoneClear pipeline achieves sufficient transparency in compact bone (~1 mm) within a practical timeframe while maintaining antigenicity for post-clearing immunolabeling.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Post-Fixation Wash**
1.1 Wash fixed parietal bone sample (pre-fixed in 4% PFA/PBS) with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 minutes)

**2 Decalcification-Free Pretreatment / Delipidation**
2.1 Incubation in BoneClear Reagent A [10% (wt/vol) N,N,N′,N′-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine (THPED) + 10% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in ddH₂O, pH adjusted to 9.5–10.0 with NaOH] with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Replace with fresh BoneClear Reagent A. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Wash with 1× PBS + 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

**3 Bleaching (Autofluorescence Quenching)**
3.1 Incubation in freshly prepared 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in BoneClear Reagent A to quench bone autofluorescence. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)

**4 Permeabilization and Blocking**
4.1 Incubation in permeabilization/blocking buffer [1× PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) + 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide] with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**5 Primary Antibody Labeling**
5.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail in antibody diluent [1× PBS + 0.5% Triton X-100 + 5% NDS + 0.1% sodium azide]:
- Anti-B220 (PTPRC) rabbit monoclonal antibody, 1:200 dilution (pan-immune/B-lineage marker)
- Anti-F4/80 rat monoclonal antibody, 1:150 dilution (myeloid macrophage/monocyte marker)
With gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
5.2 Wash with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 2 hours)

**6 Secondary Antibody Labeling**
6.1 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail in antibody diluent [1× PBS + 0.5% Triton X-100 + 5% NDS]:
- Donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:400 dilution; for B220 detection)
- Donkey anti-rat Alexa Fluor 555 (1:400 dilution; for F4/80 detection)
Protected from light, with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
6.2 Wash with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS), protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 2 hours)

**7 Nuclear Counterstaining (DAPI)**
7.1 Incubation with DAPI solution [5 μg/mL DAPI in 1× PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100]. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
7.2 Wash with 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 minutes)

**8 Tissue Clearing (Refractive Index Homogenization)**
8.1 Incubation in BoneClear Reagent B [80% (vol/vol) 2,2′-thiodiethanol (TDE) in 1× PBS, RI ≈ 1.46] as initial RI-matching step, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
8.2 Replace with fresh BoneClear Reagent B [80% (vol/vol) TDE in 1× PBS, RI ≈ 1.46] for complete clearing and RI equilibration, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**9 Refractive Index Matching for Light-Sheet Imaging**
9.1 Transfer sample to final imaging medium: BoneClear Reagent C [97% (vol/vol) TDE in 1× PBS, RI ≈ 1.515] to match objective immersion RI, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
9.2 Confirm sample is fully transparent and equilibrated before mounting; replace medium once if cloudiness persists. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 12 additional hours)

**10 Sample Mounting and Imaging Preparation**
10.1 Mount cleared parietal bone in a custom imaging chamber or FEP-tube filled with BoneClear Reagent C (97% TDE/PBS, RI ≈ 1.515); seal to prevent evaporation and bubble formation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
10.2 Image on light-sheet fluorescence microscope (LSFM) equipped with a long-working-distance objective compatible with RI 1.515 immersion medium; use laser lines 405 nm (DAPI), 561 nm (Alexa Fluor 555 / F4/80), and 647 nm (Alexa Fluor 647 / B220) with appropriate emission filters. (Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)

**11 Storage (if imaging is delayed)**
11.1 Store cleared, mounted sample in BoneClear Reagent B (80% TDE/PBS) in sealed container, protected from light. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: up to 2 weeks)

**Chosen Method:** BoneClear
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (凝集素), Osteocalcin + Alexa Fluor, Osx (Osterix) + Alexa Fluor, DAPI]

**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically designed for intact bone tissue, employing a mild EDTA-based decalcification integrated within the clearing workflow to preserve both mineralized matrix architecture and fluorescent signals. Unlike aggressive solvent-based methods (iDISCO+/uDISCO), BoneClear uses an aqueous/detergent-based approach that maintains pre-perfused Lectin vascular labeling and is compatible with immunolabeling of osteocalcin (secreted matrix protein marking mature osteoblast activity) and Osterix/Osx (transcription factor marking osteoblast lineage cells). The dual-target strategy of Osteocalcin + Osx allows simultaneous distinction between secreted bone matrix protein and osteoblast-lineage cells. DAPI provides nuclear counterstain for cellular context. The mild decalcification conditions (low-concentration EDTA at 4 °C) minimize structural disruption to trabecular architecture and preserve the pre-existing Lectin vascular signal. The final RI-matching reagent (SeeDB2-like high-RI aqueous solution or the BoneClear-specific RI matching solution ~1.52) is compatible with light-sheet or confocal imaging of the ~5 mm bone segment.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Post-fixation Wash
1.1 Wash fixed 5 mm femoral metaphysis/diaphysis segment in 1× PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 30 min)

2 Mild Decalcification
2.1 Incubation in 10% (wt/vol) EDTA in PBS (pH 7.4) with gentle rocking to initiate decalcification while preserving fluorescent signals and trabecular microarchitecture. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Replace with fresh 10% (wt/vol) EDTA in PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Replace with fresh 10% (wt/vol) EDTA in PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.4 Assess decalcification endpoint by needle-probe flexibility test; if residual hardness remains, extend one additional 24-hour cycle. Wash in 1× PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 × 20 min)

3 Delipidation / Clearing Pre-treatment
3.1 Incubation in BoneClear Reagent A: 25% (vol/vol) N,N,N′,N′-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine (Quadrol) + 25% (wt/vol) urea in ddH₂O, pH adjusted to 9.0, with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Replace with fresh BoneClear Reagent A solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.3 Wash in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

4.1 Incubation in permeabilization buffer: 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium deoxycholate + 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Wash in 1× PBS + 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

5 Blocking
5.1 Incubation in blocking buffer: 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

6 Primary Antibody Labeling (Osteocalcin + Osterix)
6.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail in blocking buffer: anti-Osteocalcin (rabbit polyclonal, 1:200) + anti-Osterix/Osx (goat polyclonal, 1:200) + 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide in PBST, with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
6.2 Wash in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

7 Secondary Antibody Labeling
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail in blocking buffer: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:400, for Osteocalcin) + donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 555 (1:400, for Osx) in PBST + 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide, protected from light. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
7.2 Wash in PBST, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 1 hour)

8 Nuclear Counterstain (DAPI)
8.1 Incubation with DAPI (5 µg/mL) in 1× PBS, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
8.2 Wash in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

9 Lectin Vascular Signal Verification / Optional Re-staining
9.1 If pre-perfused Lectin signal (e.g., FITC-Lectin or Lectin-488) is present from in vivo perfusion, proceed directly. If signal requires reinforcement, incubate with fluorescently conjugated Lectin (e.g., Lectin-FITC, 50 µg/mL) in 1× PBS + 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20, protected from light. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
9.2 Wash in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 30 min)

10 Tissue Optical Clearing (BoneClear Reagent B)
10.1 Incubation in BoneClear Reagent B1: 20% (wt/vol) sucrose + 20% (wt/vol) urea in ddH₂O (RI ≈ 1.44), protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
10.2 Incubation in BoneClear Reagent B2: 40% (wt/vol) sucrose + 20% (wt/vol) urea in ddH₂O (RI ≈ 1.47), protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
10.3 Incubation in BoneClear Reagent B3: 40% (wt/vol) sucrose + 40% (wt/vol) urea in ddH₂O (RI ≈ 1.49), protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

11 Refractive Index Matching
11.1 Incubation in BoneClear RI-matching solution: 75% (vol/vol) 2,2′-thiodiethanol (TDE) in 1× PBS (RI ≈ 1.515), protected from light, with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
11.2 Replace with fresh 75% (vol/vol) TDE in 1× PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
11.3 Replace with 86% (vol/vol) TDE in 1× PBS (RI ≈ 1.520) for final RI equilibration, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

12 Sample Mounting and Imaging Pre-treatment
12.1 Transfer cleared bone segment into a glass-bottom imaging chamber or FEP tube filled with 86% (vol/vol) TDE in 1× PBS. Orient sample with trabecular region facing objective. Seal chamber to prevent evaporation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min equilibration before imaging)
12.2 Image using light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) or confocal microscopy with appropriate laser lines: 405 nm (DAPI, nuclear), 488 nm (Lectin-FITC, vasculature), 555 nm (Alexa Fluor 555, Osx/osteoblast lineage), 647 nm (Alexa Fluor 647, Osteocalcin/bone matrix protein). Objective: water-dipping or immersion objective with RI correction collar set to 1.52. (Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)

13 Sample Storage (if imaging is delayed)
13.1 Store cleared and RI-matched sample in 86% (vol/vol) TDE in 1× PBS in sealed container, protected from light. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: up to 4 weeks)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** BoneClear
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH (酪氨酸羟化酶) + Alexa Fluor 647, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 568, Lectin + Alexa Fluor 488]

**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically designed for mineralized/hard tissues (bone, teeth) and achieves effective optical clearing of both the hard mineral matrix and embedded soft tissue (pulp) simultaneously through a combination of decalcification, delipidation, and RI matching — making it uniquely suited for an intact adult mouse molar containing both enamel/dentin and pulp. For the dual neural target: PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal marker, labels all pulp nerve fibers) paired with Alexa Fluor 568 provides broad innervation mapping, while TH (tyrosine hydroxylase, sympathetic adrenergic marker) paired with Alexa Fluor 647 distinguishes sympathetic fibers from the total innervation. Lectin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 serves as the vascular reference channel by labeling endothelial glycocalyx/blood vessels. This three-channel strategy (488/568/647) is fully compatible with light-sheet or confocal imaging and avoids spectral overlap. BoneClear's EDTA-based decalcification step is integrated into the clearing pipeline, preserving antigenicity sufficiently for immunolabeling.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

1 Post-fixation Wash
1.1 Wash fixed molar (4% PFA in PBS, already fixed) with 1× PBS three times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min each wash)

2 Decalcification
2.1 Incubation in 10% (wt/vol) EDTA in ddH₂O (pH 7.4), with gentle rocking. Change EDTA solution every 2 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 14 days total, or until tooth is pliable by gentle bending)
2.2 Wash with 1× PBS three times to remove residual EDTA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min each wash)

3 Delipidation / Decolorization (BoneClear Step 1 — Quadrol/H₂O₂ treatment)
3.1 Incubation in BoneClear Solution A: 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N′,N′-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine (Quadrol) in ddH₂O, with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Prepare fresh BoneClear Decolorization Solution: 25% (wt/vol) Quadrol + 3% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in ddH₂O. Incubate with gentle shaking, protected from light. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.3 Wash with 1× PBS three times to remove H₂O₂ and Quadrol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min each wash)

4 Permeabilization and Blocking
4.1 Incubation in Permeabilization Buffer: 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium deoxycholate + 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS (PTwH-based), with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Incubation in Blocking Buffer: 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS) + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide in 1× PBS, with gentle rocking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5 Primary Antibody Labeling
5.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail in Antibody Diluent Buffer (2% NDS + 0.5% Triton X-100 + 0.1% sodium azide in 1× PBS):
— Anti-PGP9.5 (rabbit polyclonal, 1:500; pan-neuronal)
— Anti-TH (mouse monoclonal, 1:400; sympathetic marker)
With gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
5.2 Wash with PTwH (1× PBS + 0.2% Tween-20 + 10 µg/mL heparin), 5 washes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each wash)

6 Secondary Antibody and Lectin Labeling
6.1 Incubation with secondary antibody + lectin cocktail in Antibody Diluent Buffer:
— Donkey anti-rabbit IgG–Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500; labels PGP9.5 → pan-neuronal channel)
— Donkey anti-mouse IgG–Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500; labels TH → sympathetic channel)
— Lectin–Alexa Fluor 488 (e.g., Lycopersicon esculentum lectin, 50 µg/mL; vascular channel)
Protected from light, with gentle rocking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
6.2 Wash with PTwH, 5 washes, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each wash)
6.3 Post-fixation with 4% (wt/vol) PFA in 1× PBS to stabilize antibody–antigen complexes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
6.4 Wash with 1× PBS three times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min each wash)

7 Refractive Index (RI) Matching — BoneClear Solution B
7.1 Incubation in BoneClear RI Matching Solution Step 1: 25% (wt/vol) Quadrol + 50% (wt/vol) iohexol (Omnipaque 350) in ddH₂O (RI ≈ 1.46), protected from light, with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
7.2 Incubation in BoneClear RI Matching Solution Step 2: 25% (wt/vol) Quadrol + 75% (wt/vol) iohexol in ddH₂O (RI ≈ 1.52), protected from light, with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
7.3 Verify tissue transparency visually; if not fully transparent, extend Step 7.2 by an additional 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: up to 24 hours additional)

8 Mounting and Imaging Preparation
8.1 Transfer cleared tooth into a custom imaging chamber (e.g., FEP tube or glass-bottom dish) filled with BoneClear RI Matching Solution Step 2 (RI ≈ 1.52) to prevent dehydration and maintain RI matching. Seal chamber to avoid evaporation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour equilibration before imaging)
8.2 Image using light-sheet fluorescence microscopy (LSFM) or confocal microscopy with appropriate objectives (RI-corrected, long working distance, e.g., 10× or 25× water/glycerol-immersion objective). Acquisition channels: 488 nm (Lectin–AF488, vasculature), 561 nm (PGP9.5–AF568, pan-neuronal), 633/647 nm (TH–AF647, sympathetic). (Temperature: RT)

9 Storage
9.1 Store cleared, labeled tooth in BoneClear RI Matching Solution Step 2 in a sealed container, protected from light. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: up to 4 weeks)

**Chosen Method:** EyeCi
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin + Alexa Fluor (血管标记), Anti-Brn3a(POU4F1) + Alexa Fluor, Anti-Brn3b(POU4F2) + Alexa Fluor, DAPI]

**Justification:** EyeCi 是专为眼球组织（包括含色素的眼内结构）设计的光学透明方案，针对眼球特有的色素（RPE黑色素、虹膜色素）和高脂质含量进行了优化，能有效去除自发荧光背景，同时保留抗原性和荧光信号。相比 iDISCO+ 等有机溶剂法，EyeCi 采用水性/温和去垢剂体系，对视网膜层状结构破坏更小，适合摘除角膜后的成年小鼠眼球整体透明。标记策略：① Lectin（凝集素，如 Lectin-Alexa Fluor 488）灌注或浸泡标记视网膜血管（内皮细胞特异性结合）；② 两种 Brn3/POU4F 家族转录因子——Brn3a（POU4F1）和 Brn3b（POU4F2）——作为视网膜神经节细胞（RGC）的双重身份验证标志物，分别用不同波长 Alexa Fluor 二抗标记（如 Alexa Fluor 555 和 Alexa Fluor 647）；③ DAPI 用于细胞核定位与层次识别。该组合实现三通道同时成像，满足"两种 Brn3/POU4F 家族相关靶点"的严格要求。

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 样本前处理（角膜摘除与初步固定）**
1.1 将已灌注 4% PFA（in PBS，pH 7.4）固定的成年小鼠眼球置于冰上，用显微剪沿角膜缘环形切除角膜，保留完整眼杯（含视网膜、RPE、脉络膜、巩膜）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 10 min)
1.2 将眼杯置于新鲜 4% PFA（in PBS，pH 7.4）中进行后固定。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 用 1× PBS 洗涤眼杯，去除残余固定液，共洗涤 3 次，每次 10 min。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min total)

**2 色素脱除与漂白（EyeCi 核心步骤）**
2.1 将眼杯置于 EyeCi 漂白液（含 25% N,N,N′,N′-四(2-羟丙基)乙二胺（Quadrol）、0.1% Triton X-100 in ddH₂O，pH 9.0）中，于 37 ℃ 振荡孵育，以去除黑色素色素并降低自发荧光背景。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.2 用 1× PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100（PBST）洗涤，共 4 次，每次 30 min，去除漂白液残留。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)
2.3 目视检查眼杯色素去除情况；若色素残留明显，可在 EyeCi 漂白液中延长孵育 12–24 h，再重复 2.2 洗涤步骤。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: up to 24 hours additional if needed)

**3 通透化处理**
3.1 将眼杯置于通透化液（1× PBS + 0.5% Triton X-100 + 0.1% Tween-20 + 0.1% 脱氧胆酸钠）中振荡孵育，增强后续抗体渗透。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 用 PBST（1× PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100）洗涤 3 次，每次 20 min。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour total)

**4 封闭处理**
4.1 将眼杯置于封闭液（1× PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 + 5% 正常驴血清（NDS）+ 0.3 M 甘氨酸）中振荡孵育，以减少非特异性抗体结合。(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

**5 Lectin 血管标记（一抗/直接标记步骤）**
5.1 将眼杯置于含 Lectin-Alexa Fluor 488（如 Griffonia simplicifolia Lectin I，BS-I，10 µg/mL，in PBST + 1% NDS）的标记液中振荡孵育，直接标记视网膜血管内皮细胞。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
5.2 用 PBST 洗涤 4 次，每次 30 min，去除未结合的 Lectin。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours total)

**6 一抗孵育（Brn3a 和 Brn3b 双标记）**
6.1 将眼杯置于一抗混合液中振荡孵育：
- 兔抗 Brn3a（POU4F1）抗体，1:200 稀释
- 山羊抗 Brn3b（POU4F2）抗体，1:200 稀释
- 稀释液：PBST + 2% NDS + 0.1% 叠氮化钠
(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5 days)
6.2 用 PBST 洗涤 5 次，每次 1 hour，充分去除未结合一抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours total)

**7 二抗孵育（荧光标记）**
7.1 将眼杯置于二抗混合液中振荡孵育（避光）：
- 驴抗兔 IgG-Alexa Fluor 555，1:400 稀释（对应 Brn3a 信号）
- 驴抗山羊 IgG-Alexa Fluor 647，1:400 稀释（对应 Brn3b 信号）
- 稀释液：PBST + 2% NDS
(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 days)
7.2 用 PBST 洗涤 5 次，每次 1 hour，充分去除未结合二抗。(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours total)

**8 DAPI 核染色**
8.1 将眼杯置于 DAPI 工作液（2 µg/mL DAPI in 1× PBS）中振荡孵育（避光）。(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
8.2 用 1× PBS 洗涤 3 次，每次 20 min。(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour total)

**9 组织透明化（EyeCi 透明步骤）**
9.1 将眼杯置于 EyeCi 透明液 A（含 25% Quadrol + 15% 尿素 in ddH₂O，pH 8.5）中振荡孵育，启动脂质去除与折射率均一化。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
9.2 将眼杯转移至 EyeCi 透明液 B（含 25% Quadrol + 25% 尿素 in ddH₂O，pH 8.5）中振荡孵育，进一步透明化。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
9.3 目视检查透明度；若透明度不足，可在透明液 B 中延长孵育至透明（通常眼杯可在 48–72 h 内达到良好透明度）。(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: up to 24 hours additional if needed)

**10 折射率匹配（RI Matching）**
10.1 将透明后的眼杯置于 EyeCi RI 匹配液（含 40% 2,2′-硫代二乙醇（TDE）in 1× PBS，RI ≈ 1.46）中振荡平衡，初步 RI 匹配。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
10.2 将眼杯转移至 EyeCi 最终 RI 匹配液（含 63% TDE in 1× PBS，RI ≈ 1.49）中振荡平衡，达到与光片显微镜或共聚焦物镜浸没介质匹配的折射率。(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
10.3 将眼杯转移至新鲜 63% TDE in 1× PBS 中，静置平衡，确保 RI 均一。(Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

**11 样本保存与成像前处理**
11.1 将 RI 匹配后的眼杯转移至成像腔室（如玻璃底培养皿或定制样本槽），用 63% TDE in 1× PBS 填充腔室，避免气泡，避光密封保存。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 保存至成像，最长 2 weeks)
11.2 成像前将样本恢复至室温，检查样本透明度和荧光信号完整性；使用折射率匹配物镜（RI = 1.45–1.52，如 Zeiss W Plan-Apochromat 20×/1.0 或 Olympus XLPLN25XWMP2）进行光片显微镜或共聚焦成像。(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min equilibration before imaging)
11.3 成像通道建议：CH1: DAPI（405 nm 激发，核定位）；CH2: Alexa Fluor 488（488 nm 激发，Lectin 血管）；CH3: Alexa Fluor 555（561 nm 激发，Brn3a/POU4F1，RGC 标志物1）；CH4: Alexa Fluor 647（638 nm 激发，Brn3b/POU4F2，RGC 标志物2）。(Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)

**Chosen Method:** Ce3D

**Chosen Labeling:** [CD8 + Alexa Fluor 647, CD3 + Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]

**Justification:** Ce3D (Clearing-Enhanced 3D) is an aqueous-based clearing method that preserves antigenicity and fluorescence exceptionally well, making it ideal for immunofluorescence on human tissue. It uses N-methylacetamide and Histodenz to achieve high RI matching (~1.49) without organic solvents, thus avoiding quenching of Alexa Fluor dyes. Critically, Ce3D incorporates a melanin-bleaching step (H₂O₂) that effectively reduces the high pigment background characteristic of human skin, which is essential here. The small tissue size (2×2×1 mm³) means full penetration is achievable within the Ce3D workflow. For the dual-target immunofluorescence strategy: **CD8** (anti-human CD8, conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647) identifies cytotoxic T cells specifically, while **CD3** (anti-human CD3, conjugated to Alexa Fluor 555) marks the total T cell population — together they allow 3D discrimination of CD3+CD8+ cytotoxic T cells versus CD3+CD8− T helper cells at the epidermal/dermal junction. **DAPI** provides nuclear counterstaining to delineate tissue architecture (epidermis vs. dermis boundary). Alexa Fluor dyes are highly photostable, bright, and fully compatible with Ce3D's aqueous RI medium, suitable for confocal or light-sheet imaging.

---

**Protocol Steps:**

**1 Fixation**
1.1 Immerse freshly excised 2×2×1 mm³ human skin tissue in 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Wash tissue 3× with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes each wash)

**2 Melanin Bleaching (Depigmentation)**
2.1 Incubate tissue in freshly prepared 25% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in PBS to bleach melanin pigment. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Wash tissue 3× with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes each wash)
2.3 Visually confirm reduction of brown/black pigmentation; if pigmentation persists, repeat step 2.1 for an additional 12 hours.

**3 Permeabilization and Blocking**
3.1 Incubate tissue in permeabilization/blocking buffer: PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum (NDS), and 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

**4 Primary Antibody Labeling**
4.1 Incubate tissue with primary antibody cocktail in antibody diluent buffer (PBS + 0.5% Triton X-100 + 5% NDS + 0.1% sodium azide):
- Anti-human CD3 rabbit monoclonal antibody (clone SP7 or equivalent), 1:200 dilution
- Anti-human CD8 mouse monoclonal antibody (clone C8/144B or equivalent), 1:200 dilution
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
4.2 Wash tissue 5× with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes each wash)

**5 Secondary Antibody Labeling**
5.1 Incubate tissue with secondary antibody cocktail in antibody diluent buffer (PBS + 0.5% Triton X-100 + 5% NDS):
- Donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 555, 1:500 dilution (labels CD3)
- Donkey anti-mouse IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500 dilution (labels CD8)
(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
5.2 Wash tissue 5× with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes each wash)

**6 Nuclear Counterstaining**
6.1 Incubate tissue in DAPI solution at 5 µg/mL in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
6.2 Wash tissue 3× with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes each wash)

**7 Ce3D Clearing**
7.1 Prepare Ce3D clearing solution: 40% (wt/vol) N-methylacetamide (NMA) + 86% (wt/vol) Histodenz in PBS, supplemented with 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 0.5% (vol/vol) 1-thioglycerol (to protect fluorophores). Final RI ≈ 1.49. Filter through 0.22 µm membrane before use.
7.2 Incubate tissue in Ce3D clearing solution (first incubation, ~50% volume of final solution diluted 1:1 with PBS as a pre-equilibration step). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
7.3 Transfer tissue to full-concentration Ce3D clearing solution (undiluted). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
7.4 Replace with fresh full-concentration Ce3D clearing solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
7.5 Visually confirm tissue transparency. If not fully cleared, continue incubation in fresh Ce3D solution for an additional 12–24 hours.

**8 Refractive Index Matching**
8.1 Transfer cleared tissue into fresh Ce3D solution (RI ≈ 1.49) in a glass-bottom imaging dish or custom imaging chamber. Ensure tissue is fully submerged and no air bubbles are present. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours equilibration before imaging)
8.2 Seal the imaging chamber with a coverslip using silicone grease to prevent evaporation and maintain RI stability.

**9 Storage Prior to Imaging**
9.1 If imaging is not performed immediately, store tissue in Ce3D solution in a sealed container protected from light. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: up to 2 weeks)
9.2 Before imaging, allow tissue to re-equilibrate to RT. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

**10 Imaging**
10.1 Image using confocal microscope (or light-sheet microscope with RI-matched immersion objective, NA ≥ 0.8, water/glycerol immersion objective matched to RI 1.49) with the following channel assignments:
- DAPI: Ex 405 nm / Em 410–480 nm (nuclear architecture, epidermal/dermal boundary)
- Alexa Fluor 555 (CD3): Ex 555 nm / Em 565–620 nm (total T cells)
- Alexa Fluor 647 (CD8): Ex 647 nm / Em 660–720 nm (cytotoxic T cells)
10.2 Acquire z-stack spanning the full 1 mm depth with z-step ≤ 3 µm to resolve individual cells at the epidermal/dermal junction. (Temperature: RT, Time: per imaging session)
